reviews.review_title: I Tried Almost Every Webcam. This Is the One I Kept.
reviews.review_description:
I’ve gone through way too many webcams over the years. I’m on video calls for a good portion of my workday, so I’ve always been picky about how the camera looks and performs. This is the first one I’ve used where I’ve basically stopped looking for something better.

It did take me a little while to get everything adjusted exactly how I wanted it. Don’t expect to plug it in, spend five minutes with the settings and be done. Once I got it dialed in though, it’s been excellent.

The PTZ is probably my favorite feature. The tracking is smooth, but the presets are what I use all the time. I have a fish tank in my office and saved its location as a preset. If I want to show someone the tank during a call, I hit one button and the camera turns right to it. You can even map it to a key on your keyboard. One click, boom, fish tank. Another click and it comes right back to me. Completely unnecessary for most meetings, but I love it.

The magnetic mount is also MUCH stronger than I expected. Once it’s on my monitor, it’s not moving. I also really like that when the camera isn’t being used, it physically points itself down for privacy. I’m sitting in front of this thing all day, so being able to look at it and know the lens isn’t facing me is a nice touch.

***ONE TIP*** If you're like me on video calls all day and you cant get your "camera" to look right. Before you blame the webcam, Fix your Lighting. Here's my advice on lighting as I spent way too much time adjusting exposure, brightness and other camera settings when the real problem was my room.

The biggest improvement came from putting a light behind the webcam, facing me, rather than relying on overhead lighting.

For the most natural look, place the light slightly above eye level and about 30–45 degrees to either side of the camera. This lights your face without making it look flat or creating harsh shadows. If one side of your face still looks dark, add a much softer light on the opposite side.

Also pay attention to what's behind you. A bright window or lamp in the background forces the camera to compensate and can make your face look dark. Either close the blinds, move the light source, or add more light in front of you.

And avoid relying on ceiling lights. They tend to light the top of your head while creating shadows around your eyes.

Once I got the lighting right, I actually needed to do less tweaking inside the Insta360 software. The camera was never the problem. My lighting was.

It’s not the cheapest webcam and there’s definitely more to play around with than a basic webcam. But if you’re on video calls constantly like I am, this is the one I’d buy again. After trying more webcams than I care to admit, I finally stopped looking.

reviews.review_description:
Got this to paint warhammer minis. Works great. The upside is now I can see every tiny detail and every little flaw. The downside is that now I can see every little detail and every little flaw.

Securely clamps to my table. Arm is easily adjustable and stays where you put it. Light is bright, and the shape means you get good coverage.

I have used a halogen architect light at my jigsaw puzzle for years, but the plastic post that fits into the table clamp decided to break. So I looked for a replacement and decided to give this one a try. I think that it almost is perfect.

I like the fact that the post that fits into the table clamp is metal instead of plastic, so I shouldn't have the problem that killed the last light. The arms and spring assemblies are very well designed and the light stays in whatever position I put it in without a problem. The light head moves independently of the arm, increasing the flexibility of proper aiming of the light. And you don't have to turn screws or clamps or anything to make it stay in place. You can use one hand to quickly adjust it into whatever position you want. You can click the on/off switch slowly (once a second or so) to change the light levels, and there are 5 levels instead of the prior light's two levels.

So that's all of the good stuff, which is impressive.

The main thing that I think would make this light even better is that like other LED lights it is what I consider to be a somewhat harsh bright white light. It would be nice if there was some way to control the light temperature to make it less white and more yellow, if desired. Sure, the light color is perfect some of the time (and I suspect perfect for architects). But sometimes I wish I could soften the color a bit so that it would be easier on my eyes. The other thing is that the advertisements and product description that came with the light said that it "remembers" the prior light setting when you turn it off and returns to it when you turn it back on. But there was nothing in the documentation that I remember reading (I only quickly read it once) that described how to make this "memory" happen. So every time I turned off the light I click-click-clicked through all of the various light levels, and when I turned it back on it came back at full strength. One time when I was in a hurry, I pressed the on/off button quickly, thinking that I could get through the turn off process quickly. But I found that two quick presses of the on/off button is the process that turns off the light and saves the last illumination level. It would be nice to have read that in the documentation.

Now you know that trick too.

So if you are looking for a very flexible, sturdy light, and don't mind the light temperature that this one uses, I would highly recommend this one to you.

reviews.review_title: Recommended. Could be improved but good as is.
reviews.review_description:
TL;DR: Recommended but could be improved.

I'm using this lamp in my living room to illuminate a bluetooth keyboard in the evening.

The gooseneck keeps the lamp where I put it and feels like it's well made and will last.

The lamp has 3 color settings - white, amber and off-white(?). I'm not sure why they choose off-white rather than red, which is useful when you don't want to compromise your night vision any more than you have to.

The lamp seems to be quite efficient; I've been running it on an old no-name (and over-rated IMHO) 30,000 mA USB power bank for about 12 hours, and I've got 87% of the battery left.

It's wide enough to illuminate a full-size keyboard, but the LED strip is designed so it's easy to keep glare off the screen. I've got two power banks, neither of which start when the lamp is plugged in; you must push the button on the power bank to turn on the output. This is because the lamp (and other devices) don't draw enough current when the lamp is off for the power bank to notice it's connected! As a result, if I turn the lamp off (such that the lamp's blue standby light comes on) the power bank thinks nothing is connected and shuts down after a few seconds (and thus losing my dimmer adjustments).

The lamp has a wide illumination range; it gets quite bright, and dims to a very low level, such that I can keep it on when I'm not using it and it isn't distracting. This is important because WHEN HE LAMP LOSES POWER IT FORGETS HOW MUCH I've DIMMED IT (for which I have deducted a star). To compensate for this, when I turn the light on for the evening I set the default (white) light to the level I need to view my keyboard; I set the other two colors to the lowest level. When I want to take a break and watch TV for a bit, I select the amber color and I can dim the light is enough that I don't notice it. Then when I want to type some more I switch to the white color and I'm in business.

I have one other nit: The lamp's gooseneck threads onto the top of a stiff upright tube, which screws into the desk mount. This tube is long enough that I can barely position the lamp perfectly (due in part to my setup - others may not find it too long). This could be solved by shipping a 2nd tube about half the length of the current tube. This way I could use the short tube and it would give the gooseneck more 'reach'. Some may find it useful to use both tubes for added height.

reviews.review_title: Just what I was looking for!
reviews.review_description:
I'll be honest. I was looking for something in my local brick and mortar stores. Target, Walmart, Home Depot, Lowes... every place let me down because they all had the same unimaginative junk. And certainly not in store so I can just go get it. I have a pretty deep computer desk with dual 27" monitors on moving arms. I also have a separate soldering table. I wanted good, shadow free illumination on both and nobody had anything that would work. Lo and behold, I stumble across this on Amazon. I love when someone has a good idea and turns it into a great product.

Unboxing is just ridiculously easy. There is no building. All you have to do is screw clamp it to your surface and plug it in. It seems it'll fit a pretty thick surface too. 1 1/8" (almost 3cm) thick shelf stock for a desk and it has enough space for another inch or so. No flickering that I can see. It's clean smooth light. The color temperature options are plentiful and you can cycle through presets of both temp and brightness or do a smooth transition to what you want. The side panels are separately turned on and off (together) and can fold down 90° (if you really wanted to) or all the way up to upside down on top of the main lamp. It's all folded together in the box, so just unfold and use.

Only real issue is there's no telescoping function. So if you have a small desk and want it mounted at the back AND close to your surface, you might have to get creative.

The auto brightness is interesting... it gets brighter when the ambient light goes down. I expected the opposite. But maybe this makes sense. I prefer manual control anyway.

Overall, very great product for anyone working at a desk, writing, making, what have you. I love this thing already. There's a really good video review that will show you all you need to know. I bought two right then and there (for both tables) and I do not regret my decision at all.

This is a fun-to-use desk lamp with a clamp. It doesn't have the stability of a lamp with two side-by-side arms, however, when I type, it only wobbles a little. I've gotten used to it, so it isn't really a distraction.

My favorite part of the lamp is the side arms that swing up or down, depending on where you want to put the light. For more focus on your desk; swing down. To illuminate the ceiling, or the entire room, swing up. You can control the brightness or illumination of each type of element, so that the arms that are pointed up can have light, while the ones pointed down can be dimmed or turned off altogether to prevent glare. The brightness starts as very dim and goes all of the way up to very bright (with some glare), and many steps in between. Nice!

All in all, I've had this lamp for over a month now, and haven't noticed any defects or bad design, except for the slight wobble. It's great if you like to have a room for computer use while having the ability to light the whole room without glare. That's why I give it a '5'.

This is hands-down the best lamp I’ve ever owned. The Micomlan LED Desk Lamp with Clamp is incredibly bright, versatile, and perfect for any workspace. The adjustable arm and multiple lighting modes make it easy to dial in the exact lighting you need—whether it’s for studying, working, or detailed tasks.

The clamp is strong and secure, and the lamp feels solid and well-built without being bulky. I love how wide the lighting coverage is; it easily lights up my entire desk without glare or shadows. The settings for brightness and color temperature are a huge bonus and make it super customizable.

Setup took just a minute, and once it’s in place, it stays exactly where you put it. For the price, the quality is unmatched. This lamp instantly upgraded my desk setup, and I honestly wish I had bought it sooner.

Highly recommend—best lamp I’ve had!

reviews.review_title: Simple lamp with a great selection of colors.
reviews.review_description:
I see a lot of confusion about this product. The directions aren’t very descriptive, .

1. This product does have different color lights . 2. You can turn the color cycling off so that it stays on whatever color you desire. 3. You are able to adjust the brightness, there are three levels

The thing to keep in mind is you navigate this one button device with the timing of your button presses. A long 3 second tap will turn it on and off. The default when you turn it on is the white color. The white is not too cool, nor too warm. You can adjust the brightness and at the highest level it is plenty bright if you need to find something in the room. I don’t think it will adequately light a large dark room on its own. But you can read using this light if you are within a few feet of the lamp (for most people).

. If you want to change to the color setting, then a quick one second tap after the device is turned on. At this point, you will be on the color cycling mode. if you do nothing, the device will cycle through various shades of green, blue, red, yellow, etc. For example, you will see a turquoise blue, a cornflower blue, a hot pink, a pale green, etc. If you want to select a particular color, wait until it cycles to the color you like, and use a one second tap to select. This will pause it on the color that was lit when you tapped the button.

If you want to turn the device off, just press the button for three seconds. You will have to repeat the process every time you turn the device on, It isn’t very resource-intensive so I wouldn’t let that deter you unless you are picky and this is a dealbreaker. I’m sure more expensive units have more robust memories, settings, and remote controls with more than one button to navigate.

Only two items come in the box, the lamp (which is roughly 7” tall, and 4” wide at the base) and the power cord (which is not infuriatingly short) so setup is easy.. There’s no charging or batteries required.

So far I like it and plan to keep it. I have insomnia, and read about light therapy. When I’m ready to sleep, I plan to change the color to an Amber/orangey/pink color to mimic the sunset to tell my body it’s time to get tired and go to sleep.

I just received it, so cannot speak to longevity. I always come back and edit reviews if anything changes. If it stops working, I’ll update with a date so you’ll know how long mine lasted.

Hope this helps!

I wanted to amend this review to specify that the color portion of this lamp is not dimmable. This may present an issue if someone is trying to use a color To fall asleep as I mentioned I was using this for. I agree that the lamp is very bright for colors. reviews.review_title: This lamp has a secret feature (a glowing review)
reviews.review_description:
This lamp was purchased on 12/6/2025 for $18.99. The quality is more than adequate, but the lamp is very lightweight and definitely not what I would consider a premium product, however it looks good and functions well for the price that I paid. On the lamp that I received which is the model with a cord (not rechargeable) I can touch and hold the top control panel when the lamp is off, and it will come on in an ultra low mode which I absolutely love! Other than that if you were just to tap the top when the lamp is off there there are 3 brightness levels to cycle through with each tap: Low, Medium and High. The light that emits from this lamp is soft, the color temperature is pleasant and leans warm which for me is a great thing. To get to the colored mode you must press and hold on the top of the lamp while the white light is on and then tap the top to start/stop it from slowly cycling through the spectrum of colors, ie once it lands on your favorite color give the top panel a tap and it will freeze there on that color. The lamp also remembers that color too so the next time you enter color mode by holding down on the top panel it will come on directly to that last color which was used. I wish the brightness could be controlled when in the color mode but it cannot. I would guess that the brightness when in color mode is factory set to be somewhere around Medium and is not dimmable or adjustable in any way when in color mode which could obviously appear brighter to your eye depending on which color you have landed on or that the lamp is currently cycling through (if you just leave it continually and slowly flowing from one color to the next in a mostly smooth and seamless fashion). So far this is a nice, cheap and attractive bedside lamp.

3. There is enough vertical adjustment to clear the top of large monitors.

5. The power supply transformer plugs into a standard 120 VAC outlet. The cord is over 6 feet long so placement is not an issue.

7. The light diffusion is quite uniform and has a wide dispersion angle. I originally was looking for a unit with a light bar ("wings") but this has proven completely adequate.

I hope that it lasts for quite a while. The manufacturer states that there is an 18-month waranty but that is hard to count on with Chinese manufacturers. Really happy with this lamp, especially for the price.

There are many similar monitor lights out there, some cheaper and going as low as ~$25 and some obviously more expensive. Whether or not, or how close a copy to the BenQ the Quntis is I don't know for sure, as I've never seen the alternatives, but I can say this one is very well designed and well constructed, some plastic and also some metal in the construction and on close inspection the quality is definitely there. The mounting system is simple and functional and adapted perfectly to my HP Omen gaming monitor, which I would say has a somewhat non-standard profile shape and thickness, at least at the top where the light mounts. No problem, the mount is easily adjustable and rests perfectly and securely on my top monitor edge with full confidence that it's not going anywhere, or is any way unstable or wonky.

The light controls on top of the light are easily accessible, operated by touch and the tactile "buttons" are shaped so they can be easily felt when operating the light. There are stepless controls for brightness and color temperature, as well as a sort of "auto" button that adjusts the brightness based on the ambient light in the room, which is nice. The lightbar throws a very nice pool of light on your keyboard and desk space in front of, and not directly ON, your monitor - right where you need it - without any glare, or being too harsh. Again, the quality, brightness and temperature of the light is easily adjustable to your liking.

The monitor mounting system is sensible, simple, highly adjustable and highly functional. Lamp is powered by USB and in my case plugs right into a USB port on my monitor and totally invisible, hidden behind. Anyway, I guess I might have got a little carried away with this review, but tldr; the Quntis is an excellent monitor light and if this is something you've been looking at, I don't think you can go wrong with this one.

I got this lamp to use on a grand piano at church. The arm reaches across reasonably well from the side (though it doesn’t extend far enough to be fully centered over the music desk). The multiple color temperatures and brightness levels are very helpful for accommodating the preferences of various users, and all our pianists seem to like it.

It works smoothly and perfectly... in most keys.

BUT if you like to play in D-flat, beware! I just discovered that the resonance point of the casing appears to be a D-flat (138.591 Hz). The plastic started buzzing quietly when playing strong tonic chords in that key. This was, of course, horrifying.

I assume the same disturbing outcome holds true when playing in C-sharp major, since the identical notes are used, but I only had sheet music in D-flat today. More testing would be needed to determine whether the issue extends to enharmonic keys, but this didn’t seem urgent to share here, since:

• I didn’t want to go into too much detail that isn’t relevant to the average consumer (because we all hate that), and

• Only psychos play in C-sharp major anyway.

I realize this acoustic phenomenon may not affect all potential buyers of this lamp, but it seems like this particular harmonic bug could be mentioned somewhere in the description—if not in the product title itself—just so that members of the five-flats-loving community have some warning.

Oh, also, the buzzing stopped as soon as I moved the arm slightly, so there’s that.

TLDR: Solid build, good light quality, useful brightness and color controls, and a swing arm that does most of what you want. The big catch is that it does not behave the way modern smart home users will expect, and the mounting geometry has some real-world limits the listing photos do not show. Four stars, with caveats worth knowing before you click buy.

Let me lead with the good, because there is plenty of it.

The light itself is genuinely nice. Plenty of brightness for working, reading, or close-up tasks, and the color temperature options give you warm yellow, neutral white, and a cooler white-blue depending on what you are doing. Eleven brightness levels is more granularity than I expected. The arm extends and folds well, and the head pivots to put light right where you want it. It runs on USB, the wall adapter is included, and the wattage is low enough that you can power it from a laptop port if that is convenient. The clamp mount is solid and holds tight once you have it in place.

A note on installation. The clamp wants a specific amount of mounting surface, and my location had less than the lamp wanted in one direction. I pulled out a Dremel and shaved a small relief into the underside so the clamp could sit properly. Not a complaint, just a heads up if your desk has a thick lip, a beveled edge, or a rounded corner where you want this to live.

Now, the big thing.

This lamp does not default to on when power is restored. If you turn it off and walk away, fine. If your power blips, or if you have it on a smart switch that cuts power, the lamp comes back off. To turn it back on you have to walk over to the lamp and press the little button on the inline cord controller, which sits close to the base of the arm and is not always easy to reach.

This matters because the listing advertises a memory function, and modern buyers, especially anyone with a smart home setup, are going to read that and assume something it does not actually mean. Here is what is happening. The memory function does work, in a narrow sense. When you press the on button, the lamp comes back at whatever brightness and color mode you used last. It does not have to be reset every time. That is real and it is useful.

What the memory function does not do is preserve the on/off state across a power cut. The reason is that this is a soft-touch push button rather than a mechanical switch. The lamp's electronics have to be powered to know they are on, and when power is removed and restored the default state is off. A traditional mechanical switch physically holds the circuit closed and is why your bedroom lamp comes back on when the power flickers. This one does not, by design.

If you live in a fully manual lighting world, this is a non-issue. You will press the button and life goes on. If you have your office lights on a smart switch, or you have ever said the words "Google (or Alexa), turn on the lights," this is going to be an ongoing minor annoyance. I had assumed, like most lights, that I could plug this into the same smart switch as the rest of the room and have it come on with everything else. Instead it sits there dark while everything else lights up, waiting for me to walk over and poke it.

The other thing worth flagging is the arm geometry. The first segment, the one closest to the clamp, is not designed to swing forward. It folds up and back, which is fine on an open desk where you have empty wall behind you. If you are mounting this on the back edge of a desk that sits against a wall, on the lip of a hutch, on top of a shelving unit, or inside a cubicle, you are going to discover that the elbow needs room to bow outward behind the lamp. The listing photos all show the lamp on an open desk with nothing behind it, so this is not obvious until you have it in hand. Plan your mounting location with that in mind.

There is also a 45 minute auto-off timer button on the controller. Apparently aimed at bedtime reading. I have not used it but it is there if you want it.

Four stars. The light is good and the build is good. The memory function exists but means something different than a smart home buyer will assume, and the mounting flexibility has limits that the listing does not show. If you can live with those, this is a nice lamp at a fair price. If you were hoping to drop it into an automated lighting routine, you are going to want to know about the default-off behavior before you order.

reviews.review_title: Function Over Fashion, and I'm Fine With That
reviews.review_description:
When this lamp arrived, my first thought was that it looked like something borrowed from a dentist's office, an architect's desk, or possibly a low-budget science fiction movie.

My wife immediately clamped it onto her pottery worktable and declared it perfect.

As it turns out, she was right. The adjustable arms make it easy to position the light exactly where it's needed, and it does an excellent job of filling in the shadows on cloudy days or late afternoons when natural light isn't cooperating. The light is bright, even, and makes it easier to see texture, details, and surface work without constantly repositioning pieces.

It's not the most conventional-looking lamp I've ever seen, but after watching it in use for a while, I stopped noticing how it looked and started appreciating how well it worked. In the pottery studio, that's about as high a compliment as a tool can get.

I have searched for and bought so many different kinds of lights for my sewing machine station. None of them have been satisfactory until this light. There are two important properties I need. Brightness and flexibility. First Brightness: I am 80 and need a lot of light where the needle is stitching. Yes there is a sewing machine light that turns on when the machine is running but even though it gets hot enough to burn skin, it is frustratingly dim. This desk light has 4 color temperature settings from warm to cold controlled by one button and 4 brightness levels controlled by another button so 16 different choices in all. These are regulated by lightly touched buttons on the lowest arm and the highest brightness out shines any other light I have tried. AND there is no flicker like many LEDs. So many lights have claimed amazing brightness only to be completely useless. Flexibility: A sewing machine is a very challenging lighting problem since the needle (where the work is happening) is hidden under the mass of the machine. The light has to be mounted on the right side of the machine so it doesn't block the movement of fabric. The right side of the machine is also solid and won't let any light pass through! Ideally it has to be located between the sewer and the machine so the sewer does not throw a shadow. This desk light offers EXTREME flexibility with 4 joints which all articulate in multiple ways but once the arms are set where I want the angles do not slip. The light might look very awkward in its placement on my table (and please excuse the mess!) but the outermost arm is throwing light exactly where I need it. The fabric can easily move underneath it. The other two arms are lighting up the overall table nicely. It is very well made and the clamp keeps the light steady even with such a long reach. I love this light.

reviews.review_title: good lamp with decent features but auto dim questionable
reviews.review_description: good size for small spaces, various types of light color and dimming option with a USBA charger -- sturdy and not likely to tip over with a small platform base that will allow for small items to rest on it as well. As a treat to myself I did a work desk refresh and did a purple desk haul. Getting all the same shade of purple is a challenge, but I am picky about what I want out of a desk lamp. I like that this desk lamp has a small footprint and can be placed off to the side, out of the way, but then using the gooseneck the light can be brought in where it is needed. I also like that it is quite bright and can be dimmed from low light to full output. The light color itself can be adjusted between 3 levels, warm, cool or a mix of warm and cool. I personally prefer the white cool light as it seems like a better color for a work light. I don’t use the ambient sensor function so can’t comment. The base is heavy and holds the lamp without tipping even when the gooseneck is cantilevered far out. There is a light diffuser on the end of the lamp shade which can be removed if you want the full blast harsh light, which may be more useful in some situations. There is a usb charger port. Also the range of lowest light to highest light is not very wide. Nevertheless, at this price point there isn’t much to complain about. This is a nice bright lamp with more functionality than one would expect at such a low price and seems well made. It is recommended.

reviews.review_title: Don't use your TV while using this lamp...
reviews.review_description:
I've had the lamp for a month now, and it is as advertised. Plenty bright, very adjustable, etc.

The lamp wasn't tall enough for my use case (up from behind and over a rather large computer monitor), but a small stool and some books corrected that, and I knew from the measurements going in that I was going to have issues with the height.

Two minor negative issues that folks should know about:

1) The instructions are pictures only, and blatantly misleading at times. (It shows the wrong size screw going in the wrong location at times, etc.) Fortunately, assembly is not complicated, and you can generally work out when you're being lied to. :)

2) The biggest issue: The lamp responds to half the remotes in the house. I have a Vizio TV in my office where the lamp is, and a Samsung TV in the living room, and the directional buttons & "OK" button for both remotes turn the lamp on and off -- and the volume up/down for both remotes changes the lamp "color". This is HIGHLY ANNOYING, and the only reason for lowering the rating to a "3" star (the lamp WORKS; they just picked unfortunate frequencies for it to respond to).

That's it. I like the lamp. I just hate having to reset it every time I adjust the TV.

reviews.review_title: The best air purifier, hands down.
reviews.review_description: I have had my first unwave for about six years and love it so much, I bought another one while on sale. I tell people that there is nothing like it. I rarely need to dust, I have no dog hair flying around, and the house smells fresh all of the time. Mine has ran 24 hours a day all of those years. Filters are so easy to clean. I could not be happier. I would back this air purifier any day. I had many choices back then and even more so now, but I still would choose unwave, and I did , an extra for the guest bedroom. Amazon has great sales on them once in a while, I got lucky and saved a lot of money. I leave mine on 3 and settings are so simple. Noise levels are low as mine is setting 10 feet from tv and 6 feet from me, no problems. I can open the door to let my dog out and the air light comes on, meaning the air quality outside needs cleaned. Strange but true.

These Nuwave Whole House filters are wonderful. Their design is perfect, drawing the air from ground level and powerfully expelling it through the top aimed upwards. We like the way it filters and cleans dust and odor so well, we invested in a second one. They are big, but do a big job! And moving them is a breeze with the wheels. When they are at maximum work level, sound a little like running water out of a faucet. Doesn’t bother anyone, because they are purifying the air. You can really tell the difference in the atmosphere since they arrived. They are a little bit pricey, but do a great job and maintenance is cheap, because most of the 5 filters are brush-able or washable. The cabinet is very accessible, so easy to clean everything. The two are about 6 months old now and still running like new. Also, you can control them with your WiFi devices. Great product. We’re so glad we took the risk. Recommend.

Growing up, I've always had problems due to allergies. Eventually, I learned about air purifiers. I tried other brands without too much research into them and they seemed okay, but then I decided to get serious so I really looked into what people like and this product was highly regarded.

I can't speak as an expert on how effective it really is (trusting the places that claimed they did such tests), but it does feel like there's an improvement though I think it's most noticeable after cooking when the smells don't linger as long as they used to (I may have bought if for allergy relief, but I love it for not having to smell the same food for days).

The thing I like is also that you get 5 years worth of filters which is very handy. I've had one product for about a year so it was time to replace some of the filters (fortunately, most only need to be washed periodically).

And I say one product, because I liked it and honestly I wasn't sure if one unit really could cover the 3 floors of my house - I usually keep one in the first and second floors where I spend most of my time, but I do move one to the basement from time to time as needed. The main thing that got me was the unit is a little heavy which isn't a huge deal... unless you have stairs in which case it is annoying if you need to move it up and down frequently.

Other than that, I have no issues. So far, both units have been fine in the 12 / 9 months I've had them without any issues. I appreciate that you can put it in sleep mode so the unit still runs, but you don't have bright lights blinding me. I've seen reviews complain about connecting to the phone and honestly... I can't speak for that because I don't care about that feature. Turning it on and off using the buttons on the machine are all I need.

reviews.review_title: Great unit to filter a large area
reviews.review_description:

We have it in our restaurant seating area which is about 4800 cu Ft. This unit is supposed to take care of 2500 cu Ft, I believe. However, it works great in our seating area of 20X20X12.

I noticed it instantly detects foul orders (dirty mop buckets, garbage cans rolling next to it) and instantly kicks into another gear to clear the air when in auto.

The turbo button (not sure it's called "turbo") is a a good way to prep the area if you know you'll be working in the area. We just opened and this came in handy during and after our restoration.

It is quiet and looks really nice. It is easy to move and has many control options. We use the auto mode while open and manually turn it off at night. It has a timer and scheduler but we've not used those features yet. There are a lot of filters and many extra filters. That's a nice bonus.

A little on the pricey side, but for the volume of air we ask it to clean, and all its features, it's worth the investment.

Strange this is, after I've been working all day and stand next to this unit, it kicks into high gear and the indicators show "dirty"... Maybe it's trying to tell me I need a shower? ... I take it that the sensor is tuned to sense humidity and sweat and reacts to conditions in the air.

Love this unit, I recommend purchasing.

reviews.review_description: My wife had a pretty severe asthma attack and her doctor recommended an air purifier. I bought the KNKA APH4000 based on price and positive reviews. This turned out to be a fantastic purchase . It is quiet unless the air quality is bad and it kicks into high gear. It is still tolerable and pretty quickly brings the air quality to safer levels. Most of the time my machine keeps it steady between 007 and 009. If iI use the stove the air quality gets quickly worse and the machine reacts instantly. With the recent issues my area had with wildfire smoke, this purifier keep levels inside my house tolerable and my wife did not have any further issues with her asthma. My favorite feature on the APH4000 is the LED color bar. It goes from green to blue to orange to red depending on the current air quality. Not only is it extremely cool looking, but you can see from across the room if the air quality has dropped. The digital readout also shows the actual air quality index number. I am very impressed with this unit and am very glad I made this purchase.

Okay, I don't normally jump on here to review products, but this filter is one of the most well-made items I've purchased in years. It works flawlessly and quietly. Setup was easy and I daresay fun. reviews.review_title: Beyond thankful I chose this unit!
reviews.review_description:
Lots of positives with this unit. Glad we purchased it and I’ve recommended it to family and friends.

Pros:

-Does its job surprisingly well for the price and makes a huge difference in our home. Performs very well and covers our entire main floor. No complaints in coverage.

-Very accurately monitors and displays Air Quality. -Affordable and competitive filter replacements widely available and that aren’t so proprietary that it makes them needlessly complex/expensive to manufacture(whether due to shape or enforcing official filters only with detection systems). This is a common grift with other brands where they deceptively cheat customers by designing their filters to be cost-prohibitive preventing generic options and competitive pricing… OR by even using “”smart”” features that prevent you from using unofficial filters enabling for more predatory pricing and gouging. Some other brands may even shut down and force filter replacements sooner than necessary for additional profits. Essentially hooking you with the unit itself and bleed you dry with the filters with no alternative options… I have ZERO concerns of that type of practice with this unit. Always will have plenty of options because with this design(standard shape and construction) suitable filters are/can be easily manufactured by competitors.

-I also particularly like that it doesn’t want anything to do with your phone or your home WiFi network. I don’t want or need that. Those features are often a headache and are almost always a very real security concern without many or any added benefits. This is simple and perfectly effective without it.

“Cons”/Notes:

-Not really a con and this could easily be seen as actually another positive and speak to why it works so well… but it requires 2 filters for every replacement cycle meaning one for each side. They are very affordable though and last 3-6 months just as described. $40 for a 4pk which is enough for up to 12 months! Can’t beat that. Having one good sized filter for each side actually aids in its ability to intake air, so hard to call that a true negative—in the grand scheme it’s probably another positive.

We’re quite pleased with this air purifier and seriously debating on buying a second for another floor of the house. Seems rather smart to stock up with a couple years worth of filters in this economy which I will be doing. Being able to keep up with filter replacements is the most important factor in ANY air purifier purchase no matter the brand… neglecting this can actually make your air quality worse rather than better by allowing captured fungi and bacteria to grow on the filters and be redistributed throughout your home. This unit and its filters are a great choice and won’t become cost prohibitive to keep well-maintained. Such a win. Very thankful I chose this unit.

Its much smaller than you think and is very quiet, especially on the lower settings. Easy to set up, just take the filter bags off and pop the feet on. The controls are easy. I have a 100lbs great pyrenees that is hard to bathe regularly. She gets a little stinky occasionally and is noticeable in my 1050 sqft house. One of these in my living room has solved that problem with just the regular filter, not even the pet one. I did order a couple pet filters for when the regular filter is done but I dont see needing the pet specific one for my purposes. I even got a 2nd for the cat litter in the basement. We have an off brand rotating box that is great but still some smell. One of these purifiers in the basement with the regular filter takes care of that too. Granted, we buy him good food so he is not a smelly cat by any means. The house smells better than ever.

We have been using this unit for a week now, it works great. It took a few minutes after unpacking, and reading the instructions, to actually find the power button. The control panel is pretty much invisible, until you plug the unit into power. Then things become obvious, and actually quite easy to use. I also appreciate that it does not require an app, or any such nonsense. It's a machine that you can plug in, turn it on and it does exactly what it's supposed to do!😁 Plus, it does a far better job of removing wildfire smoke and agriculture dust from the air than we expected for something of it's size and price. It's not silent, but reasonably quiet when it's at the lower speeds.

reviews.review_title: Amazing | it actually works | should be 5* but there is always room for improvement
reviews.review_description: Amazing little things. I felt/ smelled the difference within a few hours of plugging them in. The air just felt a lot cleaner. It does have the option of adding scented oil on a little sponge. I have not used it because I think it defeats the purpose of clean/ neutral air. But it feels great knowing it has such a feature. The filters must be some type of high tech because they work great. And the unit itself is super quiet/ silent. Currently I cannot think of ways to improve this amazing little unit.

The air purifier I had was too fussy for me, as I had 3 HEPA filters and a carbon fiber filter to take out & replace at different times. This purifier is a mighty little guy, at least half as big as my other unit, but much more powerful & less fussy. I got this around the first of June this year. I followed all the directions, as stated in the included booklet. I keep the booklet under the unit for future reference. I turned the unit on and noticed how quiet it is. I turned off the light on the panel because I didn't need yet another light to add to the other gadgets that also came with their own little lights. I set it on "auto" and walked away, letting it do its thing. I have a 936 square foot home, with a full basement. I figured this unit was more than capable of handling the upper level, as I keep the basement door shut & I rarely go down there. It has its own filtration system anyway, for my husband's wood shop. This unit is so quiet that I had to check it to make sure it was still running & to see if the panel light changed color so I could clean the filter. Nope, it was still working, doing its thing. A few days ago (almost halfway through August now), I was watching TV & saw the panel light go on. It was red! Red means the air quality is bad because the filter needs cleaning. The fan also kicked into gear where I could hear it, which told me that it sensed the change & was working on pulling more air through a filter that needed cleaning. I took both filters out, vacuumed them both, and cleaned the covers & the areas around where the filters fit. I put it all back together, then pushed the fan button until the number read 3 & walked away. I watched as the panel lit up in red, then changed to blue, which is better, but I'd rather it be green, which is best. That was yesterday. I'm checking it now & it is green! My husband has COPD & he was coughing more than usual yesterday. I noticed that after I cleaned the filters (front & back) and ran the unit on #3 for about an hour, his coughing was much less. Today the air seems less dense...lighter...cleaner. I keep this in the livingroom, which is open to the kitchen. These are the rooms we spend the most time in, so this is where the unit is. For us, this unit works perfectly. It's less fussy, with only two filters to buy...one for each side. They vacuumed easily with my little stick vacuum (Shark) using no attachments, just the handheld portion of the machine. Just turn this little guy in & he can take it from there. I would think you would have to get another unit if you had a bigger house, but for us, this exceeded my expectations.

reviews.review_title: Small, quiet and light weight but out performs units twice its size.
reviews.review_description:
This works and performs very well. Great settings with a digital read out that shows you how bad your air is. I baught another one 1 day later because it is so good. Easily cleans air for up to about 1500 sq.' I put one with me in my work shed and its amazing how 2 seconds of 2 stroke smoke makes this thing take off when on automatic because the smoke that unfortunately smells so good is toxic as hell to breath but it was an eye opener to see. reviews.review_description: Great so far. Very easy to use and very effective for a moderately sized row house. Within 15 minutes on the highest setting I could feel the difference in the air quality. I put it in different rooms daily. It's light enough to carry from room to room. I keep it on a low setting at night. It's quiet and a powerhouse. I'm really happy with my purchase.

I only just got this yesterday and used it last night for the first time but I feel compelled to write a quick review already. This thing is a game. changer. Ever since moving to Texas, I suffer from terrible seasonal allergies. I never have in my life until now (turns out I'm allergic to a handful of trees that are native around here. Fun.) Some years are worse than others but this year is baaad. For the past few weeks my mornings have had me waking up congested and unable to breathe, blowing wads of snot out of my nose (sorry!), and with a itchy/scratchy sore throat. First thing I do is take an allergy pill and wait in misery until it finally seems to kick in around mid morning. (I've had a terrible time finding meds that work too. It just sucks.) I don't know why I never thought to get an air purifier. I guess when I thought of air purifiers I'd always think of the fancy Dyson ones that cost hundreds of dollars. I mean, puh-lease. Not happening. Then I found this little guy. Had great reviews, was the perfect little size for our master bedroom (216sqft), and reasonably priced with reasonably priced replacement filters. In a plee of desperation I talked my husband into us trying it. It got in yesterday (quicker than expected, yay!). I immediately unboxed it upon getting home from work and plugged it in. It says you only need to run it for about 15-20 minutes on high to cycle the room but I set that little baby on high with a two hour timer and let it run. When it was time for bed, I set the 6 hour timer on sleep mode. The sleep mode is great. It's a lot more quiet than I expected. I still expected to be able to hear a little white noise from it (which doesn't bother me at all) but unless I lift my head off the pillow and really listen, I can only just baaarely hear it. And I have it on my side of the bed about 3 feet away. Our home air system is louder than it on sleep mode. If you enjoy white noise, you could probably just run it on low and be fine. It has a button to turn off the indicator lights at night too so you don't have bright lights keeping you awake if that's a problem for you. Anyway, I woke up this morning with NO allergy symptoms. None. No congestion, absolutely clear nasal passages, and NO sore throat at all! I'm blown away. I'll try to come back and revise this review if my opinion changes but after the first night and the relief I was FINALLY able to feel from my allergies this morning I absolutely rate this thing 5 stars. Worth every penny!

reviews.review_title: Pet Odor and old house odor, bye bye!
reviews.review_description:
Edit to original review: it’s been several months at this point and I have two in our small farmhouse. They work amazing, best purchase we’ve made.

So far: it’s perfect, surpassed all expectations, ALL.

Backstory: we’re living in a house from the late 1800s, that has been dormant for about ten years until we moved in a couple years ago. We have five pets, four cats which are strictly indoor and use an automatic litter box (Popur S7 which does great for the smell, it can only do so much though) and one fat, lazy, stinky pitbull. The house is musky, it’s old, it had way too much mold in the detached basement when we moved in. And the pets? They stink bad too, this is coming from someone who is very particular about the house smelling good. The litter box is horrible, the dog is gross, the house is old.

I went searching for an air purifier, I’ve been wanting the SHARK never change, but couldn’t break down and buy it for $300. Didn’t try it out, can’t say if it’s good or not.

While I was looking at reviews, I found the shark had only 5,000 reviews on Amazon, and it was at 4.3 stars. Okay, that’s not too bad. But this Levoit one had over 100,000 reviews and 4.8 stars. That’s nuts in comparison. I done a lot of looking on Reddit and found that the shark wasn’t even mentioned in the majority of good quality reviews, so I disregarded it.

This specific one happened to be in budget and also has amazing reviews.

We received it last night and set it up this morning, yep this morning, in our cat’s litter box room which is also unfortunately our closet. That room is the worst room of the house in my opinion. It’s been running for about 6 hours and I already notice a huge impact. It’s easier to breath, the air doesn’t feel so heavy, and the litter box is nonexistent, even right after they use it. Hubby sprayed cologne on himself and not 20 seconds later I walked in and it was gone, already sucked away. I put a box fan on it to help circulation and have it on 3.

I’m buying another. Maybe two more. If I remember I’ll come back and review again when it gets a little later in the month. We’re leaving for vacation next Monday, so I’m curious how it will hold up against the cats stagnant litter box, which usually stinks pretty bad when we get home after a week.

TLDR; Amazing for pet odor, amazing for muskiness. Perfect and worth every penny.

reviews.review_title: Levoit Air Purifier Home Allergies, Asthma
reviews.review_description:
I love the Levoit Air Purifier! It is very quiet all of the time, but if you use the night time sleep mode, you can just barely hear it at all. The fan has three speeds as well as the sleep mode. You can set the sleep mode for up to 8 hours, the best I remember. I do use sleep mode but not with the timer. You can turn off the display panel and I do that at night because I prefer a totally dark room. I run it all day on low and so far, a week out from getting it and setting it up, there are no signs of anything that needs to be cleaned from the outside as I've seen in other reviews. I don't have any pets, just nasty carpet. I call it nasty, because all carpet is nasty to me. I dislike carpet so much! I don't have a choice, though. I think the filter is supposed to last around six months, so we shall see. I bought a replacement filter when I bought the purifier and several filters for the humidifier, as well. It looks like I may have to change the Humidifier filter once a week as a week out, it is starting to turn brownish-yellow around the top of it. I don't smoke and do try to keep an extremely clean place, so not sure what the discoloration is. I'm the only one who has ever lived here. I use distilled water but also bought the demineralization kit and extra filters for the humidifier in case I run out of distilled water and have to use tap water. I clean the humidifier every day. It's not hard to do once you do it. I love the modern look and it is built very well. It's really not hard to use at all. I believe it is super effective combined with my also Levoit Humidifier. I have them on opposite sides of my small bedroom as I couldn't put my humidifier under the smoke alarm. My skin feels much softer and cleaner using the both of them. I could instantly tell a difference in how well I could breathe using the them. As before purchasing them, I couldn't breathe out of my nose at all. The humidity is brutal here. I have been able to get the humidity down to 58, which is something the local meteorologist said couldn't happen in these heatwave temperatures! Ha! I only use GENUINE LEVOIT filters and they're a bit more costly, but I prefer to use the real deal and have less problems/headaches. It can be a bit catchy to find them on Amazon and the generic ones keep popping up; however, I went straight to the Levoit store to get the genuine ones. Blessed to be able to somewhat better control my Asthma and all-season Allergies with the help of these two awesome products! Thank you, Amazon and Levoit! reviews.review_title: Fingers crossed this helps my allergic dog!
reviews.review_description:
I got this air purifier for my bedroom. My dog has a very severe dust mite allergy. He was literally disintegrating. His hair was falling out and his dandruff was like a blizzard. He had full body yeast and it smelled like a dirty gym sock on steroids.

Despite having no carpet, rugs and bedding that are washed weekly, and dust mite covers on both of our beds, he was still miserable. He is so allergic that out of desperation I'm trying everything I possibly can to minimize his exposure while his immunotherapy does its job.

The vet said that short of having hospital level air purification I would never get rid of all the dust mites, but I can limit his exposure with air purifiers, so we are giving it a try. There's no way I can accurately gauge how much this air purifier is reducing the dust mites, but it has to be better than it was before I got it.

My dog gets 3 medicated baths a week and is about to start immunotherapy, so I can't really credit any progress to the air purifier alone, but there is no doubt it will help reduce the total number of dust mites he is exposed to.

I also got a larger air purifier for my living room/kitchen. I live in a camper currently as I recently moved and am building a home. Since we live in cramped quarters with less ventilation than a sticks and bricks home, the dust mites and other allergens are far more concentrated.

I've noticed since having these two purifiers running that our home smells fresher and cleaner, any smells do not linger. I've tried my hardest to deep clean any dust collected around the house in all the little nooks and crannies that you can't see and hopefully the purifiers will help keep that to a minimum. For some reason even in the dead of winter we seem to have a lot of dust. Again, probably because the space is so small. It seems the smaller the space, the bigger the mess! Thankfully it doesn't take as long to clean a smaller space.

I'm not sure if I'll ever really know how effective these are, but I can say I've noticed a big difference since I got them in the quality of the air. We have wood heat so there's not a furnace constantly blowing air around. They provide air flow in what used to be pretty stagnant areas in the winter when the a/c isn't running.

The stinky sock yeasty dog smell has been reduced quite a bit, and any other lingering smells like cooking or flatulence from my gassy teenager don't tend to hang around as long lol. So they have been a win-win! They seem to work very well.

I don't use the timer features because I let them both run 24/7, but it's nice to have that as an option if it's ever needed. I really appreciate the small footprint of this purifier because there's not much room in a camper. I have it on my bedside table. You can see in the picture about how big it is next to my 40oz swig.

Even on high it's very quiet, but I'm one of those "can't sleep without a fan" people so I enjoy the sound lol. Between this and the fan at the foot of my bed pushing air towards it, our air in the bedroom ought to be squeaky clean!

The setup was incredibly straightforward – just unbox, remove the plastic from the filter, plug it in, and you’re good to go. The design is sleek and modern, with a cylindrical shape that fits neatly on a nightstand or floor corner without dominating the room. At around 8.7 inches in diameter and 14.2 inches tall, it’s compact enough for apartments or offices, yet powerful for its size.

Key features include a 3-stage filtration system: a pre-filter for larger particles like dust and hair, a True HEPA filter that captures 99.97% of airborne particles as small as 0.3 microns (think pollen, mold spores, and fine dust), and an activated carbon filter to tackle odors, smoke, and VOCs. It has three fan speeds plus a sleep mode that dims the lights and runs ultra-quietly at just 24dB – quieter than a whisper, making it perfect for nighttime use. There’s also a timer (2/4/6/8 hours) and a display lock to prevent accidental changes.

In terms of performance, this little unit punches above its weight. It refreshes the air in a 219 sq. ft. room up to 5 times per hour on high speed, according to the specs. I tested it during a smoky day from nearby wildfires, and within an hour, the air felt noticeably fresher – no lingering smells or stuffiness. Pros:

• Quiet operation: Sleep mode is a lifesaver for light sleepers. 1

Cons:

Overall, the Levoit Core 300 is a fantastic entry-level air purifier that’s reliable, user-friendly, and effective for everyday use. If you’re dealing with allergies, pets, or just want cleaner air in a small space, I highly recommend it. It’s ETL, CARB, and Energy Star certified, so you know it’s safe and efficient. reviews.review_title: Perfect for elderly parent with pets
reviews.review_description:
I bought this for my mom. My siblings don’t visit her because they claimed pet hair/dander was severely triggering their allergies. I thought they were making it up because I personally never had any kind of reaction. Well, I recently I went to visit Mom for a few hours as I normally do, and the trifecta of dust, dander, and pet hair hit me like a ton of bricks. For 3 days, I was having coughing fits, wheezing, and my eyes were itchy and felt like there was dust in them 24/7. My mom already has COPD and frequently complains about being short of breath, so realizing that she was casually breathing all of this in 24/7 completely freaked me OUT. That said, I went on the search for an air purifier and ended up pulling the trigger on this one and can finally report on well it works.

Even though at first my mom wasn’t happy that I spent money and bought this for her, after I set it up, she allowed me to leave it running on high if it meant there could be a chance that it might make her air quality suitable for my siblings start visiting again. Well, 6 weeks later, I was able to convince my siblings to come with me to mom’s house to visit for Christmas because now there she has a good air purifier. Upon entering my mom’s house with my family, the first thing I noticed immediately was how much lighter the air way. Before this filter, the air was thick, heavy, and DUSTY. Afternoon light filtering through the blinds would reveal clouds of pet hair and dust particles swirling around like smoke. Now? Nothing! No dust in the air when sunshine is coming though the windows. The second thing I noticed was that the smell of litterbox went from 100% to 40-50%. My family had a wonderful, comfortable holiday visit with my Mom, they were shocked how much of a difference this machine made. No one had any of their allergies triggered. YAY!! My mom, who originally wanted to hate this machine, finally confessed that she’s breathing a lot better lately & believes that it’s due to this machine improving her air. She leaves it running on auto now, when she cooks, it kicks into high gear until the numbers go down. She loves it a lot. Highly recommend this machine.

reviews.review_title: Quiet, washable pre filter to extend the life of the Hepa filter
reviews.review_description:
Great air filter. It is small enough to tuck into an out of the way space and runs very quietly so it is not noticeable. I like having the option to turn the display off so it keeps the bedroom dark.

We noticed an improvement in the air quality the first night as it removed the pollen, which has been horrible this year. My family and I sleep through the night without getting all congested, I purchased two units so my son has one in his room as well.

The aromatherapy option is wonderful as well so we can add a relaxing scent to let us drift off to sleep easily.

It appears well built and changing the filters is very easy to accomplish. I especially like the washable pre-filter as it collect teh pet hair on it and will make the Hepa filter last longer. I am looking forward to many years of use out of this .
Love it. Husband stopped sneezing.

Bought this to try and minimize the dust and pet dander in the house. Have only been running it for about a week now, but I have noticed a bit of a difference. Air smells cleaner even with the monsoons we have had come through. So far so good. Glad I made the purchase.

I had been struggling with terrible allergies in my home, so I bought this air purifier on an impulse after reading reviews. I’m honestly so glad I did because the difference has been incredible. Setup was unbelievably easy. All I had to do was take it out of the box, remove the plastic wrapping from the filter, plug in the power cord, and turn it on. Within the first night, the air quality reading dropped from 159 to under 20, which really impressed me.

The biggest thing I noticed was how much fresher and cleaner my home felt almost immediately. I could actually tell a difference in the air quality, especially when waking up in the morning. It’s also surprisingly quiet, even when running for long periods of time, so it doesn’t disturb sleep or everyday activities.

Update after over a month of use: this has honestly been one of the best purchases I’ve made for my home. The improvement with my allergies was night and day. I used to constantly wake up congested and sneezing, and now my symptoms are so much more manageable. My house gets less dusty which makes less sweeping and dusting. My favorite feature is the automatic mode. It adjusts the fan speed on its own depending on the air quality, which is so convenient. I especially notice it when we’re cooking dinner — the purifier automatically ramps up to a higher setting while the air quality changes, then lowers itself again once everything is back to normal.

I also appreciate that it works so effectively without needing constant adjustments or attention from me. It has become one of those appliances I barely think about anymore because it just quietly does its job in the background. Looking back, I only wish I had purchased it sooner.

I absolutely love this air purifier!! First of all, it is so quiet that I almost forget its on. But as soon as it senses something in the air, it kicks up the speed! reviews.review_title: Quiet, Effective, and Worth Every Penny
reviews.review_description:
I’ve been using this LEVOIT air purifier for a while now, and I’m very happy with it. It was easy to set up, and it runs very quietly, even at night.

I noticed the air feels fresher, and it does a great job reducing dust and everyday odors. I also like that it has different fan speeds, so I can adjust it depending on what I need.

The build quality is excellent, and the controls are simple to use. Overall, it’s been a great addition to my home, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for an effective and reliable air purifier.

I got this air purifier because with all the animal hair, dust, and seasonal allergens floating around, I was coughing constantly- night and day. I happened to get it a little on sale, and while the cost is a little high, it has proven its worth to the penny. It comes with multiple speeds, modes, and most importantly the sleep function. When its in night/sleep mode, its still releasing air but there is no light pollution or any sounds. It is so quiet I forget its on. I also see a vast improvement on my air quality and I no longer wake up the whole household at night with my coughing. It does its best work in one room, but I have noticed that the room its in has less dust. Ive also noticed it is a little if a deoderizor, which is great for someone who has a sensitive nose. Overall, yes its a little expensive upfront but the design of it, the quality of its work, and being able to finally sleep through the night is priceless. I dont know about its longevity but I did buy a very small and older version from this manufacturer 3 years ago and its still going.

I've not had the purifier for a full 30 days yet, but so far it is excellent! I did thorough research when replacing my MedifyAir purifier and found that Levoit is one of the few that is actually 3rd party tested and thus markets the correct numbers of how much space it can cover, unlike MedifyAir and some others brands. I am very impressed with the packaging, the ease of set up, and that you don't have to use the app unless you want to. Though the app is very nice. It has some nice smart features, but again, you don't have to use them if you don't want. You can literally plug it in and turn it on and go. I also like the fact that the filters are cheaper than what I have been used to buying and they last longer! So more efficient, longer lasting, cheaper filters, covers more space, WIN-WIN!

reviews.review_title: Quiet, Smart, and Effective for Bedrooms
reviews.review_description:
I've been using the Levoit 200S-P in a bedroom, and it's been a great balance of performance, noise level, and convenience.

Setup took just a few minutes, and pairing it with the VeSync app was straightforward. I like being able to check the air quality, adjust the fan speed, create schedules, and turn it on before I get home.

Auto mode works well and usually keeps the fan quiet unless it detects a noticeable change in air quality. It's nice when I'm cooking and the lights will blink red indicating the air quality has changed and it will kick on high speed.

For everyday use, it's very quiet on the lower settings, making it easy to sleep with. On the highest speed it moves a lot more air, but as expected it's much louder. I typically leave it in Auto mode and rarely have to adjust it.

The filter has done a good job reducing dust and everyday odors in the room. While no air purifier can eliminate every smell instantly, I've noticed the room feels fresher, and there's less dust settling on furniture over time. It's also very easy to clean.

A few things to keep in mind: replacement filters aren't the cheapest, and this unit is best suited for bedrooms or other smaller spaces. If you're trying to clean the air in a large open living area, you'll probably want to step up to a larger model like the Core 400S or 600S.

Overall, if you're looking for a reliable, easy-to-use smart air purifier for a bedroom or office, I'd recommend the Levoit 200S-P. It's quiet, simple to maintain, and has performed exactly as I hoped.

I bought this for my living room and kitchen with an open concept of around 540 sq. Ft. It took about 4 hours for the light to change from red to blue. I can't really tell a difference because I'm home all the time, however my guests say it smells fresher. I have 2 cats and a dog and their hair and dander is a nightmare! I've already cleaned off the front and the screen twice in two weeks, so that shows it working, but I still have some dust and hair floating around just not quite as bad, however I did shave my long thick hair coated dog and that helped alot!

From the reviews I expected more out of this, my allergies haven't changed I'm still congested and use meds for that, but I also have various food allergies.

I put this unit in a high traffic area and center of living room and kitchen. I've noticed my TV doesn't have near as much dust and hair accumulation on the screen. For the price it's okay, it doesn't compare to the real expensive ones perhaps, but it does help.

reviews.review_title: Efficient - Easy to Operate - Attractive - Quiet
reviews.review_description: This is a very attractive and easy unit to use. The filter is easily replaced, and the sleep mode is fantastic! It is quiet at any speed but barely noticeable on Level 2. WE can feel the difference in the freshness of the air in the home. Less sneezing and coughing! :)

reviews.review_title: Best air purifier I’ve ever owned
reviews.review_description:

reviews.review_title: Great air filter for houses with dogs!!!
reviews.review_description:
So, I am an engineer by trade and am pretty picky with design and quality of the items I purchase, especially ones I buy on Amazon. I also have some pretty bad allergies, and I have a big dog with lots of hair unfortunately. I needed an air filter for my room that would allow me to sleep through the night without my allergies getting the best of me.

This item is perfect for me on several levels since I have a large dog and bad allergies. First off, I bought this for my bedroom, and it is a large room for sure. It also needs to run 24/7 without it being too loud. I was impressed when the unit came out of the box as it has two HEPA air filters on each side to draw air in from and the next most important thing is the fitment of those filters which is tight. This means that air will not be able to go around the filters which is important for an air filter.

This unit is whisper quiet when it is running. Even at its highest fan setting the noise is not disturbing. Another feature that is very nice, but not a deal breaker for me, is that the display can be dimmed. Well, this unit not only has a few different dimming settings, but can turn off all the lights on the display. This is a high-quality unit and is definitely worth the money. I am happy with my purchase and whenever I need other products I will be happy to check out this brand.

After using this Siesean Air Purifier for Large Rooms for over 3months now, it seems to be doing it’s job. The unit

seems well made; is very stylish & functional. As far as it’s efficiency, I don’t have the appropriate instruments to measure any actual air quality performance in it’s operation..

I have this unit in my cigar smoking room. There is also a separate ventilation system, & this unit does help with the

smoke removal & air circulation. Previously, I had another (more popular brand name, air purifier that costs 3x as much as this unit, and this product performs just as well if not better. This unit has 2 filters on both sides which allows for much more air intake?exhaust & a very strong motor/fan to circulate the air. It does take a couple of days to eliminate the cigar odors, but my previous, more expensive unit took just as long.

It comes with a very good user’s manual. Cleaning & replacing the filters is very easy. It seems that much thought & quality construction went into the design of this product.

Up to now, I am very satisfied with this purchase. We’ll just have to wait & see in the long run.

We all spend time keeping our homes clean and it is just as important to keep the air clean . I always have it running for everyday dust and allergens but I am especially grateful for the times of the year when the wildfires seem to affect everyone in the country and you can't escape the bad air. In my home it will be running on the highest speed doing the most to protect the vulnerable people who I love. The value is good and the unit is as well. Happy with my filter.

reviews.review_title: Affordable and effective for dust and allergens
reviews.review_description:
We moved into an incredibly dusty townhouse, I have terrible allergies, and we discovered our neighbors are chain smokers. We now have 3 Levoit air purifiers in our home: Vital 100 (non-smart version), Core Mini and Vital 200S.

I initially bought the Vital 100 and put it in our bedroom because I have terrible allergies. It collected a ton of dust and helped a lot with the allergies. I thought I didn't need the smart version but in hindsight the availability of specialty filters and the remote control would be very helpful. It's relatively quiet although on high it's too noisy for me to sleep with. I absolutely love that you can turn the all the control lights off. We tried using this for the cigarette smell but it wasn't very effective except when the smell was very light. It did completely abolish cooking smells though. If I could go back in time I would have ordered the 100S instead but this one works fine.

The smoke smell from the neighbors comes into our house through the laundry room which is a very small room. I bought the Core Mini to try to combat it. The Core Mini doesn't really do much to get rid of smells and was definitely overwhelmed by the smoke so now we move it around the house now when the pollen level is high. It works ok for dust and allergens but the range isn't great; you need to be right next to it to notice a difference. On low and medium speed it's barely audible and high is relatively quiet but overall the fan isn't very powerful. The lights on this one automatically turn off after a few seconds making it bedroom friendly. If I could do it again, I would have skipped this one and bought one of the larger ones sooner.

Lastly, in an attempt to mitigate the smoke coming from next door, we got the big boi Vital 200S with the add on smoke specialty filter. So far it isn't able to remove the smell while they're smoking but it does cut down the severity and will clear it eventually provided the source stops for long enough. It's amazingly quiet on the lower speeds. It's pretty loud on the higher speeds but the fan moves a ton of air around. I'm disappointed that the auto mode doesn't detect the smoke smell but I can use the app to turn it to high speed as soon as I smell it. You don't have to use the app but it's really easy to set up and connect. The app allows you to set schedules which is really handy and as I touched on earlier, it works as a remote control. As with the others, you're able to turn the lights off completely so it's good for bedrooms. We've only had this running a few days but I'm pretty impressed with what it can do.

I use this in a room I use to have an Ionic air purifier, the old worked there was some dust near the unit, but the smell of Ozone was too much since i kept my door closed most of the day. the Levoit was a perfect replacement, no smell, lot less noise and my room felt refreshed when i open the door. I have the 330 model for over 2 years in the Livingroom and i happy with that one as well. the only down i don't like is the 300 can sense the air and adjust where the 200 can't, but you can program to go on or off multi times throughout the day, the night light is a nice touch for when it's in my sons room or i want to see enough light in a pitch black room. fits perfect in my bedroom, cleans the air, no dusty or ozone smell. very effective for the rom it is in.

reviews.review_title: Great small sized air purifier that does some heavy lifting
reviews.review_description:
I got this air purifier for my bedroom as my sleep can be disturbed by air quality pretty easily. I was highly skeptical of this product at first as the price point to me indicated that it might be cheap in terms of quality of the product but so far it has been pretty impressive. On even the lowest setting, it has substantially improved the air quality not just in the bedroom but in the adjoining room so we're looking at space of about 200-300 square feet or so. I would say I can breathe easier at night with it and my comfort level while sleeping has increased a bit.

The air after it's been running for a bit smells and just seems fresher and I am considering getting a second one to see if it can handle a much larger area.

Noise is pretty low on it's lowest "normal" setting and the night mode feature drops the noise to almost silent, but not quite. At it's lowest setting, there is an odd whine, for lack of better words that can just barely be heard. This whine was an annoyance at first but you get used to and can ignore it. It still works well on the lowest setting to keep the room fresh so it's a good deal.

Setup was easy as can physically, however I cannot as yet speak to the application setup as I haven't gotten to that. I treat air purifiers as non-smart devices but I do plan to at least try to integrate it with Home Assistant and if that doesn't work I may try integration with Amazon Alexa. I'll update the review when that happens.

Durability of the purifier long term is unknown, though the filters do seem very easy to replace and their price point does make them economical enough to justify getting a filter instead of replacing the entire air purifier.

Summary: Good, powerful little air purifier that can sit on a dresser or nightstand, relatively quiet with some caveats. Long term durability is unknown but still was a good buy overall.

I bought this purifier because I really wanted one that I could turn on from my phone while laying in bed, since I am completely blind in the dark due to my vision impairment, and I don't necessarily have anywhere to place this type of electronic near my bed that was the major deal breaker for me. This air purifier is about the size of a PS5, but a little more convenient due to the cylinidrical shape of it. The app set up is easy and it allows you to auto order a new filter through the app via a scheduled set up. I have mine set up for every 6 months and you can tell the difference between the 2 filters after those 6 months.... the app also will tell you the life on your filter left and will tell you the air quality/ pollen count outside of your home. All the modes do exactly as they say and the sleep mode is ultra quiet which is nice. I've been using this air purifier for almost 2 years now and it is still working great. You can immidetly tell when you take it out of the box that it is a good high quality purifier and not a purifier where they say its high quality and after a week it stops working... My last purifier was lmof a lower quality and stopped working with-in a year, but also I paid $50 for that one and I didn't have a dog at that time.

It is so nice to have a higher quality purifier that works exactly as it says on the ads. The app also includes other Levoit electronics you can add to your account so you have all your Lwvoit products in one spot on your phone which I think is so mice and easy. The app is also really easy to use and to set up everything on, it looks and feels very professional and easy which I really enjoy. I love opening up my app and seeing all my Levoit electronics in one spot, ready to turn on or off, or to change any mode it's on to something different. You can aslo set up a schedule of when you would like your devices to turn on and off and what mode to use whenbit does.

Starting with the positives, the ease of use is great. The touch controls are intuitive, and setting it up right out of the box was a breeze.
