reviews.review_description:
I’ve had this pressure cooker for about a year and it is amazing. My favorite features are:

Automatic steam release. Who hasn’t been shy about releasing pressure from a cooker? The sound alone used to make me jump, even if I knew it was not going to burn me because the valve was pointed in the opposite direction. Now I just sit in the living room and listen for the appliance to release in the manner I asked it to. Ahhhhh. It does instant, intermittent and natural releases. Truly my favorite feature.

Step by step instructions. Now, I don’t really need these, but it is so much fun to choose a recipe and have the app tell you what to do. Need to add a cup of water? Sure, you can add a cup of water after measuring it. But it’s so cool to see the scale tell you EXACTLY when you’ve added the right amount. I can imagine a person who has never cooked anything would love the step by step instructions even more than I do.

Next, I love the app. “When will dinner be ready?” Um…. (Open app) “13 minutes and 11 seconds.” I’ll bet you can’t be that precise unless you’re using this awesome app! By the way, even if you aren’t using the pre-programmed recipes, the app still shows you what’s going on and allows you to make changes.

I love being able to do almost everything in one pan. Want spaghetti? Brown the meat, sauté the vegetables, add the dry pasta and water, and it’s ready in literally a few minutes. One pot.

There is no guesswork in timing. Tonight I selected sous vide, pork, pork chops, one in thick. It set the temp and time automatically and automatically selected sear when finished. This works for whatever feature and ingredient you are cooking.

Sooooo many cook functions. Slow cooker, pressure cooker, sous vide, sauté, and the list goes on and on.

The only feature that I wish was better is on the app. I wish there were two ways you could save recipes. Right now you can click the heart on a recipe to mark it as a favorite. I would like to see a way to add a folder for “want to try” or something similar. I look at recipes in the app and don’t know yet if they will be a favorite but definitely am interested in trying them. They all get lumped together in one folder which can be inconvenient if you use the cooker and app as much as I do. I did send a request to the company but I don’t know if it’s scheduled for an update in the future or not.

I hope this helps if you’re trying to justify the investment. There is a little bit of a learning curve, but if you use a tablet or smart anything I don’t think you’ll have a problem.

Bottom line? Just buy it!

reviews.review_title: This is like having a personal chef!!!
reviews.review_description:
I've been cooking dinner for more than 50 years. I'm at the age where I don't like to try new recipes because it's too much mental strain on me to find a recipe, read through it, then follow it step by step. I never thought I'd say this, but it's too much work mentally, and it's too much physical strain to stand at a stove, so I stick to simple cooking at my age.

Then I needed a new pressure cooker, came to Amazon to find one and came across this gem. It looked easy enough for me to understand, it was digital, and the reviews were great, so I took a chance and paid twice the amount I would have paid for a regular stove top pressure cooker pan that only is used to pressure cook.

I'm glad I took the chance!!!

This Chef iQ is like having your own personal chef standing next to you telling you step by step how to make amazing meals!

It has made cooking fun and easy again!

The app has many different recipes, including beef and barley soup which I have been wanting to make for years but have no desire to stand at a stove cooking...now I can have my Chef iQ tell me step by step what to add, and the best part is thr scale. It weighs the amount of water you put in, it weighs the meat (no more digging through the garbage to see if it was 2 pounds roast or a 3 pound roast) it weighs it for you!

A dinner that would have taken me hours, and dirtied many dishes and pans, is now made in one pot and it does everything for you!

It took 30 minutes to pressure cook 5 pounds of roast. When it was done I pulled it apart some of them and added some BBQ sauce and we had pulled beef sandwiches, then saved the rest for dinner, again using the insta pot to steam veggies to add to the beef to make a stew. It took less than an hour to make 2 meals!

Washing the unit is simple, just make sure you remove the gasket ring and wash under it, then replace it.

This unit has made 2 elderly people become instant chefs! My husband can't stand for long and for years had to give up making his famous rice and beans. I came back from walking the dog to find a plate of freshly made rice and beans waiting for me, and a husband with a smile so big because he was able to cook again! This pot gave us more than easy and amazing meals, it gave us back the pride and confidence that we can once again make difficult recipes that used to require standing at the stove all day and using and washing many pans, it's given us more time together and has truly made life easier for both of us!

I highly recommend this product for everyone!

It would have been amazing to have this unit when I was in college, to be able to cook full meals in one pot without knowing how to cook would have been so great as a college student living in a dorm!

This makes a great wedding gift, housewarming gift, college student gift, and just a great gift for everyone you love and want to make their life easier!

Read more

I love this pressure cooker; everything I’ve cooked in it so far has come out perfectly, tender & tasty! It guides you step by step to insure safety. It heats up rapidly & gets to pressure quickly. It is so whisper quiet, I can hardly hear it operating except for a momentary whoosh when the pressure plug pops up. I love that I can connect with it on my phone & see exactly where it’s at in the cooking process. It has a built in scale which is nice for knowing the quantity of food you put in. I love the auto venting so I don’t have to risk burning myself from the hot steam. It gives a nice little 10 second warning before it releases. It’s beautifully built with quality materials & is easy to clean & maintain. I love the steamer rack & especially the steamer basket for vegetables. For a family, it would be nice if it came in a 8 qt size, but it’s mainly just me & my husband, so the 6 qt size is fine.

I received my new Chef IQ Smart Cooker today. I proceeded to set it up. The app worked fine, I had no problems with that. In the box there was a large rubber ring that appears to fit on the inner pot but when I put it on there it caused the lid to not fit. I have no idea where this goes, if it is necessary or if it is only for certain types of cooking because there was no manual with the item. I found the manual online but it is very vague as to what this ring is for or how/where to install it. I tried to contact support but they do not have a phone number or email on their website, all they have is a totally ridiculous chat feature that asks questions that require you to have the item in front of you to answer which is very difficult to do when the item is in the kitchen and my PC is in my office. I brought it to the office and got the information, entered it and then they asked for a picture of my receipt, like what do they need that for? Then I had to upload a video of the issue. In the end all that does is send an email to someone somewhere on the planet but who knows where. I am not disappointed with the product as I have not had an opportunity to use it yet since I have no ideas where that ring goes and I do not want to try to cook if it is required for safety reasons. I will await their response but I will never purchase another items from Chef IQ and I will probably return this one in the next couple days depending on how long it takes to get a response and what that response is.

So I received an email from the company saying it will take 3-5 business days to get a response from technical support. Then this morning the cooker says to make sure the rubber gasket is in place but I still have no idea where it should be. This is the absolute worse support, or lack thereof, I have experienced in years. Either they are a one man shop or they have so many complaints coming in that it takes up to five business days to get a response from them.

Read more

I have the Chef iQ temp probe that work well. I decided to try this device. I love all the different recipes. I decided to try the Shepards Pie for my first attempt. I must say I am very impressed. It walks you through the entire process. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.review_title: Product is great, customer service is TOP TIER!
reviews.review_description:
We purchased our Chef IQ during the pandemic (2021), after our barely 1.5 year old Instant Pot we'd received as a wedding gift died--we were just barely out of warranty and they had zero interest in helping. We have used it a minimum of once a week ever since. It's easy to use, size is great, cleans up well, cooks perfectly, and we've used it on multiple settings - high and low pressure, all 3 release settings, slow cooker, sear/saute, and recently the sous vide mode. I've done everything from a whole chicken, soups and chilis, pulled pork, sous vide steak, and more.

We've been in need of a new inside liner pot of awhile, and I kept watching their website and Amazon for replacement ones to become available, but I kept missing them so this past October (2025) I decided to email their customer service and ask when they would be in stock. Ours was so scratched at this point that it was unsafe to use and we needed a replacement, or needed to replace the entire machine. Ana at Chef IQ support asked me for a couple of photos, and just sent us a whole new pot! I was blown away, and it arrived quickly.

Just after the new year, the whole thing just...stopped working. So here I am emailing Ana, again, asking her how to fix it or if there's a part I can buy (I'm decently handy). She asked me for a brief video of it plugged into the same outlet as another appliance that worked, to show it was non functional. I just received a notice that I have A WHOLE NEW APPLIANCE on its way! I'm stunned. I don't remember the last time I've had any type of customer service support actually fully support their customers to this level, especially in this world of planned obsolescence of appliances and devices.

Thank you Ana, and thank you Chef IQ! You have a customer for life. Husband's birthday's coming up and he's been eyeing your thermometers...

Read more

I bought this multifunction pot in 2021 and, although I give it 4 stars because it had some problems with the screen during the first years and had to be replaced three times, since 2023 it has worked perfectly without presenting any faults. What I like the most is that I use it practically every day and it continues to work perfectly. Cook food quickly, saving a lot of time in the kitchen. In addition, it includes an integrated scale that is very useful for measuring ingredients without the need for additional utensils. Another point in favor is its application with recipes, which makes it much easier to find ideas for cooking, and the screen changes according to the season, something that gives it a modern and pleasant touch. The overall quality of the equipment is excellent and, after so many years of intensive use, it continues to prove to be a worthwhile investment. After you learn to use it, you will love it.
I love it! I need another one

reviews.review_title: High quality product that is easy to use.
reviews.review_description: My new favorite. Easy to use menu. Stainless steel pot. Cooking times are perfect. I cook for a lot of family and the 8 quart can handle it. You can literally cook two different dishes, like beans and then the chicken for dinner one after another in about 1.5 hours and feed a lot of people. Well built, easy to use, easy to clean and the steam release works well. There is still some noise, but its a lot quieter than my old one.
This has made cooking so effortless. On the days that I forget to take something out or things that would take hours, now take minutes. Highly recommended for anyone. It's really quiet & easy to use.

I've been using pressure cookers for years, and did not want to give up to the new tachnology. Being older and after falling asleep on my pressure cooker(and burning it up), I ordered this. I've only used it once, but the results were great. I love the stainless pot, it's easy to clean and transfers no taste. It was a great replacement for my pressure cookers, as now I don't worry of burnung down the house and killing everyone inside.

I’m relatively new to using the Instant Pot, but so far I love it. It makes cooking beans so much easier. It’s super functional, especially during times when you forget to lay out meat to thaw earlier in the day and feel pressed on timing. You can stick dry beans and frozen meat right in for cooking instead of having to wait hours to soak or thaw. I will say I wouldn’t rely completely on it being the “faster” option though simply because it does take a significant amount of time to depressurize, especially when it comes to food like soups where there’s a large quantity of liquid. I have a household of 4 and it’s great for us, though sometimes I do wish it had more room, but during my research I learned that the bigger Instant Pots take even more time to come to pressure and to depressurize so I just went with the 6 quart option and I’m satisfied with it. It is hard to remove the smells off of the inner ring when cleaning so definitely follow the instructions for using one inner ring for sweets and the other for savory foods (it does come with 2 rings). I’m not the best cook, but this allows me to cook way more things that I otherwise wouldn’t even attempt on my own because this kind of makes it a foolproof process.

reviews.review_title: Defective Lid Design - Don't waste your $$$
reviews.review_description:
I purchased this large instant pot because we like to make bone broth and others students and soups and so I bought the biggest one I could find. Thinking that instant pot would be easy to use was a huge mistake. I cannot get past the installing the lid to perform a test run. This is a poorly designed system. You need to fiddle with this large red O-ring and get it to into the lid somehow I've done this about 15 times now and I'm able to get it in there so that when you turn the lid upside down the rings stays, but I can't get the lid to seal on the pot. The lid is impossible to push down by myself to lock and then trying to turn with a rubber, O-ring is not working at all. I think this is a huge design flaw, and this is not easy to use. I should just be able to open and close and not have to fiddle with this O-ring. I can't even get beyond the Test. I called the product support line. The one 800 customer service number listed here and they want me to send email photos of the product when it's brand new out of the box and there's no one that could talk me through tips and tricks of getting the top on. The customer support person hung up on me after putting me on hold and never call me back. They probably have too many complaints on this product. I would give this zero stars andreturn it if I could, but I think it's past the window so I guess this is going to be a donation because who has time to fiddle with this thing I've already spent hours trying to just steam water on the test. It's impossible. I am very experienced at using scientific instruments as a chemist, working in a lab and I figured an Instant pot in your kitchen should be something that ANYONE can do and I don't see how people are using this if I can't get it to work unless there's something defective with my unit.

If you're looking for an Instant Pot that doesn't take over your kitchen but still does everything you need, I highly recommend this one. It has been a fantastic purchase!

reviews.review_title: Nice Instant Pot With a Couple of Drawbacks
reviews.review_description:
PROS:

1) Aesthetically pleasing appearance in my upgraded light kitchen, much prettier than my other black and stainless Instant Pots. Even the panel is mostly white. Color is a soft white or very light off white, not stark white which I was hoping for.

2) Much quieter than my other 3 and 6 quart Instant Pots. No loud obnoxious beeps.

3) The release button is on the front of the lid rather than next to the pressure release spout making it much much safer to use.

4) The glass lid from my 6 quart Instant Pot unit fits this container so they are interchangeable. A huge plus since the unit doesn’t come with a cover for refrigeration.

5) I love the wider shorter bowl which makes it easier to cook and serve.

6) I like that it has both high and low temperature settings for Slow Cook unlike my 3 quart Instant Pot.

CONS:

1) Cord is cheap and flimsy, nothing like the more substantial 3 pronged cord on my other Instant Pot units. This was a huge downgrade. And it’s black, an eyesore on this otherwise very pretty unit. Should have used a better quality white cord. I’m purchasing a sleeve for it.

2) Electric Cord is not detachable like with my other Instant Pot units so you can’t replace it in case you want something longer or shorter or better quality or just want to remove it for storage.

3) You can’t purchase additional replacement containers in this size and shape which I was able to do with my other Instant Pot units. Hopefully they’ll eventually manufacture them. But in the meantime the one container is all I have.

4) The Pressure Cook/Steam settings have only one temperature unlike my other stainless Instant Pot units which had both low and high options. I consider this a rather significant downgrade. After using it several times and judging by how long it takes to heat up, cook, and depressurize the temp seems to be high. Disappointing as I always used the low temp setting before.

Overall I like the RIO except for the cord and that I can’t buy extra containers. So far it’s working well. I’ve already made soup, pasta, and rice which came out perfect.

I’ve had this Instant Pot for over 6 months now and finally came back to leave a review. I honestly use it a lot more than I expected! The 4QT size is perfect for me and my roommate, big enough to make a few servings but doesn’t take up too much space in the kitchen.

I’ve made chicken soup, beef stew, rice, and a bunch of other things in it, and everything has turned out really well. It’s especially nice for soups and stews because I can just put everything in and let it cook without having to watch the stove. Super convenient when I’m busy or just don’t feel like cooking too much lol.

Really happy with it after using it for months. Definitely one of my most useful kitchen purchases!

I've been using this Instant pot almost every day now, and it has made cooking so much easier. I use it regularly for meal prep and to make soups, rice, beans, lentils, potatoes, and other quick meals. It's especially helpful on busy days because I can start it and walk away instead of standing by the stove.

The Pressure Cook, Sauté, Steam, Rice, and Yogurt functions all work really well, and I love the Keep Warm feature - it keeps food at a good temperature until everyone is ready to eat.

It takes a few minutes to come to pressure before cooking starts, and depending on the recipe, you'll also need time for the pressure to release. But once you know that, it's pretty easy to factor into your meal planning.

It has saved me a lot of time and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a versatile multi-cooker.

reviews.review_title: I guess I like kitchen gadgets now...
reviews.review_description:
I was always pretty anti-kitchen gadgets. The InstantPot seemed like just another thing that did stuff I could already do on my stove or oven. Boy, was I wrong.

I honestly am in disbelief how much I love using this thing. It is so versatile that I use it more than anything else in my kitchen, except maybe the sink.

The reasons why? Well, for starters it’s super easy to clean. Instead of making a mess with multiple pans and pots and lids with food stuff splattering everywhere, the InstantPot is one thing that’s fully contained. When the timer ends I take out the food, clean the pot, and wipe down the lid and little “gutter” and that’s it. Two, it’s so FAST! Now, granted some things will feel like they take the same or similar amount of time when pressure cooking because the machine has to build pressure. BUT, the difference is that I can set this and LEAVE! When it’s ready it beeps and I can choose to keep the food warm or have it stop cooking when the timer is done.

What really sold me on finally purchasing this is the air fryer attachment. I’ve been wanting an air fryer so this was much cheaper than buying everything separately. I will say that while I do love the air fryer it’s probably not the best on the market. When using a two-tiered basket, whatever is in the top portion *will* be more cooked than the bottom. This is a problem I will try to fix by simply removing the top portion when it’s cooked and letting the bottom cook longer until it’s done. Not ideal, but for delicious air fried food ans the convenience of having these capabilities from one machine at this price, I’ll make do.

I recommend purchasing an InstantPot cookbook to accompany this. It will help acquaint you to how this machine can be used, even if the cookbook is more oriented towards one of the models without the air fryer.

What do I use this for? So far I’ve made vegan chana masala (yum!), vegan banana bread (yum!), air fried Brussels sprouts (yum!), truffle fries (you get the idea). I’ve also used this to steam food to make dog food for my pup with allergies. One of my favorite things to use this for is dry goods!! I will dump a whole bag of dry beans or quinoa or whatever in the pot, add spices, water, set it, and it’s done to perfection so quickly! I’ll then can everything and freeze it so I have beans and quinoa on hand all the time whenever I need them for a meal! It’s the best! Not to mention the pressure cooker seems to really INFUSE whatever you’re cooking with the spices you choose. The beans I’ve made with this I’ve eaten plain they were so so tasty!

I live with roommates but this has been the best purchase ever. I’m lucky to have the room to store it, but it’s also great because they can cook on the stove or in the oven if they want, and I have everything I need right in this InstantPot so no one has to wait on anyone to clear out before they can do their own thing.

Things I wish it did differently:

- I wish the display showed seconds. Minor inconvenience but the display in general makes it feel cheap.

- I wish the display showed what setting it was on and what action it was currently doing. For example, a small icon for “pressure cooking” so you can remember that you chose the correct setting. Or a little icon that showed it was building pressure so you don’t think you didn’t hit “start” or something before waking away. Also, something that showed the current temperature inside instead of what you set it to so you know how things are cooking or heating up/cooling down.

- A persistant beep every minute or so when food is finished cooking.

reviews.review_title: Multifunction kitchen device that works? This must be 2020...
reviews.review_description:
Grabbed this on black friday promo as it saved on counter space combining instant pot and airfrier. Haven’t trued the dehydrator, but both of its primary functions work well. Makes better rice than American rice cookers, but so so compared to a Zojirushi. Thanksgiving was easier with this as it saved over space and made air fried potato skins the MVP casserole topping and brussel sprouts crisp. Cleaning the air fry lid might be difficult one day, but didn’t seem to need much the first few weeks of repeated use. Also has slow cooker capability. Importantly, the bucket is stainless steel, so no teflon flakes to give you cancer when it inevitably starts flaking off. The air fry basket may have a teflon coating though, so be careful with washing it and poking contents during mid cycle turns.

The interface is clunky, but better than having bluetooth and an app that stops working after the latest ios release and makes the thing stop working altogether after an unwanted or failed firmware update pushed out to better steal your personal info and sell it to advertisers. PSA: “smart” speakers or fridges or tvs are not smart to buy, particularly if they have no “dumb” or disconnected capabilities. If you do buy a smart device and keep it airgapped (offline) don’t let it ever connect as devices denied updates for a time may brick themselves when first connected years later because they attempt to jump through too many updates simultaneously. This killed a grandparent’s walmart tv in good working order after being plugged into ethernet for the first time post relocation move as the manufacturer had never considered a user going from firmware v 1.1 to 4.1 in one jump rather than 1 to 2 to 3 to 4. (Steps off soapbox).

Yeah, this thing is worth it despite breaking some of Alton Brown’s kitchen device rules. Replaced my crock pot, rice cooker, lack of dehydrator, and lack of airfrier. Don’t make popcorn in it unless testing your smoke alarm or trying to get guests out of your house. Shouldn’t have to say this, but don’t dishwasher the electric parts like the frier lid.

reviews.review_title: Durable non-stick pot and features that other models at this price don't have
reviews.review_description:
While this is a pretty standard pressure cooker for this price point, I chose this one because most don't have a sous vide function. Overall I am happy with it. I have a higher end brand at home, but purchased this during an extended stay with family and it's been perfect in that context. So far I have not noticed a big difference between this model and the name brand. In at least one respect, this model is better. The non-stick pot seems far more durable than the name brand. I haven't been careful with this pot, and in a few weeks of heavy use (like once a day), there's no discoloration or dinging through the non-stick coating.

As noted, it has a sous vide function. Don't sleep on this, getting pre-marinated meat at the market and popping it in the water bath without even opening the packaging is incredibly nice; the meat turns out great, it's incredibly forgiving, and there's zero clean-up. It's particularly choice for dinner parties where everyone hangs out beforehand and you want to be able to serve hot food as soon as everyone sits down. Only down side compared to a standalone sous vide is that you're limited to the area of the pot (though the pot is big so it fits most jobs), and the time to heat the water is long compared to the standalone.

A few minor quibbles: the yogurt function is not great.. There is no built-in boil function, so that must be done independently. I had been very happy with the name brand version, as there is very little scalding, which is the big down side of doing it stove-top. You can use the saute function to boil in this model, but you have to babysit it more. The non-stick pot does a pretty good job of avoiding scalding but I don't trust it enough to walk away like you can with other models. Given no boil feature, the Comfee basically holds the milk to the yogurt temperature. That means you have to have a thermometer to test the temp yourself prior to adding the cultures, or risk killing them. Other models self-regulate and let you know when you can add the cultures. You also cannot easily add time if you check the yogurt and it's still too runny. A minor issue, but a surprising one. I'll still use this to make yogurt, but I'm guessing the sous vide function is a better way to do the post-boiling steps.

Second, the manual is pretty worthless. The model works like most pressure cookers, but the buttons are not quite consistent with other brands ("Level" is not the best choice of description). So, I wouldn't give this model to, e.g., my mother who's never used a pressure cooker before, as it would likely be too confusing. I'm a frequent user of other models and have been for years, and I even found it a little less clear than I'd like. On top of this, unlike name brands, there is no real quick start guide or recipe book. Not an issue for me, but might be for some.

Third, the pressure valve is a little subtle and a little spitty(?) It always takes me a second to feel out which way is sealed and which is open, as the markings are faint and the rise between the two is subtle. Fancier models either make this really clear, or automatically seal when you close the lid. The valve on this feels very old school. And because the release is manual (turning the valve by hand rather than sliding a button, e.g.), it requires more care to quick release the pressure without burning yourself. The release spigot tends to spit a little, so I find I need to be very careful. On other models, I would trust my pre-teen kid to be able to use it without any worry, but for this model, I'd be worried they'd hurt themselves from carelessness.

Finally, the choice of included extras is a little unusual: a rice cup (3/4 cup, as you'd get with a rice cooker), a rice paddle, a deep serving spoon, and a trivet. I didn't notice markings inside the bowl that show how much water you add per rice cup serving, so I'm not entirely sure why the rice cup. The rice paddle is an unexpected positive, though I suspect most people who are frequent rice eaters probably already have one that came with a rice cooker. Still, perhaps a good thing for college students or others who have limited space for small kitchen appliances who may actually use this as a rice cooker. I do like the included spoon, as I keep it in the pot when not in use and thus always have it for serving directly from the cooker. The fact that it's right there is a good way to never use metal on the non-stick surface.

All that said, the durability of the pot is a much bigger deal than the minor negatives, all of which can be worked around. At this price point, the features and build seem on par with more expensive models, other than the throwback valve.

reviews.review_title: I like that the app has a "Timed Venting" option
reviews.review_description:
Updated 12/29/24 - My Instant Pot timed venting wish has finally come true, so I just changed my rating to five stars. They added a new app option when timed venting is selected, so now you can choose the amount of time you want to vent the pot. It takes the guessing game out of using the timed venting feature. It's the addition I have been hoping for ever since they added timed venting to the app.

Updated 9/27/24: They just added a new notification feature to the app and I really like it. You get a push status notification when the pressure cooker starts preheating, then moves to the cooking cycle, then goes into venting mode and when it completes the venting cycle. It's particularly helpful to get notified when it goes into the venting process in case you want to precisely time the venting based on what you are cooking. It's a helpful enhancement.

Original review - I have an older model 6 QT Instant Pot Pro and I wanted this new one for its ability to connect to wifi, so I can use the app to control it. I especially like that the app has an extra venting option that is not available on the panel of the Instant Pot itself. It's a "Timed" option (see photo) that I actually discovered by accident when I was programming a cooking cycle. It's not explained anywhere in the documentation or even in the app, but it's very helpful when doing grains where I want it to natural release for a few minutes and then quickly finish the release without manual intervention. This is where the "Timed" option comes in. It seems to kick in about five to seven minutes after natural release starts. It varies, maybe based on how full the pot is, but since there's no documentation, it's just a guess on my part. It works great because I can be anywhere in the house and not have to rush to my kitchen to manually change the venting to quick release. I really love being able to monitor the progress from my iPhone and see when it has finished whatever cycle I've chosen.

The cooking pot itself is different than my older model. It has two handles on it so it makes lifting the hot pot out of the unit so easy. I also like that it automatically seals itself when you lock the lid. No more manually turning a small knob from venting to sealing. That makes it foolproof. It cooks the same way as my older model, but these new options make it my preferred pot. It doesn't have as many preprogrammed settings as my older model, but I never really used those anyway. I like to use the standard pressure cook option and choose the cooking times and the pressure and venting levels myself.

I took one star off because "Timed Venting" is not a feature on the unit and it's not explained in any documentation, but it's offered as a feature in the app. I think they need to point that out somewhere and not leave it up to consumers to find it by accident or have to guess to see how it works.

reviews.review_title: Techies like us, love having Bluetooth accessibility! Great InstantPot!
reviews.review_description:
Our original InstantPot just "bit the dust." We LOVED having it and it produced many, many wonderful memories meals for us.

While we mourned the passing of our "Old Faithful" InstantPot, I decided to start researching other electric pressure cookers and again, we came back to InstantPot and wanted to see what options they had. After reading all of the reviews and articles on this particular model, I told my wife 'PLEASE, PLEASE get me this one for Christmas!" She said, you can go ahead and order it but you're not allowed to open it until Christmas! Like anyone, I said YES!!!!

I opened it and then downloaded the app being that it is Bluetooth compatible. I cannot tell you enough, what a pleasant surprise it was, to see just how easy it was to set up and connect via our home WiFi. I can now use the app to set the time, the release time, etc. It's amazingly friendly to use and works great. One thing I will tell you is that if you, like me, use the Saute' mode, to first brown meat, you can NOT start hte InstantPot in this mode via the app. You must physically hit the start button in order to have the Saute' mode come on. Yes, you can set it up in the app but cannot physically start the InstantPot in this particular mode. I know I"m repating myself but I want to make sure that everyone understands this. To me, it's a safety feature and I can appreciate why it's done this way. The last thing you want to do is to accidently have your InstantPot start in this mode while you're away or remote.

PROS: Excellent quality, every time I turn it on, it immediately conects to the WiFi and can be accessed via the app

CONS: None noted at the time of this review.

There are a ton of youtube videos, showing you not only how to use it but how to make one pot dinners.

It's easy to use, wifi is easy to set up which afterwards connects whether you are using the app or not, to show remaining cooking time. I only have basic cooking skills, so I prefer to watch the youtube videos for recipes than the app for now.

Food prep always takes the longest, but once you have everything ready, put the food in, close the lid, set the time and wait for it to finish.

When you set a time according to a recipe, that is the actual Pressure Cooking time. The unit has to preheat before Pressure Cooking time begins, and that's several minutes depending on the model. Then the unit has to vent the pressure (choice of Natural, Pulse, or Quick Vent.) Be careful with Quick Vent as it may make some meats tougher than if you simply waited for the Natural vent process.

If you enable push notifications, it will tell you when preheating has ended and cooking has begun, and of course when cooking has ended and venting has begun (you'll likely hear the venting process from the next room.

Everything but the base is dishwasher safe on the top rack, BUT, you should use a milder soap like when washing by hand, not the regular somewhat harsh dishwasher soap. The stainless steel pot didn't come quite as clean as it should have, so a little scrubbing in the sink made it bright again. You could always wash it with your regular dishwasher load (but not the other parts (lid, sealing ring, some small vent parts.)

I'm pleased with my purchase and have planned a whole week of cooking meals in it.

I'm currently using a simple recipe of chicken, onions, honey, soy sauce, and garlic. Smells good.

reviews.review_title: Better Features than Older Models - But Several Important Differences
reviews.review_description:
This is my second instant pot. My IP Ultra model recently died so I had to upgrade. Here are several important differences from previous models:

1) The inner pot has two hand holders - this is great because the previous models would swirl around when stirring. This new version prevents that from happening.

2) The cord is not removable - not a huge deal, but wondering why they would make this change. The cord is located in the back left corner. So plugging into an outlet on the back right made for a strange bend in the cord. Wondering why they can't simply place the cord in the back middle. Not a deal breaker for me, but you should be aware of it.

3) Steam valve: this works a bit differently than other models. No way to manually vent or release steam. It has to be done through the control panel. It is possible to change the setting mid-stream, but there is a delay of a few seconds once you input on the control panel.

4) Older IP accessories may not work - I used to do Pot-in-Pot cooking with a 2 level PIP on top of a trivet. This worked fine in my Instant Pot Ultra. But the first time I tried it in my IP Pro Plus, the pin got stuck, and the lid locked closed. I couldn't open it because the pin needed room to clear. I managed to figure a way out to open it by turning the pot upside down. But this new IP seems to have a slightly lower clearance. So you'll have to use a shorter trivet, or a shorter PIP. Otherwise your lid may get stuck in locked mode.

The bluetooth/wireless feature seems nice, but I tend to use the pot while I'm at home anyway. So I'm not sure how helpful it will be over time. But you do have the ability to turn on the IP while you're away from home. It involves downloading an app and connecting your IP to the wifi. The phone app gives notifications when the pre-heating is done, so thats a nice feature.

The other main reason I bought this was because of the pressure canning. You can fit up to 4 quart size mason jars to can food. This is really nice. Because of its higher temperature/pressure abilities, this IP can theoretically cook food faster vs older models. I haven't tried it out yet.

They also have a feature called "Nutriboost". This is simply a feature where the IP lets out steam periodically. Food in the inner pot then gets agitated. If this is done periodically throughout, then the food gets stirred. Its good for things like risotto and dhals where you want a smooth consistency. Its a nice feature but the name is a little misleading -- nothing about this boosts nutrition. It is simply a fancy way to stir your food while pressure cooking.

I can find the exact same model we ordered on their website. The one they "don't sell"

Final update: Contacted Amazon and explained the situation. They immediately refunded our money (thank you). We ordered again without much hope. To our surprise, the package that arrived today was the correct pot in the correct box finally

Buyer beware, the device itself is fantastic but if your box comes with tape all over it you probably didn't get what you ordered. I am leaving this at 1 star because Instant Pot customer servicw was absolutley abyssmal and refused to even try to correct the situation. I would buy from a local appliance store vs. online because of this...getting what we ordered has been a lot of uneccesary drama.

The pot itself can be reviewed now:

The set in handles that keep the pot from spinning around while you sautee are fantastic. They fit firmly in place and make lifting the pot out easy.

The liner pot is MUCH higher quality than the regular instant pots. The disc bottom is thicker than the original pots, and fully 3 ply clad, and it shows. There is no convex in the center of the bottom so you can keep food where you want it.

The steam release is variable and no touch. The 3 setting options are great and require much less attention/timer setting. It is also MUCH quieter than previous models.

The Keep Warm setting can now be used as a reheat setting, with a high, medium, low and custom temp.

The Nutriboost setting is useful for gently shaking the pot while cooking to help blend better and keep food from sticking to the bottom initially.

The buld seems very sturdy, very pleased over all with the additional features and functions of this pot. Would recommend, but suggest buying in person to avoid getting scammed.

I had an old Instant Pot duo for two years and I loved using it, I ended up getting this one because of the canning feature on it and I’m absolutely obsessed! The app works amazing with it it cans my beans beautifully genuinely love this Instant Pot! I think my friends are getting tired of hearing me. Talk about Instant Pot cooking. I’m keeping my other Instant Pot too so I can have two on hand :-)

It’s very well made, easy to clean and the settings are very clearly marked so it’s easy to use. I made a pot roast and was able to sear the meat and then cook it. The inside part is very easy to clean. You can pressure cook on low or high , it’s also a slow cooker. It appears to be durable. It’s also attractive, I got the blue color. Good value, too.

reviews.review_title: Quick & easy to use. Makes everything better with a Ninja!
reviews.review_description: Very easy to use. The size (6 1/2 qt) is perfect for a small family or couple. I made some chicken soup using 6 cups of broth, 2 lbs chicken, 2 sweet potatoes & 8 cups of fresh spinach with room for more. The chicken was Soooo tender! Very durable with a nice heavy cooking pot (not too heavy for older folks). Worked exactly as advertised. Great price and being a Ninja brand is a Plus!

I'm obsessed with Ninja stuff and honestly want everything they make. This cooker is so good—heats up super fast, built tough, and really easy to use. Totally worth the money, no messy leaks, and does so many things. Glad I got it!

I am a huge fan of the Ninja brand. I absolutely love my Ninja glass air fryer, so when I was looking for a new electric pressure cooker, I was torn between buying this Ninja model with its ceramic-coated interior (which is not the cheapest option on the market) or choosing a stainless-steel interior cooker from another brand. In the end, I decided to trust Ninja again, and I can honestly say I do not regret my decision. After using it for several weeks, I feel ready to share my experience.

The Pressure Cook function is amazing. It can cook meals in about 10 minutes, which honestly seemed unbelievable to me at first. I have made beans, meats, and different dishes, and I was impressed by how quickly everything was ready while still maintaining great flavor and texture. I also love the Sear/Sauté function because it allows you to brown and sauté your ingredients before pressure cooking. The process is faster and more convenient than other cookers I have used, and it adds so much flavor to the final dish. After that, you simply switch to pressure cooking, and the results are delicious.

I absolutely love this cooker and truly believe it is worth every penny I spent on it. The quality, versatility, and ease of use have exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and high-quality multicooker.

This cooker works very well, it is true to it's name and heats up very quickly. I have cooked quite a few meals in the Hyper Heat and all came out good. My only issue is that you need the glass lid to use the slow cooker function but it did not come with one so I had to order the lid. I have a lot of Ninja products and i can say they never disappoint.

I bought this to replace my much older Ninja pressure cooker. I LOVE the color blocking since I leave my cooker on my counter because I use it so much. Easy to clean compared to my older version. Easy to use and offers lots of additional accessories you can purchase separately. Very happy with my purchase
Have made many meals in here, would but again, saves me so much time

reviews.review_description:
I was in need of a new electric toothbrush, and as someone who has had braces for nearly 3 years (2nd round of braces as well), a water flosser is a helpful luxury.

The toothbrush itself has good vibration, with different strength levels and modes, so I think it definitely gets the job done. The color is very pretty (I got pink), and it comes with 4 brush heads total.

The water floss machine is very portable. It is easy to hold in your hand without being too bulky, and the water tank holds a sufficient amount. If you're still figuring out the water flossing technique like me, you may have to refill the tank once during use, but once I get the hang of it I'm sure I can stretch one tank for a single session. The water flosser comes with 4 heads total, one of them being a tongue scraper.

Aside from the products and their attachments, they do not come with any sort of travel accessories. The toothbrush has a little cap that covers the end of it when there is no brush head attached, and the water flosser has space in the tank to attach 2 (i think?) heads to carry. Otherwise, there is no brush head covers that came with mine, nor is there a travel case or bag.

This isn't an issue for me, as I can just buy a cheap travel case. The products themselves are great, and both the toothbrush and the water flosser come with charging cords. I haven't had any issues attaching or removing the accessories, and using the toothbrush and flosser is pretty easy and straightforward. All around, these products are pretty solid for such a good price and convenient combo!

Read more

I purchased this combo because I had never tried to water floss before and thought I would give it a try after reading reviews. It is a great value for your money. The two together you can’t purchase for this price in the store. Not in my area anyway. The battery last for days without charging. I have forgotten to charge mine for several days and it still worked. The toothbrush is noisy. I wish it was a little more quiet so I could use it when my husband is still asleep. I normally brush on the days he is off and sleeps in later than me on the weekends. The quality of the product is good. It reaches all areas and I like that it has a built in timer that makes it go off when you have brushed for long enough. The water flows is amazing on my gums and teeth. I love that I can choose my level of intensity. It does exactly what it was made to do. I am amazed at how much better my teeth and gums feel. I love the pink color. I even purchased my husband the black one. He loves these also.

Very efficient! Brush is very nice, comfortable I feel it cleans well, the water pik is good I feel it could be a little stronger but I love that they came together! Portable which is great and it does have several accessories. Charges quickly.

reviews.review_title: If you want a CLEAN mouth...
reviews.review_description: This is the best toothbrush EVER! Buy it, what are you waiting for? Seriously! The price is unbeatable! In comparison to the pricier quip toothbrushes, this one beats it! It's so functional, you can FEEL the cleanliness, and it WHITENS!! I purchased about two months ago and I have yet to charge it. It has different speed levels and it is not noisy. It's also not heavy despite looking bulky. Highly recommend this toothbrush.

I love my tooth brush set. It works great and I've only had to charge it 3 or 4 times within the past couple months.

The tooth brush bristles are a little softer than what in used to but I like it. Beings it's an electronic toothbrush, I think it's better with the softer bristles.

The water flosser is great. I love all of the different connections. They absolutely come in handy. I know I've used all of them at least once. Oh, and the setting options are awesome. Different strengths and patterns for both the toothbrush and the water flosser. Most flossers that I've tried didn't have enough pressure. This one does! I'm very pleased with this product. 😉

Good quality for toothbrush and waterpik. Very easy to use. I will say that for the toothbrush the bristles are rough so if you have sensitive gums possibly use a different head. Settings were easy to use.

FIRST time ever using a water floss at home but I can genuinely tell you this is the cleanest my n mouth has felt in years! I have veneers and whewwwwwww this flosser does its thing!! You can feel the suction in btw your teeth the quality seems great as of now , has the extra tongue cleaner as well! I honestly love this!

reviews.review_title: Well worth the money and good quality!
reviews.review_description: Was very impressed with the quality of these items compared to the price. Well worth it if these ever wear out I would definitely buy it again. But on a funny note if you go to knock it over while it's sitting on the sink and you grab it quick be careful because if it's facing you chances are you'll grab the button turn it on and squirt you in the eyes. It happened to me and I couldn't stop laughing because it was a perfect shot but of course it was just water but still funny as heck. reviews.review_title: Makes my teeth feel as clean as coming from the dentist
reviews.review_description:
So far, I am pleased with this electric toothbrush. I don’t think I’ve even explored the different modes yet (like the gum care mode), but I really just need it to perform its basic function of brushing my teeth.

I haven’t updated my electric toothbrush in many years. I had an older model of the same brand, and it just seemed like the motor/batter had gotten weak and it wasn’t functioning that well anymore.

I was definitely correct because this new Philips Sonicare packs much more of a punch compared to my old one. It was almost a little too much at first but I just needed a couple of days to adjust and now it’s great. I’ve noticed my teeth feel incredibly smooth all day long, like they do immediately after I go for a cleaning at the dentist. Now I regret not updating sooner because I think this will be great for my dental hygiene.

I got this on a prime day sale so it is absolutely worth the money, however having used it now I would have been happy paying full price for the update in quality compared to my old brush. I haven’t been able to test the battery life yet, but we have travel coming up so I am happy that it comes with a travel case.

Personally I love the modern look of the black brush, but it was hard to choose a color. It actually does feel nice to hold as well, when comparing it to my old one. It is slightly smaller and sleeker and slightly lighter weight. But not so light that it feels cheap, it still seems solid.

Obviously I haven’t had it long enough to know how long it will last. But the old one (which again was the same brand) was still going after almost a decade. So if I get that long out of it, I will be very happy.

Read more

reviews.review_title: Healthier Gums and a Cleaner Smile
reviews.review_description:
I’ve been very pleased with this Philips Sonicare toothbrush. After using it consistently, I’ve noticed a significant improvement in my gum health. My gums no longer bleed when I brush, which has been a wonderful and encouraging change.

The toothbrush leaves my teeth feeling much cleaner than a manual toothbrush, and I appreciate the built-in timer that helps me brush for the recommended amount of time. The different cleaning modes are easy to use, and the battery life has been excellent between charges.

As a retired pharmacist, I understand how important good oral hygiene is to overall health. Investing in a quality electric toothbrush has been well worth it, and seeing healthier gums has been the biggest benefit for me.

I would highly recommend the Philips Sonicare to anyone looking to improve their oral health, especially if they’re experiencing sensitive or bleeding gums. With regular use and good brushing habits, it has made a noticeable difference for me.

I can feel my teeth thanking me at night for getting a step up in motor for my electric toothbrush. It’s been like a month and my teeth look whiter and constantly feel cleaner. Prime Day this was the best bargain imo.

Holds charge well, I’m guessing it will be durable because I’ve never really had a Phillips Sonicare break on me they just lose battery eventually.

Fits my mouth and I like having multiple settings.

reviews.review_title: Fantastic clean, superb build quality, and great battery life
reviews.review_description:
As an Amazon Vine Voice reviewer, I have tested my fair share of personal care devices, and the Philips Sonicare 5950 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush immediately sets a high bar. Out of the box, you can tell this is a top tier, premium product with a lot of thought put into the engineering and design.

The matte black finish looks sleek on the bathroom counter, but more importantly, the build quality feels incredibly solid. The handle has a nice weight to it, offering a comfortable, ergonomic grip that does not feel slippery when wet. The buttons have a satisfying click with zero play, and the brush heads snap on with a tight, precise fit. It feels durable and well sealed against water, which is essential for long term use.

When it comes to performance, it leaves your teeth with that fresh, dentist clean feel every single time. The sonic vibration power is strong and consistent without feeling harsh on your gums, and the pressure sensor works like a charm to let you know if you are pressing too hard. Having the two brush heads included in the box is a great touch, making it ready for months of use right away.

The battery life is equally impressive. A single full charge easily lasts for weeks of twice daily brushing, making it super convenient for travel without having to haul extra cords around.

If you are looking for a high quality, reliable electric toothbrush that looks modern and delivers serious cleaning power, this one is worth every penny. Extremely well made and easily recommended.

Read more

These Sonicare ebrushes work pretty well. We rely on them for daily cleaning and we are pretty satisfied with them.

Use the provided travel container when packing them ( my wife did not and it broke) or at least take out the brush.

They tend to collect some crap between the brush and the handle. They last a couple years before the buttons cover breaks up and water enter the handle, affecting the battery. Twice happened to me and they start vibrating unexpectedly like they are possed LOL ( hence the 4 stars.)

Amazing. I have been using Sonicare toothbrushes for over 20 years. I decided it was time for an upgrade, but never knew they had so many versions. I chose this series as it appeared to have the right amount of bells and whistles I needed, and it was affordable. Wow. I have never been so impressed by a toothbrush, and did not realize there would be such a difference compared to my older simple version. It is powerful, but soft on the gums, so my teeth feel like they're getting scrubbed, yet there is no irritation or pressure on the gums. It has different speeds, including one for gum health. Weird to be going on so much over a toothbrush, but what a difference. Looking forward to my next dental appointment for the real truth.

reviews.review_title: I never had a tooth brush like this.
reviews.review_description:
I used to just have the mediocre vibrating toothbrushes but at work I would notice spots the brush missed. After my dentist recommended something like this, I checked it out for Prime Day and saw it was around $50 so I decided to try it out and i was blown away at how clean my teeth felt after one brushing! It was like leaving the dentists office after they cleaned your teeth. Definitely worth the price but try and wait for a sale 💕

I charged it once out of the box and within 2 months I still am at full charge! Comes with a travel case too.

I had a Sonocare a long time ago and switched to Oral-B because I liked it better. My dentist told me she thought the Sonocare was better for cleaning and gums so I switched to the Sonocare. I was surprised by how much it has improved over the years. My teeth feel much cleaner after brushing. The Sonocare is much more powerful and the head is much faster now. I expect my next checkup and cleaning to be much better. If you have sensitive teeth it offers 3 speeds to fit your needs. After I brush now my teeth feel like they were just cleaned at the dentist office. My only complaint is the price of replacement brush heads, ridiculous high prices are a typical USA industry ripping off Americans witch is out of control!

reviews.review_title: Incredible Battery Life and Fantastic Clean!
reviews.review_description:

Having 5 different modes and 3 intensity levels means anyone can find their perfect setting. It’s gentle enough for sensitive areas and braces but powerful enough to tackle plaque easily.

On top of the stellar performance, it comes with 8 replacement brush heads, which easily covers a couple of years of use right out of the box. The sleek black design looks great on the bathroom counter, too. If you’re looking for a high-quality, long-lasting sonic toothbrush without the premium price tag, this is absolutely the one to get. Highly recommend!

I’m extremely impressed with this electric toothbrush! The combination of 5 cleaning modes and 3 intensity levels makes it easy to customize the brushing experience, especially for those with sensitive teeth or braces. I was worried that an electric toothbrush might be too harsh, but the adjustable intensity settings allow for a gentle yet effective clean.

The different modes are great for everyday cleaning, gum care, whitening, and sensitive areas.

One of the best features is the inclusion of 8 replacement brush heads, which provides excellent value and means you won't need to purchase extras anytime soon. The brush heads are soft, durable, and reach difficult areas with ease.

After using it for a week, my teeth feel noticeably cleaner, and my gums seem healthier. The battery life is impressive, and the toothbrush is lightweight and comfortable to hold.

Overall, this is a fantastic electric toothbrush that offers premium features at a great value. I highly recommend it for anyone with sensitive teeth, braces, or anyone looking to upgrade their oral care routine.

reviews.review_title: One of the Best Purchases I’ve Made!
reviews.review_description: I absolutely love this rechargeable electric toothbrush! It provides powerful vibrations that leave my teeth feeling incredibly clean after every use. The battery lasts a long time, and being waterproof makes it perfect for everyday use. I also love that it comes with several replacement brush heads, which makes it an even better value. It’s easy to use, comfortable to hold, and has become one of my favorite purchases. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for an affordable, high-quality electric toothbrush.

I've purchased three 7MAGIC hair dryers before, and they've never disappointed me. This electric toothbrush continues that positive experience. It feels well made, delivers powerful cleaning, and offers excellent value for the price.

The sonic vibration is strong yet comfortable, and I like having multiple brushing modes and intensity levels to choose from. The long battery life is a huge plus, and including eight brush heads means I won't need replacements for a long time.

Overall, this is a good-quality toothbrush with great performance and thoughtful features. Based on my experience with other 7MAGIC products, this brand continues to impress. Highly recommended!

reviews.review_title: Best toothbrush ever and it’s pink!!!!
reviews.review_description: I was skeptical because of the price but I ordered another one for my partner right after I brushed my teeth with it the first time. I got smooth clean teeth the very first brushing with this toothbrush! It felt like I just left the dentist. It has multiple settings. My partner loves his. This is the best toothbrush I have ever had. I like this one better than the $60 one I had a few years ago.

reviews.review_title: Reliable, affordable and easy to use
reviews.review_description:
I’ve been using an inexpensive battery powered toothbrush for the last few years. A friend suggested this 7Magic Sonic Electric Toothbrush. I’m so happy to upgrade! The battery powered one was becoming difficult to find replacement heads and would often break when trying to change the battery. This 7Magic Electric toothbrush is hands down the best toothbrush I’ve ever owned. My teeth feel cleaner. The charge lasts a long time. I love the 3 different speeds and cleaning options from Sensitive, gum care, polish, whitening to cleaning! I’ve been pleasantly surprised by the overall quality!!

When it arrived, there was already a full charge, ready to use right away. The extra brush heads are also a huge bonus, I now don’t need to worry about trying to find a replacement any time soon.

For the price, I think this toothbrush is a great value. I would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for an affordable and reliable electric toothbrush.

reviews.review_title: Great tooth brush, but needs a durable travel case as well
reviews.review_description: I ordered this toothbrush in pink for myself, and I really like it especially that it comes with 8 replacement heads. Also, the charger for the toothbrush is a regular newer Apple iPhone cord which makes taking it with you and charging it very convenient. My husband liked my toothbrush, so I told him I’d order one for him in the black color for our anniversary. It just arrived and we were sent the navy blue color. Not the color I chose or paid for, but he doesn’t want to waste the time for me to exchange it for the black one. reviews.review_title: A Report from the Front Lines of Oral Hygiene
reviews.review_description:
Dateline: A Bathroom Sink, Under the Unforgiving Glare of the Vanity Lights. For years, the act of brushing your teeth has been a sleepy, half-conscious affair. A dull, buzzing ritual performed on autopilot before you either face the horrors of the day or collapse into bed. You thought you knew what an electric toothbrush felt like. You were wrong. You were living a lie.

I am here to tell you about the Philips Sonicare 4100. And I am here to tell you that it is a different beast entirely.

It sits in your hand with a comfortable, substantial heft—a proper tool, not some flimsy, skinny wand. The handle is sturdy, the build quality immaculate. It feels like a serious instrument for a serious job. I applied the paste, brought the brush to my teeth with the casual indifference born of long habit, and thumbed the power button.

And was immediately jolted awake by a profound, high-frequency thrum.

This was not the gentle back-and-forth of a lesser brush. This was a jump scare. A sudden, powerful hum that felt like I was holding a swarm of microscopic, hyper-caffeinated jackhammers against my teeth. This is the "sonic" part of the name, a technology that vibrates with a speed and intensity that is both shocking and deeply, profoundly effective. You can feel the difference. It's a sensation of being deep-cleaned, of having years of coffee stains and bad decisions power-washed into oblivion.

There are smart features, of course. A pressure sensor that gently chides you if you're pressing too hard, a built-in coach to keep you from savaging your own gums. A timer that dutifully guides you through the quadrants of your mouth. The included cap for the brush head is a simple, welcome touch of practical genius.

But we must address the one, single, baffling decision that holds this marvel back from pure, unadulterated perfection: the charger. In a world that has finally, blessedly, begun to standardize around the glorious, universal USB-C port, Philips has chosen to tether this futuristic cleaning wand to a proprietary, old-world charging base. It is a strange, frustrating relic, a small annoyance that requires its own dedicated spot on your counter, unable to join the happy family of your other modern chargers.

Even so, that one grievance is a whisper in the face of the roaring, high-frequency hurricane of cleaning power this toothbrush provides. The Sonicare 4100 is an impressive, powerful, and brilliantly effective piece of technology. It transforms the most mundane of daily chores into a high-performance event. A five-star champion that will leave your mouth feeling cleaner than you ever thought possible.

I’ve been using this Sonicare toothbrush for a little while now, and I’m really happy with it. It leaves my teeth feeling much cleaner than when I use a regular toothbrush, especially around the gumline.

I used Sonicare for years but started buying less expensive toothbrushes. I wasn’t happy with most of them and was surprised to see a Sonicare toothbrush at this price. It had good reviews so I purchased one. It works really well. The toothbrush head is small enough that I can get it to my back teeth and the built in timer lets me know that I’m brushing long enough. reviews.review_title: Best toothbrush you'll ever have until it inevitably breaks too soon
reviews.review_description:

reviews.review_description:

reviews.review_title: Lasted 12 years before I had to buy it again! Superior clean without the hefty price.
reviews.review_description:
After an incredible 12-year run with my first Oral-B Pro 1000, I finally bought it again!

The battery on my original brush finally bit the dust, and toward the end, it would only stay charged enough to get me through 24 hours of teeth brushing (if I was lucky) before dying. However, I loved the performance so much over the last decade that replacing it with the exact same model was an absolute no-brainer.

Here is why this brush is a classic:

Hygienist Approved: My dental hygienist once told me that it really doesn't matter how fancy or expensive an electric toothbrush is—any solid electric toothbrush is far superior to a manual brush. This model gives you that elite, professional clean without making you pay for unnecessary, over-hyped tech features.

The One Minor Con: If I have to name one downside, it is the noise. Even brand new out of the box, it does sound a bit like it might be powered by hamsters while it is working. But just because it doesn't sound whisper-quiet doesn't negate the fact that it is a remarkably solid, heavy-duty toothbrush.

A Note on the Color: The color is fun, but the listing is a bit misleading. I thought I would be getting a mint green, but instead, it is definitely a powder blue. I much prefer green to blue, but eh, whatever—it still cleans my teeth perfectly!

If you want a proven, durable electric toothbrush that will last you for years to come without draining your wallet, this is the one to get. Highly recommended!

Let me start this review by saying that when I was younger, much to my parent's dismay, I neglected to brush my teeth. I would brush them but not as often and as thoroughly as a child should. This was partly due to my very bad gag reflex and partly due to the fact that it felt painful (?). Anyway, I've had yellow teeth my whole life (I'm 29) because of it. I never got braces (thanks again gag reflex) but my parents tried everything to get me to have better oral hygiene and to have a more aesthetically pleasing smile. Now that I'm well into adulthood, my smile being so yellow, and also very crowded, was starting to bother me. I knew I had to give in and fix one or the other. (To be clear if you have crooked teeth don't feel like you have to change yourself just for society - after 29 years, I can say that I truly wanted to change the yellowness purely for myself). I've gotten healthier in almost all other aspects of my life. I decided to make the plunge and buy this in hopes it would help get my teeth cleaner and help reduce plaque buildup. Not just for aesthetics, but for actual oral hygiene.

So, I've used it twice a day for 3 days so far and my brother commented on how "white" my teeth look yesterday evening. That felt very good to hear, not gonna lie. I think this toothbrush is amazing for the price. I love how tiny the head of the brush is. It fits into my small, overcrowded mouth perfectly. I was worried that it would take forever to brush my teeth since I wasn't doing the work, the toothbrush was. However, it takes about 2 minutes and 30 seconds or 3 minutes if you're extra thorough. It allots 30 seconds to each section of your mouth, it will do a variation in the vibration to let you know when the 30 seconds is up and to move to the next portion of your mouth. It doesn't automatically shut off after 3 minutes (that I know of) if you want to go back and do another section of your mouth, which is nice. As for the pressure sensor on the toothbrush, mine does not work. It doesn't indicate any color or anything. It just appears to be a normal electric toothbrush. I may have gotten a "bad" toothbrush since it's not working, but to be honest, I truly just wanted something that would do a deep clean and this toothbrush does that. However, all the other reviews mention the sensor working so if that's something you're looking for, I would still highly recommend this toothbrush. I think mine might just be a dud in that department. The charging took several hours to be full on the first day. I keep it on the charger to ensure that it is always fully charged. If you don't have your charger with you and you need to rely on it without it, I'm told the battery lasts up to a week. Which, is very impressive for a $50 toothbrush. Amazon says that it has Bluetooth connectivity but I do not see any indication of that on the boxes or in the manual. My parents bought me an electric toothbrush when I was little, but I was too young to appreciate it. Now that I'm older, I think this is a great option for any person of any age. I do recommend it!

I have used the Oral-B electric toothbrushes for many years. I’ve been told I have a small mouth and the small round head of this toothbrush is perfect for me. It makes every brushing like going to the hygienist—smooth clean teeth. reviews.review_title: A great value that comes with power
reviews.review_description:
This is the most powerful electric toothbrush I have ever used! I ordered this toothbrush to replace a manual one that I had. My dentist recommended an electric one so I picked this one up. This is amazing! My teeth have never felt so clean

When you first get it, it will come with no charge, so make sure you charge it. In the box, it includes the toothbrush and a charger. You don’t get any extra heads so make sure that you order some. When you do use it though, you will love how clean your teeth get! My teeth have never felt so clean! I use it every day. It is waterproof, so you can take it in the shower, which is perfect for me since my mornings are rushed. It is enjoyable to use and to hold, it’s terrific!

One thing I really enjoy about it is the two minute timer. It keeps me accountable to actually brush my teeth for a long enough time, and it doesn’t allow me to brush for a longer time than I have to. It pauses every thirty seconds, so you can brush each quadrant of your teeth for thirty seconds, so you can give one section of your teeth the attention it deserves.

With the pros out of the way, I do want to talk about a few cons. There are way too many settings to use. I know that it’s nice to have many options to choose from so we can pick what we want, but you don’t need three different ways to brush your teeth. Most of the time I just click the on button and don’t bother with the other settings and turn it off when I’m done. The other settings aren’t even that different. You can see that in my included video

The battery life is also not the best. Some people have reported getting a week or two’s worth of battery, but I’m finding I have to charge mine every five days, which isn’t a dealbreaker, but I travel a lot, so it’s not ideal.

Speaking of not ideal, they use a proprietary charger which really makes this toothbrush not travel friendly. You need to take so many chargers with you for your phone and laptop. Those might have the same charger, like USB-C, but this doesn’t. So, you need to take this charger separately.

Another thing is that you need to really keep the toothbrush, charger, and any surface it touches, clean and dry. Otherwise, wherever you put this, bacteria will start to build up. If you don’t clean your charger every other day, bacteria will start to build up and it’s gross. The included picture doesn’t do it justice, and that’s just on my sink.

Despite my complaints, I really enjoy this toothbrush. It’s relatively inexpensive compared to other electric toothbrushes, it has lasted me a long time, and it’s powerful. I do recommend it!

I highly recommend the strongest mode for the most effectiveness. But hands down, this is the best toothbrush I’ve ever got in my life. I will say, because the brush is small, I usually apply the toothpaste on my finger and place it in my mouth manually, then brush. But that’s my personal preference. I just prefer more toothpaste. I love this brush and wish I had gotten one years ago! After learning from my hygienist how to use it correctly, this brush made brushing so much easier than a regular toothbrush and I can feel that the cleaning is so much more thorough. Love it. Well worth the ~$50 cost.

reviews.review_title: Kids actually Use It! Great purchase/buy.
reviews.review_description:

These brushes are known for being effective at removing plaque while still being gentle on gums, which makes them a great choice for daily use.

Overall, great value and a really solid upgrade from their older brushes. Definitely recommend if you’re looking for something reliable that actually gets used!

reviews.review_title: Just as good as the expensive ones!
reviews.review_description:
I have had the same Sonicare for about 11 years, and it’s still working. The original I have is a much more expensive sonicare than this one but when I tell you this toothbrush does the job well!! It was just time for an upgrade and I was worried about something a little less expensive not being good/ but this is great!

The only thing about the pricier versions- they usually come with a wall charger and a case, but I didn’t care because this one will be my home toothbrush. It comes with charging cord - you just need your own box. A lot more lightweight than my more costly one too- which is nice
Very pleased, noticed a difference with my teeth!

reviews.review_title: Best Electic Toothbrush You Can Get
reviews.review_description:
My dentist told me that I needed to switch to an electric toothbrush so I found the specs and review to this one to be good. The brush head isn't too small like the other ones I saw, and it has two power speeds. It may be uncomfortable to use on your teeth at first if you switch from a manual toothbrush. But let me tell you, that your teeth will get so much used to it and after a while, it won't even bother you.

I find that my teeth are just as clean as if coming from a dentist's office. My teeth feel so smooth and I can tell that it has gotten rid of any plaque or bacteria I may have. I have permanent retainers on the bottom of my teeth which can be a pain to clean and floss. But with this electric toothbrush, I can tell that it's cleaner than it has ever been as I glide my tongue around the area. I just visited the dentist and the hygienist was going about how clean my teeth are and how well I take care of them! And how I have absolutely no plaque, and I am doing the right things, and that I should keep doing what I'm doing.

I was using a battery-powered brush that was cheap from Walmart but having to replace the batteries is a hassle. The fact that this is rechargeable and the change holds for a VERY long time is what I think is the best thing about this toothbrush. It may not come with a wall adapter, but you can contact Sonicare and they can send one in for you to use. Their idea is to conserve the environment by doing so which is fine by me. I just used a wall charger I've had and it does the job.

If you're on the fence about buying this one, or any electric toothbrush-don't be. Its the best investment you can make for yourself and your oral health and I have not looked back on buying this. 10/10 recommend.
