reviews.review_title: Not as weak as they say
reviews.review_description:
This is my 1st electric toothbrush. I ordered it over the oral b smart 1500 because it's cheaper and I found more people who swear by it than oral b. Later on, I read comments where people who have this 4100 for 10+ years say that the newer 2021 version has only half the power of the old version. Someone on reddit showed images of the inside of the new and old versions and the new version has a small plastic toy-like motor, while the old version has a big copper-wrapped motor and an old version user said "now I understand why the new version is lighter and less powerful".

I was disappointed on the new version and tried to cancel the order but I couldn't. Once it came, I decided to try it and to my surprise, it brushes my teeth way better than my manual soft-bristled and hard-bristled toothbrushes(I use both manual brushes daily compared to my daily usage of the electric toothbrush 4100 C2 head of medium bristles. If you have gum sensitive issue, buy the S sensitive or G2 optimal brush head. If you want hard-bristled, buy W diamondclean brush head).

I don't know how good the old version was but this newer version definitely brushes better than any manual toothbrush unfortunately it doesn't not come with a travel case.

Update 5/16/2024: I bought the Oral B smart 1500 because it was on sale and I wanted to see how better it is compared to the sonicare. The oral B package looks nicer and bigger than the Sonicare but upon opening the smart 1500 package, I saw hair all over the toothbrush. I did read many customers saying on reddit that their Oral b toothbrush were repackaged, but I can't believe I'm a victim of this nastiness. It also took 2 weeks to reach me from Hawaii and since it says "made in China", I think the seller is located in China.

I'll return this and I'll advise you to buy the Sonicare instead of the oral b if you don't want to be cheated receiving a used-repackaged toothbrush.

Update 05/22/2024: On 05/17/24, I bought the Oral b smart clean 360 which has exact power as the smart 1500 that I returned but the smart 360 has 5 modes and a button to change the mode while the smart 1500 has 3 modes and no button to switch between the modes.

The advantage of the oral b smart clean 360 is that the brush heads cost is cheaper than the Sonicare 4100 and I find it better at whitening my teeth than the Sonicare. That's all the advantages there.

The things that I don't like with it are many, so I'm just going to name the most annoying ones:

1) The brush heads are too big compared to the Sonicare(see picture):

Putting Oral b brush heads in my mouth is like putting a golf ball in my mouth(my head and mouth are wider than the average US male).

2) The brush heads have holes(see pictures) that trap saliva+toothpaste and creates more noise when the brush handle needle rotates in the presence of the liquid mixture, and moisture will be also trapped easily in the holes(most customers complain about Oral b brush heads design. Oral b corrected the needle issue with the IO version but the IO introduced a shallow hole which now traps moisture in the brush handle).

When I'm using the Oral b with no choice but to have my mouth wide-open, it forces my mouth to produce more saliva which gets mixed with the toothpaste and enters the brush head and creates more noise.

3) Rattling noise: The Oral b smart clean 360 isn't as noisy as people say. It's the quality of the noise the problem. It's a very unpleasant rattling noise as if you're hearing an old car engine with broken parts in it. That noise gets worse when liquid enters the brush head holes.

4) The charger is not round like a perfect circle:

You must put the Oral b brush handle in a specific position to charge it and if you place it wrong, it'll fall and might break.

5) The Daily Clean mode is rough and combined with the big brush head the experience is bad, but the smart clean 360 has more mode which make it smoother and better than the smart 1500 but not as good as the Sonicare 4100.

6)It has no auto-stop mode: You keep brushing without knowing how long you have been brushing your teeth.

To summarize, the oral b non-IO brush heads are cheap but very badly designed for a pleasant toothbrushing. I won't recommend it if you're shorter than 6 foot tall or have a small mouth.

reviews.review_title: Replaced my old Series 2 Sonicare with this one and can highly recommend this 4100 Model.
reviews.review_description: I was replacing my "old" Phillips Sonicare, specifically the HX6240, which was a series 2 model. Loved it. I found newer brands of electric toothbrushes seemed to be including 2 features I did not want, sending my data; and, reminders to brush a new area every 20 sec for 2 minutes. The latter called Brush Pacer results in 6 reminders. I prefer 4 reminders, the Quad Pacer Timer, 4 - 30 sec increments. Easier to keep track of where I already brushed. This new 4100 had the Quad Pacer, was not info invasive, and I could use the same brush tips I liked. The Lithium Ion battery on this new one lasts longer than the old NiMH one. It can sit on a "similar looking" charging base to the old one. But the new model is charged via a USB type A cable base and cord. You can use any standard USB charger you already own for phones or tablets. This model includes 2 Pressure sensitive settings, which is all I need. It is lighter and has a slimmer profile. One unexpected thing is that you can actually charge the new model on the older model's base. My spouse still uses the older model, and when we have extended travel together we take just one charger. Its turned out to be the perfect replacement electric toothbrush for me. (Photos: Older Model is on your left.)

This is my second one. My first Sonicare 4100 lasted until it finally wore out, so I bought the same model again.

It’s one of the most affordable Sonicare electric toothbrushes, but it still does a great job. It cleans well, the battery lasts a long time, and it’s simple to use without a lot of unnecessary features.

If you’re looking for a reliable electric toothbrush at a reasonable price, I definitely recommend this one.

This item does not last very long. Iffy quality. The price is great for what it is, and it has what feels like a solid vibrational capacity, though. I bought this three years ago, and it became dysfunctional. The on/off button wore down to its metal interior, and then that button became unreliable, not working 60%+ of the time. I am debating buying another one when other options exist with maybe a higher price point but longer durability.

reviews.review_title: Love it but have to buy it again every year and a half.
reviews.review_description: I'll soon be buying my third. I had one and it died after a year or so, so I switched to that other popular brand but kind of hated using it. So I came back to this one and it also died. Maybe I just got two lemons, I thought, so I bought a third and after 16 months it also died. I'm in a dilemma. I don't like using that round-head brand but I am now pretty sure that I'm going to be buying this ever 1.5 years. Crap in terms of lifespan but good while it works.

This brush has everything: A low price, high quality, both gentle and vigorous settings, is light weight, and I love how small they’ve made the brush head since my last model, because this allows for more precise access between teeth and behind molars. Thank you.
I like it, teeth feel cleaner and the timers while brushing are very helpful. Battery seems to hold up very well.

reviews.review_title: minor accidents and there goes your 3 digit electric tooth brush
reviews.review_description:
Sonicare loses cleaning power after minor drops

I’ve now gone through three Sonicare toothbrushes in about two years. In my experience, even a minor drop can make the vibration much weaker. The brush still turns on and vibrates, but the power drops so much that it no longer feels like an effective electric toothbrush, even with a new brush head.

That is the most frustrating part: it does not completely fail, so at first glance it seems fine, but the cleaning performance is clearly reduced. At that point, the main advantage of using an electric toothbrush is basically caput..

This has happened to me twice, and it makes the product feel far less durable than it should be for normal real-world household use. For a premium toothbrush, I expected better resistance to minor drops and better long-term reliability.

I still think Sonicare is a great product, but after this repeated experience I would strongly advise buyers to be very careful with handling and not assume it can tolerate everyday bumps or falls. Planned obscolecence? Sad if it is. I am sure it should not take more than a minor cushioning, internal or external to make the product more rugged.

reviews.review_title: From manual brushing to automatic brushing!
reviews.review_description:
I can't believe I waited this long to switch. This is my first time ever using an electric toothbrush, and I am seriously surprised by its effectiveness. My teeth have honestly never felt cleaner, it feels like I just walked out of a professional dental cleaning every single time I brush. One of the most useful features is the built-in timer. reviews.review_title: Oral-B Pro 1000 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush is a High-Quality Product!
reviews.review_description:
I purchased “Oral-B Pro 1000 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush” on the recommendation of my dental hygienist, who suggested the brand to help manage my gingivitis. After my previous Oral-B lasted over a decade, I was happy to stick with the same reliable brand.

I find this model to be extremely effective; it does all the hard work for me, and the built-in timer works perfectly. It is a high-quality product that offers great value and dependability.

While I am giving it a 5-star rating, there are three minor drawbacks: the battery life is somewhat short, the motor is noticeably loud, and the power button can be a bit difficult to press, especially with wet hands. Despite these small issues, I highly recommend this toothbrush and am confident it won't disappoint!

reviews.review_title: True longevity & happy to purchase 2 more
reviews.review_description:
Oral-B Pro 1000 Rechargeable Toothbrush has not disappointed me. I’ve had my own since 2019. It still functions beautifully. The one thing I’ve noticed is the battery charge doesn’t last as long as it did when it was new. I could go 2 weeks or more without charging. Now it’s about 1 week & I need to charge. I do brush morning & night for the full 2 minutes. I love everything about it. I don’t have sensitive teeth thus my teeth can handle the deep cleaning it provides. I really don’t recommend this if you do have sensitive teeth as I feel it would be too harsh. The timing function works wonderfully for it tells me when to move onto the next area of my mouth. ••To prevent a yukky mess that drips down I have learned 2 things: I thoroughly run water under the brush while it’s running to fully clean it. This, however, doesn’t prevent yuk from your brushing from forming down where the brush head meets the toothbrush. I became tired of a toothbrush that had dried toothpaste on it even though I thought cleaning the head was enough. Unfortunately the yuk does collect at that area & begins the mess. To prevent that I do now take the head of the brush every time I use it now. I just sit in to side in a dry cloth. Hence a clean brush.

Since my purchase I’ve purchased 2 more. One for my husband who was told by his Dentist he needed an electric toothbrush because he was developing gingivitis. He loves it because it’s so easy to brush now. The toothbrush does all the work. At first he was doing the brushing & ruined the head a little. So a reminder this does the brushing for you. You only need to move the brush around your mouth. Since having mine I haven’t had one cavity. One thing my hygienist did mention when I first got it was I wasn’t getting high enough to my upper gums. Now I make sure I do. I also purchased one for my 15yo Son as his Pediatric Dentist said it was okay & recommended that he start early with an excellent choice in toothbrushes. For $50- the price hasn’t changed since 2019 - this is well worth getting. For multiple reasons as I feel I thoroughly cleans my teeth. Once I began using this my mouth felt clean & fresh & it does every time I use it. I also feel using an electric toothbrush has saved $ I’d be spending on dental bills. The cost always swayed me away from making the purchase but I’m glad I did. Obviously since mine still works since 2019 there’s definite genuine quality with Oral-B. The box does state it comes with a 2 year limited warranty & there is a 60 day risk free trial. The paperwork details are in the box. For all I’ve written I highly recommend this Oral-B electric toothbrush & I don’t feel you’ll be disappointed. ••I do not purchase genuine Oral-B brush heads. From the beginning I’ve purchased a generic version from Amazon which have worked perfectly. My pictures reflect how nicely it’s packaged upon its arrival.

reviews.review_title: Does a very good job on plaque
reviews.review_description:
I have always used a standard manual brush. I was skeptical of electric because it seemed like the little head only moved in short back and forth spins (instead of complete circles) making it less effective. In addition, I assumed that you could not apply any pressure, or the head would stop moving.

My dentist recommended I try one to help with plaque build up that I seem to accumulate quickly on the inside of my lower front teeth. So, I bought this one (my wife has had one a few years). Some observations:

- It does a very good job keeping plaque off. I actually started using this brush halfway between dentist appointments. I found that it could not remove already present plaque (at least not what I had), but that once removed by the dentist, this brush does a great job keeping it off. Much better than a manual brush. For that alone I am sold.

- The small size is very good for getting around back teeth / wisdom teeth. It also gets you to focus on a tooth at a time (vs. the sawing motion across many teeth) - which actually took no more time. Overall, a session might take very slightly longer than manual, but is certainly more thorough.

- You can press down pretty hard, and the brush keeps oscillating. Although, in my experience, there is no need. I tend to use less pressure than a manual brush. While the brush head is doing a short back and forth spin (vs. a total 360), that seems just as effective (perhaps more so, since you get both directions of spin very quickly on all surfaces).

- The brush does a pulsing vibration after 2 minutes. You can just ignore it and keep brushing. It also does much lighter pulses every 30 seconds, to help you time your session into groups of upper front, upper back, lower front, lower back. Again, you can ignore all this and just brush at your own pace.

- If two people in the same bathroom are using this type of brush, there are two good options. One, have both people use the same base, and just switch out the head (they are color coded for this reason). Or two, give each person their own unit, but keep just one charging base out. The charge need is so infrequent, that its easy to just leave one brush standing on its own, and the other on the charger; then just switch out when a charge is needed. This clears up counter space and cords.

- We have purchased the generic (and less expensive) replacement heads. In our experience, they were identical to the originals in materials and make. I am sure there is a lot of quality variation, but it was not hard to find good options.

- My wife and I have what appear to be identical models, except we did one black, one white to make them easy to keep separate. Mine, the white, only turns off by pressing the off button 3 times (since it cycles through modes using the on/off button). This is the only thing I really do not like. The black one turns off with one click. Perhaps it is a setting, but we can find no way to change it. So, I find myself holding the brush in my mouth (to stop splatter) while finding the button (see below), and pressing 3 times.

- The on off button is a little hard to press. It is flush and shallow. I always manage to get it on and off, but sometimes it is surprisingly hard. Recently, it would not turn on, and I thought it must have lost its charge. Turns out I just had to press very firmly. This can be a challenge when turning the unit off. You tend to keep it in your mouth (to prevent splatter), and so finding and pressing the button is sometimes a little harder than you would think. I think for most people, this is just a negative to be accepted. But for people who are older, or not dexterous in the hands, I think this would actually make the brush impossible to use.

Overall, I am happy with it, because it prevents plaque, end of story. If I could change one thing, it would be a single press, easy press on\off button.

reviews.review_title: A Nice Upgrade From My Oral-B Pro 100
reviews.review_description:
I recently upgraded from my old Oral-B Pro 100 to the Oral-B iO Series 3, and I can definitely tell the difference. The brushing experience feels much smoother and quieter, and my teeth feel noticeably cleaner after each use.

One of my favorite improvements is the pressure sensor. It helps me avoid brushing too hard, which is something my old toothbrush didn't have. I also like the different cleaning modes they're simple to switch between and let me choose what feels best.

The brush head glides comfortably over my teeth, and the handle feels solid and well-made. Battery life has also been great so far, lasting several days before needing a recharge.

If you're still using an older Oral-B model like the Pro 100 and have been thinking about upgrading, I think the iO Series 3 is well worth it. It feels like a much more refined brushing experience, and I'm really happy with the purchase.

reviews.review_title: Very nice looking, powerful and inexpensive. A great purchase!!
reviews.review_description: What a bargain!! This is replacing our old power toothbrush and upgrading to something much better. The cleaning modes are delightful, and the recharge time is efficient. Keeping the brush assembly in the holder and protected from the elements with the plastic case is such a great idea. The quality of this Oral-B toothbrush is second to none, as expected. The power and vibration of the brush is something we'll have to get used to, but that's a given considering our old one is well over 10 years old. 2 thumbs up on this product.

Really like this toothbrush. Holds a charge well and I really like the brush heads they seem to clean very well. Has a 2 minute timer and lights that help you to know if you are applying the correct amount of pressure. I'm pleased with it and happy I bought it.

reviews.review_title: Its a good toothbrush would recommend if your in the market
reviews.review_description:

I always forget to write reviews after I buy stuff on Amazon. I should try to do it more because it is helpful when you find a review that is real.

So, I bought this toothbrush to replace another brand that I bought about a year and a half ago. The old toothbrush just wasn't doing a good job at cleaning my teeth. I have always had problems with cavities and plaque build-up. The only sure-fire way of getting all of the plaque for me was to use Plax prior to brushing. Still, I find myself in the dentist's office every six months with a hygienist jack-hammering my mouth with water pick to get my teeth clean. It's embarrassing and it makes me feel anxious about my gum health. I saw the Oral-B iO Series 3 here on Amazon and it was discounted. According to Oral-B it is really good at getting rid of plaque. I took the manufacturer at their word, and bought it. Holy crap, ya'll! This thing is amazing!

The iO3 has a round brush head similar to the polishing tool your dental hygienist uses. I've used cheaper Oral-B electric toothbrushes that also have round heads, but they weren't as robust as the brush head on the iO3. The bristles aren't hard, but they are dense and arranged in a way that they can hug your teeth while brushing. You can get that brush on every surface of each tooth (except directly between the teeth, of course). The motorized handle has a pressure sensor that changes color based on how hard or soft you are pressing. If you get it just right, it lights up green.

The iO3 also helps you time your brushing so that you the recommended two minutes. It pulses when it's time to change to a different quadrant. It doesn't automatically shut off when the two minutes are up, however. That's fine with me as I will just continue brushing other parts of my mouth like my tongue and the roof of my palette when I'm done with my teeth.

There are supposedly three types of brushing settings to choose from, but I have only used the default cleaning setting. The other two setting are supposed to be for sensitive teeth and whitening. The default works just fine for me.

The build is solid and feels good in my hands. I like that the handle comes with two brush heads, a travel case, and case for the brush heads. I like to take my brush head off and put it in the case after I'm finished just because I'm paranoid about having a toothbrush exposed in the bathroom. It's nice to have the option to shield it from germs.

So, TLDR, this is a great electric toothbrush. My teeth haven't felt this clean since the last time I went to the dentist. Oral-B did a fantastic job of designing a product that makes brushing easy and will almost certainly result in you having a positive visit at the dentist, and may help reverse gum issues and prevent cavities. I definitely recommend you buy this product if you are in the market for an electric toothbrush.

reviews.review_title: A noticeable upgrade from the Pro 1000!

reviews.review_title: Simple, effective, and reliable sonic cleaning without the extra frills!
reviews.review_description:
As an Amazon Vine Voice, I tested the PHILIPS Sonicare 1100 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush over a two-week period, using it for twice-daily brushing routines to evaluate its cleaning power, battery life, and overall usability. If you want to step up from a manual toothbrush without paying for expensive, feature-heavy models you'll never use, this stripped-down sonic brush is a compelling option. 

Here is my honest breakdown of how it performs:

⭐ Cleaning Performance & Power

Sonic Technology: Delivering solid vibration action, it drives fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline. It leaves your mouth feeling remarkably fresh—way cleaner than any standard manual brush. 

Single-Mode Simplicity: It features just one cleaning speed and one button. While it lacks multiple intensity settings or fancy pulse cycles, it focuses entirely on doing the core job exceptionally well. 

Easy-Start Feature: If you are new to electric toothbrushes, it includes a built-in feature that gently ramps up the power gradually over your first 14 brushing sessions to prevent gum sensitivity. 

🛠️ Design & Usability

Slim & Lightweight: The handle has a sleek, ergonomic profile that feels comfortable and lightweight in the hand without taking up unnecessary counter space. 

Smart Timers: The integrated SmarTimer automatically shuts the brush off after the dentist-recommended 2 minutes, while the QuadPacer pulses every 30 seconds to signal when you should switch quadrants of your mouth. 

🔋 Battery Life & Charging

Dependable Endurance: The internal rechargeable battery easily lasts up to 2 weeks (around 14 days) on a single charge under normal use. 

Convenient Indicator: A subtle battery level LED indicator alerts you when it's time to drop it back on its USB charging base. 

🛑 Minor Cons to Consider

No Pressure Sensor: Because this is a budget-friendly model, it lacks a pressure sensor warning light. If you have a heavy hand, you'll need to mind how hard you press manually. 

Basic Accessories: The kit keeps things minimal with just the handle, one brush head, and a USB charging stand (wall adapter block not always included). 

The Verdict

The PHILIPS Sonicare 1100 proves you don’t need to spend a fortune to get a dentist-clean mouth. It cuts out the complicated modes in favor of reliable timers, great battery life, and powerful sonic action. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a straightforward, high-value electric toothbrush!

reviews.review_title: Lasted 12 years before I had to buy it again! Superior clean without the hefty price.
reviews.review_description:

Here is why this brush is a classic:

The One Minor Con: If I have to name one downside, it is the noise. Even brand new out of the box, it does sound a bit like it might be powered by hamsters while it is working. A Note on the Color: The color is fun, but the listing is a bit misleading. I thought I would be getting a mint green, but instead, it is definitely a powder blue. I much prefer green to blue, but eh, whatever—it still cleans my teeth perfectly!

If you want a proven, durable electric toothbrush that will last you for years to come without draining your wallet, this is the one to get. Highly recommended!

Let me start this review by saying that when I was younger, much to my parent's dismay, I neglected to brush my teeth. I would brush them but not as often and as thoroughly as a child should. This was partly due to my very bad gag reflex and partly due to the fact that it felt painful (?). Anyway, I've had yellow teeth my whole life (I'm 29) because of it. I never got braces (thanks again gag reflex) but my parents tried everything to get me to have better oral hygiene and to have a more aesthetically pleasing smile. Now that I'm well into adulthood, my smile being so yellow, and also very crowded, was starting to bother me. I knew I had to give in and fix one or the other. (To be clear if you have crooked teeth don't feel like you have to change yourself just for society - after 29 years, I can say that I truly wanted to change the yellowness purely for myself). I've gotten healthier in almost all other aspects of my life. I decided to make the plunge and buy this in hopes it would help get my teeth cleaner and help reduce plaque buildup. Not just for aesthetics, but for actual oral hygiene.

So, I've used it twice a day for 3 days so far and my brother commented on how "white" my teeth look yesterday evening. That felt very good to hear, not gonna lie. I think this toothbrush is amazing for the price. I love how tiny the head of the brush is. It fits into my small, overcrowded mouth perfectly. I was worried that it would take forever to brush my teeth since I wasn't doing the work, the toothbrush was. However, it takes about 2 minutes and 30 seconds or 3 minutes if you're extra thorough. It allots 30 seconds to each section of your mouth, it will do a variation in the vibration to let you know when the 30 seconds is up and to move to the next portion of your mouth. It doesn't automatically shut off after 3 minutes (that I know of) if you want to go back and do another section of your mouth, which is nice. As for the pressure sensor on the toothbrush, mine does not work. It doesn't indicate any color or anything. It just appears to be a normal electric toothbrush. I may have gotten a "bad" toothbrush since it's not working, but to be honest, I truly just wanted something that would do a deep clean and this toothbrush does that. However, all the other reviews mention the sensor working so if that's something you're looking for, I would still highly recommend this toothbrush. I think mine might just be a dud in that department. The charging took several hours to be full on the first day. I keep it on the charger to ensure that it is always fully charged. If you don't have your charger with you and you need to rely on it without it, I'm told the battery lasts up to a week. Which, is very impressive for a $50 toothbrush. Amazon says that it has Bluetooth connectivity but I do not see any indication of that on the boxes or in the manual. My parents bought me an electric toothbrush when I was little, but I was too young to appreciate it. Now that I'm older, I think this is a great option for any person of any age. I do recommend it!

reviews.review_title: A great value that comes with power
reviews.review_description:
This is the most powerful electric toothbrush I have ever used! I ordered this toothbrush to replace a manual one that I had. My dentist recommended an electric one so I picked this one up. This is amazing! My teeth have never felt so clean

When you first get it, it will come with no charge, so make sure you charge it. In the box, it includes the toothbrush and a charger. You don’t get any extra heads so make sure that you order some. When you do use it though, you will love how clean your teeth get! My teeth have never felt so clean! I use it every day. It is waterproof, so you can take it in the shower, which is perfect for me since my mornings are rushed. It is enjoyable to use and to hold, it’s terrific!

One thing I really enjoy about it is the two minute timer. It keeps me accountable to actually brush my teeth for a long enough time, and it doesn’t allow me to brush for a longer time than I have to. It pauses every thirty seconds, so you can brush each quadrant of your teeth for thirty seconds, so you can give one section of your teeth the attention it deserves.

With the pros out of the way, I do want to talk about a few cons. There are way too many settings to use. I know that it’s nice to have many options to choose from so we can pick what we want, but you don’t need three different ways to brush your teeth. Most of the time I just click the on button and don’t bother with the other settings and turn it off when I’m done. The other settings aren’t even that different. You can see that in my included video

The battery life is also not the best. Some people have reported getting a week or two’s worth of battery, but I’m finding I have to charge mine every five days, which isn’t a dealbreaker, but I travel a lot, so it’s not ideal.

Speaking of not ideal, they use a proprietary charger which really makes this toothbrush not travel friendly. You need to take so many chargers with you for your phone and laptop. Those might have the same charger, like USB-C, but this doesn’t. So, you need to take this charger separately.

Another thing is that you need to really keep the toothbrush, charger, and any surface it touches, clean and dry. Otherwise, wherever you put this, bacteria will start to build up. If you don’t clean your charger every other day, bacteria will start to build up and it’s gross. The included picture doesn’t do it justice, and that’s just on my sink.

Despite my complaints, I really enjoy this toothbrush. It’s relatively inexpensive compared to other electric toothbrushes, it has lasted me a long time, and it’s powerful. I do recommend it!

Occasional it totally glitches and I need to restart the app and the brush. I also thought the battery would lastonger but it's about the same as my OG Oral-B electric that was around $40. It also gives you a score for each session and a running score, which I like even though I thought I'd never use that. reviews.review_title: A true Sonicare replacement but pulling the heads off takes serious grip strength
reviews.review_description:
I finally refused to buy another $100 Philips Sonicare after my second one died exactly when the two-year warranty expired. I picked this COSLUS up at full price strictly because getting the handle a travel case and an 18-month supply of brush heads cost less than one pack of name-brand refills. I honestly expected a hollow rattling piece of cheap plastic. Instead the matte black handle has a solid weight to it and the motor delivers that intense high-pitched sonic hum that instantly foams up your toothpaste. After brushing twice a day for six weeks my teeth have that perfectly slick feeling you normally only get leaving the dentist chair.

The battery performance is what really convinced me to keep it. I left the wireless charger in the box and haven't plugged this thing in once since day one. I even took it on two weekend work trips without the cord and the motor hasn't dropped a fraction of its power. It does the standard 30-second stutter to tell you to switch quadrants which is great for mindless early morning brushing.

I am capping it at four stars for two very specific physical limitations. First the five cleaning modes change the rhythm of the brushing but you cannot adjust the actual intensity up or down. If the standard mode is too aggressive for your gums you just have to switch to the softer pulsating mode. Second the replacement heads lock onto the metal shaft so aggressively that taking them off requires an absurd amount of force. I actually had to wrap a hand towel around the brush head just to get enough grip to yank it off without snapping the plastic. If you have arthritis or hand mobility issues you should definitely skip this. But if you just want a reliable powerhouse of a toothbrush and don't mind wrestling with a piece of plastic every three months this is a massive steal.

reviews.review_title: Excellent Alternative to the Big Brands
reviews.review_description:

The overall quality is very good. It has a premium look and feel, and the brushing experience is remarkably similar to what you’d expect from much more expensive name-brand electric toothbrushes.

One thing I really appreciate is that it comes with multiple replacement brush heads. Considering the overall price, that adds a lot of value since replacement heads can often cost almost as much as a budget toothbrush.

Battery life has also been excellent. My wife only needs to recharge it about every two weeks, give or take, depending on how often she brushes. For everyday use, that’s more than enough and means you don’t have to constantly think about charging it.

I don’t believe it includes a travel case, but honestly that wasn’t important for us and certainly isn’t a dealbreaker considering everything else you get.

Overall, I think this is an excellent value. If you’re looking for an electric toothbrush that delivers a brushing experience similar to the big-name brands without spending a premium price, I’d definitely recommend giving this one a try. reviews.review_description: I haven’t used one before now but my dentist suggested I do so. I researched to find something reasonably priced that offered a quiet, efficient but gentle, brush. Love it and it does a fantastic job. Some people complaining about it getting dirty because they never wash it after use. I have mine for over 8 months and it looks brand new. I would not buy this product again. While it has several issues I could overlook, one major problem makes it unusable for me. The vibration of this brush feels “off” in a way that makes me dizzy and gives me a headache every time I use it,

and I’m not someone who normally gets headaches. I actually dread brushing my teeth with it, and at this point I’ll probably just accept the $60 loss and purchase something else.

The strange part is that the brush isn’t loud and the vibration doesn’t feel particularly strong, yet something about the way it operates gives me headaches even on the lowest setting.

There are also other issues that add to my frustration. The brush head doesn’t come with a cover, yet the instructions recommend removing it after each use to clean and dry it. That means it has to sit uncovered on its side, which isn’t ideal for keeping it clean. The timer is also odd. It gives the standard 30‑second alerts for a 2‑minute brushing cycle, but it doesn’t turn off at the end. It just keeps running and continues the 30‑second pulses. To power it down, you have to click through every mode, there’s no simple one‑button off option, unless I am missing instructions.

Another strange issue is that while my teeth feel polished after use, my mouth as a whole doesn’t feel clean. I’ve used the same toothpaste for years and have never had this bad taste in my mouth after brushing. It’s disgusting and it’s super frustrating.

Overall, I cannot recommend this product. And if you suffer from headaches, I would stay far away.

reviews.review_title: Hygienist Approved Clean That’ll Make You Smile Wider
reviews.review_description:
TL;DR: The Oral-B iO Series 2 turned my semi-okay brushing routine into something my dental hygienist actually high-fived me for. Quiet motor, smart pressure sensor, and three useful modes mean it’s basically a tiny personal trainer for your teeth—and it works.

________________________________________

What I Love

Feature Real World Impact

Automatic Pressure Sensor lights up red and slows the head if I press too hard, so my gums are finally spared my “scrub like a sidewalk” technique.

3 Modes (Super Sensitive, Gentle, Daily Clean) I start on Super Sensitive first thing in the morning, switch to Daily Clean after coffee—versatility without overthinking it.

2 Minute Timer with 30 Second Pulses Reminds me to hit every quadrant. No more guessing whether I’ve done my time.

Whisper Quiet Motor Barely louder than a kitten’s purr—no bathroom wake-up calls for anyone still sleeping.

Long-lasting battery. One charge lasted me an entire weeklong trip (twice daily brushing).

________________________________________

Results That Actually Show

My hygienist recommended this after a lecture on plaque, and three months later, she spent most of my check-up admiring how little scraping she had to do. In her words: “Whatever you’re using, keep using it.” Translation: The iO Series 2 is doing its job.

________________________________________

Small Gripes (but nothing deal-breaking)

• No travel case in the starter kit—had to toss it in a zip lock for my trip.

• Replacement heads cost more than generic ones, but you’re paying for the iO’s magnetic tech. I swap mine every ~3 months to stay frugal.

________________________________________

Bottom Line

If you’re ready to graduate from manual brushing (or an older, rattly electric) to something that polices your pressure and times your session, this is an easy win. The improvement in my check-up alone justifies the price, and the sleek “Night Black” handle looks sharp on the counter.

Would buy again in a heartbeat—and my hygienist would probably throw me another high five.

The toothbrush leaves my teeth feeling much cleaner than a manual toothbrush, and I appreciate the built-in timer that helps me brush for the recommended amount of time. The different cleaning modes are easy to use, and the battery life has been excellent between charges.

As a retired pharmacist, I understand how important good oral hygiene is to overall health. Investing in a quality electric toothbrush has been well worth it, and seeing healthier gums has been the biggest benefit for me.

I would highly recommend the Philips Sonicare to anyone looking to improve their oral health, especially if they’re experiencing sensitive or bleeding gums. With regular use and good brushing habits, it has made a noticeable difference for me.

I can feel my teeth thanking me at night for getting a step up in motor for my electric toothbrush. It’s been like a month and my teeth look whiter and constantly feel cleaner. Prime Day this was the best bargain imo.

Holds charge well, I’m guessing it will be durable because I’ve never really had a Phillips Sonicare break on me they just lose battery eventually.

Fits my mouth and I like having multiple settings.

reviews.review_description:
As an Amazon Vine Voice reviewer, I have tested my fair share of personal care devices, and the Philips Sonicare 5950 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush immediately sets a high bar. Out of the box, you can tell this is a top tier, premium product with a lot of thought put into the engineering and design.

The matte black finish looks sleek on the bathroom counter, but more importantly, the build quality feels incredibly solid. The handle has a nice weight to it, offering a comfortable, ergonomic grip that does not feel slippery when wet. The buttons have a satisfying click with zero play, and the brush heads snap on with a tight, precise fit. It feels durable and well sealed against water, which is essential for long term use.

When it comes to performance, it leaves your teeth with that fresh, dentist clean feel every single time. The sonic vibration power is strong and consistent without feeling harsh on your gums, and the pressure sensor works like a charm to let you know if you are pressing too hard. Having the two brush heads included in the box is a great touch, making it ready for months of use right away.

The battery life is equally impressive. A single full charge easily lasts for weeks of twice daily brushing, making it super convenient for travel without having to haul extra cords around.

If you are looking for a high quality, reliable electric toothbrush that looks modern and delivers serious cleaning power, this one is worth every penny. Extremely well made and easily recommended.

This toothbrush is awesome. First of all, you can tell how much battery life is left by the three dots at the base. So much better than the last Sonicare toothbrush that I owned. The clean level is perfect for a thorough brushing. Not too hard or damaging to your gums. I love the travel case too, because it's the same size as the toothbrush. Takes up less space when traveling than my old one did.

reviews.review_title: Good toothbrush, but I miss the extra features
reviews.review_description: Overall, this is a great electric toothbrush. It cleans well, has good battery life, and leaves my teeth feeling fresh after every use. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because I miss my older Sonicare model, which had more cleaning modes and customization options. If you’re coming from a basic toothbrush, you’ll probably love it, but if you’re upgrading from an older premium Sonicare, you may notice some missing features. Overall, it’s still a solid toothbrush that I’d recommend.

This is my first electric toothbrush and I really like it! It comes with a lot of battery already on it so I haven't even charged it yet and I've been using it for a few weeks. It seems heavy duty and I like the options for sensitivity, whitening, etc. The app is neat too so I can see stats on how much I've brushed, how many brushes until I have to charge it again, and can easily buy brushes heads. I feel like the brush is the right size for my mouth and I'm glad I got this upgraded version!

reviews.review_title: Like brushing your teeth with a beehive
reviews.review_description: Does the trick, the brushing is good, but it isn’t really clear what the toothbrush is trying to communicate to you.

HOLY SMOKES! This is by far the best Sonicare toothbrush I have owned. We have been using Sonicare brushes for the last 23 years and have gone through several (always bought the two in one pack from big box store) over the years. Well mine puttered out so I needed just one so where do I go? You got it. Amazon. :) After much research and reading all reviews I decided to give this one a try. WOWZA what a difference in vibration & noise level. I think all Sonicare brushes are on the expensive side but once you try you just can't go back. That being said the value for this particular brush was within budget range so I jumped and boy am I glad I did. I LOVE IT!

title: Oral-B Pro 1000 CrossAction Electric Toothbrush, Green
description: The Oral-B Pro 1000 rechargeable electric toothbrush provides a clinically proven superior deep clean in hard-to-reach areas vs. a regular manual toothbrush. 300% MORE plaque removal along the gumline versus a regular manual toothbrush. The professionally inspired design of the CrossAction brush head surrounds each tooth with bristles angled at 16 degrees. The Oral-B Pro 1000 has 3D cleaning action that oscillates, rotates, and pulsates to break up and remove plaque along the gumline than a regular manual toothbrush. The pressure sensor stops pulsations if you brush too hard to prevent harmful over-brushing and there are 3 modes. The toothbrush also includes an in-handle timer to help you brush for a dentist-recommended two minutes. Best of all, it is brought to you by Oral-B—the #1 brand used by dentists worldwide.* *Based on surveys of a representative worldwide sample of dentists carried out for P&G regularly. Do not use on children under age 3. Replace brush (head) every 3 months or sooner if brush head becomes worn.

reviews.review_title: Lasted 12 years before I had to buy it again! Superior clean without the hefty price.
reviews.review_description:
After an incredible 12-year run with my first Oral-B Pro 1000, I finally bought it again!

The battery on my original brush finally bit the dust, and toward the end, it would only stay charged enough to get me through 24 hours of teeth brushing (if I was lucky) before dying. However, I loved the performance so much over the last decade that replacing it with the exact same model was an absolute no-brainer.

Here is why this brush is a classic:

Hygienist Approved: My dental hygienist once told me that it really doesn't matter how fancy or expensive an electric toothbrush is—any solid electric toothbrush is far superior to a manual brush. This model gives you that elite, professional clean without making you pay for unnecessary, over-hyped tech features.

The One Minor Con: If I have to name one downside, it is the noise. Even brand new out of the box, it does sound a bit like it might be powered by hamsters while it is working. But just because it doesn't sound whisper-quiet doesn't negate the fact that it is a remarkably solid, heavy-duty toothbrush.

A Note on the Color: The color is fun, but the listing is a bit misleading. I thought I would be getting a mint green, but instead, it is definitely a powder blue. I much prefer green to blue, but eh, whatever—it still cleans my teeth perfectly!

If you want a proven, durable electric toothbrush that will last you for years to come without draining your wallet, this is the one to get. Highly recommended!

Let me start this review by saying that when I was younger, much to my parent's dismay, I neglected to brush my teeth. I would brush them but not as often and as thoroughly as a child should. This was partly due to my very bad gag reflex and partly due to the fact that it felt painful (?). Anyway, I've had yellow teeth my whole life (I'm 29) because of it. I never got braces (thanks again gag reflex) but my parents tried everything to get me to have better oral hygiene and to have a more aesthetically pleasing smile. Now that I'm well into adulthood, my smile being so yellow, and also very crowded, was starting to bother me. I knew I had to give in and fix one or the other. (To be clear if you have crooked teeth don't feel like you have to change yourself just for society - after 29 years, I can say that I truly wanted to change the yellowness purely for myself). I've gotten healthier in almost all other aspects of my life. I decided to make the plunge and buy this in hopes it would help get my teeth cleaner and help reduce plaque buildup. Not just for aesthetics, but for actual oral hygiene.

So, I've used it twice a day for 3 days so far and my brother commented on how "white" my teeth look yesterday evening. That felt very good to hear, not gonna lie. I think this toothbrush is amazing for the price. I love how tiny the head of the brush is. It fits into my small, overcrowded mouth perfectly. I was worried that it would take forever to brush my teeth since I wasn't doing the work, the toothbrush was. However, it takes about 2 minutes and 30 seconds or 3 minutes if you're extra thorough. It allots 30 seconds to each section of your mouth, it will do a variation in the vibration to let you know when the 30 seconds is up and to move to the next portion of your mouth. It doesn't automatically shut off after 3 minutes (that I know of) if you want to go back and do another section of your mouth, which is nice. As for the pressure sensor on the toothbrush, mine does not work. It doesn't indicate any color or anything. It just appears to be a normal electric toothbrush. I may have gotten a "bad" toothbrush since it's not working, but to be honest, I truly just wanted something that would do a deep clean and this toothbrush does that. However, all the other reviews mention the sensor working so if that's something you're looking for, I would still highly recommend this toothbrush. I think mine might just be a dud in that department. The charging took several hours to be full on the first day. I keep it on the charger to ensure that it is always fully charged. If you don't have your charger with you and you need to rely on it without it, I'm told the battery lasts up to a week. Which, is very impressive for a $50 toothbrush. Amazon says that it has Bluetooth connectivity but I do not see any indication of that on the boxes or in the manual. My parents bought me an electric toothbrush when I was little, but I was too young to appreciate it. Now that I'm older, I think this is a great option for any person of any age. I do recommend it!

I have used the Oral-B electric toothbrushes for many years. I’ve been told I have a small mouth and the small round head of this toothbrush is perfect for me. It makes every brushing like going to the hygienist—smooth clean teeth. It has a timer for a total of 2 minutes, with a change every 30 seconds to move you through the front and back of both sides of your mouth. I wouldn’t use any other toothbrush.

reviews.review_title: A great value that comes with power
reviews.review_description:
This is the most powerful electric toothbrush I have ever used! I ordered this toothbrush to replace a manual one that I had. My dentist recommended an electric one so I picked this one up. This is amazing! My teeth have never felt so clean

When you first get it, it will come with no charge, so make sure you charge it. In the box, it includes the toothbrush and a charger. You don’t get any extra heads so make sure that you order some. When you do use it though, you will love how clean your teeth get! My teeth have never felt so clean! I use it every day. It is waterproof, so you can take it in the shower, which is perfect for me since my mornings are rushed. It is enjoyable to use and to hold, it’s terrific!

One thing I really enjoy about it is the two minute timer. It keeps me accountable to actually brush my teeth for a long enough time, and it doesn’t allow me to brush for a longer time than I have to. It pauses every thirty seconds, so you can brush each quadrant of your teeth for thirty seconds, so you can give one section of your teeth the attention it deserves.

With the pros out of the way, I do want to talk about a few cons. There are way too many settings to use. I know that it’s nice to have many options to choose from so we can pick what we want, but you don’t need three different ways to brush your teeth. Most of the time I just click the on button and don’t bother with the other settings and turn it off when I’m done. The other settings aren’t even that different. You can see that in my included video

The battery life is also not the best. Some people have reported getting a week or two’s worth of battery, but I’m finding I have to charge mine every five days, which isn’t a dealbreaker, but I travel a lot, so it’s not ideal.

Speaking of not ideal, they use a proprietary charger which really makes this toothbrush not travel friendly. You need to take so many chargers with you for your phone and laptop. Those might have the same charger, like USB-C, but this doesn’t. So, you need to take this charger separately.

Another thing is that you need to really keep the toothbrush, charger, and any surface it touches, clean and dry. Otherwise, wherever you put this, bacteria will start to build up. If you don’t clean your charger every other day, bacteria will start to build up and it’s gross. The included picture doesn’t do it justice, and that’s just on my sink.

Despite my complaints, I really enjoy this toothbrush. It’s relatively inexpensive compared to other electric toothbrushes, it has lasted me a long time, and it’s powerful. I do recommend it!

reviews.review_title: Great electric toothbrush but head replacement gets pricey!
reviews.review_description: Great, lightweight electric toothbrush with several different replacement heads to choose from. Lower upfront cost to purchase the toothbrush than other brands or models within the Oral-B family. Recharges fast and is easy to take on trips too. Only issue is with the price of replacement heads - that is where they get you. Just do your research as the brush heads need replacing every few months and it adds up.

reviews.review_title: Don’t be frightened when your teeth feels clean for the first time!
reviews.review_description: Absolutely phenomenal. People weren’t lying when they said it feels like you just came from the dentist. I don’t know how it does it, but if you brush the same way you brush with a manual toothbrush, alongside the intense vibration, it feels like it removes 100% of plaque, especially the plaque that’s hard to get behind each tooth. Also, at first, the vibration may feel a little intense, but you’ll get used to it. But if it’s too strong, just press the button and it will go to a slower mode. I highly recommend the strongest mode for the most effectiveness. But hands down, this is the best toothbrush I’ve ever got in my life. I will say, because the brush is small, I usually apply the toothpaste on my finger and place it in my mouth manually, then brush. But that’s my personal preference. I just prefer more toothpaste. And it sits well on the charging pad. I honestly have no complaints.

I love this brush and wish I had gotten one years ago! After learning from my hygienist how to use it correctly, this brush made brushing so much easier than a regular toothbrush and I can feel that the cleaning is so much more thorough. Love it. Well worth the ~$50 cost.

reviews.review_title: This is a bit pricy over time but it works well
reviews.review_description: Love this. Power runs about 5 uses for me. Good buy, only thing worth noting is that the new heads are like 15$ a pop which is expensive in the long haul.

reviews.review_title: Big Performance Without the Big Price Tag: A Total Game Changer
reviews.review_description:
I used to rely strictly on an Oral-B rotary toothbrush, but after picking up a cheap vibrating brush on a whim, I realized how much I preferred sonic vibration. Deciding it was time to step up to a proper rechargeable unit, I chose this one, and it has been an absolute game changer. In fact, I loved my first one so much that I ended up buying a couple more for family members.

Real-World Details & Performance

The feature that immediately stands out is the variety of oscillating patterns. Each setting delivers a distinctly different vibration feel, making it easy to switch up depending on what feels best for a deep clean. The shape of the brush head is exceptionally comfortable in the mouth, and the cleaning power easily outperforms my old Oral-B—I honestly don't see myself ever going back to a rotating head.

While I haven't tried ultra-premium brands like Sonicare, I can't imagine they offer much more than what this unit delivers. Another massive plus is the value packed into the box: it comes with enough replacement heads to last a full year, making it effortless to swap in a fresh head every few months for that brand-new, fresh-from-the-dentist feeling.

Pros & Cons

Pros:

Multiple Effective Modes: Distinct oscillating patterns that allow you to customize your clean.

Superior Clean & Ergonomics: Head shape fits comfortably and cleans noticeably better than traditional rotary brushes.

Outstanding Value: Includes a full year’s supply of replacement heads right out of the box.

High Satisfaction: Fantastic overall performance that prompted me to buy additional units for family.

Cons:

Sonic Transition: If you are strictly used to rotating/rotary brush heads, the intense sonic vibration takes a couple of days to get used to.

Final Verdict

I highly recommend this toothbrush to anyone looking to upgrade to a high-performing sonic toothbrush without paying the inflated price tag of big-name brands. It delivers fantastic performance, incredible value, and a top-notch clean.

reviews.review_title: An absolute game-changer for kids with braces!
reviews.review_description:
I originally purchased two of these electric toothbrushes for my kids after our orthodontist highly recommended switching from manual brushing to help keep their braces clean. Anyone with kids in braces knows exactly how difficult it is to get them to brush effectively around all those brackets and wires!

These toothbrushes have been an absolute lifesaver. First off, my kids actually love using them. The brushing modes are incredibly effective at sweeping away food and plaque, but gentle enough that they don't irritate their gums. They find the handles easy to maneuver, and the built-in timer keeps them brushing for the right amount of time without me having to stand there and nag. It has taken the daily battle completely out of our morning and bedtime routines.

The absolute best part, however, has been the results. At our last checkup, our dentist specifically went out of their way to comment on how incredibly clean their teeth are now. They noted a massive improvement in plaque removal around the orthodontic hardware compared to when we were using standard manual brushes.

If you are a parent on the fence about upgrading to an electric toothbrush, especially if you are dealing with braces, this is 100% worth the investment. The quality is fantastic, the kids are happy, and the dentist is thrilled.

Highly recommend!

I've been using this for a few months now. The brushes are a nice size and clean well, comparable to the much more expensive Sonicare I used for many years before it died. To get 8 brush heads, charging stand and this quality for this price (on sale for $8.99) is such a great deal. I had tried another brand for the same price before I found this one. The brush heads were too small and soft to clean well and it had no charging stand and limited features. I struggled with it for a year and a half before it died. I'm so happy to have found this one as a replacement. Highly recommend!

reviews.reviewer_name: For some reason I can't seem to return this pkg please advise?
reviews.review_description: Not bad for the price it works pretty good I probably wouldn't buy it again however I still like it and it comes with a lot of the brushes

The built is at par with Sonicare. There’s a heft to the body, nothing like my previous flimsy toothbrush. Even better: 8 spare toothbrushes, more brushing modes, a separate charing module. Nice carrying case.

Looks great on the countertop. Is very durable. I have not used all of the settings yet, but the ones I have, I love & I look forward to using them all soon.

So this is my first electric toothbrush in years , I don’t have anything to really compare it to . I personally like it . It has different modes and it’s easy to use . Have to get used to that weird feeling in your mouth when using it but I actually really do like it . It charges fast and comes with a nice amount of brush heads . reviews.review_title: Nice, charges quickly and last a month between.
reviews.review_description: A few months usage and we got a second one for wife when her expensive one finally wore out. She likes hers also. I’m really happy with mine and would get another. It charges quickly and last about a month between charges

This toothbrush is amazing and, in my opinion, better than the Waterpik. My mouth feels cleaner, the brush intensity is perfect at all levels, and I like the toothbrush head replacement reminder light. My only issue: I had to buy the charging brick separately.
Can’t beat it especially for the price

Really nice toothbrush. I have had a Philips Sonicare for many years. I redid my bathroom and it's all blue, and granted this is a little more expensive than the regular white one. But the Blue looks SO GOOD with my Blue Bathroom. And of course it works great!

Brush is great but no case and more annoying than anything no wall plug for the charger. For an almost $100 toothbrush Philips can include a 5 dollar part instead of assuming everyone has an extra plug lying around.

This is my 2nd Sonicare toothbrush. I used the 1st one for years and had no issues. But eventually after going thru several brush heads the replaceable brush heads did not fit tightly as they did when new. This was because at the time I was using non-Philips replacement brush heads. I was about to order some genuine Philips brush heads when I saw this item on Sale and decided to just buy a brand-new tooth brush (that came with two brush heads) that had some additional features (different settings for duration, modes, etc.). It works just as well as my first one and I highly recommend this product.
Love this. Wish I had invested in earlier. Really whitens my teeth
Excellent easy to use long battery life. Replaced a previous Sonicare this one seems more effective. Happy with purchase

reviews.review_title: Excellent electric toothbrush for the price.
reviews.review_description: I had been using a different electric toothbrush for many years however it was no longer effective. Love this brush and my teeth feel so clean. The App guides your brushing and I like the fact it is so easy to clean. I chose the IO #5 and don’t feel the need for the more expensive versions.

reviews.review_title: Fantastic price point for such a capable little brush!
reviews.review_description: This is great, especially for the price point. It's a fantastic value. If you just want a basic oral, this is the one. It's just like the big guy, perfectly soft bristles, it's not vibration so much as just buzzing and it shouldn't bother your hands. Looks great on the counter. It has a nice group of settings, there's no "AI" brushing but I had it on my last one and it wasn't much use. Durability is yet to be determined although it looks like the same as my other one. It's rechargeable and so far I made it a, week without recharging, so I'd rate it's portability as an A+, you get a travel case with it too. Very pleased with this purchase.

reviews.review_title: Better than Phillips Sonicare. App is actually useful and not just a gimmick.
reviews.review_description:
So, I'm a long-time user of Sonicare, which means I've gone through a number of them that always tend to break right at warranty expiry. Though I usually find them on sale, they are not cheap, nor are the brushes, and for the price they are still so prone to breaking down and various issues. So, when my current one started to have an issue (turning on randomly on its own, startling all around), I started shopping for a replacement. This Oral B brush went on sale, so I decided to check it out - maybe return if it wasn't all that great in comparison. At first, I was a little confused, because I thought these brushes mainly worked by rotation, but they are both that and sonication. I don't know if the vibration speed matches to Sonicare, but it doesn't seem critical. One immediate thing I noticed was the light ring which instantly lets you know if you are pressing too hard or not enough. As somebody with gum issues, this is appreciated. Next thing, do set up and try out the app. I was skeptical, but it really does a good job of figuring out what part of your mouth you are brushing, apparently by some kind of bluetooth-based sonar and something in the brush that can tell if it's facing up or down. It's not to the level of knowing which tooth, but it maps the front and two sides of both the top and bottom of your mouth, which is still pretty detailed. Rather than just using some kind of timer, it tracks that you spend the proper amount of time in each of the 6 regions. Your coverage within each region is then up to you. Sure, there are some times when it is a bit off, but I find that that tends to happen if I turn my head. So if you keep your head still, it seems to work more accurately. Not too hard to do. Besides the main brush tracking, you can set specific goals, and it will add recommendations for other steps like tongue brushing and flossing. I started a program for plaque removal. So now, instead of brushing or not kind of mindlessly in the shower one a day, I have started brushing twice a day, with more intention, and it's even slightly fun. And so far, my teeth feel smoother and cleaner. I also get less gum bleed, perhaps due to avoiding pressing too hard. I think this is still a bit pricey at full price, but maybe in this case it could be worth it for the improvement in your teeth and gum health. On sale, I can definitely recommend. Will it last long term? We'll see.

reviews.review_title: Smart, Powerful, and Leaves Teeth Feeling Dentist-Clean
reviews.review_description:
I’ve been using the Oral-B iO5 and it’s honestly a huge upgrade from a regular toothbrush.

The cleaning power is excellent—my teeth feel noticeably smoother and cleaner after every use. The micro-vibrations combined with the round brush head really make a difference, removing more plaque than a manual brush.

What I really like is the smart pressure sensor and guided brushing. It helps you avoid brushing too hard and improves your technique over time, which is great for gum health.

It’s also very easy to use, with multiple modes depending on your needs (sensitive, whitening, daily clean, etc.), and the overall design feels premium and comfortable.

Overall, this is a high-quality electric toothbrush that delivers a professional-level clean at home—definitely worth it if you want to upgrade your oral care routine.
I love my toothbrush. The bristles are very good, it has just enough power. I will say however, my only complaint is the battery does not seem to last that long! Other than that I have no complaints

This has quickly become a favorite for our entire family. Everyone has used it, and it's been a great purchase from day one. The quality is better than we expected, and it's easy to use, making it something we reach for regularly.

What I appreciate most is that it has held up well with multiple people using it. It does exactly what it's supposed to do, and we haven't had any issues with it so far.

If you're considering buying one, I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it. It's been a great value for our family, and we'd definitely purchase it again.

I had a different brand before this one and that one was my first electric toothbrush. One thing I didn’t like about it was the size of the brush head. It was too narrow and since it was a vibration device only, the head material being plastic was very uncomfortable to use and the vibration of the head material against my teeth was annoying if you didn’t hold it just right. The size of the head was very small and narrow so it seemed to take a long time to get the job done. After receiving and using this device, what a difference it made. Very easy to use and cleaned extremely well. The brush head size was perfect and comfortable and even though there is some vibration, it was very comfortable and easy to get used to and wasn’t annoying. As far as cleaning goes, this device was exceptional and did a fantastic job on the first try, the rotation of the heads really seem to help clean. The APP mapping of the brushing worked great and let me know where I needed to brush and for how long. It’s not a cheap brush but so far seems to be well worth the expense. It came with three brush heads and I used the ultimate clean one only so far and did a great job. The brush heads may seem expensive but if the system does what it’s supposed to do then I’m all in. So far I’m very pleased with my purchase and delivery was received overnight so delivery was quick as usual from Amazon.

reviews.review_title: Good: Great cleaning - Bad: MESSY -- a 2 min brushing turns into 4 mins of cleanup
reviews.review_description:
To be clear, the cleaning power gets five stars.

However, this is the messiest toothbrush I've ever used. The brush heads have two holes in the back, and you might think you could _hold_ it a certain way to keep toothpaste and spit from getting everywhere. You would be wrong.

If you've never had a smart electric toothbrush, the ideas here are very cool and mostly useful, but be prepared to have a LOT more cleanup when done than simply rinsing the head under the sink and wiping your mouth. Pay close attention, or you'll have stains on your shirt. Toothpaste WILL be on your chin, your hand, and dribbling down your arm, unless you keep your elbow raised for the duration!

I love the ideas and how well it cleans my teeth, but for the reasons mentioned above, I can't really recommend this to people I actually like.

reviews.review_title: Torn between this and the other brand
reviews.review_description:
Been a Sonicare user for 10-15 years and decided I wanted to try the Oral B. I didn't want to spend a lot, so I found this one and ordered it.

Things I like:

Love circular motion of the brush instead of the up an down movement of the Sonicare.

Love that it has a sensor to alert you if you are brushing too hard. Such a simple feature and hopefully it shows on my next dental visit.

Battery seems to last a long time between charges. I am going on two weeks without charging which is great for travel.

Like that the handle stays cleaner compared to my older Sonicare because of how it is designed. Toothpaste and water run down it and does not have a place to collect.

Things I don't like:

The brush had by design traps water whereas the Sonicare brush design seems to drain water better. I rinse my toothbrush and then lay it brush side down on a towel to let it dry before standing it up on the counter or charger. If not, I worry about it not drying fully and things growing.

I hate that it doesn't have an auto shut off. It does vibrate every 30 seconds but it doesn't shut off. First time I used it I probably brushed for 3.5 minutes before I realized it wasn't going to turn off.

Overall the quality doesn't seem as nice. Maybe this would be different if I had spent more money on a higher end model, but because this something I was just buying to try, I didn't want to spend a lot. If I was completely sold on this brush, I would upgrade for sure.

I really am torn between the two brands of brushes. Now if someone would make one that has the best of both. :)

reviews.review_title: Better than I expected for the price compared to more sophisticated models

Works great, cleans teeth, has 3 speeds, and has a timer for all sections of your mouth, great toothbrush, own 2 in different colors 😀

My product came used the toothbrush itself was all covered in dirt the whole body of the toothbrush and then there were 3 pieces of toilet paper bunched up in the box now this is serious here sending people who buy brand new merchandise stuff like this and it has actually been happening to me frequently I used to see reviews about it and thought maybe they weren't true but now I'm learning that this is actually happening so without a doubt I'm telling you to buy this toothbrush somewhere else!!!! My only skepticism remaining is around the brush head, which is recessed in the middle. I am not sure on how thorough a job that shape does, as it feels like only the edges touch my teeth. reviews.review_description: Nice and quiet. I like having 3 speeds. I don’t need a timer, but I do want to get alerts if I use too much pressure, which it does.

reviews.review_title: A simple but highly effective electric toothbrush
reviews.review_description:
This toothbrush functions excellently. I don't need anything fancier - it has three different speed/pressure modes and recharges on it's base. I have a bar covering my lower teeth that is hard to clean, but this brush and it's heads do it well. This is my first electric toothbrush and I will be sticking with it as long as I can.

ONLY con is that grime buildup from the brushing process can build up in both the head and the stem of the brush unit. To keep them both clean, I remove the head, rinse both parts and tap them a few times on the counter to get the debris out. I let them both dry separately, and just reconnect it when I'm ready to use it again. It may seem tedious, but it keeps everything clean in the long run.

I like the toothbrush but even though I charged it the appropriate time…like 2 days! After using it a couple days the red light comes on indicating it needs to be charged. I am returning for the same model and hope for better luck

reviews.review_title: Powerful dual Sonicare set with great features
reviews.review_description:
I purchased the Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 Electric Toothbrush as a 2-pack (black and white) and have been very happy with the overall quality and performance. Having two handles in one package is extremely convenient—for example, one for home and one for travel, or one for myself and one for a partner—without needing to buy a second set separately. The build quality feels solid, and both brushes look sleek and modern, with a premium finish that matches the price point.

In terms of brushing performance, the sonic cleaning is excellent. My teeth feel noticeably smoother and cleaner compared to a standard manual toothbrush, and the different modes make it easy to tailor the experience to daily cleaning, gum care, or more intensive polishing. The pressure sensor and timing guidance are genuinely useful; they help prevent brushing too hard and encourage you to cover the full mouth evenly, which is a nice touch for long-term gum and enamel health.

The app connectivity is a bonus, especially if you like data and feedback. It can help reinforce better brushing habits and highlight areas you might be missing, though it does add a layer of complexity—Bluetooth pairing and checking the phone during brushing isn’t for everyone. Battery life has been good so far, but you do need to stay on top of charging both handles, especially if you’re traveling frequently or using multiple modes.

Overall, this dual-handle DiamondClean 9000 set is a great choice if you want top-tier cleaning performance, smart features, and a premium look, and you value having two brushes in one package. Love my Sonicare! Gave the black one to my son. Price was fantastic and the settings are great. The charger cup is super cute and the rechargeable case is a must! The speed and vibration are unmatched without clunky noise and the “deep clean” setting is perfect for the evening brush. The whitening setting is great for morning to set my smile for success. Quality is always expected from Sonicare.

I needed a new toothbrush, and was very happy to find this set. I got it during Amazon prime day and it was much cheaper than I have seen it in stores. I had the same diamond clean, but the last version of it. This one definitely vibrates with more intensity. It cleans really well. The quality is great. I had the glass with my last toothbrush and the glass can still fit on top of this charger or you can use it with the plastic charger. I have been using it with the plastic charger instead of the glass. It seems more compact that way. It charges with no issues and it has an app that connects to the toothbrushes and it tells you how long that you’ve been brushing each day and how many times a day that you’re brushing and it gives you goals. I really like that new feature. It’s makes it fun to be able to see how long I’ve been brushing my teeth.

Okay, if you are reading this and the price is higher than $199, WAIT. It goes down to $199 fairly regularly-- at least it did 2-3 times this year (including prime day), and did last year for Black Friday sales.

I LOVE my sonicare. You will have to pry it out of my cold, dead, hands. It makes brushing so much easier, and I like the light when you are brushing too hard, which I've heard dentists say is a pretty bad thing.

The battery life is great-- a solid 2-3 weeks out of one charge. I love that I can charge it, go on a week's vacation, and not worry about bringing the charger. I just throw a cover on the brush head and toss in my carry-on (note: since it is a rechargeable battery, please put it in your carry-on). The cover for the brush head is useless, so use something else when putting it in luggage.

It has 4-5 different modes-- whitening, gum sensitivity, deep cleaning, etc. I like the whitening one, which is 2 min 40 seconds. It buzzes every 20 seconds to get you to move on to the next section. You can choose from strong, medium, or mild vibration. And the strong one is STRONG. I feel my head buzz when I use it, lol, so I normally stick to the medium.

My teeth feel so much cleaner when using this, and I love the discipline it gives me. However, I have seen this vary in price from $199-399. Please don't buy it when it's at its high price. You can get a much better deal!

Overall, this is a high-quality toothbrush that really improves daily oral care. I would definitely recommend it.

Size is the same and the functions are comparable. It does have an extra function my old model did not. Works just as good if not better. Its a great value for the 2 that you get.

Other than that the design is sleek, easy to use, and I like that you can change the cleaning type and the vibration strength. It comes with standing charger as well as I like how you can take it with you anywhere and use the travel case to charge without having to bring the standing charger. Overall it's been great.

reviews.review_title: Great set especially if you have dental implants
reviews.review_description:
I recently picked this up after getting full dental implants and this is a great set. I had ordered black but somehow I received pink? I don't even see a pink set available on Amazon. Regardless I kept it. In all I like it but the charging cables may be an issue somewhere down the line. Here are my pros and cons.

Pros:

- You can adjust the waterpik settings without needing to have the waterpik on.

- You can easily turn the waterpik on/off without fear of hitting one of the setting buttons.

- The reservoir is the perfect size for me for one use.

- You get a travel case for both the toothbrush and waterpik.

- The toothbrush has a very nice "gums" setting

- The base charger for the toothbrush has an interesting design which I believe will be easier to clean than my Oral-B.

Cons:

- You only get one charger cable to share between the waterpik and the toothbrush.

- The charger cable is a non-standard barrel charger so good luck on finding a spare online. It should be USB-C or something more universal.

- I'm concerned that the toothbrush base charger port may corrode over time due to water ingress. It should not have been removable.

The battery holds a nice charge, it gets the job done without damage to my gums

Great product and great price! Everything works efficiently. The water flosser definitely is the most powerful one I’ve ever used before on the “high” setting.
