reviews.review_title: A great option over a standard toothbrush
reviews.review_description:
What started as having just one of these in our household has turned into the whole family using these Sonicare toothbrushes. Having considered all the various models this particular one proved perfect for our use case. We have 5 of these in our household. We do have the white and black models and either are based on preference but over time I tend to think that even though the black (this model) might show residue easier that also makes it easier to see and clean and it's possible the white could discolor over time.

The travel case is a nice feature to have. Have not traveled with it as of yet to see how functional and how much room it may consume if trying to travel light but it's there. The is not enough room to also store the charger in the case but will hold the handle and the brush (separated from the handle) in the included durable travel case. It does come with two additional brushes which is nice. The charging base is a standard two prong plug. Be cautious as some models seem to have a USB charging base that would require an additional purchase of a charger to charge in a standard outlet.

This model has three settings with lighting for each. The bottom of the two buttons easily move through each setting with each press. There is a low battery indicator as well.

Brushing with this is amazing. It's much more effective than a standard toothbrush or any standard electric toothbrush used over time. Even the kids notice how much cleaner their teeth seem after a use. Brushing harder is not good on teeth as any dentist has told me over time so this brush helps regulate how you brush. You don't have to brush with the Sonicare. The Sonicare does the brushing. You can simply slowly guide the brush over your teeth and let the Sonicare do its job. If the brush is pressed too hard against the teeth the Sonicare vibrations will halt as a sign you are trying to brush too hard.

Overall this device is highly recommended and it's even better if you watch for a good deal that does or had occurred periodically.

It took me awhile before I figured out how to not spray the mirror but this tooth cleaning tool is fabulous and I recommend it ASAP. My dentist was so impressed he ordered them for the office to sell. It charges but I never leave it off the charger. You can message your gums, clean as well as remove particles in your teeth. Fabulous. The brushes get accustom but once you do it’s easy peasy. Teeth are white and very clean.

I have had better service from this unit than previous Philips Sonicare models, so I'm a happy fellow. Charging is easy; just place the unit onto the charging pin on the platform. Material is sturdy and quite waterproof and it is a good weight for sturdy application without fatigue. I've tried to wear the battery down for travel and couldn't do so over a couple of days continuous discharging and still going strong. It's especially good for gum care along with tooth cleaning. I also like the 2-minute operating length with beeps every 30 seconds.

reviews.review_title: I like brushing my teeth with it
reviews.review_description:
I am a lifelong manual medium bristles toothbrush user. Over the years, I have seen electric toothbrushes in my friend's and family's bathrooms and never thought I would ever want to use one.

After doing some research, I decided to buy this electric toothbrush. At first, I was not sure if the small brush head would do as good of a job as my standard size manual toothbrush. It took me two days and four brushings to get use to it. The small brush head did a better job at cleaning my teeth. I can not believe how clean my teeth feel after brushing 2 minutes with this toothbrush. Even my gumline has felt cleaner after brushing with this thing multiple times for a week. With my manual toothbrush, there were times I could feel that my gumline was not as clean as it should be. Never once did I irritate my gums while brushing like I did with my manual toothbrush many of times. The electric toothbrush pressure sensor prevented me from doing that to my gums.

The 2-minute timer for the clean mode is good for me. After brushing teeth, I switch the intensity to the gum care mode to clean my gums. I like how the brush head replacement reminder and pressure sensor can be deactivated if you do not like those features. My traveling case struggles to stay closed. I may have to buy a different one for traveling with this electric toothbrush.

I am impressed with it and wished that I would have bought one of these years ago.

1-24-26

I'm not impressed with the charger. If I use the toothbrush until the battery indicator starts to flash auburn color LED, it takes more than eight hours to fully charge the battery. There is not enough counter space for me to keep the toothbrush docked on the charger. My Philips Norelco All-in-One Series 9000 Trimmer, Wahl Pro Series Detail Trimmer, and Wahl Lithium Ion Pro Rechargeable Cordless Hair Clippers all charge faster than this thing. Heck, a Dewalt 6Ah battery chargers faster than this toothbrush.

I always forget to write reviews after I buy stuff on Amazon. I should try to do it more because it is helpful when you find a review that is real.

So, I bought this toothbrush to replace another brand that I bought about a year and a half ago. The old toothbrush just wasn't doing a good job at cleaning my teeth. I have always had problems with cavities and plaque build-up. The only sure-fire way of getting all of the plaque for me was to use Plax prior to brushing. Still, I find myself in the dentist's office every six months with a hygienist jack-hammering my mouth with water pick to get my teeth clean. It's embarrassing and it makes me feel anxious about my gum health. I saw the Oral-B iO Series 3 here on Amazon and it was discounted. According to Oral-B it is really good at getting rid of plaque. I took the manufacturer at their word, and bought it. Holy crap, ya'll! This thing is amazing!

The iO3 has a round brush head similar to the polishing tool your dental hygienist uses. I've used cheaper Oral-B electric toothbrushes that also have round heads, but they weren't as robust as the brush head on the iO3. The bristles aren't hard, but they are dense and arranged in a way that they can hug your teeth while brushing. You can get that brush on every surface of each tooth (except directly between the teeth, of course). The motorized handle has a pressure sensor that changes color based on how hard or soft you are pressing. If you get it just right, it lights up green.

The iO3 also helps you time your brushing so that you the recommended two minutes. It pulses when it's time to change to a different quadrant. It doesn't automatically shut off when the two minutes are up, however. That's fine with me as I will just continue brushing other parts of my mouth like my tongue and the roof of my palette when I'm done with my teeth.

There are supposedly three types of brushing settings to choose from, but I have only used the default cleaning setting. The other two setting are supposed to be for sensitive teeth and whitening. The default works just fine for me.

The build is solid and feels good in my hands. I like that the handle comes with two brush heads, a travel case, and case for the brush heads. I like to take my brush head off and put it in the case after I'm finished just because I'm paranoid about having a toothbrush exposed in the bathroom. It's nice to have the option to shield it from germs.

So, TLDR, this is a great electric toothbrush. My teeth haven't felt this clean since the last time I went to the dentist. Oral-B did a fantastic job of designing a product that makes brushing easy and will almost certainly result in you having a positive visit at the dentist, and may help reverse gum issues and prevent cavities. I definitely recommend you buy this product if you are in the market for an electric toothbrush.

Item is as described. I got the peach pink color and I would just call it pink. It’s pretty. It arrived charged. Thorough user manual. I love that it is quiet; my old one was clanking loudly. I love that it is well regarded by the industry experts for a price that is very reasonable. I’ve only had it a few days; so far so good.

First, there are two types of electric toothbrushes. True electric and ultrasonic.

True electric toothbrushes have heads that spin, etc. They provide spin or rotation to the bristles needed to brush your teeth so all you have to do is move the brush across your teeth. If this is what you want, then skip this set.

Then there are ultrasonic toothbrushes, like this one. These toothbrushes have heads that just vibrate. There is no spin or rotation to push the bristles between and around your teeth. You still need to physically run the brush back and forth, in a circular motion, etc, for them to work.

With that clarified, this brush works great. The head a nice size - not too big, not too small. The bristles are firm but not scratch off your enamel hard - as long as you don't use too much pressure. The head has longer bristles on either side that reach between your teeth and along your gum lines.

The toothbrush stops vibrating for a moment every 30 seconds and then turns off at 2 minutes. This allows you to time your brushing by quadrant (upper left, upper right, lower left, lower right). This makes it easy for those non-morning folks who suddenly realize they've been brushing one tooth for 5 minutes (you'll understand if this is you).

The vibrations take a bit of getting used to - in some modes they can tickle your gums. Each mode is supposed to be for a specific use: White, Clean, Soft, Polish, Gum Care. The modes appear to simply change the amount of vibration - white being the strongest and gum care being the weakest. I would suggest just finding the mode you are most comfortable with and staying with that.

Yes, you DO need to put the brush in your mouth BEFORE you turn it on. Just like you put the lid on the blender before turning it on. If you don't, then there WILL be a mess. This is not a failing of the toothbrush, it is simply the nature of the beast.

I like that it comes with 8 heads. I've had other electric toothbrushes only to find after 3-6 months that I couldn't get replacement heads for them anymore. At this price point ($20 as of this review), if I can't get replacement heads after going through the 8 included, then I've still spent less than if I was buying standard toothbrushes.

The heads do fit snugly and securely. The more you switch them out, the weaker that connection will be, and a head could come out during brushing due to the vibrations. I recommend you buy separate toothbrushes for each member of the family rather than trying to share and switch heads out daily.

The toothbrush holder is simple but effective. It keeps the head protected while allowing it to air dry and it holds the toothbrush for convenient access. I attached the cover to a textured high gloss wall next to the sink and it has stayed in place without issue. The cover opens with just a light pull on the toothbrush so there is no fighting to get your toothbrush out.

Overall, I highly recommend this toothbrush if you are looking for an ultrasonic (vibrating not spinning or rotating) toothbrush.

reviews.review_title: Lighter touch than others; higher vibration speed; does a fine job on only one battery.
reviews.review_description:
I have always used the Arm & Hammer Spin-Brush, and now that it is no longer available, had to find a replacement. I specifically wanted one that used batteries, so I don't have to fuss with a charger when on a trip.

I was frankly concerned that there were no two-battery units like the Spin Brush, worried that a one-battery unit would not be as aggressive as I would like. And when I first used this one, it seemed less forceful, so my concern remained.

Over a few days I realized that this brush vibrates a a much higher rate than the old two-battery Spin Brush, so it seemed to be doing its job just as well as my old device. In fact, it finally occurred to me that the whole idea of an electric toothbrush was to increase the brushing action rate compared to manually brushing; therefore faster is better, offsetting any lack of aggressive power.

I have come to believe that this brush is every bit as good as my old one, even with only one battery.

One thing I should mention though, is after several weeks I failed to notice it was moving slower. Just as an experiment I put in a new battery and voila! It began spinning at a much higher rate - I hadn't noticed it slowing down, and will now pay attention as it may need a battery every two to three weeks. That's not a problem as my old Spin Brush needed two batteries over 4 to 5 weeks, so it's basically a "break-even" on battery usage.

It's been over a month since I got this brush, and in fact ordered several because they are very well priced on Amazon; I waited to review it honestly and can now say I am comfortable with the lighter touch and faster speed as a better solution to power toothbrushing.

I hope this doesn't get discontinued in a couple of years now that I find it so useful!

reviews.review_title: Works well ... but wears out FAST!
reviews.review_description:
Mixed feelings on this one. I've been using it for quite a few years now. I like how it works, when it works. It's just that the brush heads and the brush itself wears out a lot quicker than I like. I generally have to change the heads once a month or so. What happens is while that the bristles themselves aren't really worn down at that point, the head itself loses its back and forth rotation. It might "appear" to be still be turning, but check it in the mirror when there is pressure on it, i.e. against your teeth and gums, or test it against your fingernail, and you'll see when it's no longer effective. At that point, it's just basically vibrating in your mouth without cleaning anything. Folks who use this regularly should check for this. It took me a while to realize that after a month or so, I was merely pretending to brush my teeth but not really cleaning anything. Also, once the head wears, the seam/gap between the main piece and the rotating brush part loosens and widens quite a bit and pinches the insides of your mouth.

The brush itself tends to wear out after about 4 to 5 months, where once again it still "appears" to be working, but if you check carefully, you'll find that even if you put a new head in there, the rotating properties diminish greatly. I think the inner mechanism simply wears out by then, and no longer connects and moves the brush head as well. Yes, once again, let's all thank corporate America for "Planned Obsolescence".

I used to use Sonic Care. The $125 model I bought was good, but no longer held a charge after 2 years. How convenient for Sonic Care. Then I tried their battery operated $40 model, which worked OK but had a really stupidly designed battery cap which allowed water to flow into the compartment. Wow, that's TITANICALLY STUPID!!! Anyway, found this and works OK ... and have been using it since. However, not without the stated reservations. If one were to change the brush and brush heads as often as necessary (which I do), it's not really all that cheap to use. It's actually pretty expensive to use. About 10 to 12 heads and 2 or 3 brushes a year. Do the math. If I find a better alternative, I'll switch without too much nostalgia, ha ha.

Note: I do want to state that my brushing routine is probably a lot more thorough and longer than most (about 5 minutes per session), so others may get a longer "effective life" than I get. But still, can't imagine their recommendation of changing the heads every 3 months being adequate. Folks who use this really should monitor the "TRUE effective life" of their brushes and heads, otherwise you might "think" you're brushing your teeth, but might actually be doing nothing to effectively "clean" them.

Hope this is helpful.

Cheers

reviews.review_title: It's a nice toothbrush - but be watchful of the inside of the brush head, it can become moldy
reviews.review_description:
Wow. This Oral B is a big improvement over the one I replaced. It’s whisper quiet in comparison, and I really like the pressure sensor light (green if good pressure, red if too much pressure, white if too little pressure). I also like that I can set the brush mode (speed) to “sensitive”, which is what I use exclusively with a sensitive brush head. My older Oral B only oscillated. This newer one both oscillates and micro-vibrates.

My old Oral B was about 10-12 yrs old. It still worked perfectly. Buying sensitive brushes had become fairly inexpensive. I’m pretty sure it would have kept on working at least another 5 yrs. However, my hygienist repeatedly told me: “You’re not doing this, you’re not doing that, blah blah blah.” Tiresome. Sometimes the brush would strike under the gum line around a crown and cause lingering pain.

I learned about the new Oral B with the pressure sensor and decided to buy one. Here was the surprising thing to me: I wasn’t brushing hard enough, at least according to the pressure sensor. The first time I used it, I was repeatedly in the white zone (too little pressure).

Also, here’s the thing that really did it for me, I didn’t really know how to brush correctly. I found a video on YouTube (“Tips On How To Brush with an Oral B Electric Toothbrush” by Murmann Dental Health) that explained and demonstrated exactly how to brush using an Oral B with pressure sensor. That was very illuminating. I highly recommend that or a similar video. The thing that stood out from the video was that our teeth are rounded, so we need to wrap the brush around each individual tooth .

I’ve been following what I learned in the video. So far, the brush hasn’t caused pain under the gum line. The IO sensitive brush along with the “sensitive” setting on the device have been a more comfortable brushing experience for me. I’m consistently in the green zone. Hopefully, it all makes a difference at my next dental appointment.

I was sorry to see my old Oral B go as it was still useful, but sometimes useful doesn’t mean effective or appropriate for teeth & gum challenges. It can still be useful for other purposes.

I have never used the app, so no comment there.

The travel case is very nice and will come in handy. The only thing I don’t like about it is it doesn’t include storage for what seems to be a proprietary charger. The charger is two-pin, and I guess it’s supposedly safer to use in wet environments; you may need to include it in your travel bag depending on your travel time.

5 stars from me.

The professionally inspired design of the CrossAction brush head surrounds each tooth with bristles angled at 16 degrees. I hope this review helps you in your decision!!

### Design and Build Quality:

The Oral-B Pro 1000 features a simple, ergonomic design that is easy to handle. It has a rubberized grip that ensures a secure hold, even when wet. The toothbrush comes with a single CrossAction brush head, which is angled to effectively reach between teeth and along the gum line. The design is durable, though it lacks some of the premium materials found in higher-end models. The toothbrush is available in a few different color options, typically white with blue or black accents.

### Cleaning Performance:

The Pro 1000 is equipped with a 3D cleaning action that oscillates, rotates, and pulsates to break up and remove plaque. This technology, combined with the CrossAction brush head, provides a thorough cleaning experience that is superior to manual brushing. Many users report a noticeable improvement in the cleanliness of their teeth and a reduction in plaque buildup. However, it doesn’t offer the same level of customization or advanced features as more expensive models, such as multiple cleaning modes or pressure sensors.

### Battery Life:

The toothbrush operates on a rechargeable battery that lasts about 7-10 days on a full charge, assuming two minutes of brushing twice a day. The battery life is decent, but it falls short of some higher-end models that offer up to two weeks or more. The Pro 1000 does not have a battery level indicator, so users need to be mindful of when it needs to be recharged.

### Features:

The Oral-B Pro 1000 is relatively basic in terms of features. It includes a built-in two-minute timer with 30-second intervals, which helps ensure users brush for the recommended amount of time and spend equal time on each quadrant of the mouth. However, it lacks additional features like multiple brushing modes, Bluetooth connectivity, or a travel case. This simplicity might appeal to users who prefer a straightforward brushing experience without the need for extra bells and whistles.

### Value for Money:

The Pro 1000 is competitively priced, making it an attractive option for those seeking an effective electric toothbrush without spending a premium. It offers solid performance for the price, providing a significant upgrade over manual toothbrushes and some lower-end electric models. While it lacks some advanced features, it delivers on the essentials of oral hygiene, making it a good value for most users.

### Conclusion:

The Oral-B Pro 1000 CrossAction Electric Toothbrush is a great option for those looking for a reliable and effective toothbrush without the complexity or cost of higher-end models. It excels in basic cleaning performance and ease of use, making it suitable for both new and experienced electric toothbrush users. While it doesn’t have many extra features, it covers the essentials well, providing good value for money.

reviews.review_title: Cheaper than a filling & totally worth the investment after 9 months of use
reviews.review_description:
My dental hygienist recommended this toothbrush about nine months ago. When I mentioned how expensive it was, she said, “It’s still cheaper than getting a filling.” That changed how I looked at the price, so I went for it.

The guided brushing app takes the guesswork out of whether I’m actually brushing everywhere. I used it twice a day in the beginning, which really helped me build better brushing habits. Nine months later, I don’t use the app every time anymore, but I still check in here and there to make sure I’m staying on track. The pressure sensor is also super helpful! My dentist mentioned that many people damage their gums and teeth by brushing too hard, and this makes it very obvious when you’re using too much pressure.

I’ve had two dental cleanings since switching, and both were probably the quickest I’ve ever had. My dentist and hygienist said everything looked great with very little cleaning needed and mentioned they commonly see this with patients using an Oral-B iO.

The brush heads indicate when they need replacing, which for me has been roughly every three months. They’re about $10 per replacement head, so that’s another ~$40 a year to factor into the cost. Not cheap, but reasonable enough for me considering how well the toothbrush has performed.

My only complaint is that it’s can be a bit messy. Even after rinsing the head and shaking off excess water, some water/toothpaste tends to run down the handle once it’s on the charger, so I clean the charging base a couple times a week.

It’s definitely an investment, but after nine months of daily use and two great dental checkups, I’m very happy I bought it.

reviews.review_title: A baffling design flaw in a very expensive toothbrush
reviews.review_description:
I bought the Oral-B iO Series 9 expecting a premium product. The toothbrush itself has a lot to recommend it, but the charging base has one of the worst design flaws I have encountered in a consumer product.

The iO9 is a relatively tall, expensive electronic device, yet while charging it essentially balances upright on a small, shallow magnetic base. There is no meaningful post, socket, collar, or other mechanical support to keep the handle from tipping sideways. Because the handle is so tall, it takes remarkably little lateral force to knock it off the charger.

This isn’t a hypothetical concern. I had a previous Oral-B toothbrush fall from its charger and break. With this one, I eventually stopped keeping it conveniently in the bathroom because I didn’t trust the charger to keep it secure. I actually improvised a second magnetic support against the handle when I kept it elsewhere, which dramatically improved its stability.

What makes this especially frustrating is that the problem is neither difficult to foresee nor difficult to solve. Competing electric toothbrushes use charging designs that mechanically locate and support the handle. Even a modest post, recess, collar, or other positive restraint could dramatically reduce the chance of an expensive toothbrush being knocked onto a hard bathroom floor.

For a flagship toothbrush at this price, this is particularly difficult to excuse. Oral-B put enormous engineering effort into the iO’s display, sensors, pressure detection, Bluetooth connectivity, brushing modes, and app integration. The company should have put comparable thought into the much simpler requirement that the toothbrush remain standing securely while it charges.

Prospective buyers should know about this before purchasing because it isn’t something obvious from the feature list. If you buy one, be very careful where you place the charger

Love the travel charger, effectiveness I once had of tartar removal & overall cleanliness. To me, the value is good and it’s sleek and easy to travel with. The initial charge has lasted so far 2 weeks. Bristles are firm but will soften.

This puppy is miles beyond my ten year old Sonicare, and also various newer models from other brands. Faster vibrations, stronger cleaning, more settings, much longer battery life. Definitely the best electric toothbrush I've used.

Use it with a good tooth powder, activated charcoal, baking soda, clay, or better still alternate between a few of these, and your dental bills will quickly shrink.

At fifty during prime week, this was a steal. Even at double that, it's definitely worth it.

reviews.review_title: I SWEAR by the brand -- reliable, sturdy yet delicate enough for my hand and small mouth.
reviews.review_description:
This is my THIRD Philips Sonicare in my lifetime. I'm old. I have good teeth and I take care of them. My dental hygienist tells me I'm one of her favorite patients. It's the toothbrush my dentist from years ago recommended and I absolutely love the brand. It's great for my gums as well as my teeth. It is GREAT value for the money and the fact that in my lifetime, I'm on my third (I'm 76), I think that's a very good brand recommendation. And it's very lightweight and easily transported. I like the white because I feel like I can see that it's pristine and clean. Nice design that lets me twist the bristles up and down along each tooth. Love it and highly recommend it.

The whitening depends more on dentifrice being used, I believe, and the fact that one brushes multiple times a day. Check with your dentist on details for whitening.

reviews.review_title: A new level in toothbrush performance, but no wall plug and an intrusive app
reviews.review_description:
This toothbrush appears to live up to the extravagant claim on the box. I have no way of knowing if the amount of plaque removed is actually 2000% more than what my previous Sonicare could do, but it is a huge improvement. I used to believe the job of an electric toothbrush was to pound my gums into submission, but this model is far more gentle and does a better job of reaching the tricky trouble spots my dentist never tires of pointing out. So I do recommend this product with almost no reservations.

But before you open the box you should know that the power cord is a USB-A plug, wall unit not included. Phillips says this is to cut down on electronic waste, which is such an obvious euphemism for "it saves us money" that you wonder why they even bothered.

Also, the Sonicare 7300 has Bluetooth connectivity, and you can download an app and connect to, um, your toothbrush. I said what the heck I'll give it a try. The app says it values your privacy but then it doesn't let you complete setup unless you agree to send all data to Phillips so they can help you with suggestions for improving your dental hygiene. Then the home screen comes up and it's a dental chart, at which point I killed the app and uninstalled it. Perhaps you might find such detailed help useful, but I'm not interested in being an unpaid beta tester or belonging to a floating focus group for future products.

I've been using a Sonicare for years and will continue to do so. But the way this product is packaged and presented seems to make it just another way that big business is trying to carve off a big slice of my conscious awareness. And I’m getting tired of that.

reviews.review_title: A good value for the uses you'll get out it.
reviews.review_description: this toothbrush is a good value for the money, since it is packaged with a charging base, travel case, and 3 replacement toothbrush heads. You can also set it up to auto deliver the heads when they get worn out. The auto delivery is easy to do, just follow the instructions that will be on the Amazon website. reviews.review_title: The Toothbrush That Thinks It’s Better Than Me… and Honestly Is
reviews.review_description:
The Philips Sonicare 7300 doesn’t just clean your teeth — it judges your entire dental existence. In the best way.

The first time I turned it on, I swear it sounded like it was saying, “Move aside, amateur, I’ve got this.” And it did. This thing blasts plaque off your teeth like it’s clearing a runway. My mouth hasn’t felt this clean since the day I grew my first tooth.

The pressure sensor lights up like a tattletale every time you brush too hard. The timer keeps you honest. The brush heads feel like they were engineered by NASA for enamel. And the clean afterward? Unreal. My teeth are so smooth I’m convinced I could butter toast with them.

It’s powerful, it’s smart, it’s slightly condescending — and it’s absolutely fantastic.

Five stars. My dentist is going to weep with joy.

I always forget to write reviews after I buy stuff on Amazon. I should try to do it more because it is helpful when you find a review that is real.

So, I bought this toothbrush to replace another brand that I bought about a year and a half ago. The old toothbrush just wasn't doing a good job at cleaning my teeth. I have always had problems with cavities and plaque build-up. The only sure-fire way of getting all of the plaque for me was to use Plax prior to brushing. Still, I find myself in the dentist's office every six months with a hygienist jack-hammering my mouth with water pick to get my teeth clean. It's embarrassing and it makes me feel anxious about my gum health. I saw the Oral-B iO Series 3 here on Amazon and it was discounted. According to Oral-B it is really good at getting rid of plaque. I took the manufacturer at their word, and bought it. Holy crap, ya'll! This thing is amazing!

The iO3 has a round brush head similar to the polishing tool your dental hygienist uses. I've used cheaper Oral-B electric toothbrushes that also have round heads, but they weren't as robust as the brush head on the iO3. The bristles aren't hard, but they are dense and arranged in a way that they can hug your teeth while brushing. You can get that brush on every surface of each tooth (except directly between the teeth, of course). The motorized handle has a pressure sensor that changes color based on how hard or soft you are pressing. If you get it just right, it lights up green.

The iO3 also helps you time your brushing so that you the recommended two minutes. It pulses when it's time to change to a different quadrant. It doesn't automatically shut off when the two minutes are up, however. That's fine with me as I will just continue brushing other parts of my mouth like my tongue and the roof of my palette when I'm done with my teeth.

There are supposedly three types of brushing settings to choose from, but I have only used the default cleaning setting. The other two setting are supposed to be for sensitive teeth and whitening. The default works just fine for me.

The build is solid and feels good in my hands. I like that the handle comes with two brush heads, a travel case, and case for the brush heads. I like to take my brush head off and put it in the case after I'm finished just because I'm paranoid about having a toothbrush exposed in the bathroom. It's nice to have the option to shield it from germs.

So, TLDR, this is a great electric toothbrush. My teeth haven't felt this clean since the last time I went to the dentist. Oral-B did a fantastic job of designing a product that makes brushing easy and will almost certainly result in you having a positive visit at the dentist, and may help reverse gum issues and prevent cavities. I definitely recommend you buy this product if you are in the market for an electric toothbrush.

The only thing I don't like is the brush head that came with it, but I replaced it with the Diamond Clean head that I'm used to and it's now basically all the same, just a better price. The brush seems well made and the usual quality of Sonicare products, I'll update if it dies sooner than normal. Overall, I like it. I won't discourage you from buying one of the more expensive models if you want the additional settings, but this has all I really need. • Classic power: It has the strong, familiar buzz of a new Sonicare.

• Great value: It does everything I need without paying for extra features I never used.

• Charger: Includes a USB car charger. (USB wall adapter block not included; plugs into any standard USB port).

Things to point out:

• Brush head swap: You do get a brush head included in the box however there are different brush head options that you can purchase separately at the store.

If you want extra settings, you can buy an expensive Philips Sonicare model. But if you just want a great clean, this simple sonicare toothbrush is all you need!

I like to take my brush head off and put it in the case after I'm finished just because I'm paranoid about having a toothbrush exposed in the bathroom. It's nice to have the option to shield it from germs.

So, TLDR, this is a great electric toothbrush. My teeth haven't felt this clean since the last time I went to the dentist. Oral-B did a fantastic job of designing a product that makes brushing easy and will almost certainly result in you having a positive visit at the dentist, and may help reverse gum issues and prevent cavities. I definitely recommend you buy this product if you are in the market for an electric toothbrush.

Read more

reviews.review_title: A noticeable upgrade from the Pro 1000!
reviews.review_description:
I previously owned the Oral-B Pro 1000, and while it did a good job cleaning my teeth, this model is definitely an upgrade.

The pressure sensor is one of my favorite features. When I press too hard, the light changes color, making it easy to know when to ease up. It's a simple feature, but very useful.

It's also noticeably quieter and smoother than the Pro 1000, and the battery life is much better. Overall, brushing just feels more comfortable and enjoyable with this model.

I'm very happy with this upgrade and would definitely recommend it.

This is by far the best toothbrush I have ever used! The dentist told me several years ago to buy an electric toothbrush so I bought the cheap oral B ones from walmart and forced myself to use that several times a week. Thinking that was better then just using my regular manual one. My husband bought this in black about a month ago and liked it and it was on sale so I decided to jump and get it as well. I've been using it for a week now and my mouth still feels as clean as it did the day I came home from the dentist with a cleaning. It was a little strong on the vibrations at first but after the week of using it consistently it no longer bothers me. Its not loud at all and I love the 30 second interval vibrations it gives you so you know to move on to the next quadrant in your mouth. Over all the best thing I've bought all year. Would recommend it to everyone.

reviews.review_title: Great if you don’t expect it to last long!
reviews.review_description:
UPDATE: product was covered by warranty. Turned out not to be the battery but the handle which Oral-B replaced. So far so good. Customer service was helpful and responded in a timely manner.

Worked great for 8 months, now it won’t charge. Trying to get product support without much success, they close support via chat and phone call at 3:00. I’m still at work till 5:00. Bought replacement heads I hope I can still return. Kept it clean and yet it is still dead. Probably won’t buy again unless since this product should last at least a year. Sad, I like the toothbrush. Will update if resolved.

title: Oral-B Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush, iO5 Customizable Clean, 5 Cleaning Modes, Visual Pressure Sensor to Protect Gums, Travel Case, White
description: The iO is Oral-B’s best technology: Clinically Proven 100% Cleaner teeth & healthier gums in 1 week versus a regular manual toothbrush. The i05 coaches you to a perfect clean with a Smart Display, this is real time personalized coaching. The accompanying App detects the position through Artificial Intelligence. Oral-B is on your team for your everyday brushing task. A Round head and gentle micro-vibrations, the Magnetic interaction delivers smooth, harmonious motion through a Synchronized cleaning action (micro-vibrations synced with oscillations). A Built-in-2-Minute Timer ensures an even easier experience, helping you get an optimal clean on all your teeth. The Oral-B's quadrant timer breaks the two minutes up into four 30-second intervals to clean each quadrant of your mouth; we keep the time, so you don’t have to. Delivering the perfect pressure is done by having a Pressure Sensor. The Pressure Sensor Indicates optimal cleaning pressure and warns of over pressure. With an accompanying travel case, you’ll have a fresh clean everywhere you go. We’re with you on your next trip or even your mid-day on-the go brushing! Best of all, it is brought to you by Oral-B—the #1 brand used by dentists worldwide.* *Based on surveys of a representative worldwide sample of dentists carried out for P&G regularly. Do not use on children under age 3. Replace brush (head) every 3 months or sooner if brush head becomes worn.

reviews.review_title: I wish I would have bought sooner.
reviews.review_description: I just love my oral B Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush. I wish I would have bought it sooner. My mouth and teeth feel so much cleaner. I, also, have less dry mouth. My dentist is also very pleased that I bought this oral B. I would highly recommend. 2 minutes is not long to brush your teeth. Let the brush do the cleaning. The oral B has a timer and it lets you know when you are done brushing. Just gently move the brush along to a different spot and let the rotating brush do the work. My teeth and mouth have felt so clean!

reviews.review_title: A Game-Changer for My Oral Care Routine
reviews.review_description:
This toothbrush replaced my Philips Sonicare, and I can honestly say I’ll never go back. It provides a noticeably better cleaning experience, especially along the gumline. The round brush head and circular motion are much more effective for me than the side-to-side movement of my Sonicare.

My teeth feel significantly cleaner after each use, and I’ve noticed a fresher, more polished feeling overall. The toothbrush also charges quickly, and the compact charging base takes up very little counter space, which is a nice bonus.

I absolutely love this toothbrush and highly recommend it to anyone considering making the switch!

Great toothbrush! It has great features that are exceptional! As you brush your teeth, it will vibrate every 20 seconds which is a signal to move to the next quadrant of your mouth. It gets clean the whole tooth and gum area. It also has a pressure gauge that lets you know by having a green light that you are applying the right amount of pressure on the teeth as you brush. I highly recommend this toothbrush even though it is a bit pricey but well worth it!!

I've used Oral B electric toothbrushes for years per my dentist's recommendation. She has always recommended the round Oral B brush versus the other shape that other brands use. This is now my 3rd Oral B electric toothbrush and replaced my old one which was on it's last leg. I can't believe what a difference this new toothbrush has made! The pressure monitor made me realize that I was not applying enough pressure when brushing. Once I brushed so that the pressure light was green, I felt like I just stepped out of the dentist's office. I haven't even started to use the other functions yet but really look forward to reading the directions so I can. I highly recommend this toothbrush!

reviews.review_title: Good toothbrush with a few minor drawbacks
reviews.review_description:
I’ve been using this toothbrush for a little while now and overall, I’m fairly happy with it! I like the color (white) and it charged quickly right out of the box. It makes my mouth feel super clean, especially behind my front teeth, which is an area I usually struggle to get to with manual brushes. The small head is perfect for reaching my back molar teeth, which is great since I have a smaller mouth.

The bristles are a bit firm and felt a little rough on my gums at first, but I think I’m starting to get used to them. It might not be ideal if you have very sensitive gums. That said, the toothbrush arrived quickly and was packaged really nicely, which I appreciated.

Overall, I’d recommend it if you’re looking for an effective and compact electric toothbrush!

This is the 4th Oral B electronic toothbrush we have purchased for our family. Quality and brushing ability is fantastic. Battery life is good as we use the charging stand provided. Noise level is low and we are very pleased with the ease of use and functionality.

Best electric tooth brush I have ever owned. Stays charged for a week & easy to clean...

Give it a 10+
I bought this to replace my ten year old Oral B electric toothbrush. Even though it still works, I felt it was time to replace it. Works even better than the original.

title: Waterpik Sonic-Fusion Flossing Electric Toothbrush Water Flosser, White
description: Transform your daily oral care routine with the Waterpik Sonic Fusion 2.0 Professional flossing toothbrush, an innovative electric toothbrush with water flosser combo that delivers comprehensive dental cleaning in one convenient device. This advanced flossing toothbrush combines powerful sonic technology with proven Waterpik water flossing effectiveness, making it the ultimate solution for superior oral hygiene at home. It is a great solution for anyone who wants to simplify their oral care routine and improve gum health. The Waterpik Sonic-Fusion 2.0 features 3 distinct cleaning modes that adapt to your specific needs. Choose brush mode for traditional sonic toothbrush cleaning, floss mode for targeted water flosser irrigation, or combine both together. It removes up to 99.9% of plaque bacteria from treated areas that cause gingivitis, cavities, and bad breath and is clinically proven up to 2X as effective as traditional brushing and flossing. Sonic-Fusion includes 10 customizable water flosser settings and provides 60 seconds of continuous floss time, ensuring thorough cleaning between teeth and below the gumline. The built-in 2-minute brushing timer with 30-second pacer guides optimal brushing technique, while the recharge indicator keeps you informed of battery status for the toothbrush. This complete oral irrigator package includes a 16 oz removable reservoir for easy filling and cleaning, 2 flossing brush heads in compact and full sizes, 2 protective brush head covers, a premium travel case, and a magnetic brush head storage post. Waterpik is the #1 water flosser brand recommended by dental professionals, and the Waterpik Sonic-Fusion 2.0 is accepted by the American Dental Association (ADA) for safety and effectiveness. Backed by a 3-year manufacturer's limited warranty, see product manual for details.

reviews.review_title: Amazing - Your gums will thank you.
reviews.review_description: This is an amazing setup and actually the second one I’ve bought. The first lasted about 5 years before it started to get worn and dirty from regular use. I’ve historically had pockets in my gums and used to get lectured at every dental cleaning for not flossing enough. This completely changed that routine—it does the job thoroughly and makes flossing easy and consistent. My gums have never been healthier since using it. Overall, it’s one of those products I wish I had started using sooner.

This is a great product. I always put off flossing my teeth, but did it for dental health reasons. The water Pick, combined with the brushing action is both quick and easy to use and leaves a feeling that your mouth has been thoroughly cleaned.

Definitely not a budget item. It costs about $200 including tax.

I had an old waterpik which had seen better days. I had a sonic toothbrush which made my teeth feel wonderful but gave me repetitive stress issues. I finally decided to spend the money on this combo unit and it really is better than the the sum of its parts. It finds all the little hidden bits of leaves and such that distress one's teeth while efficiently cleaning that all important gumline. That is, it does exactly what it's supposed to do. And there's no spitting! Bonus!

So, only *mostly* love, because it's just a little too smart for its own good. The brush pulses to make four time divisions then turns off. The only way to have enough water to make it to the end is to have it overflow while filling. Filled up to what looks like the same point is not sufficient. I'm big on saving water, but just a tad more generosity in the tank would actually save water. The old hunch is necessary while doing the combination, or else water will run down one's forearm. I'm not sure if there could be any design solution to that, but it's the brushing part that takes that long. Those who can't hunch can use the brushing part and waterpik part separately. It was hard at first to set the toothbrush in the receptacle, but I learned that holding the hose coil in place, against the unit, it's much easier to seat the brush.

The only really bad thing about this is the price--and I paid up not to have black. :)

reviews.review_title: Takes a bit to figure out and adjust to...
reviews.review_description: One thing to know is that although its advertised that you can brush and floss at the same time, the actual application of this concept leaves something to be desired. When you activate the floss and bruch together feature, the flossing rinses all the toothpaste from you mouth before it can be used. So, I brush, then floss. The deep clean is amazing and this has enough power. The brush is set for two minutes and the it will stop automatically. FLAW: if you pause it briefly while brushing, the two minutes restarts. Unlike my phillips sonic care, which you could pause and restart without resetting the two minute time limit. This comes with two heads, one normal size and one for travel, i found they work equally well until one literally broke off in my mouth. I ordered more from Amazon and they have lasted well, so maybe a fluke. Bottom line: This thing does what it does well, but one must be patient and brush first, then floor. Also, don't forget to fill the water reservoir with warm water prior to using flosser. The flosser is super powerful and will clean the heck out of your teeth. Which, as I think about it, is the entire purpose of this thing: clean teeth. This doesn't disappoint.

reviews.review_title: Great Customer Service & Tips on Reconnecting the Flosser
reviews.review_description:
TLDR: If somehow the flosser doesn't respond to the toothbrush's signals and the radio and toothbrush resets don’t work, drain the toothbrush's battery completely by setting it idle for a week or so and reconnect the set to power. Make sure you place the toothbrush in the base before reconnecting the set to power.

Waterpik offers great customer service and the device works great and does what it's supposed to do most of the time.

-----------------------------------------

I bought one 2.5 years ago, and after less than 2 months of using it, the flosser stopped responding to the toothbrush's command. I don't know how it happened but I knew it was a housekeeper who unplugged the device as he had to clean the counter. After a few days of testing the flossing function and trying the troubleshooting techniques without success, I gave up and contacted Waterpik's customer service. They asked for anything, you know, that would allow them to honor the warranty. The process was a bit annoying (just a bit, and is absolutely nothing compared to arguing with insurance about coverage) but Waterpik in the end sent me another set for free which I'm still using today.

Being the environmentally conscious and lazy person I am, I kept the first set because it'd be a chore to dispose of it properly, so I just put it into the original packaging and stored it in the vanity cabinet. Last year, I had to move to another state and while I was packing stuff up, I saw the set and decided to give it another try before completely throwing it away. And it xxxxing worked!!!!!! Now that I commute in between cities, I've placed one at the residence close to my workplace!!! Also I've been periodontitis free for the past 2 years! Thanks Waterpik!!

Read more
Got this at the recommendation of my dentist product works great.
This is the Cadillac of dental care! You can floss and brush at the same time. And, it lets you change pressure on the flossing, and speed on the brushing.

reviews.review_title: It was just meh, and then the flosser feature broke
reviews.review_description:
Unfortunately, I don't recommend this product for the following reasons:

1) The button to turn on/off the water flosser is directly below the button to turn on/off the toothbrush. I can't count the number of times that I've inadvertently pressed the flosser button and water sprays everywhere. It's easy to press this button because of its location on the toothbrush, and also because the handle for the toothbrush is small in diameter and slippery when wet...and of course it's going to get wet...so it's tough to avoid pressing buttons while trying to hold onto it. I can disconnect the water flosser to avoid this problem, but that defeats the purpose imho and is a hassle.

2) I seem to spend an inordinate amount of time keeping this unit clean. The toothbrush and base have lots of crevices.

3) At this price, I expected a better product, especially from Waterpik. It’s just meh. Not great, not terrible. I can work around the above annoyances, but wish I hadn’t spent so much money on it.

I gave it 3 stars because the water flosser does a good job, and the reservoir holds a sufficient amount of water compared to the "all-in-one" models, where the water reservoir is in the handle.

If you have a dental implant, you need a water flosser. Once this toothbrush/flosser needs replacing, I'll look for a different design. Hopefully Waterpik will come up with something better.

UPDATE: Not long after giving this product 3 stars and a "Meh" review, the flosser stopped working. Actually, it won't STOP working, and wants to run continuously when the unit is plugged in. Now all I have is an expensive electric toothbrush. It gets one star.

Read more

title: Feno Smartbrush Electric Toothbrush for Adults, Oscillating, Rechargeable
description: About this item                  FAST & CONVENIENT BRUSHING – Feno’s AI-powered electric tooth brush features a personalized U-shaped mouthpiece with oscillating bristles, designed to simplify your daily oral care routine.     AI-POWERED SMART TOOTHBRUSH WITH APP – Connect with the Feno Plus App to view brushing performance data, track daily habits, and access app-based insights that support long-term oral care routines. MODERN SMARTBRUSH TECHNOLOGY BY FENO – Combining AI-powered brushing, wireless charging, replaceable mouthpieces, and water-resistant design, the Feno Smartbrush is a next-generation toothbrush for adults. Once braces are removed, it becomes an excellent tool to help maintain a straight, healthy smile.       Show more

reviews.review_title: My teeth have never felt this clean before!
reviews.review_description:
I absolutely love this toothbrush! The delivery was very fast, and it came with everything I needed for a complete cleaning routine.

I was pleasantly surprised by the toothpaste, it has a foamy texture, tastes great, and leaves my mouth feeling fresh. The toothbrush fits comfortably in my mouth, and I love that it has bristles on both the front and back, so it cleans all of my teeth at the same time.

It charges quickly and is very easy to use. What impressed me the most was how fast the brushing process is. Even though it only takes a short time, my teeth feel incredibly clean afterward. They feel so smooth, and my breath stays fresh after every use.

I highly recommend this toothbrush without hesitation, and I'll definitely be buying one for the rest of my family!

I’ve tried quite a few electric toothbrushes, but the Feno Smartbrush is by far one of the easiest to use. The U-shaped brush design makes brushing quick and convenient, especially on busy mornings. It feels gentle on my gums while still leaving my teeth feeling clean and fresh.

The companion app is a nice bonus for tracking brushing habits, and the battery lasts a long time between charges. The sleek, modern design also looks great on my bathroom counter.

If you’re looking for a toothbrush that makes oral care simple and efficient, I’d definitely recommend giving the Feno Smartbrush a try!

reviews.review_title: WORTHLESS PRODUCT AND BS AI SUPPORT
reviews.review_description: This thing is quite literally the biggest bag of crap I have ever splurged on. The brain trust at Feno gave a worthless video on how things SHOULD go when you unpack it - fun fact - it doesn’t work. When I took it out of the box and plugged it in - attached the mag charger in the appropriate orientation (yes, I know to follow instructions) it heated up quite significantly and just sat there. I charged it for the suggested two hours and then some - nothing. I thought to myself - I’ll let go over night - nothing. Then, I said screw it, let’s give another 14 hours while I’m at work - came home - hot as hell - nothing - again. Tech support is a joke - they want pictures to make sure you can follow instructions and point the mag charger down - completely AI powered responses. Still nothing - throwing this piece of crap and crap it came with into a Walmart bag and dropping it off at the UPS store for a refund. SAVE YOUR MONEY - complete crap and crap support - ok - I’m done - time to go back to the oral -B

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I’ve been genuinely impressed with the Feno Smart Toothbrush! The design is sleek, comfortable to use, and it makes brushing feel so much more efficient. I love how easy it is to incorporate into my daily routine, and my teeth feel incredibly clean and polished after every use.

The smart features are intuitive, and the overall quality feels premium. If you’re looking to upgrade your oral care routine with a modern, well-designed toothbrush, I highly recommend giving Feno a try. It’s been a fantastic addition to my everyday routine!

I’ve been using the Feno Smartbrush for over a month now, and it’s honestly become part of my daily routine. The biggest thing for me is how fast it is—I can brush all of my teeth in just seconds, which is super convenient, especially on busy mornings.

I also really like the companion app. It gives me useful information about my brushing habits and helps me stay consistent with my oral care.

reviews.review_title: It's a good way to brush, but Privacy, please.
reviews.review_description:
I like the brush and 30second brush time.

Seems to get stuff out that regular brushing left behind.

However- it has an internet connection and a camera- so no telling what pictures we're sending in my bathroom. If you're a privacy conscious person, might want to steer clear. I just make sure it is turned around all the time. But still- who wants an internet connected camera in their bathroom? Rethink that one, Feno.

The Feno Smartbrush is incredibly practical and delivers an excellent clean in just 20 seconds! It’s easy to use, feels thorough, and makes my brushing routine so much quicker. I’ve really been enjoying it and highly recommend it!

reviews.review_title: 20 seconds and my teeth feel dentist-clean
reviews.review_description:
I was honestly curious after seeing so many good reviews, and I’m glad I gave it a try. The 20-second brushing is what caught my attention, but what impressed me most is how clean my teeth feel afterward. My teeth feel smooth and fresh, almost like I just came from a dental cleaning.

At 53, I’m always looking for ways to simplify my routine without sacrificing results, and this has made brushing faster and easier. It took me a couple of tries to get used to the mouthpiece, but once I did, it became super simple.

If you’re someone who wants to save time and still keep up with oral care, this is definitely worth trying.

title: Philips Sonicare C2 Brush Heads, 3-Pack, 9 Month Supply, White
description: Brush away plaque effectively with this replacement brush head from Philips Sonicare: an everyday brush head designed to give a thorough cleaning. These Philips Sonicare toothbrush heads feature densely packed, high-quality tufts to remove plaque and specially curved power tufts to easily reach teeth at the back of the mouth. The result speaks for itself: Philips Sonicare C2 Plaque Control removes up to 700% more plaque than a manual toothbrush. Trust proven Sonicare technology: Philips Sonicare toothbrushes clean gently yet effectively and care for your teeth and gums with up to 62,000 bristle movements. Sonicare Fluid Action supports cleaning by driving fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline. All Philips sonic toothbrush heads are meticulously designed and clinically tested to meet the highest standard in quality, safety and performance. They are compatible with all Philips Sonicare click-on electric toothbrushes¹. Dental professionals recommend changing your brush head every 3 months, that's why Philips Sonicare toothbrushes have BrushSync technology. It tracks how often and how hard you brush, and the light on the handle turns on when it's time to replace your brush head.⁴ You will also know when to replace it when blue bristles turn white. ¹ not compatible with Philips One and e-series handles ² allocated to plastic of brush head on mass balance basis ³ where facilities exist ⁴ the feature is available for BrushSync-compatible handles

reviews.review_description:
✅ I love how I get 4 heads in a pack which last me about 6months. So I will say great value for budget

✅ the heads are soft for my gums by yet sturdy enough to actually clean and whiten my teeth

✅ perfect for Philips electric toothbrush

✅ I brush my teeth 2x a day everyday and I don’t have to change the heads out until about 1month and a half so it’s very durable and reliable

✅vibration is side to side and also is not aggressive

I have ordered these several times before so I knew just what I was getting. They fit my electric toothbrush and work well to clean my teeth. I like that they come with a cover for each brush so you can keep them protected from germs. I also like that they come 3 in a package so I can easily replace one when it wears out.

Don't be afraid to put the extra money into a Philips brand. This is a company that stands behind their products. The Philips Sonicare with the C2 replacements heads leave my teeth and gums feeling cleaner than any other toothbrush I have ever tried. Don't purchase the off brand, buy Philips, it's well worth the price.

reviews.review_title: Fantastic Replacements for the best toothbrush on the market!!!!!! A+.
reviews.review_description: The Best toothbrush replacements on the market. My dentist used to say, " You brush well, but need to do a little better job here and there. Once I started using the Philips Sonicare, she said I can't do much better than I am doing now. This brush and its replacements are the best on the market, Hands down.

reviews.review_title: Easy to Replace and Works Well
reviews.review_description:
These replacement brush heads are very easy to install and fit perfectly on my Philips Sonicare toothbrush. Swapping them out only takes a few seconds.

They provide a comfortable brushing experience and do a good job cleaning my teeth.

Overall, a reliable replacement option that is convenient to use and performs as expected.

The last time I got replacement heads, I got the wrong ones. These are the right ones, so the product information is correct. I thought the price was reasonable for a quantity of 6. I also like to buy the actual brand name instead of something that "will fit." I have been using a Sonicare for many years and have been satisfied with the product itself and with the replacement heads.

These Sonicare replacement heads so a consistently good job. I've ordered them for a few years now and I'm never disappointed. I stick with the Sonicare because my unit is a Sonicare. They are comfortably soft (which I like), competitive in price, and last for a reasonable length of time. I order them for myself and my children. Even though the Sonicare system is somewhat pricey, they are good for the gums and teeth & do a great job cleaning thoroughly but gently.

reviews.review_title: Worth the Premium: Genuine Sonicare Heads That Click In Tight & Perform 🦷
reviews.review_description:
I bought this to replace the brushes on the Philips Sonicare 4100 Series electric toothbrush. Some key things to know:

1️⃣ Fit & compatibility: They click on securely (no wobble), and are easy to remove and replace on the 4100.

2️⃣ Cleaning performance: I definitely see a difference in the amount of plaque I have after switching to the Sonicare. The bristle quality & durability of these are just like what came with the brush. These are from the manufacturer, so did not expect any quality issues.

3️⃣Durability: These last about 2-3 months for me. Generally, I replace them every 2 months.

Overall, I’m happy with the purchase. Price is high, but if you want something that fits correctly and works well, buy the original.

title: Oral-B Pro 100 3D White, Battery Toothbrush, White
description: Power up to a better clean with the Oral-B Pro 100 Precision Clean Battery Power Toothbrush. Your teeth and gums will feel pampered because you're removing more plaque than a regular manual toothbrush each time you brush.

reviews.review_description: This great quality toothbrush works perfect. I read the few negative reviews but have had no problem so far with it. It does an amazing job cleaning my teeth. Very strong motor. Actually my gums were a little sensitive at first because of the strong cleaning power. I am delighted with my purchase, & recommend it to others. I would buy again.

reviews.review_title: Just like the rechargeable I've used for, perfect for travel or hospital stay
reviews.review_description:
purchased for travel, really, I've entirely lost the technique for brushing my teeth? I just don't feel I am getting every corner they way an electric tooth brush does and, I have a lot of repair work so, getting everything clean is essential.

It works as well as my rechargeable model and is not heavy. The only thing that baffles me is the timer, my rechargeable unit twitches every 30 seconds giving you half a minute for each quadrant...

this one, I think it runs the full two minutes, giving you total time, not a real problem because, if you have done this for years, you have a pattern for it, but I keep meaning to time it out of curiosity

very pleased with it, in fact, I keep this one in the kitchen to remind me, if I snack late at night or, eat something more likely to stain my teeth, really, just walk upstairs into the bathroom, right?

but seeing it in the kitchen reminds me and, less likely to snack if I brush my teeth after I have cleaned up following dinner...

reviews.review_title: Second only to a professional cleaning
reviews.review_description: I love this toothbrush. My teeth have never felt cleaner after a simple brushing. The price is reasonable. I am hooked. Money well spent.

I bought this toothbrush specifically for my frequent work travel, and it’s been a great choice. It’s the perfect size to fit easily in my luggage, and I love that you don’t have to bring a charger—one less thing to worry about when packing.

The brushing power is impressive. The first time I used it my mouth felt cleaner than it had been a long time! I barely have to move it; I just gently hold it in place and it cleans better than some of the rechargeable toothbrushes I’ve owned. It feels sturdy and well-made. While it’s a bit heavier than a standard manual toothbrush, it’s not too heavy for travel and actually feels very comfortable to hold. Battery life seems to be holding up strong. I’ve had it for many months.

Overall, this is a strong, travel-friendly toothbrush that delivers excellent cleaning without the hassle of charging.

Read more
Oral-B toothbrush awesome

reviews.review_title: Great battery powered toothbrush - no cords on the counter!
reviews.review_description: I like this toothbrush specifically because it is battery powered so can be put completely away in the medicine cabinet or bathroom drawer. My husband prefers the rechargeable type, but the cords all over the counter to plug it in really bother me, so this battery powered option is great! For the price it works just as good as his fancy recharge one too!

reviews.review_title: Easy to use, but noticeably weak power
reviews.review_description:
I tried the Oral-B Pro 100 3D White toothbrush, and while it’s simple and easy to use, the overall performance is pretty underwhelming. It runs on regular AA batteries, which makes it convenient, but you can definitely feel the difference compared to rechargeable models.

The round brush head is nice and does a decent job cleaning tooth by tooth, and it’s compatible with other Oral-B heads, which is a plus. It also has a built-in timer to help with brushing time, so the basics are there.

That said, the power is where it falls short. It feels weak, especially if you’re used to stronger electric toothbrushes. It gets the job done at a basic level, but it doesn’t give that deep clean feeling you might expect. Even reviews describe it as more of a “basic” option rather than a high-performance one.

Overall, it’s fine as an entry-level or travel toothbrush, but if you’re looking for something with real power and a stronger clean, this probably won’t be enough.

Now you can get that exact same feeling with the TAO Clean Sonic Toothbrush and Cleaning Station. Using state-of-the-art sonic technology and 40,000 tiny brush strokes per minute, this electric toothbrush safely and hygienically cleans your mouth by dislodging debris from your teeth and gums, and efficiently polishing your teeth. The Sonic electric toothbrush offers two cleaning modes: the recommended Super Clean, and Sensitive Clean, for those with sensitive gums and teeth. To ensure you have the most thorough cleaning experience, we’ve created a map of your mouth (found in the instruction manual) that splits it into quadrants. Every 30 seconds, the toothbrush briefly pauses so that you know it’s time to move onto the next quadrant of your mouth. A timed cleaning where the brush actually does the work for you, tells you when to move on, and shuts off when you’re done. But what really sets the TAO Clean Sonic Toothbrush apart from its competitors? It’s the TAO Clean Base Station – a unique charging base for your brush handle that won’t take up a lot of space on your vanity, it also cleans and dries your brush head! Once you dock your damp toothbrush after brushing your teeth, the 360 degree TAO Clean Halo uses powerful UV-C rays to kill 99.9% of bacteria, and then the built-in dryer wicks away any moisture from the brush to ensure that no germs or bacteria stand a chance. After all, what’s the point of using a toothbrush to brush your teeth if you’re not going to keep the brush itself clean? Our philosophy is clean and simple– literally. We create technological devices that live up to high cleanliness standards to naturally integrate into your daily routine in a seamless way. We firmly believe that every object we create must deliver a wonderful user experience from start to finish.

reviews.review_title: Fresh from the dentist clean, tiny design flaws.
reviews.review_description:
The positive reviews concerning the distinctive clean feel even after the first use are all true. As a matter of fact, almost all positive reviews on this item are somewhat accurate. I would like to focus on the details that I searched for and couldn’t find on reviews both written or in video format. They may seem like “cons” but I must add that for me they were not deal breakers. Instead I’d like to think of them as constructive criticism, since they are details that I would like to see on later generations of this item.

Cable management: It is difficult to tell the power source and cable situation from all the photos and videos online, which are edited for aesthetic purposes.

I kind of knew what the set up would be from previous experiences with other electronic devices so I knew what to expect. However, for those who are expecting the same sleek, cable-free look from the photos online please take note that if your bathroom has power outlets above the sink area, like most homes in america, there will be a cable bunch up on your countertop. Even if the cable is wound up and tied together, it may still be an atrocious sight for that OCD gem in your home, who probably spends a lot of time at the sink.

Power Adaptor: Once plugged in, the power adaptor sticks out over three and a quarter inches from the power outlet, yet another design flaw. With the amount of compact usb adaptors available this shouldn’t be difficult to correct since the company would only need to replace one part.

Power adaptor plug: The placement of the power socket on the base station is a bit awkward and creates a distance of about two and a half inches from the wall or backsplash. I have similar electronics with the power socket located below the item, which makes for a neater appearance and freedom to push the item flush to the wall when necessary.

Other small details that the shopper should be aware of is the size of the item and color of the brush handle. Please take a closer look and notice that the brush handle is two toned. I think it looks good but, anyone expecting it to be solid white will be thoroughly disappointed.

Also, please double check the dimensions of this item and know that it is not a compact design. Definitely not for a countertop where space is at a premium.

With all that being said…or typed; I would like to reiterate that all these may seem like “cons” but they really are small details that everyone should know to ensure that they are completely happy with their purchase upon receipt.

So, In conclusion this item would be perfect if it was a bit more compact, and the cable/power adaptor issue was resolved. With the portable power core technology available now a days I don’t see why we shouldn’t expect a wireless base station that could hold a charge for a few days in the near future.

If you made it this far, thanks for taking the time to read and I hope this helped out even just a lil bit. Bitty boppity, give me the zoppity!

Read more

I like the way this brush cleans my teeth and I give it 5 stars for that. But, I am having the most difficult time trying to figure out how to hold it properly. I compared it to my old electric toothbrush and it is smaller in diameter. It is also all plastic handle with nothing to really grab onto. It becomes wet and then the trouble starts. It slips and slides. I don’t like the way it is configured. This has nothing to do with the brush itself, but the packaging is the worst packaging I have ever encountered. I absolutely could not get it opened. Trying to open it I tore a piece of skin off the top of my finger. I then got a knife out and cut it open. No instructions in the box. Typing on the keyboard is pretty smooth too. It could use one or two more outlets on the sides though. You only get one USB Type-A port, one USB Type-C port and a headphone jack. Fine if you're more of a minimalist, but not ideal for multi-tasking work. Also, a little tip; When powering on, all you need to do is press the power button, NOT press and hold. I didn't realize that at first and thought initially that their was a problem. Just a piece of advice. Overall, it's a good laptop, at a fair price and should work well for the "Average Joe". I just got it, so the only question I have is, how long will it last? Hopefully it lasts me quite a while. But we'll see. reviews.review_title: Computer great, refurbish quality missed a major issue.
reviews.review_description:
This review is mostly about the refurbish service, the computer itself is absolutely fantastic. My expectations for a refurbished computer was that I would get something that would show very modest wear, but work perfectly. I was delighted when I first opened my new Lenovo computer. The screen, keyboard, and touchpad appeared like it was brand new had never been touched. I was initially delighted with my purchase and started loading software and restoring my data. On the second day however, I noticed some unusual indentations around the power button. As I explored it further, I found that the computer had probably been dropped on its side. It actually bent the case enough to make the SD card slot unusable. It also makes the USB connectors quite tight (which may not actually be a bad thing in and of itself - but it's not right). The bottom of the case shows a physical crack and I am moderately concerned about whether there's some hairline fractures or other damage that isn't immediately obvious. The bottom line is, I've decided to keep the computer since it seems to be working fine and I really appreciate the pristine screen and keyboard that I received. I don't use the SD card slot so it's not a big deal to me for that. But I guess I'm just a little disappointed to have received a laptop that was clearly dropped hard enough to bend the case. I know this happed before shipping as the box it was delivered in showed no signs of any drop. It is a bit of a testament to the high-quality build that Lenovo puts into their computers but not a great example of careful oversight on the Amazon reconditioning service. I think they should have been more descriptive about this kind of damage on this particular item (maybe offered it with a bit more discount?)

reviews.review_title: Great Buy, was what i expected it to be
reviews.review_description:
Keep in mind that this is more of a rant, and I'm half asleep, but this is what I've gone through so far with the product.

Originally came from an hp g62 2010 - 2018, was able to make the laptop last. Finally wanted to upgrade and saw this on sale, so I went for it and it was what I wanted in a laptop for what I do: Music, School, Youtube, Slaughtering Demons.

The rant and rave of an individual:

The screen is very nice, I can confirm it is an In-plane Switching Monitor or (IPS) as I do not have to center the screen or move my body to get a great view of it, unlike a lot of TN panels that I've used back in the day. The disassembly of the device is very very simple, remove the screws from the bottom of the case and the case pops off, might need a thin tool to pry the case off a bit (only con here) and you'll see the ram and the hard drive and the nvme along with the fans which make it easy for upgrades and cleaning. Also the battery is not soldered into the board and easily comes out for replacement after you remove some screws. All screws I noticed were Phillip's head. (I like to watch disassembly videos in case something happened, that way I can tear into it and hopefully fix the issue.) The ram is decent for 12 gigs, a 4 gig stick and an 8 gig stick, but I plan on upgrading the ram soon. Now after uninstalling a few things and setting windows to use less resources, I idle at about 18-19% which isn't bad at all, depends on what you do though. I do believe the manufacturer specifications have tested up to 16 gigs of 2666 on the board, however; there are cases with other omen laptops, where you can plop in 16 gigs in each dimm slot for a total of 32 gigs, wouldn't recommend it because it's not officially supported, but I will go ahead and try it (making sure i'm at the latest bios update from hp), and will provide an additional review/update. (I like to run a lot of things at once.) The processor is very nice, windows shows that i have 4 physical cpus and 8 logical processors, and I idle at 0% after turning the thing on (which mine booted into windows less than 3 seconds with the nvme 128 gig harddrive). I plan on upgrading the nvme from 128 gigs to 1 terabyte, might clone the drive or just grab a fresh install of windows 10 and slap it on a usb drive and fresh install, go from there. From what I read on the specification sheet for the dc0010nr, I think a cap of 512 Gigs nvme was officially tested and supported, but I'm going another 512 and see how the machine fairs. The 1 terabyte hard drive isn't slow at all, but I have nothing on it but a few games and some music, I constantly keep it defragged. The sound on the laptop is definitely an upgrade from my old hp g62 via software and hardware, but i use headphones into the 3.5mm jacks for mic and playback anyways. when it comes to gaming: Doom 2016 gives about 100 to 130fps on 1080p, ultra + open glide settings.... battlefield 1 on 1080p ultra gives about 45+ on mp and 60+ sp, drop it to high and it gives about 60+ but it depends on what map and what all is going on via gameplay. The heat on the laptop isn't bad, the machine will get warm and the fans will kick into high gear almost like a delay, but there is absolutely no throttling and when i'm finished with my gaming, the fans kick off to silent almost immediately. Also with the gpu, this is a verified gtx 1050 ti with 4096MB of vram in it.

Final note:

I think it's worth what I payed for: 799.99. If my desktop crashes and burns, it's a great replacement for it. It absolutely destroys solitaire and minesweeper along with other office products like excel spread-sheeting and you're in need for a couple of Pareto diagrams or 3 point beta distributions to resolve employee padding with P.M.O affairs making sure the stakeholders are happy. Alas I digress... I unboxed it, i pressed the power button and it immediately shot into windows and was ready to go. :)
