reviews.review_description: This machine makes great espresso with grounds, but I took away one star because all the info I found mislead me into believing it was compatible with nespresso pods. This is only true if you buy an adapter, but when I asked this question, it said none was needed. This caused me to buy a bunch of pods that I can’t use. I hope they change this info to help others in their purchasing. Other than that, i recommend this machine!
Love it
love it
Easy to use Great quality

title: BLACK+DECKER 12 Cup Thermal Programmable Coffee Maker with Brew Strength and VORTEX Technology, Black/Steel, CM2046S
description: Keep coffee hot for up to two hours with the BLACK plus DECKER 12-Cup Thermal Programmable Coffeemaker. The thermal carafe features a four layer vacuum seal to maintain optimal temperature for up to 2 hours. The vacuum seal locks in heat while staying cool to the touch. The Vortex Technology evenly saturates coffee grounds for full and rich flavor extraction using optimal water temperatures. Plus, you can customize the brew to fit your tastes. The easy-to-use digital controls include a delay timer and the option for a stronger brew. As an added feature, the LCD display includes a fresh brew timer that indicates how much time has passed since the coffee was brewed, up to 120 minutes. *cup equals approximately 5 oz. (varies by brewing technique) Keeps coffee 154°F or hotter up to two hours.

reviews.review_description:
I am so happy to do a review about this coffee pot. I’m gonna tell you everything I love about it. I love the fact that it has a carafe. I love the fact that it has a button you can press to make it stronger. I have to say this is the best cup of coffee I’ve ever made in my own home. It is absolutely delicious and I don’t use anything but Folgers nothing special. If you get this, you will not have a problem. You will not have a bad cup of coffee. When I first got it, it did some leaking. I went to the troubleshooting. It told me how to fix it. Well now it’s perfect. I also like the fact that there is a Customer Service phone number that you could call if the troubleshooting doesn’t work out. So many companies nowadays want you to text and they don’t want to talk to you. Well, I feel like I should be able to talk to them if I bought the product. This company feels like I do because of that I appreciate them. The coffee pot is very large and it also is very high. It does not fit under my cabinets, which is a problem. Well, it fits under my cabinet. I just can’t open the top. So I solved it by buying a round apparatus that has wheels on the bottom that people use for plants. I’ve set it on that and now I can roll it back to the wall and forward when I wanna fill it problem solved. The price is very reasonable. I think I mentioned that that’s also very important in this day and age. You will not be unhappy with this coffee pot, with the carafe that keeps it warm for quite a while. Follow the instructions to put hot water in it first let the pot warm-up. I also don’t dump the water out. I put the hot water in the coffee maker and it makes the coffee hotter. It is just steaming. This is a great product if you’re looking for great coffee this is the one to buy and remember it may leak when you first get it, don’t worry about it. Just follow the instructions. Make sure the ball is hitting the pot and it’ll be fine. Best coffee I’ve ever had in my house.

Read more

I’ve had this coffee maker for several years now and I’m very satisfied. It has a 12 cup brew capacity which is plenty for us. It also fits well with our kitchen decor with the black on stainless steel color. I line that it keeps the coffee hot in an insulated carafe rather than a hot plate so the coffee never burns. It has been very reliable so far. Also, the process to set the delayed start is very easy so we set up the coffee maker at night and have coffee ready for us when we make our way to the kitchen.

5 weeks and works fantastic. Nice to wake up to 6 mugs of piping hot coffee, that stays nice and hot (even with adding creamer) for about 4hrs and warm thereafter, so it doesn't go to waste...I like it hot. Had to buy new paper filters, but no problem with collapsing and getting grounds in the coffee. The ability to pull out the carafe while coffee is brewing is nice when forgetting to auto button at night. It is a great replacement for one where that didn't function properly. So glad we got it.

reviews.review_title: Great coffee maker and really affordable
reviews.review_description: I bought this coffee maker to replace our Cuisinart coffee maker that gave up the ghost after many years of service. I wasn’t sure about my choice to go with the Black & Decker because it was quite a bet cheaper than a new Cuisinart but I have to say it’s been great and I don’t regret my choice at all. My biggest gripe with the Cuisinart was how small the opening on the carafe was that made it difficult to clean. The Black & Decker has a large opening making cleaning a breeze. It also has a better pour spout than the Cuisinart. The only downside is that the carafe doesn’t keep the coffee hot as long as it predecessor did but that’s rarely a problem in our household. The programming display is also a little Hard to read with my old eyes. I doubt it would be a problem for younger users. All in all it makes a great cup of coffee in under 10 minutes and I often use the scheduling feature so I wake up with that first cup waiting for me in the mornings.

reviews.review_title: Great coffee, design and lasts forever.
reviews.review_description: This thing is an A+ for us. This is the same one that we have at out winter home and have had it for years. I makes great coffee and keeps it hot for hours. I am not sure if it is induction or what but there are no hot surfaces and if you turn it back on it heats the coffee in the thermos. The on thing I would change on it is make the display darker so you can read it. You need a magnifying glass to read am or pm. Still doesn't stop me from buying it again. My older one is a little noisier than the new one. I really have to listen to make sure it is brewing. I love the appearance and you can see the water level, holds a little over 6 cups of water. Looks exactly like my 15 year old one, if it ain't broke don't fix it.

reviews.review_title: Decent, but I thought I would like this more
reviews.review_description:
I've had this coffee maker now for about 3 weeks. I don't love it, but I don't hate it. I'm also not 100% sure if I would recommend it either. Here's why. PLEASE READ ENTIRE REVIEW FOR IMPORTANT INFO.

Before purchasing this, I read lots of the reviews, and watched all of the video reviews before I decided on this one. Because everyone seemed happy with theirs, I went ahead and bought it. It was pricier than others, but I always go by the old saying, "you get what you pay for". It shipped very quickly and arrived the next day. When I got mine, I went through the setup procedure and I was ready to enjoy my first pot of coffee. The first thing I noticed was the lid was very loose, and I knew it was supposed to "lock" into place. After all, that's how the coffee is supposed to stay hot, in the carafe, and not on a warming plate, right? Even the description states:

• 4 LAYER VACUUM SEALED THERMAL CARAFE: keeps coffee hot for up to two hours with the 4-layer vacuum sealed thermal carafe.

On mine, I quickly discovered that there was a plastic seal missing from the carafe lid, which supposedly makes the carafe air tight. I reached out to Black+Decker and they quickly sent me a replacement lid (thank you Black+Decker). Finally, after getting the new lid I would be able to enjoy nice hot coffee. And I did...sort of. After using it for a few weeks now, I've noticed that the first cup of coffee that comes out is piping hot. By the time I get my second cup (maybe 45 minutes later) the coffee is what I would describe as "very warm", not hot. By the time I get to my 3rd cup, (don't judge) the coffee in the carafe is just lukewarm, (hello Mr. Microwave). I think I expected it to remain closer to hot much longer. BUT, while writing this review, I noticed in the product description it says:

• IMPORTANT PRO TIP: To help coffee stay at brewed temperature, warm the carafe by filling with hot tap water and then discarding before brewing.

So, I tried that this morning, and, it did help somewhat to keep the coffee in the carafe hotter, longer. I'm going to keep doing this and experiment to get the best results. My feeling on this is that it's just an extra step in the morning I wouldn't have to do with a traditional coffee maker with a glass carafe. One thing I do like is that the carafe does stay cool to the touch on the outside and also the no-drip spout feature.

What I used to like about my old coffee maker is being able to use the glass carafe to measure the water and pour it right into the reservoir. With this carafe, there's no way to do that so I have to use a measuring cup. This is a minor inconvenience though.

One other feature I wish this coffee maker had is that the clock display does not illuminate when power button is pushed (see picture) or while brewing coffee. It seems like a very dim display.

Bottom line, typically if I don't like something I buy, I return it. However, I'm not going to return this simply because I don't want to go through the hassle of packing it all up and returning it, and I still get my coffee every morning.

Read more

reviews.review_title: Simple is always best - Don't forget the filter basket!
reviews.review_description:
I had a coffee maker from another well-known brand that was more expensive. The power button developed a mind of its own, so I replaced within the warranty window and the replacement developed the same issue a year later. I decided to go with this brand for the price and simplicity. The power button is on the side instead of the top where condensation may have caused the issue on my other machine. In general, it's simple, but REALLY well made with a smart design. I'm hoping this lasts us forever. We're a fan of the carafe style because I wake up much earlier than my partner. The coffee stays fresh, hot, and doesn't burn. It's perfect!

One note - It doesn't come with a filter basket, so be sure to purchase one!

reviews.review_title: The Greatest Coffee Pot ever owned.
reviews.review_description:
I’ve been using the BLACK+DECKER 12 Cup Thermal Programmable Coffeemaker for a while now, and I’m thrilled with how it’s transformed my morning routine and even my camping adventures.

This is a pretty and sleek, black-and-silver machine, that features a stainless steel thermal carafe with a four-layer vacuum seal, keeps my coffee hot for EASILY up to two hours while staying cool to the touch.

Its Vortex Technology, programmable brewing options, and user-friendly digital controls make it a standout in my kitchen. Priced between $50 and $100, it delivers premium features like a brew strength selector, a fresh brew timer, and a no-drip spout at a budget-friendly cost, making it an absolute gem for coffee lovers like me who value quality and convenience.The coffee this machine brews is consistently delicious, thanks to the Vortex Technology, which evenly saturates the grounds for rich, full-bodied flavor. Whether I’m craving a bold morning kick or a smoother cup, the brew strength selector lets me customize each pot perfectly. I love how the machine reaches the ideal brewing temperature of 195° to 205°F, as noted by reviewers, ensuring every sip is packed with flavor. The LCD display’s fresh brew timer is a thoughtful touch, showing me exactly how long it’s been since my coffee was brewed—up to 120 minutes—so I know it’s still at its peak. One morning, I brewed a pot at 7 a.m., and by 10 a.m., it was still piping hot, which is a game-changer for my busy days.The programmable features make my life so much easier. I can set the 24-hour auto-brew timer the night before, and waking up to the aroma of fresh coffee is pure bliss. The digital controls are intuitive, with large, clearly marked buttons for setting brew strength, batch size (including a 1-4 cup option for smaller batches), and the timer. I’ve found the 1-4 cup setting perfect for when I’m brewing just for myself without sacrificing flavor. The Auto Clean system is another lifesaver, alerting me when it’s time to run a cleaning cycle with vinegar, keeping the machine in top shape with minimal effort. One user mentioned, “Set it up the night before, and you wake up to that smell of freshly brewed coffee,” which perfectly sums up my experience.For camping, this coffeemaker is a dream. Its compact size (9 x 7.75 x 14.25 inches) fits easily in my RV, and the thermal carafe is a godsend for keeping coffee hot during chilly mornings by the campfire. I’ve taken it on weekend trips, and the no-drip Perfect Pour spout means I can pour coffee into my mug without spilling a drop, even on uneven campsite tables. The carafe’s wide mouth makes it easy to clean with a damp towel, and the removable, dishwasher-safe brew basket simplifies cleanup after muddy outdoor adventures. I once brewed a full 12-cup pot (each cup is about 5 ounces) for a group of friends at a campsite, and everyone was amazed at how hot and fresh it stayed for hours.Maintenance is a breeze, which I appreciate as someone with a packed schedule.

The washable brew basket is compatible with reusable filters like the GOLDTONE, saving me money on paper filters and making cleanup quick. The carafe’s wide opening allows me to wipe it down easily, and the machine’s Auto Shutoff feature gives me peace of mind, turning off automatically after brewing. I also love the durability of the stainless steel carafe—it’s sturdy, and the vacuum seal ensures it keeps my coffee at 154°F or hotter for hours,

The only minor downside is the LCD screen isn’t backlit but that is no big deal.

I love this pot and its features and functions.

title: BLACK+DECKER 12-Cup Coffee Maker with Easy On/Off Switch, Easy Pour, Non-Drip Carafe with Removable Filter Basket, Vortex Technology, Black
description: BLACK+DECKER 12-Cup Coffee Maker with Easy On/Off Switch, Easy Pour, Non-Drip Carafe with Removable Filter Basket, Black. This Coffee Maker is your kitchen friendly coffee maker, with just a flip of a switch you get up to 12 cups of hot coffee ready to go. And with the Sneak-A-Cup™ Feature, you can grab a cup of coffee before brewing ends. Includes a removable filter basket that is dishwasher safe.

reviews.review_description:
So far so great! I’ve brewed coffee multiple times now using this product and it works great. I love how it’s super basic and easy to use. After using multiple other products such as the keurig and nespresso I got tired of the constant buying of capsules and cups etccc. This thing is easy to use and allows for your coffee to be warm for multiple hours.

It fits right under my counter, paper roll next to it for reference. Brews a bunch of coffee (12 cups). Just one switch that’s all (to turn off and on). The coffee container does feel like it contains some plastic but so far durable and has not stained.

I only just got it but love it. They're isn't any hissing,dripping, or

spilling all over the counter when you pour a cup of coffee. The last coffee pot did all of that. It's hot and doesn't take up to much space like some other ones do. More counter space. Personally, I do love the shape and size of it. But that's a preference thing.

It seems like a very good coffee brewing system I've had it now for a little while and I like the fact that it can make so much coffee I actually wait for it to cool down and pour it into two of my 1 liter empty bottles of Essentia Water. The one feature were you can pull the coffee pot out while it's still brewing to pour a cup the first time I tried it it worked fine the second time I was showing her friend and it didn't work I had to put the pot back under later another day I tried it again and it worked fine I would say be careful on that particular feature it may or may not work 🤷

Works great, very straight forward by having just an on/off button. Average size and easy to clean. Only wish it would turn off automatically. I wanted a very basic coffee maker, which this is. However, the auto turn off not being a feature on this is a bummer.

This is an inexpensive coffee maker that will make me happy every morning!

My former coffee maker was very expensive, and I purchased it bc my son and daughter loved theirs. The maker did everything but mop the floor😂. I fought with the basket every day. Today, the basket jammed! Enough! This must have been defective, but I fought with I for months! So, I ordered the B&D.

This simple, basic appliance will make me very happy tomorrow morning! B&D👍👍

reviews.review_title: Lasted almost two years of daily use
reviews.review_description: We bought this September 2024 and now as of August 9, 2026 it finally died. We used it every day for almost two years, sometimes more than once a day. Never had any problems whatsoever! This would last longer if we didn’t use it so much but we’re so thankful for it!

reviews.review_title: Works just like a coffee maker is supposed to work
reviews.review_description:
This is a very basic coffee maker. It doesn't have a control panel or a computer. It doesn't think it's smarter than me and turn off when it thinks I've had enough or anything like that.

It has an ON and OFF switch. I used a 24 hour timer that I bought online for $6.99 so it turns on when I decide and off when I decide. You can make up to 12 cups of coffee (which turns out to be 8 normal mugs) as weak or strong as you want and the only waste product is a bio-degradable paper filter that was made from recycled product in the first place.

This is coffee like your fathers drank before then went to work building the skyscrapers and freeways and utility systems that are the foundation of our society - in Hollynut, Irish Wisk, Basil, Thyme and frillyBisk coffee in an environmentally destructive single serving cup before you shuffle back to the bedroom still in your PJs to continue your career as an "influencer."
Starting leaking water at 10 months of age, that surprised me. One pot every day. I figured it would last at least 1 year perhaps 2. :-(

title: 10 Cup Programmable Coffee Maker, Regular & Strong Brew Drip Coffee Machine
description:
About this item
10 Cup Large Capacity: This drip coffee maker with large capacity easily serves your whole family and guests. Perfect for daily home use, parties and office gatherings to enjoy fresh coffee together
24 Hour Programmable Function: Pre-set your brew time in advance with the programmable coffee machine. Wake up to hot, flavorful ready-to-drink coffee and simplify your morning routine
2H Keep Warm & Auto Shut Off: Keeps coffee at ideal temperature for 2 hours to preserve rich taste. Built-in auto shut off ensures safe use and prevents overheating for daily peace of mind
Pause & Serve Feature: Grab a quick cup mid-brew anytime. The pause design stops dripping instantly, no spills or stains, and keeps your kitchen counter clean
Adjustable Strength & Premium Glass Carafe: Choose regular or strong brew to customize your coffee. Durable high borosilicate glass carafe is heat-resistant with drip-free spout for clean, easy pouring
› See more product details

reviews.review_description:
I bought this exact coffee maker about 3 months ago and I haven’t had any issues or problems with it so I decided to get a second one for my vacation home. The coffee maker is compact and looks nice on my counter. The instruction manual has straightforward step by step instructions for first time use and for normal coffee brewing. However, there are a couple of things in the instruction manual that I disagree with. First, it says “the appliance can be used by children 8 years old and above if they’ve been given supervision or instruction.” I can’t imagine letting my 8 year old grandson use my coffee maker or why I would want him to. Also, it says you should unplug and thoroughly clean all parts of the coffee maker daily. That’s probably a good thing to do but I have only been cleaning mine periodically. And for clarification, #3 under Normal Brewing says to use one level spoon of coffee for each cup. This should say one level Tablespoon for each cup of coffee. Other than those things I found the instruction manual to be helpful and clear.

The coffee maker has all the common features found in coffee makers. It can be programmed to go on automatically at a specified time which is convenient for people who work or are in a hurry in the morning. We tried this function and it was easy to do, however, since we are retired we like to prepare the coffee the night before but then press the on/off button when we get up in the morning. The coffee maker has a pause and serve function so you can grab a cup of coffee before the brewing stops. It also has an automatic shut off that turns the coffee maker off two hours after it was turned on. I find this feature to be very important because I often forget to turn it off. There are two other features on this coffee pot that I really like. First, it has a button to make the coffee a little stronger. You just press the “strength” button and a little coffee bean symbol shows up under the time. This slows down the drip and gives the coffee a bolder flavor without making it bitter or too strong. The second thing that I really like is that this machine makes HOT coffee which is the way I like it.

Read more

Been hearing the Jeffersons theme song in my head with this thing, because I feel like I'm Movin' On Up, To The East Side. I've been drinking instant, or pour over, or percolator, campfire, etc. And one cup at a time. This one is a tad pricey, but it pays for itself over time, compared to how I normally drink it, for sure. And it negates the need for filters, so you save on those. Definitely comes out cheaper in the long run, compared to instant. Tickled pink to be able to make 10 cups at a time and keep it hot, instead of one cup at a time, and having to reheat it. With this, I can just top it up and make it hot again. So luxurious and timesaving.

Love the rich setting for making it stronger. Puts hair on your chest, like I need any more of that. LoL.

Love that it stops dripping while you pour a cup! That feature is to die for, because sometimes you really need that first cup, and it's not done brewing, so you make a mess. Not now.

Also great to have a digital clock to look at if I don't have my watch or phone, or it's quicker to look at the coffee maker.

Built well, works well. Again, price is slightly stiff, but it also holds up its end of the bargain in performance and features. Have to call it a Win.

Read more

reviews.review_title: 10 Cup Programmable Coffee Maker: Looks Great And It Works Great Too
reviews.review_description: Sometimes I want a whole pot of coffee and not just 1 cup so this works great for me. It is very asthetic looking and goes very will with my Stainless Steel and Black Kitchen appliances. I really like that this coffee maker is programmable and I can set the time that I want it to brew my coffee so that when I get up in the morning my coffee is waiting on me instead of me waiting on my coffee to brew. This has a "strength" feature to it and I couldn't really tell much difference in taste but I already use a very dark - strong french roast to begin with. The touch controls on this are very sensitive and just the slightest touch of the buttons will change the time or the programming so be careful with that. I set it for 10 cups and I get 10 cups, not 8 or 9 cups but actually 10 cups so that is great. The price really makes this a good value too. I really like how well this coffee maker works.

This coffeemaker is great. I have (and LOVE) a french press, Nespresso and Keurig machines but sometimes you just want to brew a pot of coffee for company without a bunch of steps.

I appreciate that the functions are so simple. The “strong” feature is probably my favorite, as I appreciate strong black coffee. This delivers a solid cup without any bitterness or burnt taste. The mesh reusable filter is great, you may or may not feel the need to line it depending on the type of grounds you’re using. But it’s nice to have that built in without a need to constantly go buy filters.

The programmable functions are simple too. I always try to test things first without reading the manual since let’s be real, that’s how I roll when I open an amazon package…and while I went back to review everything, it was very intuitive to use without doing any reading at all.

This is a solid, basic machine that feels well built and has just the functions I need without a bunch of complicated options I don’t want. Definitely worth the money in my opinion!

This is a no name brand 10 cup coffee maker, and it’s great. The price is so reasonable for all the useful features. It is very modern looking with black and stainless steel accents. The coffee pot is large enough for 10 cups of coffee, and has a pause and serve feature, which is great for people like me who have no patience when a pot of coffee is brewing and I need a cup asap. You can also program the coffee maker to set it up and have it turned on automatically, that is great for the mornings or if you are having a party and don’t want to think about setting up the coffee pot. One feature which was so unexpected was the adjustable brew strength, I never thought of that before, but I have to admit, I really appreciate having it. What a difference it makes with my brew. I am really impressed with this. It is perfect to keep as an extra, use in a vacation home or for everyday use. This coffee maker works really well, is a good compact size while brewing a full 10 cups, and is a reasonable price.

reviews.review_title: No customer service when things go wrongly
reviews.review_description: Stay away!!! I ordered this machine because I have limited space. It made OK coffee but it broke within two months. Since the coffee pot is made and sold via a Chinese company, there is no customer service and I guess no warranty either. I went to their website but the contact information tab doesn’t display contact info. I went to the Amazon online store and again no contact information. Shame on Amazon for associating with such a vendor.

This 10-cup programmable coffee maker is a solid option for everyday home or office use. I like the adjustable brew strength, which makes it easy to customize the coffee depending on my preference. The programmable timer is convenient for having coffee ready when needed, and the pause-and-serve feature is useful when you don’t want to wait for the entire pot to finish. The permanent filter is another nice touch since there’s no need to constantly buy paper filters.

The stainless-steel design looks clean and fits nicely on the counter without taking up too much space. The glass carafe is easy to monitor, although it does require some care to avoid accidental damage.

My main complaint is that some of the controls and settings take a little getting used to, and the carafe could be easier to pour without occasional dripping.

Overall, it’s a capable and convenient coffee maker with useful features at a reasonable value.

This coffee maker is really nice and easy to use. It comes with a reusable filter so no need to spend extra money on disposable filters. Another really nice feature is the adjustable brew strength that offers a personalized brew of either regular or strong. The look of the machine is nice and I like the buttonless/touch screen feature. This was a great price for such a nice drip coffee machine.

title: Hamilton Beach 2-Way Drip Coffee Maker & Single Serve Coffee Machine
description: Whether you want to grab a quick cup of coffee to go on hectic weekdays or enjoy a full pot on laid-back weekends, the Hamilton Beach 2-Way Programmable Coffee Maker does both while saving space on your kitchen countertop.

reviews.review_title: Finally—One Coffee Maker That Does It ALL: Full Pot, Single Cup, Hot or Iced! & No K-cups needed!!
reviews.review_description:
I really like the versatility of this Coffee Maker. Some mornings I want to brew a full pot, while other times I only need one cup, so having both options in one machine is extremely convenient. It also saves me from having two different coffee makers taking up counter space.

The 12-cup glass carafe is a great size when making coffee for more than one or when I know I’ll want a second cup. For those times when I just want something quick, the single-serve side is exactly what I need. I also appreciate being able to make either hot or iced coffee depending on what I’m in the mood for.

The coffee comes out nicely brewed and flavorful. The Auto Pause & Pour feature is another small convenience that I use more than I expected—it’s nice to be able to grab a cup before the entire pot has finished brewing.

The controls are straightforward, and I like the clean black finish. Even though it offers two brewing options, the overall design is practical and doesn’t feel unnecessarily complicated.

For me, the biggest selling point is simply choice: a full 12-cup pot when I need it, a single cup when I don’t, and the option for hot or iced coffee. ALSO - NO K-CUPS needed! Just use your favorite coffee for a single cup. It’s a very practical everyday coffee maker and a good option for a household where everyone doesn’t necessarily drink coffee at the same time. The only thing I do wish this machine had was the ability to use a K-cup instead of ground coffee for the single-serve. But, this is not a deal-breaker since this machine offers so much more.

Read more

Love the color, it goes with my kitchen machine. After cleaning I immediately tried out the single coffee maker and it works great. It is a bit on the slower side, than what I'm used to and I'm still experimenting with the amount of coffee, but I made a tasty cup of coffee and ice coffee. I love that I can program my morning coffee again. It is very easy to use.

The only thing I wish was different, I would have liked to have a removable water tank. I have to pour the water from my water filter into a measuring cup and then pour it into the machine, otherwise I make a mess. Filters are easy to clean and I appreciate being able to change between mild, bold, and ice coffee.

I just hope this machine will last longer than my last 3 machines!

reviews.review_title: It’s not flashy—it’s just nearly perfect!!
reviews.review_description:
Our Ninja coffee maker was great but dying. Really tired of spending $125+ for this small appliance that only lasts two years or so….we’ve replaced a lot of coffee makers!

I’d been looking at this unit but when the price notably dropped during Prime Days, that was it! Still, I didn’t have high hopes for this inexpensive unit. No clue about its lifespan (yet), but so far I LOVE IT!

There are two downsides: it brews slooooooow on both sides, pot or cup. The other is a common issue—aiming water in the lid opening is rough if there are cabinets overhead. Even without cabinets the fill area is rather small and awkward (coming from a Ninja with a separate water tank).

Upside is everything else is awesome! Brews VERY hot….like a $600 coffee maker a coffee master would buy. Coffee tastes excellent from extruding at 200+ degrees using the “bold” setting, and the warming pad keeps it very hot! Ninja didn’t come close. Controls are super easy to use, looks beautiful and more expensive than it is, carafe pours beautifully without the drips at the end, delay timer and “stop dispensing to grab a cup” features are perfect.

If you’re in the market for a coffee maker and you don’t require flashy manufacturing labels or endless brewing options—this is the unit!! Buy it!!!

Read more

I got this as a Christmas Present for my mom as she was in need of a new coffee machine.After researching I chose this one and I’m glad I did,it’s easy to use and set up,I like and she also likes the separate 2 way coffee maker,it’s easy to clean and it’s not a big hassle either which is great! It can brew quickly compared to other past coffee makers we’ve had,it stays hot.i also like the idea that you can put a travel mug on the tray on the other side while getting ready for work or just going out and needing a cup of coffee on the go.the tray is removable to give a bit more room to fit a slightly taller travel coffee mug.I do wish that the tray area had a bit more height and width to be a bit more versatile with different size coffee mugs as my moms one coffee mug is too tall and to wide but other than that I’d say it’s pretty compatible with something a bit smaller. I’d definitely recommend this machine! And will consider buying other products from this company

I got this one to replace my single serve Keurig.

I wanted all three options that this one provides.

The timer is so nice so that I have coffee when I wake up in the coffee pot.

It stays warm for a couple of hours and then turns off. This makes me feel good about not burning the house down with my forgetfulness.

You can brew 12 cups!

The single serve side causes some splashing and I’m not sure why but I just wipe off the maker anyway.

It’s made well.

It comes with a reusable mesh pod like thing to make single serves. I ordered a mesh basket that fits in this for the pot side also.

reviews.review_title: Really decent coffee maker that could use a few quality of life upgrades
reviews.review_description:
Overall, I really like this coffee maker. It does have a couple of quirks though.

One thing I didn't see talked about in any of the reviews I read before buying was that this has two separate water reservoirs. If you fill water from the opening at the front of the maker, you're filling the single cup portion first, and then the excess goes into the main tank for brewing a pot. I find this to be the easier place to fill it using, but that also means that you always have water in the reservoir for the single cup. I'm not a huge fan of that. It also means that if you decide you want a smaller single cup later, there's no way to remove any of the water that you've already put in. So, you're always going to get a full sized cup.

The single cup function is great and really convenient though, and I find myself using it more often than I expected. The mesh filter is really handy but you will always end up with some really fine grinds on the bottom of the cup. This isn't a problem for me, but some people may feel sick if they drink this portion of the coffee.

The iced coffee function is nice to have, but makes really weak coffee. Typically, to make iced coffee, you would leave the grinds soaking in cold water for several hours. So, this is a quick way to get room temperature coffee, but it's not great and melting ice will only further weaken it. Also, if the machine drips at all after you've taken the cup off, it falls into a small pool under the cup holder. It's nice that it's there, but would have been better if there was something you could remove to rinse out instead of just being part of the unit itself.

I also wish that it was possible to adjust how long the hot plate stays on for. It doesn't go off for four hours, and that's just way too long to leave coffee sitting.

The carafe is pretty decent. It doesn't stain easily, which is always nice. But it isn't great at getting all of the water out when pouring, even if turned completely upside down. Not a huge deal, but it's not what I'm used to. There also seems to be something about the way the brewer and carafe line up that always causes a few drops of coffee to fall from the machine after you've taken the carafe off, falling onto the hot plate. I find myself having to clean it off way more often than I should.

Overall though, it's a very solid machine that does a good job making coffee. It's easy to use and although I have mixed feelings about all of the additional functions, they're nice to have in something around this price point. I'm happy with the purchase overall.

reviews.review_title: It takes some muscle to lock in the filter. That's for sure.
reviews.review_description:
In the box you get the machine, a portafilter handle, a single-shot basket, a double-shot basket, a plastic tamper/scoop, and a small removable drip tray with a splash guard.

It has three buttons: single espresso, double espresso, and steam/hot water. The indicator lights stay solid when it’s ready (takes about 45-60 seconds to heat up). There’s also a separate knob on the side to switch between brewing and steaming.

First-time setup is straightforward: fill the tank with cool filtered water (I use filtered to slow down scale buildup), run an empty cycle with the portafilter locked in, then run some water through the steam wand to prime the pump. The initial water that comes out is clean, no weird plastic taste.

The portafilter locks in from about a 45-degree angle and needs to be pushed in firmly and perfectly straight (or slightly to the right) for the brew to start properly; it can take a little force and fiddling at first.

Tamping matters; grounds need to be as level as possible and the rim kept clean, otherwise it won’t seal well. Once it’s locked in, the single and double buttons dispense a fixed volume that produces a decent espresso with visible crema.

For milk, the steam wand works fine. You turn the side knob to steam mode, wait for the light, submerge the tip about 1 cm into the milk, and it froths quickly. The wand itself is a simple panarello style. Cleaning it properly is important: the outer plastic sleeve twists off counterclockwise (it’s stiff on purpose), and you really need to remove and rinse both the sleeve and the metal tube underneath after every use, otherwise dried milk builds up inside and affects taste.

Overall, it’s a very basic but functional 20-bar pump machine. It makes real espresso and steamed milk in a tiny footprint, requires a bit of care with assembly and cleaning, and definitely rewards a level tamp and a firm hand when locking the portafilter. Nothing fancy, but it does what it’s supposed to do.

reviews.review_description:
Excellent little coffee maker. This is actually my second Tastyle coffee maker, the first one I purchased for my office. The first was a hit with my coworkers and they loved it for its simplicity and frother function so when I saw this available, I had to get it. This one works just as well as the first, with simple operation, adaptable cup volume, and rechargeable frother. I was very pleased that a frother pitcher and a stainless steel tumbler were included because the first coffee maker didn’t have these extras and we had to go and purchase the frother pitcher separately. This coffee maker can make single servings of coffee, whether from prefilled disposable pods or a refillable, reusable pod that is included. At my house, we prefer not to use disposable items if possible so we purchased coffee beans and grind them at home. The reusable pod works well with out freshly ground beans, and the coffee comes put clean with minimal to no grit. The frother is my favorite part and so far it has performed admirably with whole milk, heavy cream, or half and half. The frother cup/pitcher allows for a smooth pour and there is a froth art pen if you want to get fancy but we haven’t really used it. Clean up is simple, just a simple wipe down, run a cycle with just water, and an occasional descaling if necessary. Tastyle has descaling tablets we have used in our office machine and they work great. I haven’t really used the stickers yet but they are cute for anyone wanting add some personality and color to their machine or tumbler. Highly recommend this machine, we like it a lot.

Read more

Man this coffee pot is wonderful are Keurig dorm room style we have in the kitchen because we have very little counter space went out a few months back so instead of buying another Keurig we bought a cheap $25 knock off from Walmart and it worked okay and fine but this one has replaced it and blows both of those out of the water I love the tank on the back you get several cups I like that you get larger cups of coffee it's wonderful having the additional 24 oz coffee mug that came with it I'm not a big frother fan but it works well I haven't done the cold brew yet but I've done the bold and I've done several size cups and the hot Brew everything runs as it should one thing that I did not like is the top on the tank feels a little chintzy but it's really no different than any other coffee maker I kind of wish it had it either a hinge or some kind of seal to make it a little tighter but other than that it's Stout it's not going to tip over it don't take long to brew a cup whether it's a 10 oz or 24 oz cup it looks nice and you also can use coffee grounds with the additional coffee ground pod

reviews.review_title: Slim and cute but limited to tall cups to prevent some splatter
reviews.review_description:
Single serve coffee maker with attached frother for milk. I'll start with what I like about the product first. Number one is the slim profile. The attachment milk frother can unplug and plug in easy to make it truly slim to fit in between some appliances I want it to permanently sit. I most likely wont be using much of the milk frother attachment so with it unplugged it will fit nice but its good to have for an occasion that I do want to froth my milk for which I'll just have to scoot the appliance a bit up.

The included mug is great for travel and the bottom narrows to fit in my vehicles cupholder. The stickers are cute but nothing really plus or a positive and that's just my opinion. In fact, The spinning wheel sticker that I added to the front seems to land a large suspicious amount of the time on the vanilla coffee like it's rigged or something but no biggie just pointing it out.

Overall ease of use is simple like your typical coffee maker that includes two separate attachments one for K cups and the other for just using your own crushed ground coffee grinds of your choice. The coffee came out good and didn't take too long which is positive. The bottom spill catch tray even though its slim to match the width of the coffee maker did feel adequate to catch splatter and I had some coffee splatter on the freshly cleaned countertop I set up for the review. Now the counter is I was using my own mug and which is shorter than the included 24oz mug it came with but I had it set on 12oz so that means less coffee to dispense for my shorter house coffee mug. It wasn't crazy splatter but for my super white counter tops it sticks out a lot. This might mean to solve this issue you would need taller mugs or coffee cups so there is less air gap between the machine and the top of the cup. Overall so far that is the only negative I have encountered so I'm deducting one star just for that.

Read more

I've really liked my Tastyle single brew coffee makers. They are straight forward, no-nonsense, reliable devices. They make a good solid cup every time. Now they've come out with this - a single serve coffee maker with a frother, and a clear tank. Now we're talking. The clear tank means no more squinting to see if the water is at the right level. An attached frother makes going from coffee to fancy coffee, an immediate upgrade that requires very little effort on my part. So now my basic cup becomes an indulgence. Yes, it comes with a detachable milk frother, AND the insulated travel mug, AND the metal frother pitcher, and an upgraded, no-grit filter basket, and even the cup platform has been upgraded to a plastic housing with a stainless steel drain grate. And all of this at an excellent price. I've been happy with my Tastyle coffee makers, but this is next level. Whether you enjoy a hot cup or an iced one, this device is worth it!

reviews.review_title: Finally, We Can Each Make Coffee the Way We Like It
reviews.review_description:
We take coffee pretty seriously around here. My husband prefers his darker and richer, while I like a lighter coffee that I mix with my morning protein powder. For years, we have alternated whose preference gets brewed in the regular coffee maker.

This machine pretty much ended that problem immediately. It only took a few minutes to set up, and our old coffee maker was moved to a cabinet for emergencies. My husband can brew his stronger coffee directly into the included travel cup as he heads out the door, while I can brew mine straight into my ceramic mug with my protein powder already waiting.

I also really like having the milk frother built into the machine. I can mix my cup right there instead of hunting for the handheld frother every morning.

For two people who like very different coffee, the single-serve setup works much better for us than making a full pot.

reviews.review_title: Works Just as Well as Our Keurig and Now Lives in the Basement
reviews.review_description:
This coffee maker performs exactly the way it should and the coffee tastes just as good as what we get from our main Keurig. The frother is a really nice bonus that our Keurig does not have and that alone adds some versatility to what you can make.

We put this in our basement kitchenette since our Keurig has a larger water tank and made more sense to keep upstairs where it gets the most use. This is a perfect fit for a secondary space that just needs a solid single serve option.

The one thing I find a little puzzling is the spinner and 5D decor stickers that come with it. I get what they were going for but it kind of cheapens the look of an otherwise clean appliance. You do not have to use them obviously but it feels like an odd inclusion. No real complaints beyond that. Good machine that does its job well.

reviews.review_title: Tastyle BrewKit Single Serve Coffee Maker with Frother for K‑Cup & Ground Includes 24
reviews.review_description: I really love this coffee maker because it comes with so much more than I expected. Being able to use both K Cups and ground coffee is a huge plus, especially when I want the convenience of a pod or feel like making coffee a little differently. The three brew styles and different cup sizes give me plenty of options, and the 40 ounce removable water tank means I am not constantly refilling it. I also love that it includes the 24 ounce tumbler, pitcher, turntable, and even the cute 5D decor stickers. The setup is fun, functional, and looks great on the counter. For everything included and the versatility of the machine, the price was absolutely worth it.

title: Keurig K-Express Single Serve K-Cup Pod Coffee Maker, 3 Brew Sizes, Strong Button Feature, 42oz Removable Reservoir, Evergreen
description: Welcome to Keurig® quality, at our most welcoming price. Enjoy rich, full-flavored taste every time you brew with the Keurig® K-Express® Single Serve Coffee Maker. Whether you’re looking to start your morning strong or need the perfect afternoon pick-me-up, use the STRONG button for a bolder, more intense coffee taste. And speaking of bold – the sleek, modern design of the K-Express® coffee maker makes a big impression in any kitchen. Enjoy an 8, 10, or 12oz. cup of your favorite beverages – all fast and freshly brewed in minutes at the touch of a button. The 42oz. removable reservoir lets you brew up to 4 cups* before refilling, and back-to-back brewing means you don’t have to wait for your brewer to reheat before brewing a second cup. Plus, you can choose your favorites from the hundreds of coffee brands and flavors available in K-Cup® pods, including tea or hot cocoa. You can even use a My K-Cup® Reusable Coffee Filter (sold separately) with your own favorite ground coffee. And all of this comes at a price that helps you put America’s #1 single serve coffee maker brand on your counter.*8 oz. cup size**Cup not included**

reviews.review_description: I bought one a 3 years ago I cleaned it regularly. When I cleanedit this time it won’t turn on after cleaning. Doesn’t even light up. Talked to my friends they said that thought was crazy to expect more than 3 years. It worked great until that last cleaning. Did I do something wrong? Great coffee maker up till this so I did order another one it is on its way. It I need coffee NOW. LOL

reviews.review_title: Compact, Quiet, and Still Going Strong After a Year
reviews.review_description:
This Keurig single-serve coffee maker has been great for everyday use, especially if you don’t want a large machine taking up counter space. I’ve had mine for over a year, use it every day, and it still works just as reliably as it did when I first got it.

It brews incredibly quickly, usually in around 30 seconds or less, and it’s surprisingly quiet while running. I also love how small and lightweight it is. It’s easy to move around, pack up, or take somewhere else when needed, so portability is definitely one of its strongest features.

I’ve had no issues using different pod options with it. It works with the regular coffee pods I buy, including Starbucks, as well as the reusable pod options I’ve tried. I like having the flexibility to use either prefilled pods or my own coffee without needing separate equipment.

Pros:

* Excellent space-saving design

* Very quiet

* Brews in around 30 seconds

* Small and lightweight

* Extremely portable

* Works with multiple pod options

* Compatible with reusable pods

* Easy to use

* Reliable for daily use

* Still working great after more than a year

Overall: This has proven to be a really dependable little coffee maker. I use it every single day, it takes up barely any room, and I can have coffee ready incredibly quickly. After more than a year of regular use with no issues, I definitely think it’s a great value for the money.

reviews.review_title: “Beautiful color, easy setup, and great coffee!” ☕💚
reviews.review_description:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Love the color and how easy it is to use!

I just received my new Keurig, and I’m really happy with it so far! The dark green color is absolutely beautiful and looks even better in person. It fits perfectly on my coffee station without taking up too much space.

Setup was quick and easy right out of the box. Within a few minutes, I had it ready to brew my first cup. I like that it has multiple cup-size options, and it fits my travel mug without any issues.

The coffee brews quickly, is nice and hot, and the machine is much quieter than I expected. Overall, it feels well-made and is perfect for anyone who wants a simple, reliable coffee maker without a lot of extra buttons.

If you’re looking for a compact Keurig that looks great and makes a good cup of coffee, I would definitely recommend this one!

reviews.review_title: Excellent Coffee Maker – Fast, Easy, and Great-Tasting Coffee
reviews.review_description:
I’ve been using the Keurig K-Express for a while now, and I’m very happy with it. It’s compact, stylish, and fits perfectly on my kitchen counter. The Warm Stone color looks modern and elegant.

The coffee brews quickly, and I love the Strong Brew option because it gives my coffee a richer, bolder flavor. The 42 oz water reservoir is convenient since I can make several cups before needing to refill it. It’s incredibly easy to use and clean, making it perfect for busy mornings. If you’re looking for a reliable single-serve coffee maker that delivers great coffee every time, this is an excellent choice. I would definitely recommend it!

First, an introduction, this will take some going through, bear with me. First, I had refused for years to get a Keurig, as I did not feel the quality and richness of a good strong cup of coffee was possible. But I finally got tired of trying other methods of brewing, from using a regular single cup espresso maker, moka pot, pour over, French press... I finally opted for the ease of a Keurig mini-plus. Coffee was ...eh... I switched coffee brands, to what I feel has to be the best commercial brand. And the coffee was EXcellenT! About a year later, despite regular cleaning cycles, the thing just stopped working. I tried to take it apart, watched some youtube videos which just solidified the fact that the company made these non-serviceable. P.O.'d at this obvious tactic to sell more, I waited a few weeks, but went and got another one. Same deal a year later. Another one. This last one gave me signs before ending it's own life. I would have to run several cycles where nothing would come out... till finally something... drip... by drip... several hours later, the thing would start running again, only to stop again the next day or two. Finally, it just died.

So I REFUSED to get another. These things are ridiculous, right? So I got a new French press. Coffee is great!! But... omg... what a pain cleaning that thing every.... single... time... I mean, really, it's no big deal. But, it CAn be. So I saw this thing on sale, I thought, well, it's HAlf the price of the other ones... and I def want something different this time. Cut to now....

This thing has SEVERAL issues that I don't like. First of all, it is a thinner cheaper plastic, and has a cheap looking shine to it. Ok, I'm over it. The plastic... I mean, can't they make these things with glass reservoirs.... the plastic reservoir has screws on the inside of it. I don't care if they say it is food safe... Plastic is also considered food safe... but that doesn't mean it is.. those are just bureaucratic rhetoric lies. But I digress,...So this coffee maker has an adjustment for high altitude... is THAT what ruined my previous Keurigs? High altitude? Hmmm. Ok, so maybe that's a plus. It also has different sizes that you can choose -8,10, & 12 oz. With the mini-plus, you choose the size by the amount of water you pour in. That means that this one measures what it sucks in. Hmmm. The mini-plus had the controls on the top. Easy peasy. This one has the controls on the side. It also doesn't have rubber feet on the bottom. So when you try to push the buttons, the thing slides away from you. Impossible to push any buttons with one hand, you have to use two. Even with rubber feet, you have to use two hands. I'm not a paraplegic, but it's rather stupid to have to hold the thing to press a button or two, or three. Which is what you have to do. It's just really awkward because you really have to hold it in the back to keep it from moving when you press the button in front. And you have to do that without touching the reservoir, which will pop out if you tried that.

But let's get to the coffee. So with the mini-plus, the first liquid out of the machine, was dark coffee. As it was finishing, the coffee would be a little more clear, but not pure water. With this machine, for the first few seconds, it is spewing out crystal clear WATER. I don't even know how that is possible. But this, it does. It also claims to be faster than the mini-cup. I hestitate to say "brews faster", because it doesn't brew, Keurigs simply spew water into and through the k-cup, it's a pressurized system, not a true brewing system. And it definitely IS faster. And that's a problem, as evidenced by the watery coffee that it spews out. Sure enough, the "coffee" tastes like water. This is the 8 oz brew, mind you, with the machine set to "strong". I first tried the 12oz, and ended up pouring it down the sink. The 8 oz wasn't much better. My next step is to switch out cups while it's pouring out the water at the beginning of the cycle and see if I can get a stronger "brew".

All in all, it's convenient enough. But it will sit on my counter, mostly unused, for when I have those really lazy, sleepy, or sick days, when all I want to do is pop in a capsule, and deal with the rest of it... Very disappointed. Perhaps if you live in a low altitude area, the mini-plus would work for you. I really do recommend that one above this.

Read more

reviews.review_title: Mine did not last a year.
reviews.review_description: I loved this keurig for my family. It was perfect for my dsuggter, who had just started drinking mainly decaf coffee. Bought in Oct 2025, and it just stopped working after I cleaned it with descaling solution in June 2026. I had previously cleaned it earlier in the year without any issues. Not sure what went wrong. Not sure if I will buy another one. It was a good thing while it lasted.

I absolutely love my new Keurig K-Express! From the moment I took it out of the box, it was incredibly easy to set up and start using. Within just a few minutes, I was enjoying my first cup of coffee.

What impressed me most is how quickly it brews. Mornings are busy, and having a fresh, hot cup of coffee ready in about a minute is a game changer. The Strong Brew button is one of my favorite features because it gives my coffee a richer, bolder flavor without any extra effort.

The compact design fits perfectly on my countertop without taking up a lot of space, and the removable water reservoir makes refilling simple. It has been reliable, easy to clean, and consistently brews a great cup every single time.

If you're looking for an affordable, dependable single-serve coffee maker that delivers great-tasting coffee and is simple to use, I highly recommend the Keurig K-Express. It has exceeded my expectations, and I couldn't be happier with my purchase!

I got this to replace my original Keurig. The old k50 or whatever it was. This thing takes up less space, looks more sleek, and works better than the original. It's faster, the coffee tastes better, it has the strong button. Also, I keep my coffee maker in my bedroom, and with the old one if you wanted it to be ready to make a quick cup of coffee it had to be turned on which meant that it had lights illuminated. I had to cover them with tape. This new one can go from being turned off to making a quick cup of coffee immediately. And after 5 minutes it automatically turns any illumination off. That means it doesn't make light in my bedroom at night. It's just a way way better version. It's quieter. I love it I'm so glad I got it. I will say that I got this brand new, and it was a really good deal, and I can see why because the manual includes an offer for discounted coffee that expired over two years ago. I'm guessing Keurig punched out a few too many of these models and they've been sitting in a warehouse for too many years. My advice is buy it now before it goes out of stock. It is an excellent coffee maker.

title: Keurig K-Supreme Single Serve K-Cup Pod Coffee Maker, MultiStream Technology, 4 Brew Sizes, 66oz Dual-Position Removable Reservoir, Black
description: Elevate your everyday coffee experience to delicious new heights with the Keurig K-Supreme Single Serve coffee maker in Black. The K-Supreme coffee maker is the first series of Keurig brewer to feature MultiStream Technology, an innovative new way to more evenly saturate the coffee grounds* in every K-Cup pod. This technique extracts full flavor and aroma from your K-Cup pod, so you can enjoy an exceptionally flavorful experience every time you brew. Looking to customize your perfect cup? Use the Strong button for a stronger, more intense coffee taste or brew hot over ice for a refreshingly delicious iced coffee. No matter what you prefer, you can enjoy 6, 8, 10, or 12 oz. of your favorite coffee, tea, cocoa, and more – all freshly brewed in minutes. The K-Supreme coffee maker is travel mug-friendly, and the stylish 66 oz. dual-position reservoir makes it easy to refill and easy to find the perfect spot on your countertop. Choose from hundreds of delicious varieties of K-Cup pods or brew your own ground coffee with the My K-Cup Universal Reusable Coffee Filter (sold separately). *vs. Keurig leading K-Classic brewer

reviews.review_description: Okay, so this review is long overdue. I bought this beautiful machine in December of 24 as a Christmas for myself from my husband and I actually had surgery on Tuesday and that may seem irrelevant but stay with me. On Tuesday of this week 07/14/26 is when my baby decided to start smelling like something was burning and would not turn on. I was devastated 💔. So we pulled out our old single cup, wait a half hour to heat up water, back up and used it until Thursday. Went looking for a replacement, this machine had went up in price by over 50 bucks so I'm not liking the situation already. I found a video on how to fix the problem. The thermostat overheated due to the water tank being off kilter. So the warranty is void anyway, I popped the case off and reset the thermostat with a paper clip, and the machine works perfectly. This is a common issue with this machine apparently. So if this happens don't throw your treasure away, please find the video and try to save your beloved machine.
Typically lasts about 1 year.

reviews.review_title: Great product but it stopped working after 8 months. The warrantee was honored.
reviews.review_description:
I've used Keurig coffee makers for many years. I really like the K-Supreme. It's compact, brews a cup of coffee quickly, has a strong brew option and I like having the serving size options (4, 8, 10 and 12oz). The problem I had is it stopped working after 8 months - it would not power on. Granted I used the coffee maker a lot - 5 to 6 cups a day - but it should last longer than 8 months. My guess, and it's just a guess, is the thermal fuse went - there was a slight "burnt electronics" smell when it stopped working. Keurig did honor the 1 year warrantee and shipped me a brand new replacement unit at no cost and I did not have to return the defective unit. A word of warning, I had to prove the unit was purchased on Amazon and shipped directly by Amazon. Apparently, Keurig may not honor the warrantee if the unit was purchased from a third party seller. The warrantee claim process was challenging at best. The call center is most likely overseas. Information like your email address is repeated back to you in a Alpha Charlie Bravo manner. Even with that, the Agent got it wrong and I waited about a week for an email to start the claims process. A call back confirmand they had my email address wrong. I submitted the required proof of purchased information and my claim was denied. Another call resolved that when I pointed out the receipt showed I purchased the item on Amazon and I told the Agent I had additional proof the unit was shipped directly by Amazon. My claim was then approved and I received a brand new replacement with all accessories in about one week.

Read more

reviews.review_title: Great coffee maker so far upgrade over previous generations
reviews.review_description:
OK so this review is an overall review of not just the product but Amazon as well. I have had this machine around 3 months now.

The machine itself is amazing. The ease of use from the previous generation one is night and day.

Things i like:

The handle on the water reservoir.. finally.. LoL. The reservoir plastic is also thicker and more durable. My previous model reservoir was thinner plastic and cracked and it was also curved. This machine's water container is rectangular so more solid. That in itself makes this machine worth it.

This machine makes hotter coffee and the over ice feature is nice.

I love the grey color.

What i dont like:

Lid will not close all the way with reusable K-cups. Will not close even with the Keurig branded ones. This is only cosmetic it seems though. Functionality seems unchanged.

When i use this coffee maker the LED lights in the kitchen will flicker. The previous model did NOT do this and had similar wattage rating and a grounded plug. The wattage is listed on this newer machine is 1520W. the only other thing on the same circuit is the LED lights.

This coffee maker does NOT have a grounded plug. Maybe this is why the lights flicker?

I got a great price on this for Black Friday time. The first one i got was DoA and would not turn on. It had very obviously been repackaged and retaped. Getting an Amazon chat associate is not as easy as it should be. The AI questions absolutely suck! I was able to finally get a rep on chat and they did make it right. Had UPS come and pick it up at my home which saved me a trip to the UPS store that has lines out the door. The new machine I received is working great so far!

Read more

I upgraded my previous Keurig coffee maker that I bought in 2013. It was worth the upgrade.

I like how easy this machine is to use.

Easy setup: Right out of the box there was little that needed to be done. Just remove factory tape, plug it in and run a single water only cycle and good to go.

Taste: I use a quality coffee. I played with the "strong" button and that was one of the best cups of coffee I've had.

Speed: Hot water on demand. This machine heats the water right before it hits the pod. There is no internal reservoir the water is first pumped into to heat first. This means the speed of use is much faster. My previous unit had this and it took a bit longer to get that first cup. Because there is no internal reservoir there is less places for scaling to take place. Using filtered water also reduces this buildup.

Extraction: This unit is cooler than some other units and extracts at 192 with a final cup temp of about 165. This is less than coffee enthusiasts recommend. I taste no difference as my coffee still had a rich and bold flavor. For someone who enjoys coffee without all the fine tuning this works great.

Ascetically pleasing: I love how small this unit is and how it looks on the counter. It doesn't have a LCD readout with the time or a way to auto set for an automatic cup. The hot water on demand eliminates this need. Just turn it on and you have a cup in maybe a minute. Also, without an LCD display, less to break.

Clean up: The area that the pod is inserted in is not concave as my previous unit was. It can be easily wiped clean. My previous unit could get a buildup of crud around the pod area. That can't happen with this unit.

Descaling setting: While I've not used it yet, I like that it has a descaling setting when I do clean out my machine. My previous didn't have this and it took longer to run cycles.

Cons: Factory taste!! My first two cups of coffee tasted like crap. I assumed this was because it was still getting the factory taste out of the unit. On the 3rd attempt I used the "strong" button and wow I tasted a difference. I'm also using zero water for my coffee.

Overall if you want a "no thrills" machine that makes coffee fast and very well then I recommend this product.

Read more

Perfect for individuals or couples who don't drink enough coffee to make a full pot and waste the rest. My wife and I typically only drink about 3 cups each morning. We used to brew coffee by the pot, but even limiting the brew to four cups, we still ended up wasting a cup.

Our previous Keurig K-Supreme stopped working, so we tried another brand that offered both K-Cup and coffee pot capabilities. We were expecting company for Christmas, and this seemed to be a good idea at the time.

The Keurig K-Supreme provides a much more robust flavor and gives a comparable amount of coffee in about half the time of the other brand. We purchased the other brand about a month before Christmas, so we could try to adapt to it. After a week, I ordered the K-Supreme and stored it until after the company left at the end of the holidays.

The K-Supreme is easy to use, fits on the coffee station counter, and under the cabinet with no problem.

If there is any fault with the K-Supreme, it is the tendency to fail after several de-scaling periods. I think the solution would be to de-scale the unit more regularly and not wait until the warning light goes off. It may be the mineral content of our water, but we do use and replace the water filter in the tank regularly. I have seen cleaning tablets offered on Amazon. I plan on giving those a try.

The only other nit to pick, and it is probably the result of using fine-ground coffee in the mesh pod that comes with the brewer. We had purchased ground coffee for use in the brewer from the other company. It works just fine and does not pass the fine grounds through the mesh, but the grounds get so tightly packed during brewing that it is difficult to clear the grounds from the mesh cup. After the ground coffee is gone, we will switch to medium grind.

reviews.review_title: Disappointed in the quality! Brand has gone downhill!
reviews.review_description: I never write a review because everyone has different perspectives about the items they purchase. However, this product warrants a review! I am so disappointed with this brand. This is the third Keurig Single Serve that I have bought over the years. The first one I bought was back in 1998 and it was wonderful and lasted many years. The second one I bought in 2020 and was great at first but then it stopped working. Then in October 2025 I replaced it with another Keurig Single Serve, thought I would give the brand one more try. In my opinion, the quality of the Keuring Single Serve seems to have gone downhill. I will not buy another Keurig.

reviews.review_title: Filter traps air bubbles & machine needs to be burped occasionally.
reviews.review_description:
UPDATE: We did buy a new one, but it's in the box until needed. Wife noticed there were air bubbles under the reservoir filter & wondered if that was causing the problems. She removed the filter (we have whole house filtration anyway) & burped the machine by shaking it upside down, Solved the problem & has been making great coffee ever since!

Love the slimness. Made great coffee, until it didn't. Followed all instructions & descaling schedule. Started having issues 3 months after purchase. Would only make half a cup of 12oz coffee. Then it didn't recognize that it was full of water & we had to jiggle the reservoir. Sometimes it would make noise without brewing at all. Ordering another one since we purchased a bunch of the stainless K-cups with the 5 holes specifically for this machine.

title: Amazon Basics 5 Cup Drip Coffee Maker with Glass Coffee Pot (0.8 Qt), Auto Shut-off, Auto Pause, Removable Filter Basket, Matte Black
description: An Amazon Brand

reviews.review_description: Inexpensive, but impressive. I purchased this unit after purchasing the Krups version (which is also nice). The Krups one did not have an auto-shutoff, but this one does. I sometimes forget to turn off the coffee and didn't want a possible fire risk with a dry pot situation. This Amazon Basics unit is no frills, does what it says, and has the auto-shutoff (yes, I tested it, and yes, it works). The build quality is cheap, but works as intended. For under $20, I can't complain. The carafe is a 5-sup, but fill up my Yeti mug perfectly with 2 full cups - which is the perfect amount of coffee for me. Brew time is relatively fast and carafe keeps it nice and hot. Recommend!

Great coffee maker! I'm the only one to drink coffee in our house and love this coffee makers small size though it would work well for a couple too. Easy to use and no leaks. Brews at the perfect temperature. Decided to purchase this as reducing plastic waste from kcups and also reduce costs. This coffee machine performs very well and very happy with this purchase.

reviews.review_title: I like it! Basic Little Coffee Pot
reviews.review_description:
★★★★★ Perfect for one or two people

I really like this little coffee maker! It's compact, brews quickly, and doesn't take up much counter space. The Pause & Serve feature is handy when I want a cup before the pot is finished, and the auto shutoff is a great safety feature for peace of mind. Because I always forget to shut off the Coffee pot

For the price, it's an excellent value and makes a great cup of coffee. I definitely recommend it!

reviews.review_title: It works as advertised, but there are some things to know...
reviews.review_description:
I started using this coffee maker on July 7, 2026, and I'm writing this review on July 14, 2026. Here are some things a potential buyer should know.

Things I like:

1. It makes good coffee.

2. It has a small footprint on my counter.

3. The automatic turn-off of the warmer after 2 hours.

4. The ease of use.

5. The coffee is nice and hot, and the warmer keeps it that way for 2 hours.

Something you should know: Believe the reviewers who note that the five cups it claims to make are very small cups. My coffee cup holds a comfortable 10 ounces (300ml). If I fill the water up just short of the 4-cup line on this machine, it makes two of my 10 ounce cups. That's perfect for me, but it might not be right for you, unless you do use tiny cups.

There is nothing that I strongly dislike about this coffee maker, but there is one thing that I find mildly annoying: It is so light that it slides on my counter when I open the bin to put in water and coffee or when I press the on-off switch. These simple tasks become two-hand operations--one hand to steady the machine, the other to do the task at hand. (I might try to find a way to remedy this.)

This machine is not perfect, but for the price and for what I need, I am very satisfied with the purchase. If I have more to add after I've put more miles on it, I will update this review.

I am very happy with this coffee machine. It is easy to use, heats up quickly, and makes delicious coffee every time. The design is modern and looks great on my kitchen counter. I also like that it is simple to clean and doesn’t take up too much space. The coffee comes out hot, flavorful, and smooth. For the price, the quality is amazing. I would definitely recommend this coffee maker to anyone who loves a good cup of coffee!
This may seem rather small for a coffee maker, but it is perfect for those that only want a few cups odf coffee in the morning. Easy to use and clean, and very affordable!

reviews.review_title: Switch turns off and on randomly.
reviews.review_description: This coffee pot is wonderful in theory. And worked great for a few months. Now the switch, which is a push button not a toggle, will trunks off and on randomly and sometimes many times in a row. I am just unplugging it when I am done with it because I dont want it to burn my house down.

reviews.review_title: Great small pot for one person wanting hot fresh coffee.
reviews.review_description: Perfect for one person! I made a pot that gave me 2 (two) 8oz cups of hot coffee. Unless you are serving tiny demitasse cups of coffee, this little machine does not make 5 cups. Works out fine for me, just be aware of this. Brew time was about 5 minutes from turn on to pot filled. It was super simple to assemble. Rinse everything before using as machine is packed in styrafoam/plastic wrap. Recommended.

title: Keurig K-Express Single Serve K-Cup Pod Coffee Maker, 3 Brew Sizes, Strong Button Feature, 42oz Removable Reservoir, Warm Stone
description: Welcome to Keurig® quality, at our most welcoming price. Enjoy rich, full-flavored taste every time you brew with the Keurig® K-Express® Single Serve Coffee Maker. Whether you’re looking to start your morning strong or need the perfect afternoon pick-me-up, use the STRONG button for a bolder, more intense coffee taste. And speaking of bold – the sleek, modern design of the K-Express® coffee maker makes a big impression in any kitchen. Enjoy an 8, 10, or 12oz. cup of your favorite beverages – all fast and freshly brewed in minutes at the touch of a button. The 42oz. removable reservoir lets you brew up to 4 cups* before refilling, and back-to-back brewing means you don’t have to wait for your brewer to reheat before brewing a second cup. Plus, you can choose your favorites from the hundreds of coffee brands and flavors available in K-Cup® pods, including tea or hot cocoa. You can even use a My K-Cup® Reusable Coffee Filter (sold separately) with your own favorite ground coffee. And all of this comes at a price that helps you put America’s #1 single serve coffee maker brand on your counter.*8 oz. cup size**Cup not included**

reviews.review_description: I bought one a 3 years ago I cleaned it regularly. When I cleanedit this time it won’t turn on after cleaning. Doesn’t even light up. Talked to my friends they said that thought was crazy to expect more than 3 years. It worked great until that last cleaning. Did I do something wrong? Great coffee maker up till this so I did order another one it is on its way. It I need coffee NOW. LOL

reviews.review_title: Compact, Quiet, and Still Going Strong After a Year
reviews.review_description:
This Keurig single-serve coffee maker has been great for everyday use, especially if you don’t want a large machine taking up counter space. I’ve had mine for over a year, use it every day, and it still works just as reliably as it did when I first got it.

It brews incredibly quickly, usually in around 30 seconds or less, and it’s surprisingly quiet while running. I also love how small and lightweight it is. It’s easy to move around, pack up, or take somewhere else when needed, so portability is definitely one of its strongest features.

I’ve had no issues using different pod options with it. It works with the regular coffee pods I buy, including Starbucks, as well as the reusable pod options I’ve tried. I like having the flexibility to use either prefilled pods or my own coffee without needing separate equipment.

Pros:

* Excellent space-saving design

* Very quiet

* Brews in around 30 seconds

* Small and lightweight

* Extremely portable

* Works with multiple pod options

* Compatible with reusable pods

* Easy to use

* Reliable for daily use

* Still working great after more than a year

Overall: This has proven to be a really dependable little coffee maker. I use it every single day, it takes up barely any room, and I can have coffee ready incredibly quickly. After more than a year of regular use with no issues, I definitely think it’s a great value for the money.
