reviews.review_title: Exceptionally Good Gaming Monitor - Considering the Price!
reviews.review_description:
I got this for $279 during Prime Day, so far, I'm exceptionally happy with it. I had it running in DCI-P3, there is very slight color shifting on this monitor more so than my other non-OLED monitor, the Samsung G7 Faker Edition. I’ve found that keeping the panel on native, black level at 50 and OD setting on off or dynamic and this issue is pretty much resolved. The OD settings leave a lot to be desired, the only manageable ones I've come across is dynamic and off, all of the others cause a degree of blurring or overshoot-undershoot in the image response times.

Initial Pros and Cons:

Pros:

-Everything works as intended, no issues out of the box, do dead pixels, backlight bleed, etc., looks great.

-Stand is actually fairly decent, for the price point.

-Crystal clear image, the AG used is fantastic, I have 34GS95QE, AW3225QF and Samsung G7 Faker Edition, and in many ways, I prefer the image quality of this monitor, great flexible gaming capabilities.

-Tremendous number of settings, what I've found that works the best, Brightness 38, contrast 50, preset, user, color natural, response - dynamic, professional - screen native, blue light at 25%, local dimming set to auto, this IMO, is the best you can get this monitor at settings wise.

HDMI upscales PS4 Pro and Xbox Series X to 4K 60hz and the latter also at 1440P 120hz.

-Screen uniformity, exceptional.

-Has a more natural look than OLEDs due to their constant blue light push, it's the technology, this monitor in the right settings, reminds me of a CRT, in some ways.

-Recommend setting the black equalizer to 50, anything lower introduces black crush, higher image washout, at 50, it helps in the overall response times, look and feel, had this set to zero and the image was ghosting a lot when scrolling, panning.

-M27T6 is significantly better than AOC's offering, the (Q27G40XMN) which I bought and returned from a different seller, IMO, the two shouldn't even be considered comparable. That monitor has two big issues, DP 1.2 and you can’t defeat the brightness settings when using local dimming, it locks to 100% brightness.

-Able to do full 10-bit at 180hz over DP 1.4 connection.

Cons:

-Image shifting noticeable, used to OLEDs, instant response times, it's better than most, though still noticeable.

-local dimming greatly reduces brightness, though you can easily up the brightness to offset this issue.

-DCI-P3 and BT. 2020 look great, for very specific games-apps, otherwise, your much better off with screen native, it provides a much more natural look.

-Over Drive settings introduce a lot of panel response time issues, blurring and overshooting, this monitor works better after it's been on for 15 minutes or so, it needs to warm up, literally. I’ve found off or dynamic OD settings work the best.

-HDR on Vesa IMO looks the best, in FPS type of games, though strategy games and such, AOE, CIV, etc., Game HDR looks more natural, you're able to change a lot of settings with HDR, which most monitors lock you out of, don't believe this unit is truly capable of the specs, HDR-1400 etc., though played a few games last night, IMO, they looked pretty good in HDR. NBA 2k25, Oblivion, Baldur's Gate 3 and others look tremendously good with HDR enabled, this monitor does a great job with 1152 dimming zones and creating a colorful and detailed HDR image for gaming or even media content, such as Netflix.

-Dirty screen effect when shifting your sight from side to side, nothing major, though I've noticed it more than I would prefer, there is an ever so slight grainy effect, only noticeable in certain situations.

For the price and what's offered, I can't recommend it enough!

reviews.review_title: Excellent monitor with some tweaking read full review
reviews.review_description:
Excellent monitor, but a little too saturated on default settings out of the box. For the best experience, either use sRGB mode with low local dimming at 75% or 100% brightness, or, like I do, and use DCI-P3 color mode with low local dimming at 100% brightness, and it looks really accurate and great!

As for HDR, it's a mixed bag. In order to get the best brightness and bang for your buck, you shouldn't be using this monitor with Windows HDR or macOS. If you want true 1:1 HDR, it is much better with a console that has proper HDR settings and out of the box tuning. But if you want to use it with a PC or Mac, it is still mostly fine, but I would calibrate the HDR using the built-in calibration in Windows.

The refresh rate is also a mixed bag. If your computers GPU or console doesn't support the latest DP 1.4 and/or HDMI 2.1 standard, then you won't be able to do more than 120Hz at 4K without display compression, and it looks and feels horrible when compression is on and visable at 160hz.

My recommendation is this setup for PC:

Use the DCI-P3 color mode for the best color accuracy across HDR and SDR, but if you don't plan on using HDR and use exclusively SDR, then stick to sRGB mode for the best accuracy for SDR content and gaming.

100% brightness for the best brightness and hitting the advertised HDR brightness claims. Note this may be too much for the average person, so if that's the case, stick to 75%, which still hits a respectable brightness. For HDR calibration in Windows: set to 1930 nits (small window) and 1600 nits (full screen), as those are the official rated numbers. Use exclusively 120Hz at 4K and the standard preset for overdrive, as any other preset has overshoot and ghosting and any refresh rate above 120hz is pointless if you get display compression and not that noticable or helps much in gaming.

As for the 320Hz dual-mode operation, it does not support native scaling, so you just get a blown-up 1080p image with no scaling, and it looks very blurry and unclear on the 4K display. It does hit its advertised 320Hz, but it is unusable in my opinion due to the blurriness of the picture from the lack of proper image display scaling. I also think they are slightly overdriving the pixels more than usual because even on the standard preset, there is still a lot of visible ghosting and overshoot on the monitor. I had to fully turn it off to get rid of it, but that defeats the point of the 320Hz mode, as it introduces more input delay for a clearer, smoother image. If you bought this monitor purely for the 320Hz mode and don’t plan to use 4K, you would be better off with a monitor that has native 320Hz support. This is clearly more of a 4K monitor than a 320Hz 1080p one.

In conclusion, if you are looking for an excellent 4K monitor with really bright colors and overall brightness for viewing content and gaming in HDR, then this is it. But if you are looking for the best response times and don’t want to tweak settings out of the box, then maybe look for something else, as this monitor is clearly aimed at MiniLED enthusiasts and people who know what they are buying and how to properly set it up for the best experience. If you want a great MiniLED thats for beginners I recommend the AOC Q27G3XMN 27" for a better entry point to gaming with a MiniLED as it's 1440p and doesn't need any tweaking out of the box for a great experience if you want to try out MiniLED without eating away $500.

reviews.review_title: Good monitor, but needs manual adjustment for proper color.
reviews.review_description:
Well constructed and very sharp, but terrible color balance that can be corrected with the included controls.

The settings I came up with for natural skin tones and not having your eyes ruined by an extremely bright and blue screen output are these:

Set it to theatre mode

Cut brightness down to 25 (!). Way, way down.

Set red, green, and blue under the 'Color Temperature' to 65, 85, and 77, respectively.

Your mileage may vary, but you can use these settings as a starting point and adjust for your personal taste.

These settings work best in low to average room lighting; if in a brighter room, you may have to adjust more.

I would have given the monitor a 5-star rating, but the default settings are not pleasant at all.

reviews.review_title: Good monitor with one minor caveat.
reviews.review_description:
I got this monitor when it was $149 and while other options exist for a cheaper price and better refresh rate, this has the color saturation option. Basically, you can make the colors pop much more, which is a huge plus in my book as only a few monitor brands have it. It's a huge requirement for me. The 1440p is also a big upgrade compared to my other 1080p monitor, as games and other content looks way better while not being as resource intensive as 4k. However there are a few downsides to this monitor.

First downside was getting the monitor to recognize the 1440p signal. When I first set it up, it only recognized 1080p from my mini pc. When I unplugged and plugged the HDMI cable back in, then the monitor discovered the 1440p. Not a huge deal breaker, as I rarely unplug my computers.

Second downside however, is a very annoying one. When auto switching from HDMI to Display Port, the monitor sometimes goes into sleep mode, or just bugs out. This is very frustrating as I constantly go from my mini PC (on HDMI), to my Desktop (on Display Port). It'll sometimes work without issue, and other times I have to power off the monitor via the back button for it to work again. But sometimes when powering back on from this issue, the monitor light will be amber instead of white, even though it's not sleeping and fully on. I have to physically unplug and replug the monitor in to fix this. (See the attached photo). Disappointing that this is an issue, given my other 1080p monitor from ASUS never had this issue.

So ya, if you can get this for sale under $130 then sure it's a good monitor. If not, find something else that is less buggy.

With a built-in, easy-clean straw and a wide-mouth opening, the FreeSip reusable bottle is designed for drinking two different ways: sipping upright through the straw or tilting back to swig from the wide-mouth spout opening. Add in a push-to-open lid and playful colors, and staying hydrated has never been simpler—or more fun. Additional features include double-wall insulated stainless steel that keeps drinks cold up to 24 hours, a carry loop that doubles as a lock, a cup holder-friendly base, and a wide opening for easy cleaning and adding ice. The Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless-Steel Water Bottle with Locking Push-Button Lid is available in three sizes: 24-Ounce, 32-Ounce, and 40-Ounce. Lid is dishwasher safe; hand wash cup. Not for use with hot liquids. Manufacturer’s limited lifetime warranty.

reviews.review_description:
I purchased this bottle just to try out in the summer of 2023. It is now the summer of 2026 and I still use it multiple times a week (only because I now have multiple Owalas and I have just ordered my third Owala FreeSip). I have used so many cups—Stanleys, Yetis, Hydrojugs, Hydroflask, etc—and the Owala is still my favorite. Here’s my favorite things about it:

LEAKPROOF! This is the biggest one. I can throw it my bag and trust that everything will stay dry.

THE SPOUT! Hands down the best spout I’ve ever used. I love that I can sip through the straw but then close the lid and keep my straw clean and not have any spills if it tips over. And then it also gives me the option to absolutely inhale water if I’m about to shrivel up from dehydration. I think this alone is why I now own three in different sizes.

STAYS COLD! The 32 ounce holds ice for quite a while. It varies depending on how often I refill it but if I’m not constantly refilling it, it will hold ice for about 24 hours.

THE SIZES! I love the size options. My original one was a 32 ounce and is a great middle ground for me. It holds enough water that I’m not refilling it every hour but it’s not huge. It’s great for work and this bottle will be going to live at my job. I just ordered the 40 ounce for home because I want a little more volume when I’m outside gardening but I can’t say much about the 40 ounce size yet. I also have a 16 ounce (kids size) that I use when I leave the house. It fits in a lot of my bags and it’s leakproof so I always have cold water with me. It’s perfect especially since I’m on medication that causes dehydration if I’m not careful.

DISHWASHER SAFE! This one is self explanatory.

It’s amazing and I love it. There are a few cons though. The first one is that the 32 ounce doesn’t fit in my cup holder. Not a huge deal since it’s leakproof—I just keep it on the passenger seat. But Owala does have cup holder friendly options now if that’s something you want.

The bottle also does dent and scratch fairly easily. I dropped it getting out my car one day and it’s a little beat up now. Kind ugly, but it’s still my fave. It’s kinda disappointing because I have Yetis and Stanleys that have been through far worse and still look new. Just be mindful of that and baby it a little. Still 100% worth it though.

Long story short, it’s a great bottle that will keep your water cold and everything else dry. As someone who has used this bottle regularly for years, I highly recommend!

I freaking love this thing. I'm not a trend person, I go for function. And when my STB SIL got my fiancé a shiney new Stanley I decided it was time to replace my beat up Rtic with the mismatch lid and straw.

I may not follow trends, but I didn't want my fiancé's cup to put mine to absolute shame!

First off, can we all agree that the marshmallow is gorgeous? THIS cup is spectacular. Strange to say that about a water bottle, I know. But since I never jumped on that train, I didn't know what I had been missing out on. Let me tell you what!

The most important things to me is taking care of my service dog. She keeps me safe so her care is paramount to me. This enables me to pour my water into her bowl on the fly, without having to open my bottle past what I would do to drink from it. Quick and easy. That right there was the selling point for me. But as it turns out, there was even more benefit than that.

I don't chug my water but if I did, the chug hole does works fine.

The straw portion is ready to sip from, and it doesn't stick up tall like other water bottle straws. It's JUST tall enough to get the job done. No worry of toppling over because the straw got knocked over by the cat. (Because that happens.)

The "handle", which is generally the locking feature unless you're using it as a handle, is well placed and comfortable for my sized hands. Not to small and not clunky and large. STB SIL likes to talk about how great the Stanley handle is, which I don't really get. I like that this doesn't have a handle. I have one to carry it if I need it, and not if I don't.

The seal is completely water tight. I occasionally put a drink mix in it and shake vigorously. No leaks whatsoever. In fact...

It fits in a car cup holder upside down. That's how I transport it in the car. It doesn't fit butt down, so I put it top down. I've been known to do this with various bottles, so I tried it with this one and it fits ok. It's not ideal but it's better than nothing. Try it in yours! Since it's completely leak proof there's are no worries about spilling. (Just be careful when you remove it that it doesn't unlatch.)

Another bonus of the covered straw is that germs don't get in the straw. Perfect because people in public often don't cover their sneezes. Ugh. And the coolest part? Lipstick messes are concealed with a flip of the lid! Easy peasy!

I have noticed that the inside of the straw stains a little, which was disappointing. I don't like that I look at it and it looks dirty when it isn't. But I guess I shouldn't have used drink enhancers then. Also, my top color is very light. Other colors might not show that. Another thing that want fun was that when it fell, it dented! Oh no! So beware of that.

It keeps my water super cold and I don't go anywhere without it. I love it so much that I'm thinking of getting another so I don't have to limit myself by style! Definitely worth the price since I use it constantly, every day.

This one is so chill and Zen... The next one shall be colorful and crazy! One for every mood!

I simply can't say enough about this darn water bottle... Does that mean I'm on trend now? Who knows! I just love my Owalla! I'm definitely a fan!

Read more

Owala water bottles for the win! These are hands-down our favorite water bottles. We have tried just about every popular brand out there—Yeti, Stanley, Hydro Flask, and others—and the Owala is the one that everyone in our family consistently reaches for.

I absolutely love the versatility of the lid. You can use the built-in straw when you want to sip, or easily flip it open and drink straight from the opening. Having both options in one bottle is incredibly convenient, especially when you're on the go.

The color combinations are also so fun! There are so many options to choose from, and the colors and designs make the bottles feel a little more personal and fun to use.

Durability is another huge selling point. These bottles get used constantly and have been dropped and knocked around, yet they hold up extremely well. They seem much less prone to denting than some of the other brands we've tried, which is especially important when they're being used by kids.

And, of course, they keep drinks really cold! We can fill them with ice and water, and they stay cold for hours. The lid also seals extremely well—we have never had an issue with them leaking in a bag.

After trying so many different water bottles, Owala is definitely the winner for our family. They're durable, versatile, attractive, keep drinks cold, and don't leak. I honestly can't think of another water bottle brand we've liked as much!

As my first Owala I am so pleased with this water bottle. Keeps ice and water cold for hours, doesn’t leak, and love that you can use straw or spout. Great quality and liked the price. Only complaint is that it doesn’t fit in the car cup holders

reviews.review_title: Meet Your Hydration Goals with the BEST Water Bottle!
reviews.review_description: I am absolutely thrilled with my Owala FreeSip stainless steel water bottle as it has quickly become my absolute favorite for every day use, and it is easily the best insulated bottle I have ever owned. The best part for me is the built- in straw. It allows me to sipupright or I can drink from the widemouth opening. The push button lock lid locks securely so I can toss it in my tote bag without worrying about any spills. The stainless steel keeps the water ice cold all day even if I leave it in my hot car! It has a convenient carry loop. It can be filled with large ice cubes, and it’s easy to clean. You will love it!!!

We love this Owala! The 16 oz size is perfect for kids—big enough to hold plenty of water without being too heavy or bulky for them to carry around.

The FreeSip design is probably my favorite part because they can sip through the straw or tilt it back to drink normally. It doesn’t leak all over the place, keeps water cold for a long time, and the covered spout stays cleaner than an exposed straw. The Read My Lips color is super cute, too.

It’s held up really well to everyday kid use, which says a lot. Definitely worth the 5 stars!

I got this Owala for my son and really like it so far! My favorite feature is that you can drink from either the built-in straw or use the chug opening. It gives him both options without having to switch out lids or pieces, which is really convenient.

The bottle itself feels sturdy and good quality, and the lid closes securely and has a handle that makes it easy to carry. The colors are also really fun and vibrant.

My only concern is the coating on the outside. It feels like it may be somewhat easy to scratch, especially since this is going to be used by a kid and tossed into bags, taken to school, etc. We’ll see how it holds up over time!

Overall, though, I’m really happy with it.

I’ll update my review once I find out how sturdy it is.

reviews.review_title: Love Owala; does not leak and easy to carry. Stays cold!
reviews.review_description: Love Owala bottles and I have several of the 24 oz. I decided to get a larger size (32 oz.) this time to take to sporting events to hold more water. Water stays cold all day like the others, and it never leaks. The only downside is that it doesn't fit in my car or chair cupholders by just a fraction. I kind of suspected that might be the case going in, so it doesn't bother me too much. At games I just have to set it on the ground instead of my sports chair. It just won't be my everyday bottle - I will continue to use the 24 oz for the car since it fits perfectly in the cupholder. But Owala still gets 5 starts for the great design, easy to carry, and staying cold all day.

My only concern is the coating on the outside. It feels like it may be somewhat easy to scratch, especially since this is going to be used by a kid and tossed into bags, taken to school, etc. We’ll see how it holds up over time!

Overall, though, I’m really happy with it.

I’ll update my review once I find out how sturdy it is.

I didn't get into the Stanley craze-I've had too many accidental spills with the whole cup & straw set up. So when my kids started insisting I get an Owala, I was skeptical. But then I saw the TikTok of that one guy using his Owala as a weapon to fight off the men who attempted to break into his house, and not only did he stop them, his Owala survived with just a dent (and a broken handle, if memory serves me right)! Then Owala does the of the best PR stunt/customer appreciation ever, and not only sends that man a safe, but filled that safe with several Owala bottles! I admire a company that can back their products up; but I will support a business who listens and recognizes their customers too! So I started looking for one; I got to thinking as a woman who often does her errands alone, "you know, I can always use it for defense and I can't be accused of carrying a weapon, because technically it's a water bottle."

When Owala came out with this Amazon exclusive color, I knew it was kismet! I put it on my cart, but before I checked out, my kid saw what I was doing and she stopped me. She said, "lady, I already bought that for you. It's coming next week." LOL I guess she got tired of telling me to get one, and just grabbed it for me, knowing that burgundy is one of my favorite colors!

I've had it for 5 months now. It's a little dinged up on the bottom-nothing too bad. I just dropped it one or two times (maybe more). I love that the mouthpiece is covered up and can be locked so 1)it will always be clean; and 2)it won't accidentally spill if it tips over, or you know, you accidentally drop it. It keeps me accountable-I fill that 40 oz 2-3 times a day to make sure I stay hydrated. I love that it's insulated so I can keep my drink cold or hot-depending on what I fill it with. I love that it's easy to clean-there are no nook & crannies that can't be cleaned or reached! I just love it. Period.

Whether you're at the gym, on a trail, or sitting at your desk, this sleek and sturdy bottle will maintain its pristine look, no matter the environment. Its resilient coating means it stands up to daily wear and tear, ensuring it lasts through countless adventures.

reviews.review_description: What are the best purchases I've ever made, love this. Living in Arizona it's always hot just keeps my dreams cold for days I've had ice last for 2 days it has two option fruit heads a flip mouthpiece with a straw in the lid that just unscrews off it has d-rings to clip it to your belt loop and a paracord that's very strong and very well made I'm always sharing mine by the Paracord. Fabulous water bottle! Great to handle, holds a ton of water and keeps it cold! Took it to an outdoor event that was HOT and it really worked. Easy to clean and came with options for carrying and drinking. Lots of color options too. Don’t hesitate to buy this!

reviews.review_title: HONESTLY THE ONLY WATER BOTTLE YOU'LL EVER NEED!! BEST EVER!!! SON USES IT FOR SCHOOL EVERYDAY!!
reviews.review_description: I waited to write this review. My 8 year old son needed a daily water bottle for school & I found this on a really great deal in Sept 2025. I loved that It had a strap for him to carry, especially if we had trips! It is now March 2026 & I am BEYOND impressed with this thing! First off, it came with 2 straps- one hand strap & another for his shoulder! He has currently been into sipping through a straw, but used to prefer pouring... This one comes with BOTH types types you can change by screwing that choice lid on! It had 2 straws (I had never had to replace yet- and he brings it everyday)!! It comes with 2 brushes to clean and 1 for the straw. I have washed it so many times- it's easy! it's still exactly the same now as it was! One of the best things I like about it is how cold it keeps his drink (it like dense metal but also not really heavy) but ALSO- HUGE- the fact that somehow it doesn't seem to create any mild easier like others I've had, even if its kept out. (Once he accidentally left It at school during a week vacation and there was no signs of mold in there- I don't know how! That would have never happened with our old ones!) It slides very easily into a pouch that is the "carry pouch". I have his name tag attached to the clip on it. We have gotten so many compliments on it & asked where it came from. I bought another water bottle so I could interchange them during washes- but honestly, I've rarely ever done that bc this is my son's favorite water bottle & this will be the only one you'll ever need!

I really love this half gallon bottle. I love the color as it is my favorite so of course I was immediately drawn to it. Very good ratings as well. Compared to my other one I had through someone else it leaked if tipped over or even leaning from day one and this one doesn’t leak at all. It keeps my water cold even without ice. It’s easy to use and doesn’t feel as heavy as my old one used too. I love the lid options as I prefer the spout. I like that I can easily grab it either by the hard handle or the rope strap. All around wonderful product.

I kept running out of water at work with my Owala so I was looking for a larger size water bottle without breaking the bank.

I found this 87oz water bottle for a great price. My first impression was that it could be cumbersome to carry around, but that quickly changed. It’s so easy to carry with the braided strap (that also has a compass, nice touch!!). I really like all the extras (the slim pockets, carabiner, two style of lids, longer strap to carry, and all the washing tools). It was a bit difficult to slip the fabric off the bottle at first and the fabric has a slight smell to it, but I expect that to dissipate.

I think this is a great option to help fulfill your daily water needs!

This is an amazing tumbler! I usually do not have to put ice in after 24 hours unless I add room temperature water to the cup. It is leakproof! I've not experienced a leak, so that is another 5 Star! I gifted it to myself in February 2026 as my New Year's Gift!

The capacity is amazing! I love that I can drive over 12 hours with enough water from the start to the finish of my drive!

The handle options and the carrying case? GENIUS! I absolutely love them, those are "FIVE STARS". I used the shoulder carrying option on my last cruise! Everyone wanted one for themselves!

I gave it a 4 star because there is a "gassy, galvanized taste" that I still taste. I initially thought it was because the tumbler was new but I have owned it for over 6 months now and I do use it everyday. I understand it's a "oral galvanism or a lipid-oxidation sensory reaction", this might be different for me than someone else.

The next reason for not giving a solid 5 star!

Of the two Lid options, I prefer using the straw lid! Since I take the tumbler everywhere I go, I would prefer if the "mouthpiece, sip, or straw tip" was covered.

If they upgrade Lid Options to a "Callapsable Cover Straw Lid", I would purchase the lid!

In fact I came back to see if they upgraded, not to leave a review. I hope this was helpful to someone.

It keeps beverages cold with ice overnight and into the next day - ice is still there. Honestly we’ve never had it run out so it cold be more than 24 hours.The insulation prevents condensation/moisture on the outside. Love the sturdy handle and places to carry things like cellphone and wallet. Love that I can clip it onto another item. Or use the smaller hook for car keys.

LOVE LOVE LOVE THESE!

Love this water bottle! It holds about a half gallon, keeps water cold all day. It is insulated, has both a handle made of para-cord and 2 different tops! It never leaked on my 35 days of camping. Yes, I would order again. You won't be disappointed!

reviews.review_title: Pretty Bottle — Insulation? Not So Much.
reviews.review_description:
I rarely rate items I review so low. Here is my explanation:

I like the color, the size and the shape of the water bottle. I like that it does not appear to leak. It is convenient to have one that is not gigantic, but I was really hoping for better functionality.

I was extremely disappointed to find that this insulated water bottle does not keep my cold drinks cold anymore than a glass with ice in it. For my first experiment I put water already cold from the fridge into the clean bottle, sealed it with the lid, and placed it on the kitchen counter. Two hours later I drank from the bottle and it was nowhere near as cold as I expected. Second experiment - I filled it with cold tap water, put it unsealed in the fridge overnight. In the morning the water was nice and cold. I took it out, sealed it, placed it on the counter and again, 2 hours later it was just a little colder than room temperature. Third experiment - I put fridge cold water and 2 long ice cubes in it, sealed it and placed it on the counter. You'll never guess what I found 2 hours later. You probably guessed that the ice had melted and it was nowhere near cold.

The shorter story is that I am disappointed with this bottle's ability to keep anything cold. I thought about returning it but decided that the drive to Whole Foods and the frustration of finding a parking space was not worth the $10 I would POSSIBLY get back once Amazon decided if I deserved my full refund or not.

If you purchase this item, be prepared to just keep it in the fridge if you want your drinks to be cold. Everything else about it is fine - but sadly, its main function leaves something to be desired.

reviews.review_description:
I purchased this bottle just to try out in the summer of 2023. It is now the summer of 2026 and I still use it multiple times a week (only because I now have multiple Owalas and I have just ordered my third Owala FreeSip). I have used so many cups—Stanleys, Yetis, Hydrojugs, Hydroflask, etc—and the Owala is still my favorite. Here’s my favorite things about it:

LEAKPROOF! This is the biggest one. I can throw it my bag and trust that everything will stay dry.

THE SPOUT! Hands down the best spout I’ve ever used. I love that I can sip through the straw but then close the lid and keep my straw clean and not have any spills if it tips over. And then it also gives me the option to absolutely inhale water if I’m about to shrivel up from dehydration. I think this alone is why I now own three in different sizes.

STAYS COLD! The 32 ounce holds ice for quite a while. It varies depending on how often I refill it but if I’m not constantly refilling it, it will hold ice for about 24 hours.

THE SIZES! I love the size options. My original one was a 32 ounce and is a great middle ground for me. It holds enough water that I’m not refilling it every hour but it’s not huge. It’s great for work and this bottle will be going to live at my job. I just ordered the 40 ounce for home because I want a little more volume when I’m outside gardening but I can’t say much about the 40 ounce size yet. I also have a 16 ounce (kids size) that I use when I leave the house. It fits in a lot of my bags and it’s leakproof so I always have cold water with me. It’s perfect especially since I’m on medication that causes dehydration if I’m not careful.

DISHWASHER SAFE! This one is self explanatory.

It’s amazing and I love it. There are a few cons though. The first one is that the 32 ounce doesn’t fit in my cup holder. Not a huge deal since it’s leakproof—I just keep it on the passenger seat. But Owala does have cup holder friendly options now if that’s something you want.

The bottle also does dent and scratch fairly easily. I dropped it getting out my car one day and it’s a little beat up now. Kind ugly, but it’s still my fave. It’s kinda disappointing because I have Yetis and Stanleys that have been through far worse and still look new. Just be mindful of that and baby it a little. Still 100% worth it though.

Long story short, it’s a great bottle that will keep your water cold and everything else dry. As someone who has used this bottle regularly for years, I highly recommend!

The FreeSip design is probably my favorite part because they can sip through the straw or tilt it back to drink normally. It doesn’t leak all over the place, keeps water cold for a long time, and the covered spout stays cleaner than an exposed straw. The Read My Lips color is super cute, too.

It’s held up really well to everyday kid use, which says a lot. Definitely worth the 5 stars!

I got this Owala for my son and really like it so far! My favorite feature is that you can drink from either the built-in straw or use the chug opening. It gives him both options without having to switch out lids or pieces, which is really convenient.

The bottle itself feels sturdy and good quality, and the lid closes securely and has a handle that makes it easy to carry. The colors are also really fun and vibrant.

My only concern is the coating on the outside. It feels like it may be somewhat easy to scratch, especially since this is going to be used by a kid and tossed into bags, taken to school, etc. We’ll see how it holds up over time!

Overall, though, I’m really happy with it.

I’ll update my review once I find out how sturdy it is.

reviews.review_title: Love Owala; does not leak and easy to carry. Stays cold!
reviews.review_description: Love Owala bottles and I have several of the 24 oz. I decided to get a larger size (32 oz.) this time to take to sporting events to hold more water. Water stays cold all day like the others, and it never leaks. The only downside is that it doesn't fit in my car or chair cupholders by just a fraction. I kind of suspected that might be the case going in, so it doesn't bother me too much. At games I just have to set it on the ground instead of my sports chair. It just won't be my everyday bottle - I will continue to use the 24 oz for the car since it fits perfectly in the cupholder. But Owala still gets 5 starts for the great design, easy to carry, and staying cold all day.

It fits in my car’s cup holder, has a convenient carry handle, features a lock and unlock switch, has a dual spout with a straw and also a regular spout to drink out of, the mouthpiece is covered by a pop up lid that opens at the press of a button and protects the mouth area from dirt and germs. Last but not least is the pretty color. I bought the Out of the Blue color.

Durable, sturdy, leakproof, easy to clean. The lid, straw and gaskets are dishwasher safe. The bottle itself should be hand washed so the finish doesn’t get ruined in a dishwasher.

Since it’s easy to carry around by the handle, I am finding myself taking it wherever I go in the house and I’m actually drinking more water because of it!

Solid water bottle!!!. Not a water bottle person nor I do I really review anything but I like this is it a lot. Buy it. It’s worth it. Cool colors. The cherry one I got has a candy paint sparkle. simple ergonomic design. So far spill proof. Fits in cup holder and yea. Don’t get a Stanley get this instead.

I didn't get into the Stanley craze-I've had too many accidental spills with the whole cup & straw set up. So when my kids started insisting I get an Owala, I was skeptical. But then I saw the TikTok of that one guy using his Owala as a weapon to fight off the men who attempted to break into his house, and not only did he stop them, his Owala survived with just a dent (and a broken handle, if memory serves me right)! Then Owala does the of the best PR stunt/customer appreciation ever, and not only sends that man a safe, but filled that safe with several Owala bottles! I admire a company that can back their products up; but I will support a business who listens and recognizes their customers too! So I started looking for one; I got to thinking as a woman who often does her errands alone, "you know, I can always use it for defense and I can't be accused of carrying a weapon, because technically it's a water bottle."

When Owala came out with this Amazon exclusive color, I knew it was kismet! I put it on my cart, but before I checked out, my kid saw what I was doing and she stopped me. She said, "lady, I already bought that for you. It's coming next week." LOL I guess she got tired of telling me to get one, and just grabbed it for me, knowing that burgundy is one of my favorite colors!

It keeps me accountable-I fill that 40 oz 2-3 times a day to make sure I stay hydrated. I love that it's insulated so I can keep my drink cold or hot-depending on what I fill it with. I love that it's easy to clean-there are no nook & crannies that can't be cleaned or reached! I just love it. Period.

I plan to do the project again next year and will definitely reorder these and consider them for other projects!

I bought these because my kids always lose their water bottles. At first they were thrilled with the way they looked. Already 2 of them are quite heavily dented, just from dropping them lightly on the floor. Very flimsy material. Don’t expect them to look nice for long

I like the size of the bottles; they match the Gatorade Zero plastic bottles. I bought these metal bottles so I could buy GZ and Celsius powder packets and mix the powder with water in them, avoiding plastic waste and potential health issues from reusing plastic bottles.

I don't care if they're not insulated - the bottles stay in the fridge at home after I mix the powders, then I pour the drink into insulated containers for gym trips, hikes, etc.

The problem: I filled the bottles about halfway, then poured in the powder mix, screwed the lid on tightly (and closed the snap lids), and shook the bottles. In almost every case, the bottles leaked, some of them a lot. So I used a Q-tip to put a light film of vegetable oil on the gaskets before shaking, and that helped in most of the leaking bottles, but not all.

Bottom line: the "leak-proof" claim is false. I shouldn't have to try the vegetable oil trick, and even then, some of the bottles still leaked.

The material is very thin so it doesn't keep things cold for long and the condensation is horrible. The lids don't stay closed well and are always popping open. The worst part though is that you can't leave water sitting in them as it builds up these weird white crusty lumps that do not come off with a scrub brush. I have never had this with any of our other water bottles so I know it's not my water. Also, the metal edges on top are very sharp as I cut my finger trying to clean them with a scrub daddy. These were bought for my childcare kids and I do not feel safe using them.
We filled these up and took them down river since they don’t allow plastic and want reusable bottles they worked great

title: Nalgene 32 oz Wide Mouth Water Bottle
description: Nalgene is proud to be the first to market with a new resin powered by next generation recycling technology that transforms plastic destined for landfills into high performance BPA/BPS free bottles. The original. The trailblazer. The Sir Edmund of water bottles. If you’re looking for a water bottle that will keep you well hydrated, hold up against bangs, bumps, and drops, and not leak a single drop ever, then the iconic 16-ounce wide mouth is your water bottle. There’s a reason why we haven’t changed its design in decades—because it works (extremely well).

reviews.review_description:
Nalgene bottles just work.

The Nalgene bottle is perfect for those who enjoy outdoors activities. As funny as it is to say it "just works" when it's as simple as a bottle, it absolutely does.

For starters the material. Not only is it BPA-free, the Tritan material is perfect for a drinking bottle. It's extremely rugged, in fact Nalgene has gained a reputation for how long their bottles last. It also doesn't leave much of a taste! A lot of my experience with plastic bottles is that you can taste the plastic, the problem persists with metal as well. Nalgene bottles have a fairly neutral taste. It's also very resistant to trapping odors and tastes. My problem with alternatives is that if you hold coffee in them for a long time, then your water tastes like coffee even after a clean.

1L is a perfect amount of water to hold in my opinion. It's enough to be usable, but not overkill to where it's not a functional bottle. It's great for day to day use as well, I find myself finishing a Nalgene just fine. The size is great in this aspect, it doesn't waste space with insulation. I find a lot of metal bottles and other plastic bottles can only ever hold 500ml and some change because of their shape.

The leak proof seal just works. A lot of bottles are finicky, if you screw the cap from an angle it still leaks. I've tried to do it from an angle but it always screws on properly, I've never had a problem with it spilling.

Overall the Nalgene is the perfect bottle. It's a good middle ground of everything while having its strengths in durability, build quality, and price.

Read more

reviews.review_title: Simple bottle that’s actually easy to use and clean
reviews.review_description:
I really like the simplicity of this water bottle! No straws, no complicated lids, no weird tiny parts that are impossible to clean, this is just a simple water bottle that you’ll actually end up using every day. I got it in the color “cotton,” and it’s honestly such a nice neutral shade, knd of a soft beige that looks way more expensive than it is. The wide mouth is one of my favorite features because it makes cleaning super easy and also makes it easy to add ice. I also really like the ounce/milliliters markings on the side of the bottle, it became surprisingly helpful to me for keeping track of how much water I’m actually drinking throughout the day. This is actually my second Nalgene bottle, I bought this one to replace my older one because plastic bottles should be replaced once in a while, especially after heavy everyday use. My previous one lasted a long time though, which says a lot. The only downside is that because there’s no straw and the opening is pretty wide, drinking from it while walking or moving around can be a little awkward unless you’re careful.

Overall, really happy with it. Simple, durable, lightweight, and super practical, which honestly matters more to me than trendy designs ;)

reviews.review_title: No o-rings needed; dependable; won’t leak

The best and most dependable water bottles out there. No need for janky o-rings. The build tolerances are so tight that you just twist the lid snug and it won’t leak. Great color and the wide mouth is easy to clean.

Only drawback? When you put cold stuff in it, the condensation will get on stuff.

This is the perfect water bottle for those who want to get their daily water intake. It has the measurements and a wide mouth opening that makes cleaning easy. No straws to wash just the bottle and attached lid. Nalgene products are also very durable and affordable.

reviews.review_title: Verified Purchase ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Classic Nalgene Durability, Clear View, and Better for the Planet!

I love being able to see exactly how much water I have left at a glance, and it makes measuring out hydration mixes or tracking my daily intake incredibly easy.The biggest selling point for me is the new Sustain material. It is made from 50% recycled plastic, but it retains the legendary toughness you expect from the brand. I have already dropped this bottle onto solid concrete while getting out of my truck, and it didn't crack, shatter, or leak a single drop—just a tiny, barely noticeable scuff. The classic wide mouth is fantastic because it easily accommodates large ice cubes, fits perfectly with most backpacking water filters, and makes cleaning out the bottle manually an absolute breeze. The leak-proof loop top is rock solid, and it attaches perfectly to a carabiner for clipping onto a backpack or gym bag. There are absolutely no weird plastic tastes or odors right out of the box, either. If you want a dependable, indestructible, and eco-friendly water bottle for hiking, camping, or everyday use, this clear Nalgene is an absolute classic that will last for years.

Then Owala does the of the best PR stunt/customer appreciation ever, and not only sends that man a safe, but filled that safe with several Owala bottles! So I started looking for one; I got to thinking as a woman who often does her errands alone, "you know, I can always use it for defense and I can't be accused of carrying a weapon, because technically it's a water bottle."

When Owala came out with this Amazon exclusive color, I knew it was kismet! I put it on my cart, but before I checked out, my kid saw what I was doing and she stopped me. First of all, the color is beautiful - perhaps not quite as brilliant as in the photos, but it is delightful. This second one I received was a replacement for the first one that was sent, which seemed to have some damage to the interior lining (presumably a manufacturing flaw). This replacement bottle has a seamless and flawless interior lining, for which I am grateful; however, the outside has a slight dent in it. I'm not sure if that is because of packaging/shipping issues or if it was sent out that way. I do know the bottle was sent in a bag, not a box, so it is very possible there was damage done during shipping. I'm a bit disappointed, but not to the point of returning this one. Still, I think from now on, I will order any YETI item directly from YETI since it will hopefully be packaged better for shipping. reviews.review_title: Great water bottle for travel and every day use
reviews.review_description:
We purchased these for our whole family before a Disney trip, and they worked out great. The bottles are durable, easy to use, and kept us hydrated during long days in the parks.

The handle on top was especially convenient for hanging on our stroller, and my daughter had no trouble opening and closing it on her own. We also loved the variety of color options.

We’ve put these through a lot of use, including regular trips through the dishwasher, and they’ve held up very well with no issues. Overall, this has been an excellent water bottle, and I would definitely purchase it again.

I love my new Stanley IceFlow Aerolight 50 oz bottle. It’s really beautiful and love the lilac colour. The straw hole is wider and comfortable to drink from. It doesn’t leak and is definitely much lighter than my Yeti 46 oz. However, I gave it 4 stars because it doesn’t keep ice and water as long as my Yeti. The ice lasts up to 8 or 9 hours then melts, but the water remains cool a while longer. My Yeti 46 oz can keep ice up to one and a half days. I guess to make it lighter the insulation is not as thick so it doesn’t maintain coldness as long as the double insulated Yetis. Update: April 1. I had to come back and write an additional update. The longer I have this bottle is the more I love it. It is keeping the ice and water longer now. Not sure why it wasn't when I just got it. It is beautiful holds a lot and I absolutely love it even more than my Yeti which I had really loved. It is so tall and slender and just beautiful. Thank you Stanley & Amazon!

Absolutely in love, the color, the style and pattern have exceeded my expectations. Keeps drinks very cold. I put ice in it in the morning and the next morning you can still see some ice. Great tumbler

Definitely worth the price and no condensation at all!

This carries my water every day to the gym. I put ice and water in it and it keeps it so cold. I still had ice cube chips after a week! It is pretty and I have received several compliments on it! Well worth the money!

This is the perfect on the go size STANLEY. The color is cute. I LOVE to take water with me, but I don’t always want to take a HUGE tumbler. This water bottle holds two cups of water. So it’s big enough to be useful but also small enough not to be a nuisance. The cup is the same quality as other STANLEY cups and it’s leakproof so I don’t have to worry about it spilling in my purse or bag. I love the fact that the straw isn’t exposed and folds down easily w/o spilling. Although this is a smaller sized tumbler it still has great insulation. I would recommend this for tweens and children that want a STANLEY cup but may not responsible enough for the STANLEY price. This is also good for a busy mom on the go that realizes a 40 oz. tumbler may be impractical to take when running errands. This cup is a great lightweight way to get hydration on the go. The cup doesn’t have an aftertaste and it doesn’t hold in the taste of beverages after you’ve washed the cup so your water will always taste like water, even if you’ve previously have filled the cup with iced coffee or tea.

reviews.review_title: Falls short to Yeti but still nice!
reviews.review_description:
I wanted this Stanley to be my reason to turn away from Yeti. I love the modern design, the all black, the non-fixed handle that can be tightened to be more fixed/harder to move, and the 50 oz capacity. It was nice to see that the bottle had 4 extra oz of capacity at the same price as Yeti’s 46 oz bottle. I need to drink lots of water throughout the day and the large capacity is awesome. The lightness was originally a selling point for me; while it can hold an astonishingly large 50 oz, since the bottle is relatively light in weight, it doesn’t feel too heavy to carry a full bottle around. However, where it excels in lightness it falls short in quality. It is glaringly lower quality than Yeti’s 46 oz bottle. This Stanley has thinner metal leading to poorer insulation. What frustrated me the most was realizing how much thinner the coating was compared to Yeti; I accidentally dinged it with a fork while heating up my lunch and chipped it! I’ve dropped my Yetis dozens of times and hit them with everything from forks and knives to granite countertops and haven’t had an issue with them chipping under light use. I even noticed it will take on light scratches from the plastic buckles on my lunch box if I let them touch while in my bag. Seriously poor coating. However, getting back to the pros, the leak resistance is great and when properly closed you can rest assured you won’t have spillage or leakage. Also the straw on this bottle is much nicer than the straws on Yeti bottles; less resistance and simply easier to sip. In the end, it’s a great water bottle that has a cool modern look and a huge capacity. Overall this comes in at 4/5 stars with only one star being lost to the thinner metal and thinner coating. I would still suggest getting the Yeti 46 oz instead for the thicker metal and coating as it will likely last longer and endure more.

reviews.review_title: Durable, Leak-Proof, and Love the Two Sip Options!!

I was originally drawn to the different color options (I got Dreamy Field), but what really sold me was the two drinking options - you can sip through the straw or take a regular swig. I haven’t tested it with ice yet, so I can’t speak to that specifically, but my cold water does stay cold for a long time. reviews.review_title: Is it possible for a water bottle to improve your life?
reviews.review_description:
I don't know what kind of mad scientist they have working for Owala, but can we get this guy working on improving other things, like those gas pumps that always shut off every $.05 cents, or maybe invent a cell phone screen protector that doesn't crack a week after you put it on? Seriously, what an amazing design they have. I love the Owala spouts. I detest water bottles with straws, except for Owala. These things are so pleasant to drink out of. Also, this lid is fantastic, it's leak proof, easy to remove (Stanley, take a look, this is better), and that little string loop thing goes great over your middle finger. That's the strongest point, and if someone messes with you swing that thing like a club! Seriously, don't go around just hitting people, but as a self-defense item this will work! It kept my ice water nice and cold today. They claim you can put other stuff in here, but really, why would you? It's such a fantastic water bottle. I guess if you wanted to load it up with coffee, tea, soda, or any number of adult beverages that's up to you. I just don't want to stain up the inside. The 18 ounce fits perfectly in my backpack's water bottle pocket. I have the Bellroy Transit Workpack Pro 28L. I bought this to take with me when I fly. Empty water bottles are allowed thru security, then fill it up after going through security. It'll save you a bunch on bottled water. If you want something easy to carry, fits any cup holder, and can hold enough water to quench your thirst for a reasonable amount of time the 18 ounce is perfect. If you're one of those people that likes to carry enough water for a full day of hiking on the AT this probably isn't for you. For the rest of us it's perfect! Great job Owala!

I absolutely love my Owala FreeSip Twist water bottle! First, I love that it’s cup holder-friendly, lightweight, and easy to carry around without feeling bulky. It’s perfect for everyday use.

Then 30 minutes later, if you're absentminded like me, you're like, "Where's the top". Then you have to backtrack everywhere to remember where you put it. Your other option is to unscrew it every single time you want to take a drink and then screw it back on. Who has time for that?

Is this more of a user problem? Probably. But I'm just warning all of you ADHD, perimenopause people out there, that you'll spend a portion of your time bending over to pick the top up out of the floor or trying to remember where you put it, unless you come up with exact routines on where the top goes while you're drinking.

I mean, I guess there's always the unscrewing-drink-screwing back on method. #firstworldproblems

Highly Recommend.

reviews.review_title: Great Bottle with Minor Design Flaws - 4/5 Stars
reviews.review_description:
I've been using the WATERSY 1 gallon insulated bottle for about six months, and it's held up remarkably well.

Build Quality & Durability:

This bottle is built like a tank. I've dropped it multiple times, including on the cap, and nothing has broken or cracked. The handle is solid and shows no signs of wear even with daily use. The insulation works excellently - it keeps water cold for the advertised 48 hours, which is perfect for long hikes or all-day events.

Ease of Use:

The wide mouth opening makes filling, emptying, and cleaning incredibly easy. You can fit your entire hand inside for thorough cleaning, and ice cubes go in without any hassle. No concerns about mold or buildup in hard-to-reach areas.

The Drinking Challenge:

Here's where it gets tricky - tilting a full gallon of liquid to drink from the mouth can feel heavy and awkward. The air displacement while drinking creates a loud gurgling sound that can be disruptive in quiet settings like offices or meetings. A metal straw option would solve both issues and make this bottle perfect.

The Bottom Plate Problem:

The rubber on the bottom sits slightly higher than the metal rim, which creates two annoying issues. When you set it down on hard surfaces, it makes a bell-like ringing sound. Worse, the exposed metal rim will scratch tables, desks, and countertops because the bottle is so heavy. I've had to start using a placemat to protect my furniture.

Bottom Line:

Despite the drinking awkwardness and bottom plate design flaw, this is still an excellent water bottle for anyone who needs serious hydration capacity and temperature retention. Just be prepared to use a coaster and maybe invest in a separate metal straw. The durability and insulation quality make it worth the minor inconveniences.

On hot days, we fill these bottles with more ice, and that helps keep everything cold even while this bottle sits in the direct sun at the beach or a park.

The lids are dishwasher safe, and the small white gaskets inside the lid and the spout lid are seated pretty well, but we did lose one gasket. You can buy replacement gaskets directly from Takeya (they also run regular deals on these bottles, but in this instance I found them cheaper on Amazon and needed them really quickly). They have two different gasket styles; the better and I think newer ones have a small circular tab (almost a loop) that does double duty in helping you insert/remove the gasket and also seems to keep the gasket seated better. I say that because the one we lost did not have the tab.

I check our gaskets regularly and they seem to be quite impervious to mold. I pull them out every 4-6 months to inspect and clean them, and they are always fine with no visible signs of mold.

The one con to the bottles is that they get dented when you drop them. If you have a kid who swings their bottle around (and who wouldn't want to do that with the really great loop integrated into the lid of this bottle?), over time the bottom will reshape itself from flat to curved. Eventually my kid dropped the bottle or bashed it into one too many hard surfaces, and one of the dents broke full through. Then the outside of the bottle had a hole in it. The inside was still fine, but after hand washing the bottle, there was water inside the lining, and I don't want to risk that becoming a moldy mess. That's why I needed to replace a bottle.

We had our bottle for about a year and a half before the r outside split. That's an expensive habit, so now I am making sure my kid keeps the bumper on the bottom -- and refrains from swinging the bottle around so much.

We love our Takeya bottles! I liked their performance so much that I bought two for myself and rotate their use daily. Since we only put water in them, I put the lids in the dishwasher every day or every other day, and leave the bottles to dry in our dish rack nightly. I hand wash them with dish soap and a brush a few times a week. The only spot you have to be careful to catch is under the stainless steel rim below the lid, which is a narrow channel that can harbor some sand or dirt (and other gross stuff).

The one on the left in the photo has been used for about 18 months, and the one on the right is brand new. I made large name labels for all of them with permanent vinyl, which you can see in the older bottle has scratched off in some places. I believe I re-applied the label on the left in the last six months, so keep in mind that Cricut "permanent" vinyl is not going to last forever on a curved surface like this that gets used and banged around every day.

reviews.review_title: Simple, clean-tasting, and an easy stock-up win
reviews.review_description:
If you want no-drama drinking water for the house, car, gym bag, or emergencies, Amazon’s purified water bottles do exactly what they should: taste clean, stay sealed, and not cost a fortune. It’s the kind of neutral, crisp water you don’t think about—which is the whole point.

What I notice (and why I keep rebuying)

Clean, neutral taste: Chilled, it’s refreshing with no plasticky aftertaste. Because it’s purified (typically reverse osmosis) with a touch of minerals added for taste, it doesn’t have the “salty” edge some spring waters do.

Grab-and-go size: The 16.9-oz (500 mL) bottles fit cup holders, treadmill holders, and backpack side pockets perfectly.

Consistent seals: Caps twist off with a clean pop; I haven’t hit leakers or half-sealed bottles.

Value: Case price per bottle is hard to beat, especially for keeping a few packs on hand for guests or a go-bag.

Where it shines

Daily hydration: Easy way to track intake—four bottles gets most adults near their daily goal.

Workouts & errands: Neutral flavor is ideal when you’re sweaty; it doesn’t fight with electrolytes or mixes.

Coffee machine/steamer safe: Purified water reduces mineral build-up vs. hard tap (still descale on schedule).

Emergency stash: Two cases on a shelf = peace of mind for outages/boil advisories.

The honest nits (no sugar-coating)

Bottle thinness: They’re lightweight by design. Great for portability, not meant for multiple refills. If you squeeze hard, they’ll crinkle.

Shrink-wrap case: The plastic wrap can tear if you grab from the side—lift from the bottom to avoid the cascade-of-bottles moment.

Taste preference: If you love the mineral “snap” of spring water, purified can feel a bit “flat.” That’s normal—this aims for neutral, not terroir.

Tips to get the best out of them

Chill them. Purified water tastes best cold; keep a rotation in the fridge.

Store smart. Keep sealed cases in a cool, odor-free spot—water can absorb nearby smells.

Freeze hack: Half-drain a bottle, freeze it upright, then top with fresh water before heading out for a long day—instant ice pack + cold water for hours.

Recycle everything your local program accepts (bottle + cap + label where allowed). Day-to-day, use a reusable bottle and lean on these for travel/emergencies.

Bottom line

If you’re after clean taste, reliable packaging, and real value, Amazon’s purified water bottles deliver. They’re an easy “set it and forget it” staple—perfect for stocking the pantry without overthinking it.

It washes up easily.

It's fallen out of a backseat cup holder and laid on the floor for well over an hour without my knowledge, and although a few drops escaped from the straw, the carpet of my vehicle was dry, and the tumbler was still full of ice water.

And, ya know, it keeps you hydrated because you can always keep that thang on you.

I ordered the almond color. It's really more of a very light beige. Or coffee that's mostly creamer. A lot lighter than you'd think. It's definitely that boring popular aesthetic hue that everyone's so into, so if that's what you're going for, it's spot on.

All in all, I really really REALLY like this tumbler and I'd definitely recommend it. Then again, Simple Modern products haven't ever really let me down, so it's not a huge shocker.

I'm not talking the side pocket of my bookbag, I am talking in the main zipper with all of my other stuff. I make ZERO EFFORT to be careful when the bottle is in my bookbag. All day long that bookbag bumps into desks, walls, people, gets turned upside down, gets thrown on the floor, sat on, turned upside down, etc. This sucker doesn't leak.

And that's it. THREE things that go into making the PERFECT WATER BOTTLE. This water bottle also has the added benefit of having a killer price (I was happy to pay the price I paid for it even when I was still assuming it was nothing special). It also holds 40 ounces of water, which is kind of a large amount of water compared to most water bottles. I bought this bottle with ZERO EXPECTATIONS, and it has turned out to be one of my favorite buys from Amazon to date. It definitely sparks joy in my life! Thank you, Pogo water bottles. reviews.review_title: Very Aesthetically Pleasing, Doesn't Leak, Easy to Carry Around
reviews.review_description:
I love this water bottle. I had been lugging around a 64oz bottle that could barely fit in the side pockets of my backpack, and while it was nice to have during 12 hour shifts, I got sick of it.

I got the purple bottle with the chug lid. The color is beautiful, the design of the bottle is very cute and elegant, and the actual hole you drink from is much more desireable to me than the straws/nips a lot of bottles use nowadays. Even though it is only 32oz, I find that I don't mind refilling it once a day to get in my 64oz. I actually prefer it to a 64oz bottle, since I know I'll be getting fresh, cool water after the first fill runs out.

I've seen some comment that you can't actually "chug" with this bottle...well, of course you can't! The bottle isn't the thin, bendable plastic that you get with the water bottles from the store...it's sturdy!! And while you can't "chug," you can most certainly get some big gulps in! I'm not a slow water drinker. I don't want tiny sips, I want to get that +64oz in! This bottle is definitely good for that. You can easily get 4oz, and even more, in a single gulp. Haha, I even did it now, just to be sure...

I really love this thing. It is exactly what I was looking for, and the price is great. The lid is also very easy to open and close, but still very sturdy and secure. It also seems quite easy to clean, though I haven't had to do so just yet.

For those who have seen mold growth on their water bottles...you must wash these things at LEAST once a week, if not more often, especially if you wear anything on your lips like chapstick, lipstick, etc. Even the slight bit of backwash from out filthy human mouths is enough to contaminate the insides of the bottle. If you live in a warmer climate, this is especially true and will result in the bacteria from your backwash contaminating the bottle resulting in the growth of things like mold. It has happened to me before and I was absolutely mortified. Another reason I prefer chug lids as opposed to straws...the things are a hell of a lot easier to clean. No hidden crevices harboring disgusting human bacteria...lol.

I definitely recommend this water bottle for those of you looking to increase your intake. Very pretty, convenient, and simple to clean with the chug lid.

Other than that, it is a great water bottle and very conveinient to use. Also forgot, the ring on the side of the water bottle makes it very easy to carry without worrying about dropping it.

Good quality for a nice price. The overall look and feel of this is really nice and the thickness of the plastic doesn't feel cheap and seems rather durable. It holds a good amount of liquid at 40oz and even has a convenient measuring up to 32oz

title: CamelBak Thrive Chug Stainless Steel Water Bottle 32oz, Stone
description: The CamelBak Thrive Chug Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle is built for active lifestyles that demand dependable hydration from morning workouts to long days on the move. Its streamlined design balances durability, comfort, and ease of use without unnecessary bulk. Double wall vacuum insulated stainless steel construction helps maintain hot or cold drinks for hours, supporting consistent hydration across changing conditions. A secure, leak resistant lid helps protect bags, desks, and gear during transport, while the sweat resistant exterior keeps hands and surfaces dry. reviews.review_title: Built Like a Tank, Looks Even Better!
reviews.review_description:
I’ve gone through a lot of water bottles over the years, and this one from CamelBak is hands-down one of the best I’ve owned. First off, the build quality is unreal—this thing feels solid, durable, and ready to take a beating. Whether it’s riding around in the truck, getting knocked over, or going with me on long days, it holds up without a problem.

The insulation is legit too. Keeps my water cold for hours, even sitting out, which is huge for me. No weird taste, no sweating on the outside—just does exactly what you want it to do. No joke I've left ice in this thing and left it at work came back the next day still with ice in it.

The handle is a game changer. Makes it easy to carry around without worrying about dropping it, and it feels sturdy, not flimsy like some other bottles. The lid seals tight, no leaks at all, and it’s easy to open and close without fighting it.

And honestly, the look? Clean. Simple. That matte green finish looks great and doesn’t feel cheap at all.

If you want a bottle that’s reliable, tough, and actually looks good doing it—this is it. Worth every penny.

reviews.review_title: Stainless Steel Water Bottle 40oz, Black, Secure Leak Resistant Lid. Holds Ice for Many Hours. Nice!
reviews.review_description:
CamelBak Thrive Chug Stainless Steel Water Bottle 40oz, Black - CamelBak

I purchased this forty-ounce insulated stainless steel water bottle to keep cold water handy during long days out without needing constant refills.

Pulling it out of the thin paper shipping bag, the matte black powder-coat finish gives it a sleek look, and the integrated rubber bumper on the bottom keeps it firmly grounded.

Filling it up with cold tap water and a few ice cubes is easy thanks to the wide neck opening.

The double-wall vacuum insulation does a fantastic job holding temperature. I filled it up in the morning, and the water stayed ice-cold all day long without sweating on the outside or leaving wet rings on my wooden desk. Even the next day, both the ice and water were still in the bottle.

The chug-style spout cap unscrews smoothly and tethered out of the way, making it easy to take quick, large gulps without fighting a narrow straw or a clunky latch.

Carrying forty ounces of liquid has some weight, but the soft-grip handle built into the lid makes it comfortable to haul around. The screw-on lid seals down tight against the mouth rim, so I can toss it onto the passenger seat of my car without worrying about slow leaks dripping onto the upholstery.

The silicone boot on the base is a great touch—it dampens noise whenever I set it down on a hard countertop and protects the steel bottom from getting dented if it takes a hard knock.

Paying around thirty-eight dollars for a solid daily water bottle feels reasonable given the heavy stainless steel construction and reliable thermal performance. Running the whole assembly through the dishwasher after a long day makes cleanup completely effortless without ruining the outer finish.

The forty-ounce body is definitely on the bulkier side, so it won't fit into standard automotive cup holders, but the extra capacity is worth the trade-off. It holds plenty of water to get through an entire afternoon without stopping for top-offs.

Pros:

✅ Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold all day without sweating

✅ Rubber bumper base prevents clanking and protects against bottom dents

✅ High-flow chug spout makes drinking fast and mess-free

✅ Built-in carry handle feels sturdy and comfortable in hand

✅ A reasonable value

Cons:

❌ Large 40-ounce diameter is too wide to fit standard car cup holders

❌ Metal exterior can dent if roughly handled

❌ Tall thin profile reduces stability and can lead to tips/spills -- keep it closed and away from electronics

reviews.review_title: Everything you need in a water bottle
reviews.review_description:
Just received my new water bottle and it's fantastic!

* Keeps water cold, even after many hours

* Is lighter in weight than my previous stainless steel water bottle, not sure how that's possible at the same size

* Love that the cap snaps open and stays open after unscrewing it

* Nice features: silicone mouthpiece, rubberized bottom built in, comfy silicone carrying handle

* Beautiful color

Nice and cute water bottle, as well love its soft color. Not heavy. Has soft silicone bottom pad, carry on handle and silicone bottle neck. Leakproof - checked. Overall liked this bottle and would recommend it for purchase.

Did not expect and was a bit surprised. Just be ready if you choose this item::

Love this bottle! It keeps drinks cold for a long time, doesn't leak, and is easy to carry. The chug lid provides great water flow, making it perfect for workouts, hiking, or everyday use. The Sky Blue color is beautiful, and the quality is exactly what I expect from CamelBak.

reviews.review_title: On point and has every feature you could need.
reviews.review_description:
This bottle is perfect for what I use it for! I work for the Railroad so I am very hard on my things and they need to last. This is extremely sturdy and made with high-quality durable parts. I have only used it for cold drinks because I don’t need any type of hot drink for 12 hours, but it does keep very cold and keeps ice floating around up to 48 hours without sweating or building condensation. Despite how heavy and awkward it can get when you are putting 128 ounces of fluid into it on top of its already solid construction, I find it very easy to carry, move, and drink from. The included flip top handle is great and can be adjusted up or down. The handles on the side are also great for carrying it and if you are not wanting to use them, they fold into the bottle itself. I think having both options for a straw and for a chug cap is an awesome feature that I didn’t realize the handiness of before I bought it. It has been perfect for filling up at home and especially at the gas station or wherever you get your drinks from. I believe out of every bottle I researched to buy, which was quite a few, the opening on this one was the widest allowing you to add many different types of ice or fill it using different types of spouts and machines at the gas station. Adding to that, so far the height has been just right. You can slide it under spouts or ice machines without having to tip it at an awkward angle. If you make sure you are properly tightening the top, the cap, and pushing the straw all the way down then you will have zero leakage at all. You can flip it around, roll it around in the car, or simply hold it upside down and it does not leak a drop. I searched for quite a while for a water bottle that met all of my needs and had all the features I wanted. I liked quite a few, but they all had something that I would’ve had to settle for or didn’t like. This one includes everything that I was wanting plus it is extremely affordable for all that it does. It is 1/2 up to even 1/4 the price of other insulated gallon jugs that do not have the same features. Finally, their customer service is responsive and cares about the customer. I left an email with pictures and videos on a Friday because I thought my jug was leaking. They responded within a day or two, which was still over the weekend, and made a detailed markup of my pictures respectfully showing me that I was more than likely using it incorrectly and causing the leaks. However, they told me I didn’t even need to try the solutions they recommended if I didn’t want to and if I wanted a replacement, refund, or anything else they would be more than happy to oblige. 100% recommend to buy
