I purchased the New Balance 608 V5 while it was on sale, mainly for weightlifting.

These shoes aren't the cutest, but they perform well where it matters most for strength training. The sole is firm and very stable, keeping my feet flat and securely planted on the floor during barbell squats. Unlike cushioned walking or running shoes that compress under weight, these provide a solid, stable base that makes me feel more secure when lifting.

Because of that firm construction, don't expect a soft or plush feel. The cushioning is noticeably less than what you'd find in walking or running shoes. The comfort is okay, but that's because the shoe prioritizes stability over softness. The arch support is also fairly minimal.

I personally wouldn't recommend these for running since the shoes are quite rigid. If most of your workouts involve walking, jogging, or other cardio, there are more comfortable options available. However, if your main focus is weightlifting or strength training and you want a stable platform for exercises like squats, these work very well.

The shoes fit true to size, and I had no issues with the fit.

**Pros**

* Good stability for barbell squats and strength training

* Firm sole keeps your feet flat and securely planted

* True to size

* Great value when purchased on sale

**Cons**

* Design is fairly plain and not particularly stylish

* Minimal cushioning compared to walking or running shoes

* Fairly minimal arch support

* Too rigid for running and may not be the best choice for cardio-focused workouts

Overall, I think the New Balance 608 V5 is a good choice for anyone looking for a versatile gym shoe with a stable, supportive base for lifting. Just don't expect the soft cushioning or flexibility of a dedicated walking or running shoe.

reviews.review_title: Still My Favorite Sneakers After 5 Years — So Comfortable and Built to Last
reviews.review_description:
I bought my first pair of these New Balance 608s about five years ago, and they’re still going strong. I wear them for the gym, long walks, and everyday errands, and they’ve held up beautifully — supportive, cushioned, and never once gave me sore feet or knees. As a grandma who’s always on the move, that comfort really matters.

I finally decided to get a new pair to start breaking in, but I’ll be honest — I’m still happily wearing my older pair and probably won’t part with them anytime soon. The new ones feel just as sturdy and well‑made, with that same reliable support and soft cushioning that made me fall in love with them in the first place.

If you want a sneaker that’s comfortable right out of the box, holds up for years, and works for both walking and workouts, these are a fantastic choice. I’ve trusted them for half a decade, and they continue to be my go‑to.

New Balance is a favorite for many reasons. Two stars off for an obvious manufacturer defect that has not gone unnoticed: the toe box is definitely too narrow. I have narrow feet. I bought my normal 9.5 medium size and wear with very thin socks. The shoes are still noticeably snug, almost too tight. When other reviews mention this, pay attention and consider a buying a wide. I’m not sure why this great company would market a shoe that creates the need for returns or unhappy customers. I wish I’d bought a 9.5 wide.

reviews.review_title: SIZE UP - DON’T REMOVE ANY TAGS OR STICKERS YET.
reviews.review_description:
DETAILED REVIEW : BUY A SIZE AND A HALF UP, DON’T PEEL OFF ANY LABELS OR TAGS YET UNTIL YOU’RE SURE THEY FIT.

[July 31st 2026]

I am a solid size 9 wide in women’s shoes, with semi-flat feet. It’s hard to find supportive and affordable sneakers. Never purchased Skechers before but I really needed a comfortable, lightweight, affordable shoe for wide support. Read thoroughly through reviews and determined that I should buy a half size up for breathing room. Purchased a 9.5 wide, (Delivered SO fast by the way, next day immediately, I don’t even have prime. For me they arrived in perfect+new condition.), tried just one on, and the sole+arch+heel support was PERFECT and so cushioned. Loved the look of them, but unfortunately they were just an inch too short for the length of my foot, my big toe was *just* scuffing against the tip of the shoe, even in my thinnest/smallest pair of socks.

Truly as advertised, minus the sizing discrepancy - which was user error due to my ignorance of the brand styling and sizing. Honestly if you’re scanning through reviews and at your wits end, just order a single size, or a size and a half up. This is the way of ordering online when you can’t try the product on immediately. The shoe is comfortable and easy to slip on and tie. Laces are a little short but they’re genuinely fine to tie loosely about once, twice if you pull them taut for more length. Easy to replace the laces if you’re particular about that.

Such a cute shoe, it was perfect for what I needed - absolutely worth reordering for the correct size, I don’t even mind the return process because I caught a glimpse of a genuinely worthwhile, simple, straightforward shoe that I’ll wear often for walking+working out. Even arrived in an adhesive-lined, resealable, bag for convenient and secure returns if needed be - I got a free return! Just printed the labels and secured them on the bag, and inside. (The default order for me arrived with the resealable adhesive lined bag, and inside of that was the brand’s shoe box, for anyone curious on those details.)

Don’t stress! Take the leap of faith on the Skechers D’Lites. Order up a size, and at most a size and a half, so your toes aren’t squished if you need that space. Excited to receive my 10 wides!

Edit, Monday August 24th, 2026: 10 Wides came in! Perfect fit with extra breathing room - Got 16,000 steps in already! Will definitely have to use some supportive shoe inserts later on in their lifespan as I can already feel the sole compressing downward, but these shoes are great for my long walks so far.

title: Hoka Womens Bondi 9 | Road Running Shoes
description: One of the hardest working shoes in the HOKA lineup, the Bondi 9 delivers peak plushness for everyday miles. Overhauled from top to bottom, we’ve increased the stack height and added a new premium foam midsole to deliver that soft, resilient ride that’s become synonymous with the Bondi. Elevated with a 3D molded collar and structured knit upper with zonal breathability, this ultra-cushioned cult favorite has been finished with Durabrasion rubber to combat high wear zones.

reviews.review_description:
Hurray. Although I wish they were cheaper, these are comfortable. I have supination and high arches, and these help my feet to feel stable.

I have read that others say they ae heavy, that is not my experience. They are lighter than the brooks I also bought.

reviews.review_title: Great for pregnancy related foot pain
reviews.review_description:
I've been wanting a pair of hokas for the last few years but couldn't justify the price. I'm currently 20 weeks pregnant and starting to experience a lot of foot pain at the end of active days and my other pair of tennis shoes are nearing their end of their life so I decided now is the time. They are definitely worth it.

I took my dog for a long walk after work as I sometimes do and usually my feet would be hurting when I get home and need all night to recover, but with these, my feet felt pretty normal. I'm glad I didn't wait.

For shoes, I'm usually anywhere between a 7.5-9. My feet are pretty narrow with some bad bunions. For tennis shoes specifically, I usually go for an 8. Since I'm pregnant, I got the 8.5 and they fit well. I have just a little extra room in case of swelling or flattening. I hope they last all of my pregnancy and a few months after postpartum. Then I'll probably considering getting another pair.

reviews.review_title: Great support when you’re on your feet all day!
reviews.review_description:
Comfort, well made, good support

I really like these shoes! Size 7 Hoka brand

I ordered these shoes for my wife, who works as a nurse. Before purchasing them, she wore regular shoes that caused ankle and foot pain, especially because she has flat feet. Since switching to these shoes, she says they are very comfortable, and she has not complained about foot pain anymore. I would recommend them to anyone who works long shifts that involve a lot of walking and standing.
Love love love. Fits great. I love the room in the toe area. I love the color. They are super cute. They seem really durable. They are really comfortable.

reviews.review_title: Good product I've used many years
reviews.review_description: I use these as daily walking shoes - not running. They are classic Hoka Bondi 9 - good quality, stable on my feet with good inner arch support - they are good looking with jeans and/or shorts - moderate stability with deep soles that cushion your step - they feel stabil and with some flexibility on surfaces. I've worn HOKA for years and recommend them to anyone who is looking for a good all purpose shoe

reviews.review_title: comfortable for those with feet problems
reviews.review_description: I have had in the past heel spurs, after a year of therapy they are doing good. I was told to buy shoes with lots of cushion. I usually do pretty good with sketchers. I saw a nurse wearing these shoes and asked about them. She informed me that they were worth the money, I broke down and bought a pair that I can wear for food service and she was right. They are comfortable, true to size, lightweight and I don't have to kick them off after a 10 hour shift on concrete. Love the quality and comfort!

Love the comforting the hoka sneakers been wearing them for years. They fit true to size 7.5 for me - however I find they break down after 8 months of use and the toe box slips no longer holds foot securely in place. Quite an expensive sneaker for this to happen. I own well over 12 of these and have had the same experience over the 5 years I have been wearing them. I use the woman’s bondi

Again comfortable but toe box breaks down after 8 months.

**Design and Build:**

**Performance:**

One of the standout features of the Charged Surge 4 is its responsive Charged Cushioning midsole. This technology absorbs impact and converts it into energy return, allowing for a more efficient run. The durable rubber outsole provides reliable traction on various surfaces, enhancing stability and grip, whether you're on the treadmill or tackling outdoor trails.

**Fit and Comfort:**

The shoe delivers a snug yet comfortable fit, with a supportive design that helps reduce foot fatigue. The padded insole and responsive cushioning make for a smooth ride, accommodating longer runs without sacrificing comfort. Users have noted that the shoe provides ample support for both arch and heel, making it a great option for different foot types.

**Conclusion:**

Overall, the Under Armour Charged Surge 4 is an excellent choice for anyone looking for a reliable and stylish running shoe. With its combination of comfort, performance, and modern design, it stands out in the crowded market of athletic footwear. Whether you're a seasoned runner or just starting your fitness journey, the Charged Surge 4 is sure to meet your needs.

I thought they were small at first but lace them up, the heel cup will pull your foot in and they fit like a glove true to size. Great gym shoes very comfy but not bulky padding. Great deal. So bright in white color they glow in the sun. Fresh looking

Absolute perfection. I saw some people initially saying that the sneakers were tight, but I think they may have wrote the review before they were them in. It took about five minutes to wear them and if I’m being quite honest with you. When I first put them on, I thought I was going to have toe issues because my toes were right at the front. I’m listen to one of the reviews that stated that you need to lace the sneakers up for them to fit properly and that’s exactly what I did. Lace them up, walked around for maybe two minutes and they felt like a glove. They were breathable, but not to the point where the sun was making my feet hot. They were lightweight but also super sturdy. I was able to walk over rocks and not feel like I was stepping on the rocks with my bare foot. Will be buying these in additional colors because I genuinely do like them that much. I also think they look better in person than online. I also like the fact that these were easy to wear and use.

reviews.review_title: Good for value, not many complaints!
reviews.review_description:
I'll start by saying these are genuinely good value, based on my experience so far — with the caveat that I'm measuring that relative to other similarly priced running shoes. The cushioning is adequate for anyone who isn't a hardcore runner; I'm not, and found the Surge 4s to be no hindrance whatsoever when running. I went all-black, and they look very sleek with a nice overall silhouette. The arch support is sufficient, though it feels quite neutral. For what you pay, especially if you catch a deal, they perform well.

As for fit, I'd recommend sizing up half a size — I found my toes making a lot of contact with the front of the toe box, and going half a size up largely resolved that. No real break-in period required from what I could tell; they're pretty much plug-and-play, or rather, run-and-go.

In my experience, these shoes have been the best option for me. They fit my feet perfectly, and the arch support makes both walking and running feel amazing. I even use them for hiking from time to time. On top of that, the price is very competitive, making them an excellent value for the money.
Good fit. My husband loves them

comfortable, barely any stiffness and way better than the crappy shoes i previously had bought in the past. incredible flexibility and the size was correct. worth buying from under armour again in the future. would recommend heavily

reviews.review_title: Love the look, but sizing way off- has pros and cons
reviews.review_description:
I'm female but men's sneakers tend to fit better.

I like the way these Under Armour sneakers look. They have good symmetry according to the shape of the human foot.

I also really liked the lacing system. It was these thick rounded "protrusions" of material so that the laces could go through, and the way these "eyelets" are shaped (thicker and flat) you would need fewer of them to make the shoe lace stretch out over what would be two eyelets. This is good because on one hand it may be trouble to string a shoe lace over a lot of regular style eyelets (holes on the area which I think may be called an "eyestay") but then if you skip putting the lace into some eyelets then , in my opinion it gives the distribution of of the lace on the sneaker a very awkward look, if you can get what I mean.

I really dislike lacing systems in which there are just thin strips of string (or sometimes short strips of "ribbon" ) sticking out of the sides on top of the sneaker where the tongue is. If the string or strip of ribbon breaks then it is not easy to repair or is even impossible to repair. It makes the entire sneaker useless.

So the lacing system on the Under Armour Men's Charged Surge 4 Sneaker is overall my favorite kind .

I also like that the area of the highest eyelet is not rigid and hard. It is important for the upper-eyelet area of a sneaker or shoe to be properly flexible and /or cushioned (though also not of flimsy material). The area of the upper-most eyelet is the area that will push right into your upper foot as you bend your foot in the process of walking or running. This can hurt or cause friction.

However , as with other Under Armour sneakers I find that at least certain styles can have odd sizing. I normally use a Women's size 10 so that translates to Men's 8 to 8.5 (which can depend on the style) but I find that in Under Armour I have to use a complete size up. I ordered these UA's in size 9.5. I tried them on. They fit but I was not sure if they would start to hurt my toes should I start walking long distances in them. I could not risk it. I sent them back. I may re-order them in a larger size even though they would look a bit too big.

Another thing I did not like about this sneaker is that the sole at the heel part is designed in a way that when you walk with the sneakers on they make a noise like a shoe with a very hard heel with sharp edges would make, not a softer light noise like a sneaker should make.

I do wish that this sneaker came in slightly wider widths. It may feel more comfortable than having a rather pointed type of toe-box area.

So there are pros and cons to this sneaker at least in my opinion. I would definitely recommend them though. It can depend on your needs.

title: Skechers Men's Summits High Range Slip-in
description: Walk in lightweight comfort with the Skechers Hands Free Slip-ins™: Summits – High Reach Paired with our exclusive Heel Pillow™ to keep your foot securely in place, this vegan style features a unique Skechers Slip-ins™ pop-up heel panel, a mesh upper with fixed laces, and a cushioned Skechers Air-cool memory foam® insole.

reviews.review_title: Excessive use will tear the inner sole.
reviews.review_description: Theses shoes are very comfortable and the rear slip in shoehorn seems to work well. There is no bending and easy to slip into without fail. The durability and workmanship are equally as good does not tear easily construction is firm and looks good.the soles are durable and spongy which helps when standing for long periods of time. Inner sole I think should be a little bit more lasting as excessive use tends to tear the inner soles then you have to buy another inner sole for the shoe. Besides this Great shoes

Bought these for my husband, whose medical issues had him desperately but unsuccessfully trying numerous brands of "slip-in" shoes (including LLBean Mountain Slippers) but each turned out to be too flexible in the front &/or back to permit hands-free use. He was over-the-moon thrilled with the Skechers shoes. Finally just what he needed. Says they're extremely comfortable, with good arch support. He loves wearing them.

reviews.review_title: Arrived quickly and look nice on
reviews.review_description: The shoes arrived quickly and in good order. They are a gift for my father’s birthday. My father normally wears a 10.5 Wide in classic Reeboks. He hasn't tried "hands free" shoes, so I purchased his regular size. The 10.5 W is too large. I quickly ordered a 10 Wide. These seemed to be a little big to, but he wants to keep the 10 Wide. He is 91 years old and is having trouble bending his knees to tie his shoes & he likes to dress himself. So, we thought we would try these. They are bright white, which he loves & look nice on. He has trouble standing without his walker, but he was able to step into these shoes. He wore them for his walk with his physical therapist today and seems to like them. I will return the 10.5 Wide. When we need to order a new pair, I may order a 9.5 Wide because shoes tend to stretch with regular wear. We will see how these wear and wash up.

Great shoes but the inside lining already has a hole 🕳️ in the right toe area inside the shoe. Cheaply made not great quality especially coming from Sketchers. The slip in is an awesome time saver but they quit at quality. I was disappointed ☹️

Slipped these on and fell in love. Super comfortable and so very easy to slip in and out of. Support is absolutely perfect and not too soft or squishy feeling while walking. PERFECT! I have already ordered another version for some options. Super pleased with this purchase and would recommend to anyone wanting a super comfortable casual shoe that’s slips on and off with ease. I can see several pairs in arsenal.❤️
Liked the first pair so well ordered a 2nd pair, true fit , durable material, good price

I bought these for my son he has to wear shoes that you can just slip on and these are so easy. This is his second pair of slip ins. I have one pair for myself. It’s nice that you can just stand up and slip into your sneakers. All my other sketchers are not slip in. These are the best💖

reviews.review_title: Comfortable, Properly Snug And On In Two Seconds.
reviews.review_description:
Although your typical 'foreign-made' shoe (Vietnam this time) the 'Slip-in' feature that I made fun of when 1st appearing on TV, turns out to be the lazy-man's dream. Just when you're wondering how much lazier, and fatter can we become, along comes slip-in shoes that look like a traditional shoe, feel comfortable, and properly 'snug' so you don't have heal-rub or feel like the shoe won't stay on...it will!. Construction is solid and the tread/traction is good.

So I assume just like our 1st cars with power windows and locks, after these shoes, there's no going back? I did add 3/4 insoles, and the fit still feels fine...comfortable and snug. I don't think I'll abandon my traditional shoes, but check back this time next year and I may have a different story to tell. Does anyone remember Pixar's movie WALL-E! Well, I feel my new Skechers hands free slip-in sneaker's, and my expanding waistband are aiming me in that direction, and fast. I would buy again.

title: DOBOLIN Women's Fashion Sneakers Retro Gum Sole Casual Shoes

reviews.review_description: I love these sneakers! I have feet that are, unfortunately, very wide- to be quite honest, I look like a duck from the ankle down. Needless to say, that makes it very difficult to find shoes that not only fit but fit comfortably. Adding to the difficulty is the fact that it seems different brands have different ideas of sizes. Certain brands have women's size 10 shoes that fit more like an 8 and others have size 10 that fit like an 11. This makes it almost impossible to buy shoes online. However, that is not the case with these! I ordered a size 10 and they fit like a size 10! They have a toe box that isn't overly narrow so my toes have enough room to feel comfortable and blister-free and the sole has a nice amount of cushioning that makes them extremely comfortable to wear! Another great thing? The style of the shoe itself- it's super versatile! I can wear these shoes just as easily with jeans or sweats as I can with dressier slacks or even a dress if I wanted. Dress them up or dress them down, these are great shoes for the office in my opinion- especially if you are one who takes public transportation to/from work and have a bit of a walk from the bus or train station to the office. All told, I think they're great and seem to be very sturdy in construction and as though they will hold up over time!

reviews.review_title: Comfortable Retro Sneakers With a Great Classic Sole Look
reviews.review_description: These sneakers have a really nice retro style and are easy to wear with a lot of different casual outfits. The black upper with the white side detail and gum colored sole gives them a classic look that works well with jeans, leggings, shorts, or casual dresses. I like that they have a fairly simple design without looking boring, and the classic sole adds just enough contrast to make them stand out. They feel comfortable for everyday walking and casual wear, and the padded interior gives them a softer feel than I expected. The sole also feels sturdy and provides a good amount of grip on normal surfaces. They are lightweight enough that they do not feel clunky, but still have enough structure to feel supportive during regular use. The laces make it easy to adjust the fit, and the overall shape is flattering without making the shoe look bulky. My only minor criticism is that they are more of a casual everyday sneaker than something I would choose for serious athletic training, but that is really what I expected from this style. Overall, these are comfortable, good looking sneakers with a versatile retro design that is easy to pair with everyday clothes.

reviews.review_title: Cute Retro Sneakers with a Classic Gum Sole
reviews.review_description:
These sneakers have such a cute retro look! The gum sole gives them a classic vintage style that works with jeans, shorts, leggings, or casual dresses. They’re an easy way to make an everyday outfit look a little more put together.

They feel comfortable for walking and everyday wear, and the non-slip sole provides good traction. I also like that they’re versatile enough for casual activities like walking, light training, tennis, or skating without looking like a traditional athletic shoe.

The style is definitely my favorite feature. They have that trendy throwback appearance while still being practical enough to wear regularly.

Overall, these are comfortable, stylish, and versatile sneakers that can easily transition from casual activities to everyday outfits. If you like the retro sneaker look and a gum sole, these are a fun addition to your shoe collection!

So sporty and cute! Love these retro black and white tennis shoes. They are low profile, and a warm white and black instead of bright white. These are a “pu” leather meaning not real leather, but that’s ok, I’m not one to abuse my shoes. The width was surprisingly decent for my extra wide feet - had no issues at all getting them on or walking around. I will need to put an insert in though to adjust my supination - at the end of the day without it my feet were a little sore just on the outside where I step weirdly. But the padding inside was good, and the sole is nice and thick. I was really pleased that they worked out for me. They remind me of some of the Nikes we wore back in the 80’s - just simple, clean and comfy.

reviews.review_title: Super Cool Retro Sneakers - True to size
reviews.review_description: I love these retro-looking sneakers! They are definitely true to size. And while I need to size up for running or walking athletic shoes, for these I should have ordered my normal 9's. Luckily for my daughter, she's a true 10 and was more than willing to take them off my hands. lol! Both GenX and Millennial Approval! They are well cushioned with noticeable anti-slip treads. A true black (not a dark gray) and honestly, just super cute!!! 5 stars across the board! Comfort, style, well-made, and will turn you into a cool parent immediately!

reviews.review_title: Soft Squishy Sole and look great
reviews.review_description: Love these shoes. They actually look great and high end. They have a premium look, the gum sole with the black exterior is a great combination. There is no glue stains or defects or loose threads, and the shoes look really high quality. The sole has a soft squishy memory foam like material and my feet do not feel sore and I can stand all day and there is no pain in my toes. The look is great, the only logo is on the tongue and the side has a simple design that has a nice non loud look so the shoes work in a both causal or professional setting.

I’m really impressed with the DOBOLIN Women’s Fashion Sneakers. They’re extremely comfortable and honestly exceeded my expectations. The retro gum sole gives them a stylish look, and the color options make it easy to match them with multiple outfits — casual, sporty, or everyday wear.

They’re lightweight, affordable, and feel great right out of the box. I’ve worn them for walking, errands, and casual outings, and they’ve stayed comfortable the whole time. The non‑slip sole is a nice bonus, too.

Overall, these are stylish, comfortable, and versatile sneakers at a very fair price. I’d highly recommend them to others.

Amazon Vine Review

I wear my Brooks everywhere, but they don’t always work with every outfit. I wanted a nice, casual sneaker that I could wear to work and around town, and I was hoping these would do the trick.

These shoes run true to size. I ordered the same size I wear in my running shoes, but I probably should have gone down a half size, like I usually do with sandals and other casual shoes. My initial disappointment was that they have very little built-in support. Fortunately, because they were slightly too large, I had enough room to add my own inserts. That solved the fit issue and gave me the arch support I needed.

I wore them with jeans to church and also for a grocery trip, and I had no problems with uncomfortable or tired feet. They’re a nice combination of suede and leather, and the sole feels well made and durable.

Overall, I’m happy with how these worked out. If I had tried them on in a store first, I probably wouldn’t have purchased them because of the lack of support. But with the right inserts, they’ve become a comfortable and versatile casual option.

title: Tennis Womens Shoes Running Non Slip Comfort Gym Walking Sneakers

reviews.review_title: Light Tennis Shoes for daily living!
reviews.review_description:
These sneakers are so light they feel like slippers. They have great air flow, so my feet don't sweat in them.

I normally wear an 8.5W and I got these in 8.5 (fearing they would be too tight), however, to my joy I wore them an entire day at work and forgot I had them on.

You can tighten/loosen the laces. The heel feels nice in them, but I did notice there isn't much arch support in them as I have flat feet and the arch bothers me, so for me these shoes felt very comfortable. The pull-on tab at the back/top of the heel is very small and I found it hard to hold when putting the sneaker on my foot. As I tend to purchase tennis shoes to do things around the house or a quick trip to the store, I found the tread pattern unique.

reviews.review_title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️☆ 4 out of 5 Stars — Comfortable and Stylish Sneakers for Everyday Wear
reviews.review_description:
The BXDJCQ Women’s Tennis Shoes have a nice combination of sporty styling and casual versatility. They have a modern look that makes them easy to wear with athletic clothing, jeans, leggings, or other casual outfits. The overall design is attractive without being too flashy.

I like that these shoes are lightweight and easy to wear for everyday activities. They can be a convenient choice for walking, running errands, going to the gym, or simply spending a day on your feet. The sneaker-style design also makes them fairly versatile, so they don't have to be limited to workouts.

The fit is generally comfortable, although I would recommend paying attention to the sizing information before ordering. Like many athletic-style shoes, the amount of room and overall fit can depend on the shape of your foot and how much space you prefer in the toe area.

The main reason I am giving these shoes 4 stars instead of 5 is that they feel more suited to everyday casual activity than serious athletic training. If you're looking for a shoe specifically for intense running, high-impact workouts, or extensive athletic use, you may want something with more specialized support and cushioning.

Overall, these are attractive, lightweight, and versatile sneakers that work well for casual everyday wear and moderate activity. 4 out of 5 stars because they offer a comfortable, sporty design at a reasonable level of quality, although I would prefer additional support and cushioning for more demanding workouts.

These lightweight women’s tennis shoes are a practical choice for everyday walking, casual errands, light workouts, or anyone who wants a simple pair of comfortable sneakers without spending much. They feel light on the feet and do not have the heavy, stiff feeling that some inexpensive athletic shoes can have. The neutral, uncomplicated design also makes them easy to wear with leggings, shorts, jeans, or casual workout clothes.

The cushioning is comfortable for normal daily use, and the flexible sole makes walking feel natural rather than clunky. I also like that the upper is breathable, which helps keep feet from feeling overly warm during longer periods of wear. They slip on easily, fit securely once laced, and have enough room in the toe area for comfortable movement without feeling loose.

For the price, these are a very good value. They are not intended to replace a highly structured running shoe or a premium training shoe, but they work very well for casual activity, travel, walking, and everyday use. Anyone looking for an affordable, lightweight women’s tennis shoe that is comfortable, simple, and easy to match with daily outfits should be pleased with them.

reviews.review_title: Comfortable, Attractive, and a Good Budget Friendly Tennis Shoe
reviews.review_description:
These are a great budget friendly pair of tennis shoes. The soft pink color is really pretty and feminine, and they look just as nice in person as they do in the listing.

They’re lightweight, flexible, and breathable, making them comfortable for everyday wear. The inside has a nice amount of cushioning without feeling overly soft or bulky, and the sole has a good thickness that provides plenty of comfort while walking. The tread also offers decent traction for normal daily use.

They’re very easy to slip on and off, which is always a plus, and they seem to be well made for the price. I do think they run a little large, so keep that in mind when choosing your size.

Overall, if you’re looking for an affordable, comfortable pair of casual tennis shoes that look nice and perform well, these are an excellent value. I’m very happy with them and would definitely recommend them to anyone shopping for a budget friendly sneaker.

BXDJCQ sure did make a nice, lightweight tennis shoe.

The shoes is all mesh with a lace up on the top.

The outsole is thick and had good traction.

There is padding in the inner sole however, not as cushioned as i would normally like.

The shoe is made well but not sure how long these will last. But, for the price, who cares.

The shoe is comfortable and airy.

These fit true to size.

reviews.review_title: I was so nervous that these would be too big!
reviews.review_description:
I usually wear a 7.5 and I could only order these in an 8. I liked the look of these White Tennis Shoes alot, they looked very airy and comfortable to walk in.

The 8 fits me perfect! I am so happy they are not huge or obviously large around my toes. They are not too big at all, anywhere.

These are not as cushioned or airy as I was thinking they would be. They are not uncomfortable but I was a bit surprised as soon as I began walking in them after I put them on. They felt like my basic Canvas Lace Up Tennis Shoes.

These are reasonably priced and I love how clean and White they look. I really love when I have a nice, new, White, not dingy White, pair of Tennis Shoes to wear. These look very nice! The quality is good too!

This pair of black tennis shoes would be good for school uniform wear or work wear. The fabric of the shoe is very lightweight, so it would not be ideal in very cold weather for outside, but would work well at keeping your feet feeling aired out. The sole is a decent thickness and doesn't leave scuff marks on the gym floor (key part of our gym class). The sizing is right and maybe runs a little on the small side, but fits my 6th grader well. I'm hopeful that they will last the whole school year!

title: Women's Slip-On Canvas Sneakers, Low Top Walking Shoes

reviews.review_description: These sneakers are really nice, comfy, well-made, and nice-looking. I wasn't certain if they would fit because I have a wide width (C width), but the sneakers fit perfectly. The sneakers might not fit a very wide width. They have excellent insole cushioning, and the outer sole is thick and comfortable. The canvas is soft next to the skin, and the sneakers are very easy to put on. I love them, so I recommend!

SO COMFY!

I bought these in size 6 in the white, primarily to go with maxi dresses this summer. I usually wear a 6W but these fit perfectly. And despite not having much for support in them, these sneakers are (very lightly) cushy and very comfortable. I wear them without socks. They have enough stretch and give that they don't pinch, bind or rub anywhere on my feet (no blisters!) for casual wear. These are not the shoes for a long hike! But for running around town doing errands, walking the dog, going to the park for a summer concert or sauntering through a museum on a rainy day, these are great. They pack very small so they are easy to toss in your tote or luggage for an extra pair of casual flats. Also, it is rare for me to find a pair of cute, casual shoes that come in a regular size 6 that work with my bunions. I think these work because the fabric is a lightweight canvas with stretch. They are now my go-to shoe for summer. Not sure how they will hold up over long use, if they may develop any odor like some similar shoes like this tend to do, but supposedly they are washable using a shoe bag. I really love these, and have ordered another pair, different color. Hope those will be just as fabulous.

I gave just 4 stars based on the confusing info on sizing chart. I normally wear 9.5 wide, I went with the normal chart, not the measurement by toe-heel. Ordered size 9, fit perfectly and have some room on my toes. Price right for the quality, 4 stars for cuteness! FYI, don’t expect any foot support, it simply flat shoes just like wearing flip flops, except it’s closed shoes. I added Dr School heel inserts, because I live with bone spurs in both heels. If you’re looking for arch support, get regular sneakers.

Updated 6/9 - first time wearing the shoes today, they seem very sticky and I tripped a few times. Yes, it’s cute, but beware of danger trip and fall.

reviews.review_title: Comfy, cute, feminine, yet sporty. Great style for lots of age groups! Also, easy to clean!
reviews.review_description: I love these shoes. They are true to size and a bit sporty but with the lace detail on the back heal, which makes them more feminine. What’s nice, is I bought some for my 30 year old daughter and she also loves them, so they can be worn my young and older. I am 68! I bought two extra pairs. Haha! reviews.review_title: Support properly, and perform their duty day after day
reviews.review_description:
I wear only New Balance Extra Wide shoes. The explanation is neither mysterious nor flattering: I carry more weight than I ought to, and my feet insist on reminding me. These provide the width I need along with an arch that actually supports rather than merely decorates the insole. In a marketplace increasingly devoted to fashion masquerading as function, that is no small achievement.

I generally buy the 608 V5 cross trainers because they consistently have the best availability in Extra Wide. That alone earns them a place near the top of my shopping list. They also come in enough colors to satisfy whatever mood strikes you. I've accumulated black, white, brown, blue, and now gunmetal. Evidently, when I find something that works, I become a predictable voter.

The shoes are comfortable from the first day, supportive during long walks, and forgiving during those moments when the bathroom scale reminds me that arithmetic is undefeated. They have become my everyday footwear, accompanying me through errands, appointments, and the ordinary business of retirement.

No product is without its legislative amendments. Occasionally the shoelaces seem unnecessarily thick or comically long, as though drafted by a committee unable to agree when to stop. It's hardly a constitutional crisis, but every so often I find myself wondering whether someone at New Balance has a side business selling extra lace.

Because these are my primary shoes—and because I place a bit more stress on them than their designers probably envisioned—they're generally ready for retirement after about six months. I don't regard that as a defect so much as the inevitable consequence of constant use and a user who could stand to lose a few pounds.

Institutions endure because they reliably perform their intended function. The same may be said of these shoes. They are not flashy, they make no extravagant promises, and they will not transform your life. They simply fit well, support properly, and perform their duty day after day. In an era of exaggerated marketing claims, there is something refreshingly conservative about a product that succeeds by quietly doing exactly what it was designed to do. Five stars.

I will be getting a second pair for outside of work. The nonslip for restaurant/kitchen work is amazing!! Can’t recommend these enough! Very durable and very stylish unlike most work non-slip shoes. So cute looking but still professional. They don’t absorb food and grease from work on the material which looks like a fabric that would. Amazing quality and foot comfort, great arch support and fits perfectly. Slips on so easily and are so versatile!

I decided to chance these from the reviews. I have to stand on my feet for 8 hours a day on concrete for (restaurant) work. My feet are still hurting, but I tried them out for a 20 minute walk today and they have so much cushion I felt like I was bouncing. They have given my only relief compared to my last shoes, and they have a good fit (I am a size 8). The only thing might be if you need arch support—it doesn’t have it. But otherwise I would recommend these for anyone who is dealing with foot pain, especially if work related. Also, the slip resistance… still be careful and walk through water with slower, controlled movements, but generally speaking, they seem like they hold up. No one would know they aren’t a name brand—they are actually cuter for women, and the only thing I can’t speak to yet is durability because it’s only been a week. But they also breathe and after tying my shoelaces, I basically just slide them on. I will likely get this shoe again once I need new ones
Shoe runs true to size and has slip resistance. They are lightweight and comfortable to walk around in as a server and bartender!

Because I couldn’t give 3.5.

Profession: food server.

Time spent on my feet and in these shoes 8 hoursa day, 5 days a week. I have been a food server longer than I’d care to talk about. lol. In reality I think I have tried every non slip shoe that is out there. From $30-300. I do not mind paying for quality. That being said. Let me give you my pros and cons.

Pros

They are ACTUALLY non-slip! Not slip resistant not skid resistant, but NON-slip.

They have a thick cushiony sole that makes you feel like you’re walking in air. For a while….

They are cute enough for work shoes.

They are breathable

They are affordable. I would call the price. Mid range.

They have haven’t ripped torn or fallen apart in anyway. But I would not expect that to happen to 2 month old shoes.

Because of the massive amount of steps I take each day just on my shift the crapped out fast. (I walk somewhere between 17,000 and 20,000 steps at work alone. I normally replace all work shoes every 3-4 months. This my normal. I’m older and after that time I can feel every step I take. My feet start hurting. My knees back and even my hips. These only made it 2 months before I HAD to reorder. Started feeling every step all over my whole body!

Cons: to me they do not hold up the way I would expect a $60 work shoe to hold up. I normally purchase another brand and my shoe is in the $60 range. And I can sometimes go 6 months until I reorder.

So while I feel the initial comfort is there. If you walk a lot. I think it won’t be long before they need replacing.

I also wish there was more of a style selection.

Recap: other than the fact that I need to replace them too often they’re great! But to me that’s a HUGE issue. Because I’m dependent on them every single day!! As most people in the industry are. Just my two cents.

title: Skechers Men's Energy After Burn Sneaker

reviews.review_description:
For many years I faithfully wore the Nike Air Walk and then, low and behold, they stopped making them! They were one of very few "wide" shoes that Nike made -- plus they were all leather, very light, provided great support and were super comfortable. So, once they were discontinued, I was on the search for a replacement....

I didn't think of Skechers much as a "serious" brand, mostly because I didn't know much about them, but it turns out they do sell some wide fitment shoes, and these, for me, are an absolute great fit! I tried a pair, a few years back, and have faithfully replaced them every time, having once again found a pair of shoes I really love.

They are very similar to the Air Walks, in comfort and durability, although, sadly, they don't last as long as the Nike's did. Then again, they are about half the price! So, I don't feel too bad having to replace these more often. I'd say a pair lasts six to eight months, where the Nike's used to last more than a year, but, as I say, these are a lot more affordable to replace, so I guess it kind of works out, cost wise.

For me, the most important thing is having a pair of shoes that are comfortable, versatile and look good enough to wear to work with good Levi's and a sport shirt, yet can also be used for walks or even light hikes. Since they are all white I have the same problem I had with the white Air Walks, which is that they tend to get dirty kind of quickly, but, like the Air Walks, they also clean up beautifully with some shoe cleaner and a bit of Sneaker whitener, so they tend to look great until they simply wear out -- in my case it is usually the side that eventually blows out -- which was the same on the Air Walks, but just didn't happen as quickly. Even so, six to eight months of life is pretty good to get out of them, considering I wear these pretty often throughout the average week.

So, I'm a fan now, and in fact will be getting a second pair of these to have around, since they also come in blue and white, and that way I don't have to clean these up as often, and that's actually an improvement over the Air Walks, since they only came in the white or solid black. With these, I can now have an all white pair, and now can also have a more "casual" sneaker for other looks or outfits or uses, and, since two pairs is not much more than one pair of what the Air Walks use to cost, I'm actually a bit ahead of the game.

I'm very happy with these, and I'd certainly recommend them highly!

reviews.review_title: Superb quality, but not for my feet
reviews.review_description:
I have been a huge fan of Sketchers for awhile now; their quality and craftsmanship are superb and their shoes are built to last! I am pretty tough on my shoes, and demand a lot from them. I need a shoe that offers sturdy support, as my back is pretty much a wuss, and will freak out about the littlest things, including lack of shoe support. Sketchers has always delivered everything I need in a shoe.

I was excited to try this design, because I am on my feet a lot at work (I work 12-hour shifts on concrete floors at a manufacturing plant). From what I've read online, these shoes were ideal for my needs, because they offered the support I need for both my back and my feet. I also like the fact that these shoes have a very aggressive tread, as I do a lot of outdoor activities including hiking and camping, and I expect my everyday shoe to hold up for the task (even though I have dedicated hiking boots, sometimes you want a lighter-weight option, especially when you're carrying 60-80 pounds on your back). When these shoes arrived, I was impressed with the amount of tread and grip they provided. It wasn't like the dinky little tread you see on most shoes, it looked like they took a tire, cut it to shape, and put it on the bottom of the shoe - Sketchers meant business when they designed this shoe!

The material is warm, but lets your feet breathe, so your feet stay nice and warm in the winter. I can't say how they are in the summer, as I didn't own them in the summer months. Inside, there is a lot of padding all around, especially in the tongue of the shoe, which is nice - it gives a real nice snug fit to keep the shoe in place without having to really strap down the lacing tight. There is a huge amount of padding in back on the bottom for your heels, which, for me, is where the problem comes in. For most people, this would be a very nice feature, but for some reason, it ended up hurting my heels pretty badly, almost to the point where I didn't want to walk from one end of the house to the other. After wearing them for just one 12-hour shift, my feet were screaming, and all I wanted to do was either sit back in a chair with my feet up or lay in bed, just so I wouldn't be on my feet. I understand that every pair of shoes needs to be broken in, and during that time the shoes can be a bit uncomfortable, but not this much.

While I absolutely like these shoes and have absolutely nothing against them (other than the heel issue mentioned above), I am forced to return them to Amazon. Please remember that this is not the case for most people - my feet are extremely picky to begin with, and simply put, these shoes just aren't for me. I really like the quality and materials that Sketchers used to design this shoe, and I can honestly say that I believe they are a shoe that will hold up to use and abuse for quite a long time. Despite them not being the right shoe for my feet, I would still highly recommend them, but be aware that there is a large amount of padding in the heel area, and will lift the heel area of your foot upwards somewhat.

I don't hold anything against Sketchers or these shoes. In fact, once my return is processed, I plan on buying a new pair of my go-to shoes, which are the Sketchers Men's Stamina Nuovo sneakers.

All around, great shoe, just not for me (unfortunately).

reviews.review_title: Reebok Club C Double Platform Sneaker
reviews.review_description:
Review: Reebok Club C Double Platform Sneakers

I’ve been wearing the Reebok Club C Double Platform sneakers for a while now, and they’ve definitely become a go-to in my rotation. If you’re into classic silhouettes with a modern twist, these are a great choice.

Style:

The platform sole gives the traditional Club C design a fresh, elevated look—literally. It adds just the right amount of height without feeling over-the-top. They pair well with everything from joggers and jeans to dresses and skirts, which makes them super versatile for casual or slightly dressed-up looks.

Comfort:

Surprisingly comfy for a platform sneaker. The cushioning is solid, and the shoe feels stable and supportive, even after a long day on your feet. I wouldn’t call them ultra-lightweight, but they’re definitely not clunky either.

Fit:

They run true to size in my experience. The leather upper is snug at first but breaks in nicely after a few wears. If you have wider feet, you might want to consider going half a size up, especially if you wear thick socks.

Quality:

Reebok did a great job with the materials—good leather, clean stitching, and a durable sole that holds up well. They’re easy to clean too, which is a bonus if you like that fresh-out-the-box look.

Final Verdict:

If you’re looking for a sneaker that balances retro vibes with a modern edge, the Reebok Club C Double Platform is a solid pick. Stylish, comfortable, and versatile—definitely worth it.

The material is quality as you can expect from Sketchers shoes. They are versatile and the color worked out to where I like them (I bought them on a sale price for only a select few colors) so I'm happy about that. The sizing was spot on for me, so I’d say they fit true to size. Overall, these are practical, comfortable, and convenient shoes that live up to the hype.

I'd recommend these to anyone who wants to give the slip in style shoes a shot- and/or who wants a good quality material shoe.

reviews.review_title: Better than expected — my new go-to
reviews.review_description:
Wasn't sure what to think going in, but these Skechers Slip-Ins have exceeded my expectations. The hands-free design actually works great — no bending down or fumbling, just step in and go. Fit is comfortable right out of the box with no break-in period needed, and they've got enough cushion and support to make them my go-to shoes for walking now.

Lightweight, easy on and off, and comfortable for everyday wear. Would definitely recommend if you're looking for a convenient, comfortable walking shoe.

reviews.review_title: Slip on sketchers size 9. Great shoe.
reviews.review_description: I love these sketchers. I like that they are slip ons and I do not have to bend over to tie them, I have a bad back. The fit perfectly and do not slip off on there own unless I want to take them off. They are worth the money. The material is great quality and should last me a long time. I bought them for work and they do not hurt my feet

reviews.review_title: Comfortable and very easy to put on.
reviews.review_description: Love the slip-on shoe and the dark Grey/blue looks great. They need to do something worth the large ugly white sole.

reviews.review_title: Great shoes at a great price. If Comfort is important, try these!
reviews.review_description: Love these shoes. They look great out of the box and the fit is spot on. I like the slip in function. The memory insole is very comfortable and the heavy rubber soles have a great cushioning step. My only complaint is the color choices could be more broad. Outside of that, the fit, comfort and cost are great!

reviews.review_title: Fantastic. These shoes are a game changer.
reviews.review_description: These shoes are wonderful. Because of a recent surgery on my leg, I had a swollen foot and knee that made it nearly impossible to get any shoes on. I was told by a friend to give this brand a try, and I am so glad I did. I now have no more problems putting on my shoes. I do not have to lean down at all they just slip on and off in seconds as advertised. I purchased the Skechers men's go walk flex and highly recommend these for anyone that is having difficulty putting on or taking off their shoes for any reason. Do yourself a favor and get a pair, you will not regret it. I will buy another pair when the time comes.
Comfortable fit, nice feel when walking, easy to slip on. This is my new favorite.

title: adidas Mens Response Pace Sneakers Shoes - Blue | Road Running Shoes
description: When It Comes To Running, The Response Pace Running Shoes Are Your Go-To Partners. Designed For Those Who Embrace The Road, These Shoes Offer A Blend Of Comfort And Performance That Inspires You To Keep Moving Forward.The Cloudfoam Midsole Offers A Holistic Comfort Experience From Step-In To Stride. Designed With Extra Cushioning For An Ultra-Soft Step, It Supports You On Your Running Journey.The Breathable Mesh Upper Adapts To Your Foot, Providing Support While Keeping You Feeling Dry During Your Run. With A Full-Length Rubber Outsole, You Can Trust In Reliable Grip And Stability On Varied Surfaces.The Adidas Brand Name Is Synonymous With Quality, And These Shoes Are No Exception. Whether You're Running A Marathon Or Enjoying A Leisurely Jog, These Shoes Are Built To Support Your Active Lifestyle.

reviews.review_description:
Good running shoes for beginners. Good cushion, quality, stable, and good price.

I ran 11 km with this shoes. No pain of knee. It worht to buy it. Wonderful!
Great Value. true to size, very comfortable. Good quality. fashionable.

reviews.review_title: Good pair of athletic shoes for the price
reviews.review_description:
I will start off by saying that I'm not a runner. I do go to the gym a lot, and one of the things I do there is the step mill machine (stairclimber) and the treadmill. I also do a lot of walking (10k steps) in my neighborhood from time to time. I got these shoes for that purpose.

While I don't mind paying good $$$ for a decent pair of shoes, the last pair of shoes I paid good $$$ didn't last all that long. In fact, its outer sole was equally as thin as those on the cheaper shoes. With that said, this time around I was a little more budget conscious, and wanted the best quality shoe for the price.

I found these here, and after reading the product description and some online reviews, I decided to try them.

The shoe fit is true to size. It wasn't too tight or too loose, even with thick socks on. The insole was comfortable and even after an hour of walking around doing everyday stuff, my feet felt pretty good. The insoles felt good and comfortable, although I have plantar fasciitis so I will wait and see how that goes after a longer period of wearing. The outer sole is rubber and felt firm and grippy.

This shoe adds about an inch to inch and a quarter of height to my frame. My other shoes were somewhere in the order of half an inch to three quarters of an inch. The top part of the shoe is a mesh like fabric cloth, and allows for some breathability on a hot day. The overall quality of the shoe is pretty decent, and I detect no flaws in the craftsmanship.

I am pleased with the shoe upon my initial experiences. Time will tell how the shoe holds up. But in the meantime, I am happy with it. For what I paid ($42), this is a pretty decent pair of athletic shoes. I can't speak to its performance for running, but for my intended use in the gym, this shoe fits the bill quite well without breaking the bank.

Read more
Great fitting running shoe that is lightweight and very comfortable, makes going the extra mile much easier!

reviews.review_title: Great Shoes… Just Not the Color I Thought I Ordered
reviews.review_description:
These shoes are comfortable, stylish, and honestly better‑made than I expected — but let’s talk about the color. The listing said dark gray, but when I opened the box, my first thought was, “Ah yes… the rare and majestic Lavender Gray, found only in nature and certain 90s windbreakers.”

Don’t get me wrong, they look good. They just look good in a soft‑purple‑ish, lavender‑leaning, gray‑adjacent kind of way. If you’re expecting a storm‑cloud gray, you might be surprised. If you’re cool with a little unexpected flair, these will treat you right.

Comfort? Solid. Style? On point. Color accuracy? Let’s just say the shoes and the product description are living in slightly different realities.

Still keeping them — because apparently I’m now a lavender‑shoe guy, and honestly, I’m not mad about it.
True to size. Very comfortable. Great array of colors Son loves them (the blue). Fantastic price. Buy with confidence.

Husband says these are excellent shoes and highly recommend these. Best ones he has ever had. Very stable and feel excellent on the feet, especially standing and walking all day at work. So far, very durable.

reviews.review_title: Super comfortable and true to size
reviews.review_description: Ordered these for my son and he loves them! He says they are very comfortable and they are true to size. Would definitely order again.

title: Skechers Women's Arcade Meet Ya There Sneaker

reviews.review_description: The first thing you should know is that I had to go down a full size before these would fit. I normally wear a 9W but had to go down to 8W. Great shoe. Lightweight. Flexible. I bought the white and it will be a great shoe for substitute teaching. I like the slip on option and how it also comes with other laces if you prefer to lace it up. Elastic under the tongue to make it truly slip on. No slip sole. Great for someone with fibromyalgia and flat feet that has to be on her feet all day.

These shoes are SOOOO comfy! Have good arch support. Easy to slip on but without little peds on, the tongue gets pushed forward and you just have to pull it back out but sooo not a big deal. They are very cute on. I can’t wait to wear them in our up coming cruise!! True to size and love the olive green. I might have to get another pair just incase they stop making them because when they wear out I am going to want another pair 👍. Also the quality is really good as well. If you like the style then you’ll love these.

My normal size is 7.5, after reading the reviews I went for 6.5. They fit great without socks. If I wanted to wear socks I’d be happier with a 7. They’re cute and comfortable. Toe is a little more narrow than I’m used to but not uncomfortable, especially once I break them in.
Love these shoes! Very comfortable. I normally wear a size 8 but they were too big. I sent them back and went down 1/2 size to a 7.5 and they fit perfectly!

These shoes are way too big for what they're listed. I am normally in a women's 11 so I ordered that. Way too big!!! Army back for a women's 10 still way too big!! I'm probably like a 9- 9.5. This is not accurate. They are super cozy on the sole, nice wide toe box. But still disappointing I'll have to send them back twice.

I am not a small woman. 5’9” and 150lbs looks slim, but my poor feet have taken a beating over the years between the military, waitressing, pregnancies, you name it. These are the first shoes I’ve ever put on that don’t squish my toes (wide toe box!) support my poor falling arches, (REAL arch support!) and don’t make my feet look like bulbous misshapen potatoes. (Cute!). I ordered a second pair in black for work, (I average between 3-5 miles a day in walking carrying up to 40 lbs) and my feet aren’t killing me when I get home anymore. I’m finally able to get home from work and doing something more with my life than soak my feet and cry on the couch.

When I first bought these I bought a size 10 because my feet have grown since having kids and that’s what size my Nikes I had just bought were. Turns out these run slightly big, so I sent them back and ordered a 9.5. They fit perfectly and I love these shoes! They are extremely comfortable and absolutely adorable! I plan on buying another pair before I may not be able to find them anymore.

This is a good shoe so it gets 4 stars. Minus a star because it lists upper as canvas, but it's really a mix of canvas and rubber. That combo makes them look sportier than I want, and also makes them stiffer and heavier than than I want.

That said it's a well constructed shoe and as such, guessing it will hold up well. I walked out of it a bit like I do Sketcher slip-on shoes (I don't even try them any more). But I was pleasantly surprised to see that each pair came with a pair of full-length laces. Although I didn't unpack the laces, I'm certain they will help keep them on better, and might make them visibly less sporty. But not enough to keep them. The extra stitching meets the canvas upper adds extra seams inside the shoe that rub the sides of my feet. I ordered a 7.5M and 8M. Both felt the same in length on my foot. The 7.5 arch was in a better place, but the toe box was tighter. Considered a 7.5W, but a) about $40 more and they will still be just as heavy with extra seams on the inside. If you don't have "princess and the pea" feet like mine, I still give them 4 stars for good arch support and potential durability. Two more pair will be in stock soon :)

title: PUMA Women's Tazon 6 Sneaker | Cross Training Shoes
description:
A sleek, streamlined silhouette sets the PUMA tazon 6 shoe apart from the rest. This stylish sneaker sports a synthetic leather upper with midfoot saddle for maximum fit and comfort while eva in the heel absorb impact.

PUMA is the global athletic brand that successfully fuses influences from sport, lifestyle and fashion. PUMA's unique industry perspective delivers the unexpected in sport-lifestyle footwear, apparel and accessories, through technical innovation and revolutionary design.

reviews.review_description: A little tight. I had to use a blow dryer on it. Made my big toe hurt it was tight. Good for if you a busy individual and on your feet. Puma still has great quality. Good for people who goes walking or active.
Amazing feels great on my feet

reviews.review_title: A great cross training shoe especially for those who want stability
reviews.review_description:
This is my first purchase of Puma shoes, and I love them. I am 5'6" tall, 135 lbs, and i exercise every day for about an hour doing a mix of aerobics and cross training. I wear an 8.5 women's size and while I am a medium width my feet are just short of a wide. These were true to size and roomy in the toe box which is important.

If you haven't used cross trainers like these they might feel a bit odd at the beginning. The platform is very stable almost as if you can't roll your foot from side to side. But that is a huge benefit if like me your feet roll outward while walking. It's also a big benefit for cross training classes during which you make sudden side to side movements. These keep you firmly planted on the floor.

They look like they would be very heavy, but they are the exact opposite. They are very light but well constructed. On your feet you either love the look or you don't. They make my feet look large especially in width but it doesn't bother me a bit. The comfort is worth it. I tend to wear running tights which accentuates how wide they appear. If you are wearing yoga pants that won't bother you.

I wish they came in a wider variety of colors but again - the comfort is worth it.

I have not used these outdoors and don't plan to so i can't speak to that. I wear them in the gym for classes like HIIT, boxing and boot camp. And I have also used them on the treadmill, cross trainer and the elliptical. Overall i am very happy with them and will buy them again.

Read more

reviews.review_title: Love them but run to small
reviews.review_description: Love the look but they run small!
Amazing quality and price was so reasonable, so lightweight
I ordered wrong size. Apparently when you gain weight, your fat foot needs a bigger size! Excellent shoe!

These are just ok. They have the clunkiness of cleats with the support of being barefoot. In other words, Puma has managed to get the worst of both worlds and put them into one shoe! The only nice thing I can say is that the soles are smoother than regular cross trainers, which makes switching directions and pivoting a lot easier on my knees during Zumba class! Overall, I’d say don’t waste your money!
Fits perfectly. Good price and quality. I would buy again.

title: New Balance Men's 480 V1 Sneakers
description: Inspired by the original BB680 – game-worn by the pros – New Balance recreated a timeless classic with a simple and clean look. On the 480, leather meets an Ortholite insert for all-over comfort and stability, all day long.

reviews.review_description: I really liked these New Balance 480. They have a classic black and white design that easily combines with different styles. They feel comfortable and have a good fit, in addition to looking good quality. I especially like that they are simple but with a sporty style that looks great for everyday life. For now, I am very satisfied with the purchase and I recommend them.

reviews.review_title: Perfect! Super comfortable and good quality! New Balance rocks!
reviews.review_description:
I’m an Adidas girl, so these are my first pair of New Balance shoes. I only bought them because the price was unbeatable, and I could tell they would fit my style perfectly.

They’re incredibly comfortable, provide great arch support, have plenty of traction for everyday wear, and are very well made. You can tell they’re made from high-quality materials, yet they’re not heavy at all. I feel so confident walking in them. They make me feel like I could step on almost anything without worrying, my feet feel protected, and the shoes feel sturdy and durable.

My feet measure 24 cm (heel to toe), and I usually wear a US women’s size 7.5, sometimes an 8. Since these are men’s sizing, I ordered a men’s size 6, and they fit perfectly! They’re not too long or too tight, just the perfect fit.

I’m extremely happy with this purchase and can’t recommend these shoes enough. I can definitely see myself buying more pairs of this model in the future!

This shoe is perfect! It is so comfortable and true to size. I’ve worn them two days and so far they offer the perfect amount of support. The sole is just the right thickness. So far they are comfortable with walking. This pair works for men or women.
Great style. I love em.

reviews.review_title: Stylish and comfortable, but consider sizing down
reviews.review_description:
I really liked the look and overall quality of these New Balance 480 sneakers. They have a classic design that goes well with casual outfits, and the materials feel durable and well made.

The shoes were comfortable right out of the box, with good support for everyday wear. The sole feels sturdy, and the overall construction seems high quality.

The main thing I would mention to other buyers is that they ran a little larger than expected for me. I ordered my usual size, but I felt I would have been more comfortable going down one size. If you are between sizes, you may want to consider sizing down.

Overall, these are great-looking sneakers with solid comfort and quality. I would definitely recommend them, especially if you pay close attention to sizing before ordering.
Son loves these shoes very comfortable and also is wide in the toe area for his toes definitely going to be getting more pairs

reviews.review_title: The picture doesn't do it justice because these are gorgeous in person.
reviews.review_description: These are sharp as hell. The red pops and looks better than the picture. They are true fit to size. Love them.
It looks used even I ordered new. Kinda dirty. But it's comfortable.

title: Skechers Women's Go Walk Flex Grand Entry

reviews.review_title: Good shoes that live up to expectations
reviews.review_description:
I've had these for about 6 weeks now and have worn them almost daily for varying lengths of time. I work from home, so for much of the day I am barefoot, but I wear shoes when going out in the yard, walking my dog, or going out places. So, I can't speak to how these would feel or wear if I were wearing them for an entire day or anything, but for my purposes, they are great! Super easy to slip on, as the name implies, and they fit perfectly. I wear a women's size 11 and that's the size I bought.

I will say that the first week or so my feet would be slightly achy after wearing these for longer walks (30-60 min) but that has gone away and I don't have any discomfort while wearing them or after wearing them. I like the color (I got the off white) and I think when my current pair of black tennis shoes bites the dust I'll probably replace them with these in black.
Very Comfortable to wear! Love the colors, and the size is perfect! Easy to wear, not heavy, and my feet aren't hot when I wear them. Very durable. Glad I purchased them!
Fantastic shoes and slip ins! I'm so spoiled now and need all my shoes to be slip ins. These are true to size, fit great, look great AND SLIP IN!!

I love these shoes! They have been comfortable from the first time I wore them. They slip on easily, stay on, and support my feet well for walking without becoming sore. I have washed them a couple of times (about once a month) as directed by manufacturer in cold water & let them air dry; haven't noticed any issues with washing. I've put a lot of miles on them, & the outer sole shows hardly any wear. My only issue is that after 3 months I noticed the interior where my toes rest is starting to break down. I really wanted to wear these without insoles because those interfere with the easy slip on feature, but I finally added insoles to prevent further breakdown. I still love the shoes, but can't give 5 stars because of that. I recommend if you get these shoes that you add insoles from the beginning to get the most life out of them.

reviews.review_title: Every busy person needs these shoes
reviews.review_description:
These Skechers Hands Free Slip-ins have earned a permanent spot by my front hall tree. I can literally step right into them with my hands full—whether I’m carrying groceries, laundry, or trying to get out the door with a dozen other things. No bending over, no tugging on the heel, and no crushed backs.

They’re incredibly comfortable right out of the box, with plenty of cushioning for walking and running errands. They are like walking barefoot on a cloud. They fit securely once they’re on, but still slip on effortlessly every single time.

I didn’t think “hands-free” would make that much of a difference, but now I catch myself wearing these every day. They’ve made life just a little easier, and sometimes it’s the little things that make the biggest difference. If you’re on the fence, buy them—you’ll wonder how you ever lived without them! 👟⭐

reviews.review_title: Slip on and off tennis shoes
reviews.review_description:
I bought these as a Christmas gift for my mother-in-law because they looked lightweight, comfortable, and easy to wear. I especially loved that they are slip-on shoes, so she can easily slide her feet in and out without having to bend down and struggle with putting them on.

For someone in her 60s, the convenience factor is huge. She loved them so much that she actually asked us to buy her a second pair in another color!

They are comfortable, practical, and stylish, and they’ve become one of her favorite pairs of shoes. I’m so impressed with how much she loves them that I’m even considering buying a pair for myself.

Great purchase and I would definitely recommend these!
These shoes are amazingly comfortable and require no break-in. I like them so much. I bought another pair in White.

These feel like slippers! I was uncertain bc of its slip on feature as a sneaker. But I am pleasantly surprised. They are comfortable, and I can wear them all day.

I’ll probably get it in another color

title: Under Armour Men's Charged Assert 10 Shoes | Road Running Shoes

Lightweight, breathable mesh upper with synthetic overlays for added durability & support. EVA sockliner provides soft, step-in comfort. Charged Cushioning® midsole uses compression molded foam for ultimate responsiveness & durability. Solid rubber outsole covers high impact zones for greater durability with less weight. Offset: 10mm. Weight: 9.5 oz.. Lace type: Standard tie. NEUTRAL: For runners who need flexibility, cushioning & versatility".
