reviews.review_title: Nice sneakers at a great price.
reviews.review_description: Good looking sneakers and seems well made. Durability remains to be seen since it has not been worn yet on daily basis. Insole cushion is slightly firm compared to some other brands. Ordered X- wide width because wide was not available in my size and color which ended up being a perfect fit.

Bought for my 15yr old. These are fantastic, he's hard on shoes and we purchase under armour for our teens because they are so rough and break down shoes quick. These survive the creek, beach, long walks and fishing. They fit wonderful for wider feet and easy to tie strings. Good sole support and the base is great for lots of walking. This is a Disney, long day of walking traveling and playing hard shoes. Versitle with any outfit as well.

reviews.review_title: Breathable, great fit and so light!
reviews.review_description: I’ve been buying another brand for years. The price went way up this year so I shopped around and found these, almost half the price much lighter. The fit is perfect. They are vented and are so comfortable.so far it’s a win for me. I love these shoes

reviews.review_title: Size up half a size but good shoes
reviews.review_description: Listen to the reviews that say these run small. I ordered a size 12, am normally 12, and they are a little tight around the toe area. I'm used to a tiny bit more room up there, but it's not uncomfortable. Once tied I can slip them on and off easily, and for longer walks they seem pretty comfortable and supporting.

I wear size 9.5 wide. There a perfect fit. I'm very active on the court. Constantly planting my feet. There's enough room in the toe box. Where my feet can move from side to side. There comfortable and I can play for hours in them. Like the looks of them. For the price there worth it. I've only had them for a couple weeks now. I can't comment on durability yet. Even if they only last me 4/5 months. I'll be happy to buy another pair. I was previously spending over 100 on shoes. That last 3/4 months. I got these for 55 on sale.

reviews.reviewer_name: Hook Me Up Amazon - I’m Ready to Help Others
reviews.review_description: Great sneaker that is very suitable if you’re on your feet all day walking or running like me. They look good, has a nice tighter fit with a sturdy sole to help my low arches. Good in the water, they dry fast. Im on my feet all day and they still feel comfortable at the end. Very versatile whether you walk all day, do some running or climbing. They fo it all. The sole is good and protects my feet walking all day. They really helps me.

reviews.review_title: Amazing Shoes! Go a size up though.
reviews.review_description: First off, the shoes feel VERY light compared to my regular shoes which is a bonus for me. I only use these shoes for walking/jogging/sprinting and they feel great for all of them. Second, go about half a size up from your regulars as they fit a little tight. Nevertheless, got these on sale and they look and feel great! Worth the purchase.

reviews.review_title: Shoe Strings are a little short
reviews.review_description: On sale with the discount- 5 stars, without the discount 4 stars. They're a decent shoe that stretches to wider feet and the tread is decent. Arch support is pretty good and they're lightweight. The one definite complaint is the shoestrings are too short to double knot them so they don't come untied during the day. They're comfortable enough. I'll be happy if they last for one summer's use.

title: Project Cloud Mary Jane Shoes, Comfortable Fashion Sneakers for Women

reviews.review_title: The cutest twist to a sneaker!!
reviews.review_description:
Very happy I got these! Padded inserts are so comfortable for long wear - wore them to countless events walking miles with 0 discomfort!

Fit true to size.

The red color is perfect, and they still look brand new.

They are a great way to make athletic wear a little more fun!

reviews.review_title: Cute casual wear option True to size.
reviews.review_description: These are very cute and I like that they are leather and not PU. The inside feels like a neoprene synthethic fabric and the bottoms are smooth like vinyl. There is no loop closure, but a strap with velcro. It seems to hold well. I am a size 6, (size 36) pretty consistently. I tried both the 5.5 and 6 and the 6 felt best. They have a thin layer of memory foam on the insole, limited padding, and almost no arch support so they will not be something that I will wear for long days or long walks. But they are a great casual addition. I should note that I also ordered a similar pair by Lucky Step that seemed great with a bit more padding, but their size 6 is a 37 and was about 1/2 size too big, with no smaller option.
These shoes are adorable! Super comfortable. Well made. Quality material. I usually wear a seven and need to size down half a size. They fit loose at the heel.

These shoes are SO cute, but also seem massive? I ordered my normal size, and they fit length-wise, but the shoe just seems so big/wide. I thought they would be more of a streamlined, low profile sneaker, but they ended up looking huge on my foot. I did not wear them past trying them on due to the size/look, so can't speak to their comfort.

Extremely comfortable, and a nice wide toe. Been wearing these for 2 weeks averaging 10000 steps a day and they are holding up great! Pretty cute - could do with a little more arch support but an insert can fix that.

I did have to run a lighter around the seams to burn off some stray threads, and I also used a suede protectant spray on them. (They were really squeaky on the inside without socks before I sprayed them, but the spray fixed that) They are exactly as pictured! A deal of a shoe I'm going to get another color while they are still cheap.

4 stars for sizing.

I wear a size 8. I ordered a size 8. These shoes are so small I could barely even get my foot inside.

I love how they look & how cushy they are & I will re-order in a size 9.
love them stylish and comfy fit my wide feet fine I went with my normal size

reviews.reviewer_name: Jesus Christ is the only way to God! Amen
reviews.review_title: Cute style, comfortable, accurate size but could be gone half a size bigger for more comfort.
reviews.review_description: I’m normally a 6.5 and that is what I ordered. They fit exactly my size but if i wanted a little more room i could’ve gone for 7. I feel my toes pinch a little from time to time but they are still pretty comfortable & cute style!

title: Reebok Princess Sneakers for Women, Comfortable Walking or Tennis Womens Shoes
description: Step into timeless simplicity with the Reebok Princess sneakers, the iconic pair that blends clean design with unbeatable comfort. Built for those who appreciate effortless style, these tennis sneakers feature a smooth synthetic leather upper that’s soft, supportive, and easy to keep looking fresh. Inspired by Reebok’s roots in fitness culture, these sneakers bring a touch of retro aerobics heritage to your everyday wardrobe, offering supportive cushioning perfect for light workouts or active days on the go. The low-cut profile offers a sleek silhouette and full freedom of movement, while the EVA midsole with built in arch support delivers lightweight cushioning that keeps every step feeling soft. Inside, a plush terry lining absorbs moisture and enhances comfort, making these an ideal choice for all-day wear. Whether you're dressing up your casual look or adding a retro edge to your everyday outfit, the Reebok Princess provides that signature minimalist charm that never goes out of style. Available in red, black, navy blue, pink, or white womens sneakers size 5-12 in medium and wide widths.

reviews.review_description: they are comfortable light weight i brought them for my daughter and she love them they fits great look exactly has as the photo they are her new school shoes

Thank you to all the other reviews who already advised to size up!

I am a us women’s 5.5 exactly and in brands that only have whole sizes I always go down to a 5. However, I listened to the reviews and purchased a women’s size 6 in this shoe and it was barely big enough! I could have probably fit a 6.5 in this shoe but the 6 WILL work.

It is also true that this shoe is narrow and the toe box is especially small. I do not have wide feet for their length (very average), so it is working out, but if you do have wide feet this is not the shoe for you unfortunately. I imagine people with narrow feet would be even more comfortable in this shoe than I am.

That being said, I am very pleased with this shoe especially for the price at purchase ($49.95). It looks very cute on and will pair with everything. The gold detail on the branding really sets them off and I feel the gum color sole gives them an excellent aesthetic dimension.

They feel like they will become more comfortable after I have broken them in, after a week or two. Due to the narrowness, it did take some adjusting/work before they fit correctly over the bridge of my foot. They are a lightweight shoe, so I cannot be sure how long they will last with the materials used.

Overall, size up and I do recommend this shoe!

Read more

I’ve been wearing these Reebok sneakers for a few days now, and I’m really happy with them. They fit true to size and were comfortable right out of the box. The clean white design goes well with shorts, jeans, and casual outfits, making them very versatile.

They feel lightweight, provide good support for everyday walking, and are easy to keep clean. The quality is excellent for the price, and they look exactly like the photos. I would definitely buy another pair in the future and recommend them to anyone looking for comfortable, classic white sneakers.

Very cute

Very comfy

Also, I have high arches. Like if I wear flat shoes I will be in absolute pain within an hour or so. I usually dont mind sneakers because they usually offer enough support. These do not. Period. They dont. I had to put soles in them because after walking just for about an hour - in my house mind you because i wanted to break them in before walkimg all day at disney in nee shoes - my arches starting hurting. If you are going to put soles, or honestly just in general, go up about a half size. I would have been much happier with a size 9 rather than my usualy 8.5 but imma keep and wear these anyways because all in all they fit, they are cute, and they are comfy for the most part .

Update: after walking around my hoise for several hours, my arches are killing me. Ill return ans get a probably get half a size up

Read more
Very comfortable! I would suggest going up a size if you have bunions or other issues. I like these shoes because they are very lightweight and comfortable.

These are the best shoes I've ever owned! I put them on, stood up and I actually had to double check that they were still on.

They cradle my feet with the inner cushion and the fit, for me, is perfect! No odd squeezing in my heel like other shoes have done. I have standard feet, size 8and a half to 9 depending on the brand. Not wide, not narrow. Plenty of room for my toes without being too much. The right amount of comfortable space. I bought size 9.

My feet also could "breathe" they did not feel hot and gross and I'm wearing socks. I only just got them so I have yet to know how durable they will be, I'm sure they'll last a long time, I examined them and they look like really good quality (I'm no expert but I know what to look for). I wore them outside and still had to check they were on, very comfortable and stable. No uneven weight shifting or feeling the ground through the soles, as poorly made shoes can have this problem. I'm so happy! I bought these in black since black goes with everything and dirt won't show like it does on white shoes.

Unfortunately the Princess Reboks are now made of plastic. I had the original ones made of soft leather that lasted forever, were breathable and conformed to your foot. They were the most comfortable sneakers I ever owned. I suppose if you're Vegan and didn't like canvas shoes, these would be a good choice. But I find that fake leather shoes are hot, stiff and don't hold up well. I'm disappointed.
Just had let people know how comfortable these shoes are it feels like walking on air not tight I give them 5 stars ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

title: Skechers Women's Arch Fit Arcade Arcata

reviews.review_description:
I love the Skechers I purchased from Amazon.com. It is light, well made, stylish with just right arch fit support. I am so pleased by its quality and nice design. The only thing is that it runs a little bigger. I wear size 6 but ordered 5-1/2. It fits perfectly.

Strongly recommended. Good job!

I have had a hard time finding shoes I can stand in all day, and though I do not struggle with foot pain, my hips and knees are arthritic. Most shoes to alleviate pain include wide widths (I have narrow feet) and correct pronation (I supinate). These have light to moderate arch support, which doesn't force my foot to the outside, and are roomy without being loose. I was able to slip them on without adjusting the laces. Though the ankle is too low to give support- the inserts are perfect for me. They control my stability in the right places- while still being cushiony and soft. I would not run or do anything high impact in these- but for walking and standing all day- they are efficient. Also- first pair of actually cute skechers I’ve ever owned.

reviews.review_title: Great everyday sneakers after stretching or wearing in
reviews.review_description: These shoes are very comfortable once they are broken in. The length was great and fit as expected, but they were a little narrow, so I wet them down and put them in my shoe stretcher for a few days and they are much more comfortable after. They are so cute that my best friend bought the same exact ones after seeing mine. Don’t mind the laces in the picture, I have a golden retriever who loves to chew the plastic ends off of all of our shoelaces.

reviews.review_title: Comfortable, cushioned, arch support, high quality
reviews.review_description: I love Sketchers and have these in several colors. The fit is great and they have proper cushioning and arch support and are well made. I have problems finding shoes that are comfortable enough for me to walk in, due to an ankle injury I suffered in an accident as a child, and I’ve lived in pain every day since. So you can trust me when I say a shoe is comfortable, and these are. And cute, too! These are worth every dollar.

I love these shoes! I love wearing sneakers with dresses at work. These are perfect for the job. They are true to size. I was looking for a 9.5, as the cheaper brands pinch my toes. After reading the reviews about running large, I got a size 9. They fit perfectly. Love how these sneakers came with a second pair of full length laces. I needed them because my heal slipped in these shoes when they weren't tied. So I guess I'll have to tie my shoes. I love the shoes arch support. I'll be able to walk my campus with ease. The fact that they are easy to clean is another bonus. They can be thrown in the washer and air dried. Finally, the overall material quality is excellent. Nice stitching and rubber sole. I plan to purchase another pair in a different color.

reviews.review_title: Actual comfy shoes with support, but definitely not good on wet concrete :p
reviews.review_description:
Initially ordered a size 6. I did an exchange for a 6.5Wide as it provides more wiggle room. I do not like very tight shoes. the 6 was way too tight for me. they are easy to slip on/off, the soles are thicker than what i prefer, but they are NOT platform style soles, so they should work fine, it is SUPPORT! (avid 25+ year Converse All Star wearer here). they seem to have excellent traction, i've only worn them out once (after i received my exchanged pair) and it was a comfy walk on dry sidewalk. the shoe quality seems to be good, i have noticed a few frayed threads sticking out, but honestly, i do not care. i dislike wearing shoes inside my home, especially on a top floor apartment (noise to neighbors, yes im nice and do everything to prevent heavy walking), but recently have an issue with tendonitis in one foot. OBVIOUSLY from my chucks and getting older and how i walk around at home lol, but listen, I wore these inside for a hour and hardly any noise, i felt floaty... normally I just slide around in socks. OVERALL: the wearability seems on point, I don't have any complaints yet. they are for work where I will be on concrete all day. I already know these will help. I can't really say HOW to choose your size, just do the research and buy a pair with the idea- you may have to exchange for a different size, and with that said- DO NOT LOSE THE TAGS (i removed mine from shoes but kept in great condition inside box for the return), DO NOT WALK OUTSIDE, KEEP EVERYTHING IN GOOD CONDITION- IN CASE- you have to do an exchange. They're worth the money, I honestly believe so and I don't like any shoe but converse all-stars. oh, and they send you an extra set of longer laces which i prefer. hope this helps anyone :)

**Update- I wore these to work in a bakery/coffee/cafe, where there is concrete flooring. And by the dish area and after mopping it is too wet for these. These have 0 protection on slip-resistant. They aren't stated to have it, but who knows, some say there is good traction on wet sidewalks, so thats a plus. I can no longer wear them at work, did it for 1 day and can't risk it. The other downside for me, they have memory foam which traps heat, living in Texas, this is a huge nono. I'm learning so much about shoes in the last week I could be a sales person. If you're looking for slip-resistant, breathable. No. I did size up to a Wide which I thought would help, but these shoes are too tight for my preference. That said- they form to your foot, if you like that. They ARE comfortable, but just not what I'm looking for. I'm bummed because cute and cozy, but my work demands a different type of shoe.

Read more

reviews.review_title: Cute for hyper-flexible feet that need support!
reviews.review_description:
I love these! I over-pronate, so I'm always on the hunt for a supportive but cute shoe. I get compliments on these every time I wear them, AND they're super comfy for my hyper-flexible feet and ankles. Bonus points for being able slip them on and off without using my hands. I bought these when I was freshly postpartum and not having to bend over or need my hands was a *life saver*.

Love love love. 11/10

reviews.review_title: Great arch support and cute look!
reviews.review_description: These sneakers are perfect for me. The design is very cute and at the same time is very comfortable, roomy enough for my toes to move. Great arch support and cushioning. I suffer from arthritis and it is very hard to find comfortable fashionable looking shoes, these are both! The material is breathable and the look of the canvas is incomparable.

title: Skechers Men's Go Run Consistent 2.0 Sneaker
description: Elevate your running experience with the GO RUN Consistent 2.0 running shoes for men. These performance-driven sneakers feature an athletic mesh upper with leather overlays for enhanced support and durability. The responsive ULTRA LIGHT cushioning and Air-Cooled Goga Mat insole deliver exceptional comfort for your daily runs. With M-Strike technology for efficient stride transitions and a flexible traction outsole, these running shoes for men provide the perfect blend of comfort and performance.

reviews.review_description: I just got these sneakers today and I have to say that I really like them. I ordered size 10 and the fit is right on. They feel pretty good. The shipping took a while, but it was worth it

reviews.review_title: Great Skechers shoes at a great Price Point
reviews.review_description:
Let’s start with the name brand first

Skechers they consistently deliver a Quality Product. I have 3 of their shoes at the moment

And they all fit well long lasting and comfortable. The shoe here is just as expected

Has a great look the price was fantastic. The shoe is light and comfortable even after all day wear You are not tired from them

Very happy with the purchase and I do recommend them when they are available . I like to add that I have worn them three times each time was for over a six hour usage, They are great and they are light to wear for extended times. Amazing I found these on line and never left my home.

Free shipping is always a welcome too

Thanks Again

reviews.review_title: Great sneakers , a bday gift to a friend .
reviews.review_description: Is a gift to another friend for his bday . He is happy with it . He said is lightweight, fits perfect and so happy he can wear it with different outfits . Great colors . He said no more foot pain they’re soft , and fits perfect. He said now he got a good sneakers, and his durability gonna last longer than other brand he tried used long time ago . He said I recommend, the support real good . He feel I’m the air walking .
Never heard of go run but i do like Sketchers. Have to say there very nice shoes easy on my feet and broke in quickly.

reviews.review_title: Comfortable!! Wish the tread lasted longer
reviews.review_description: Super comfortable shoes. Used for walking and jogging. Look good and fit was true to size. Only gripe is the tread on the sole doesn't last too long. But, for the price I paid foe these, it's hard to complain too much.
Great shoes, very comfortable, great price.

reviews.review_title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Extremely Comfortable Right Out of the Box
reviews.review_description:
I’ve owned a lot of running and walking shoes over the years, and these Skechers GO RUN Consistent 2.0 sneakers are some of the most comfortable I’ve worn. The cushioning feels great without being too soft, and the Air-Cooled Goga Mat insole gives really solid support for long walks, workouts, or all-day wear. ([Ubuy Vietnam][1])

What surprised me most was how lightweight they feel while still providing good stability and traction. The mesh upper keeps my feet cool, and the fit was true to size for me. I also like that they look good enough to wear casually with jeans or athletic gear.

I’ve used them for walking, treadmill workouts, and everyday errands, and they’ve held up very well so far. Great value for the price, especially compared to more expensive athletic shoes.

Definitely recommend these if you want a comfortable everyday sneaker that can handle both workouts and daily use.
Good price and comfortable. I have to wear shoes almost at all times to provide relief to my feet and these do the job well. Fit my foot without any problems.

title: New Balance Women's 327
description: The New Balance Women's 327 Lifestyle Sneaker reimagines 1970s running style with a bold, modern shape. Inspired by New Balance heritage models, this women’s sneaker features a suede and nylon upper with an exaggerated fang design, a flared midsole, and an oversized N logo for retro-inspired style. A lugged outsole draws inspiration from the 355 trail running shoe, while the rubber heel wrap, retro nylon tongue, spliteyerow, and medial New Balance text branding add distinctive finishing details. The result is a trendy lifestyle sneaker made for everyday outfits with unmistakable vintage influence.

reviews.review_description: The shoes are incredibly cute!! The shoes are true size and really comfortable. I love the shoes so much that I will be buying another pair in a different color. They are worth every penny and this is now one of my favorite style on New balances!

Really great and cute sneaker! I love the color and they are super comfortable if you will be on your feet for a long time. They take a little getting used to, because the sneaker is not flat so I felt off balance the first few times that I wore it, but now they feel amazing! they are also very easy to clean - I just use a baby wipe on them every week or two and most of the dirt comes right off. I was nervous because they are a very light color but I already had them for 2 months and they are still pretty clean and in great condition.

I'm on my feet 8-12 hrs/day and originally bought a pair for work. Truly helped ease my back, hip, knee & foot pain... to the point that on my days off (wearing what I thought were comfy shoes) the increased pain was quite noticeable. So, I got this second pair.

The stability and comfort whether walking or standing long hours is great. I have narrow feet, ordered my usual size 9. Perfect, comfortable fit. Slip resistance is great. I was worried about the tread possibly peeling off the shoe since it wraps up the tie and heel but it seems secure so hopefully it won't be a problem. They seem very durable.

It's a great value for the money although I waited for a deal to purchase this second pair.

I ordered size 8, though I was a bit skeptical at first because I have a wide foot and I've heard these shoes is kind of narrow but with my surprised it fit well, and is very comfortable. I have been using it for work, errands, parks and the comfort is just superb. I move a lot in my line of work and never slip. The arch support is just perfect for a whole day walking back and forth. The gum sole looks very classic and the thickness is just perfect for my height. I would definitely buy another pair of different color of course, I highly recommend.

reviews.review_title: Comfortable but with an odd design.
reviews.review_description: These shoes fit well, if anything maybe just a little large in the toe box but not a problem. I love the appearance of them in terms of materials used. The shape is a bit odd and I don't love that the rubber type bottoms come up to such a big V in the back. I can see that the picture accurately shows it but I guess I thought it was leaning the shoe up a bit so that we were seeing more of the bottom of the shoe and then up the back. I'm going to keep them because I have been looking to find good walking shoes that look attractive and are comfortable and it has been a journey. So for comfort I will give them a five.

These are true to size, lightweight, and incredibly cute. I get compliments every time I wear them. They pair effortlessly with everything, from shorts and jeans to maxi skirts and dresses. They’re comfortable enough for walking while adding a polished, elevated touch to any casual outfit.

reviews.review_title: Adorable and comfortable shoe. Discern the color you choose carefully
reviews.review_description: I bought these New Balances because I wanted a cute, stylish and functional pair of walking shoes. I love the style of these shoes. But I was disappointed in the color way. I thought they would be a bright white, instead they were rather creamy- more so than the photo indicated. I decided to return based on the colorway. I did end up buying the exact style New Balances from a different website in a pink gingham . The shoes are very comfortable for power walking. I never got any blisters. I did size up a half size. So far they seem durable. Nice arch support. They are expensive, so you are paying for the name and the look. I highly recommend this shoe, but I do not recommend this colorway.

I upsized bc I hate tight shoes of any kind. Comfy, cute style. Be mindful that the N is not sewn on like a patch it's just part of the nylon. That's prob why the price is so good but in the end that wasn't a deal breaker for me!

reviews.review_description: I LOVE LOVE LOVE these shoes! They are the perfect everyday shoe & fit TTS. I have had mine for about 2 months now & I haven't had any issues with durability. I am a size 11m. Perfect fit. I wear them everyday day to work and shopping

I would say they are definitely true to size. I ordered a 7.5 originally and exchanged for my size of a 7. I get nervous ordering and never know what size to get. Very cute. I am still trying to find the right socks to wear with them because they don’t go all the way around the ankle if that makes sense

reviews.review_title: The size is a little big
reviews.review_description: A stunning shoe, really beautiful and comfortable - I really liked it. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a delicate and elegant style, but still sneakers - the size was a little big. I would recommend taking one size down.
Love it !!! Sleek and office friendly!!
These shoes are seriously so comfy. I can wear them all day without any issues. Definitely a great buy for anyone looking for comfort. I'm so glad I got them. True to size. Highly recommend!
The shoes look great and the quality is good, but they ran quite large on me, so if you’re between sizes I’d recommend ordering the smaller one. That’s why I’m giving 3 stars

reviews.review_title: Read this if you are unsure which size to get!
reviews.review_description: I was looking for a pair of silver sneakers and found these on sale. They are cute and real leather so I thought that was a huge plus. A lot of reviews are saying that they run big and to order down. I paid attention to that and it was a huge mistake. I'm usually between a 7 and a 7.5 but in sneakers I lean more towards 7.5. I first ordered the 7 and they were way too small. They fit like a 6.5 and I know they are in fact a 6.5 because the box said EU 37 which always fits like a 6.5 (7 would be a 37.5 EU) so I ordered the 7.5 (which the box says 38 which is correct for EU sizing) and they fit perfectly! So If you are a 6.5, then go ahead and order the 7. If you are between a 7 and a 7.5 then order the 7.5 for a perfect fit. They do run a bit narrow so keep that in mind if you have very wide feet they might not work for you.

title: Skechers Girls' Microspec Swirl Sweet

reviews.review_description: I loved these shoes, they fit my daughter so well. Very coumfy

I absolutely love these sneakers! They’re lightweight, comfortable, and fit my daughter perfectly. The quality is excellent and my daughter is very happy i purchased these. My daughter says they’re very comfortable for running and playing, and they’re easy to put on and take off. I would definitely buy them again and highly recommend them to other parents!
Great shoes, my granddaughter says they are super comfortable. The colors are bright and shoe fits true to size.
Bought for 7 year old granddaughter for second grade. They were her first pick & she seems pleased with them. They’re cute, lightweight & easy for her to put on herself.

reviews.review_title: Comfortable shoes but wear out fast!
reviews.review_description: Skechers shoes are my child's favorite so far. Darker colors hide dirt well and dry so fast after washing. After 2 months of use every other day, they are getting wear out. I started wondering an energetic 7 years old is too old for Skechers shoes.
Fit great. Lasted 6 months. Worth the money. Granddaughter loved them said they were comfortable.

I normally wear a size 11 but purchased 11 wide since I will be wearing them on one of the the three days at Disneyland in a few weeks. I feel assured that I won't have any rubbing, uncomfortableness while at Disneyland. I ordered another pair in another color and am so happy with these shoes!

These shoes are comfortable for work! I work on my feet all day and my back pain/leg pain has improved since I bought these shoes. My only complaint is the run a little bit big and they are not non slip. They are nice shoes and seem durable so far!
So very comfortable it feels like you’re walking on air. That appeared true to size.

reviews.review_description: Very comfortable and cute in a retro kind of way! Have gotten so many compliments for the turquoise color. Liked them so much that I bought them also in black, navy, and off-white!

Just what I wanted and Reeboks hold up well and are always comfortable. I have been reordering (alternate styles, same size Reeboks) for 40 years!! Never a problem, always a plus! In my younger years I walked in my Reeboks about 40 miles a week and now less than that, but I have never had any foot problems with my Reeboks.

True to size and comfortable to walk in. Stitching etc looks great. They're not very cushy, but have a decent sole thickness that works for me. I added an arch insert as mine are collapsed and still have sufficient room left. I hope they last!

Love these! Super comfortable and supportive. I wore all through Greece with all types of outfits. Only complaint is the grip is not incredible on the sole, so don’t wear them if going anywhere slippery!

Cute, comfy and casual. Great to wear with shorts, or any athleisure outfit. I like how small and lightweight they are make them perfect for travel. Ive worn them for 12+ hours and they stayed comfy. TTS. Also bought them in green and pink.
Beautiful color. True to size. Can't beat Reebok's
Love them. Comfortable.

reviews.review_title: Fun, Stylish, & Comfortable for Everyday Wear
reviews.review_description: Fun and stylish, this retro style is a throwback to my favorite sneakers from the 1980s! I liked them so much, I purchased both green and black. These are perfect for wearing with a t-shirt and jeans or shorts and comfortable all day for everyday wear. I have a Haugland’s deformity (bony growth in my heel) and the backs are pliable and roomy enough for me—no heel pain. Indeed, the fit was true to size. Although they are comfortable enough for everyday wear, these are not supportive or cushioned enough for me to wear for sports, hiking, or long walks. The footbed is pretty minimal for a sneaker. The quality is topnotch, well stitched and durable. All in all, a fun stylish sneaker for everyday wear, but not suitable for sports.

title: Lee Men's Specter Retro Court Sneaker
description: Looking for a tried and true sneaker that will compliment your daily attire? Enter the Lee Men's Specter, a low-top sneaker that doesn't just fit your feet but your daily lifestyle as well. Lace a pair up and move freely with comfort and style.

reviews.review_title: The Perfect Blend of Old-School Cool and Modern Comfort
reviews.review_description: I’ve been looking for a pair of white sneakers that don’t cost $150 but also don't look "cheap." The Lee Specter Retro Court hits that sweet spot perfectly. They have that classic 80s/90s tennis vibe that goes with literally everything.The Highlights:Retro Aesthetics: These look fantastic with jeans, chinos, or even shorts. The silhouette is slim—not bulky—so they don't look like "dad shoes."Surprising Comfort: Usually, "fashion" sneakers have all the cushioning of a sidewalk. These actually have a decent footbed. I wore them for a full day of walking around the city and didn't end up with the usual heel pain.Build Quality: The synthetic leather feels durable and, more importantly, it's easy to clean. A quick wipe with a damp cloth and they look brand new again.The Price Point: For the quality you're getting, these feel like a steal compared to the big-name "Swoosh" or "Three-Stripe" brands.Sizing & Fit:I found these to be true to size. I wear a 10.5 in almost everything, and the 10.5 here fit perfectly. They are a bit stiff for the first hour or two, but once the material breaks in, they flex nicely with your foot.Pros & Cons:ProsConsTimeless, clean designMinimal arch support for flat feetEasy to wipe cleanCan get a bit warm in high summerGreat value for the moneyFinal Verdict:If you want a clean, minimalist sneaker that looks more expensive than it actually is, the Lee Specter is a no-brainer. It’s the ultimate "daily driver" for your wardrobe.

The shoes have an excellent design and look great when worn. They are quite durable, and the materials feel high-quality. The sizing is true to the manufacturer's guide. Without a doubt, a great purchase in terms of value for money.
Love these sneakers! Very comfortable and I am getting a lot of nice compliments. Well made and very durable. Thanks Amazon for getting them to me quickly.

I got the gray/dark gray/smoke combo in a size 8.5 for my son's birthday, and they were a huge hit! The fit was perfect right out of the box. He is very active and even wore them while riding his bike today, reporting that they are incredibly comfortable. Mm

title: New Balance Women's Fresh Foam Arishi V4
description: The New Balance Women's Fresh Foam Arishi v4 Running Shoe is a versatile athletic shoe built for all-day wear and everyday running. The soft Fresh Foam midsole cushioning is precision engineered to deliver a cushioned, lightweight ride, while the mesh upper and no-sew overlays help create a sleek fit and feel. Soft cushioning and neutral support make it comfortable for daily movement, and the durable rubber outsole adds dependable wear. Finished with a lace-up closure for a secure fit, the Fresh Foam Arishi v4 is a great women’s shoe for workouts, errands, and active days.

reviews.review_description: These sneakers are amazing, I have two other pairs I bought 4 years ago and could never find any like those since then. True to size and I wear 7 1/2, I'm so glad the tongue is seperate from the rest of the shoe then if my foot swells it's not too tight. The laces actually stay tied and are long enough also. Toe box is very roomy and comfortable and the color is just lovely (grey) which is light for summer and the rubber sole is off white. I should buy another pair because the price was so reasonable and the product was just like I had expected. Believe me this is a wonderful sneaker and will not disappoint, I'm 72 years old and I'm not picky except when it comes to my sneakers! Thank you New Balance

reviews.review_title: Buy Them! Very comfortable for pronated flat feet. Arishi V4
reviews.review_description:
First off, these New Balance Arishi V4, running shoes are very comfortable, do not drag when walking. They put a spring in my step.

One might say I have too many shoes. Maybe. But I like having variety and I'm always looking for comfort as well

I wear a size 12, I am 6 ft 1 250 lb and I frequent the gym 4+ plus days a week. I am lean but do like to do cardio. The feeling, sweating it out.

I was looking for a pair of comfortable shoes to walk around in. Just randomly browsing. I was looking for specific shoes to help with my arches, which I barely have. I have flat feet and my left ankle pronates. It's an injury from my skateboarding and boxing probably more than 20 years ago. I am not sure as one day I noticed my ankle was off. Maybe I am just made this way LOL. I wear a special insoles made custom. I have many other decent insoles, full and 3/4 length. It's not as bad as it seems, at least I say that lol. Came across these and the Asics gt-2000.

For the price that I paid for these, they were very worth it. They were on sale, I saw my size, and ordered them.

The shoes look very good in person, is good as in the item picture.

Weight - they are very light, I'm not getting too technical by weighing them, but as light as some of my lightest running shoes are.

Material - the material and style of the outside of the shoe is particularly interesting. I like the way it's got a fuzzy kind of soft material. The inside are very comfortable and support and comfort the foot.

Ride - The ride is smooth, good for heal strikes. Very good ankle support. These definitely are a 5 star shoe. Some weeks I can do about 20+ miles on the treadmill, mostly walking at an incline. So I need good shoes.

I also purchased the Asics GT-2000.

The New Balance Arishi V4 and the Asics GT-2000 are similar and different. The GT 2000s are a more of a serious running shoe, hold the heel in place better, are bouncy. They are meant and can't work for longer distances. That isn't to say the Arishi V4 isn't great in their own right. They do it 90% just as well for a fraction of the price.

So if you're looking for a running shoe or walking shoe, generally a decent shoe and you have flat or pronated feet, look no further. These are the shoes for you. I noticed they don't have many reviews, so trust me definitely worth trying. For the price I paid, < $30ish, I think they are better than other running shoes I've owned. The tech must be getting better, new innovations. I can go on and on. These are great shoes.

Read more

These shoes were comfortable right out of the box. They are very lightweight with just the right amount of cushioning. I also love the style because they are not overly chunky. I ordered a half size bigger as I always do with athletic shoes so I can wear a thicker sock and they fit perfectly. You can't go wrong with these!

reviews.review_title: Good shoe for lots of steps!
reviews.review_description: The shoes are really comfortable!! I walked 15k steps and my feet don’t hurt much it’s very little pain. One issue is that it is a little small i’m usually a 5 but i ordered a 5.5 just in case and they do fit perfect. They are super light and very nice. Also another issue is that water can get in very easily but the shoes aren’t meant to be waterproof so i guess that’s not too bad. The quality is really good for a $55 dollar shoe. Overall would recommend these and would definitely purchase again!

These shoes arrived yesterday and the box was so light, I thought that it was missing a shoe. Today I wore these shoes for the first time and walked over 6000 steps, and my lower back never bothered me. If you want a good support shoes these are definitely the ones to buy.
The shoe overall was decent but the fit was a lot smaller than my other ones. I bought the same size I have in other colors and these fit so much smaller..not sure why.

These are CUTE! I would not buy them or wear them for serious running even though they're called running shoes, but for the price they're fine. I use them for HIIT classes and like them a lot. Tried them for lifting, but I really prefer a "barefoot" zero-drop shoe for that. But those are not cute and these really are. If you are used to a wide toe box or lots of toe space, order half size up. I would have but it wasn't available to arrive on time, so I went with my normal size and they do the job. Would not be sad about a tiny bit more space, but I am keeping them and loving them, mostly for the cuteness factor, tbph 😅

They fit well and are very light weight. I bought them for running and am disappointed that they are not very cushioned. I thought they would feel squishy with each step, like other running shoes, but they don't. We'll see how they do on a run. I'll probably keep them anyway because they look nice.

*Update*

I've worn them everyday since I got them. Very comfortable and cute. They weren't terrible for running either.

title: Reebok Swiftstrike Running Mens Shoes, Athletic Workout Gym Sneakers Men
description: Push your limits and stay comfortable all day in the Reebok Swiftstrike mens running shoes. Built for everyday wear and light training, this versatile shoe features a breathable mesh upper with supportive leather and synthetic hot melt overlays that lock in the midfoot without adding extra weight. The compression-molded EVA midsole provides responsive cushioning for smooth, comfortable strides, while the durable rubber outsole covers high-impact areas for reliable traction with minimal added weight. With its sleek, lightweight design, the Swiftstrike delivers comfort, stability, and performance wherever your day takes you. Whether you're casually walking around town, jogging on the treadmill in the gym, or running long-distance miles on the street or track, these mens athletic shoes deliver dependable comfort and versatility. Ideal as everyday trainers or mens tennis shoes for active lifestyles, these mens sneakers help ensure you make it to the finish line. Available in grey, white with navy blue, and all white or black running shoes in mens shoes size 7-16 in medium, wide and extra wide widths.

reviews.review_description:
I waited to write the review until I got to wear them for a full day, so here it is:

1.) They were a great value for the price.

2.) I got a 14 Wide and the fit is perfect.

3.) They are really comfortable and breathable, I was in them for 10 hours first time wearing them.

4.) Reebok is typically not my first choice of brands, I've owned numerous pairs over the years due to lack of availability of my size, but they just might be now.

Well made and comfortable. Fit as they should and have moderate arch support. Nice looking.

A personal nit is how they were laced up when they arrived (not an open box or returned product). Not sure there's a way to explain the form of lace up, but it is foreign (backwards) to a traditional lace up I've experienced for many years of buying shoes. It makes tying the shoes more difficult. So a simple and easy solution was to unlace the the shoes all the way and then flipping the form or style of lace up. Now much easier to cinch up and tie.

reviews.review_title: One Month In: Comfortable, Versatile, and Worth Every Penny
reviews.review_description: I've been wearing these shoes for about a month now, and I've been very pleased with them. They're comfortable whether I'm walking, jogging, or running, and they've held up well with regular use. They also have a clean, stylish look that pairs well with jeans or shorts, making them great for just about any casual or outdoor occasion. Overall, they're versatile, comfortable, and good-looking. I would definitely recommend them.
Dif not like the way the shoes came laced already. Otherwise I like them a lot.
Great shoe especially for the money. You won’t find a comfortable running shoe of this quality for this price.
Fits well. Used for indoor treadmill first and it’s lightly cushy. Good investment for a pair of shoes, if I do say so myself

This particular model is long and not true to size. I wear a 7 1/2 in all shoes and the fit of this Reebok was about 3/4 of an inch too long. If I size down, they would be too narrow for my foot. They they are well-made with adequate arch support, however. If not for the unusual length, I would keep them.

reviews.review_title: Great walking shoe in many sizes!
reviews.review_description: Bought these for my son who was looking for a walking shoe. He has a hard to find size (15!) and these were perfect. They are very comfortable and have held up.

title: Skechers Women's Bobs B Cute Sneaker

reviews.review_description: These sneakers are true to size. I'm usually a size 7 and 7 was a perfect fit. They are simple, yet cute and comfortable. They have short laces that aren't meant to be tied. They are easy to slide on and off, but the company includes regualr tie shoe laces in the box with each pair if you want to change them. The eyelets are copper colored and a small logo is embroidered in copper stitching. The upper is made of canvas. No arch support, but I prefer that. They match with many casual outfits,

reviews.review_title: My new favorite pair of shoes! These are a Must have! so comfortable for a regular casual sneaker
reviews.review_description: So cute and comfortable size fits well! Memory foam is wonderful feeling and is good for standing long periods of time! Sole feels firm and unmovable which is a big plus and these have great traction! Good foot support! And definitely worth the money my new favorite pair of shoes I’ll never leave the house without ❤️👌

I really love these for the summer! Not a lot of arch support but there is a little bit of a cushion sole. They are not as narrow as Keds which is nice. They are well made and have a roomy toe. I consistently wear a size women's 8 but I had to reorder these a full size down. I ended up with a size 7 as my perfect fit. They just run big but once you find your size you will love them. Will be super cute with summer skirts, dresses, shorts and leggings!

I ordered a 6.5 in the "Natural" color. The shoes are as I expected. The color I received was exactly what was pictured. I have really high arches, and I was looking for something that would be casual, comfortable, and wearable for walking around for a few hours while at ports of call on our cruise, and using during excursions.

These are a little large, which I like - I actually measure for a 5.5-6 and size up 1/2 for breathability and to account for swelling during exercise/heat. I just wish the tied off laces were a little smaller. It does come with standard laces, so those are an option.

The quality seems decent. I should be able to wear them in various situations. The soles have a bit of traction, so I should be able to walk in sandy or wet conditions without slipping.

The insole is memory foam, but not much of it. It's a very flat feeling. Once worn a couple of times it does reduce, but I don't know that it's enough.

Now for my big issue - there are elastic bands on either side that hold the tongue in place and hold the shoes on the feet. I am allergic to latex, so it's not ideal to have rubber in an area that could touch my skin. AI thought they were 100% canvas upper - so my fault for not confirming with the company. The bands make it so that, even though I ordered up a half size, I can't add additional arch support without making it too tight. Even with that, yes, I can and will wear socks to avoid the rubber because I really do like the shoes and I'm fortunate that my allergy is only contact related. These shoes may not work for my intended purpose, but they will work as normal casual shoes. I may even be able to wear them to work.

Read more

I've been wanting just a plain white sneaker. These fit the bill. Exactly what I wanted and very comfortable. Wore them traveling on and off planes over cobblestone walks etc. Held together and kept me on balance and comfortable. Best part threw them in the washer when we returned, air dried them and they look brand new. Great casual shoe

reviews.review_title: Very comfy even for picky feet
reviews.review_description: I have picky feet that do best with a wide toe box. These shoes don't offer that, so I ordered a wide width. That seemed to do the trick, as these are very comfortable all around. I normally wear a 7 or 7-1/2, and while 7W is a tad loose around the sides of the heels, it's not enough to be an issue. The shoes are super cute and will go great with dresses and skirts. I hope to buy a couple more in different colors.

reviews.review_title: So glad I could find these again.
reviews.review_description:
I LOVE this shoe. I have been looking for this shoe for years. I got it at sketchers forever ago, and then they NEVER had my size in stock. And when they changed the style of ALL of their shoes to the slip ins I had to accept I would never find this shoe again. I am so glad I was able to find this older style on Amazon. And at a great price! (I got the black and white one for only $25 on Amazon Prime Day!) Needless to say I am very excited to have this comfortable, easy to get on, stylish shoe back on my shoe rack!

They are very flat but that's exactly why I love them. I usually where these to go run errands since they are easy on and off and comfortable. I would say they are actually pretty durable and last quite awhile even with daily wear. Unfortunately the "memory foam" gets very stinky from lack of breathability. Which is why I usually wear them for more low key days.

Update:

Didn't realize I would need to share a review for different colors. I took some stars away because the white pair I ordered were... damaged? I don't know if that's what they would be considered. But the laces aren't meant to be used like laces. (See photo laces are tied off at the top) the white pair I got the laces were too long. And no, they don't need to be moved down, I tried. I am going to try to return them and get them replaced and will update my review once I get them back!

Read more

reviews.review_title: Great value and true to size
reviews.review_description: I love love love love these shoes! They are my second pair. They can be thrown into the washer and air dried. They are durable and comfortable. They are true to size, as most Skechers are.

title: Madden Girl Women's Navida
description: Striped with sporty fashion, the Navida sneakers from Madden Girl lace up a low-top silhouette on fresh platforms.

reviews.review_description:
These bubblegum-pink kicks are hands-down the cutest—and the comfiest—pair I’ve ever slipped on. The moment I stepped in, the ultra-soft, memory-foam footbed cradled every curve of my foot, making me feel like I was walking on clouds. The breathable knit upper gently hugs your foot without pinching, while the responsive foam midsole cushions each stride, whether you’re dashing to brunch or strolling around campus.

Despite their plush feel, they’re surprisingly lightweight and flexible. The textured outsole grips pavement and tile alike, so I’ve tackled errands, workouts, and weekend adventures without fear of slipping or leg fatigue. And the rich pink hue isn’t just pastel—it’s perfectly saturated, adding a cheerful pop to any outfit.

I’m already eyeing the same style in navy, mint, and even the seasonal lavender drop. Trust me, once you experience cloud-walking in these, you’ll want a pair for every mood and moment.

Pros

Memory-foam footbed cushions every step

Breathable knit upper hugs without rubbing

Lightweight, flexible design for all-day wear

Traction-ready outsole for stability on varied surfaces

Vibrant pink shade adds fun to any look

Cons

Knit material may collect lint if stored carelessly

Foam midsole shows wear after very intense running sessions

Styling & Next Steps

Pair with cropped jeans and a white tee for an effortless weekend vibe

Slip on with athleisure leggings and a hoodie for post-gym comfort

Opt for pastel socks to highlight the knit texture and color contrast

Rotate between colors—mint green and sky blue are perfect summer picks!

If you crave shoes that feel like a dream underfoot and look downright adorable, these pink cloud-walkers are a must. I’ll definitely be back for every shade in the collection!

Read more

reviews.review_title: Great deal for cute platform shoes!
reviews.review_description: Love these, bought them in red too and swapped out the laces! Very comfortable, very cute. I tried 9 and 9.5 and the 9 was a little cramped in the toe box for me, so you might want to size up.

I really like these. I have wide, flat feet with a high instep. With that said, I can’t wear a lot of sneakers comfortably for long periods of time. These, no problem. They are very comfortable and true to size. I’m a size 8.5. They are durable and provide sufficient arch support for me. They are not heavy as they appear. I ordered the green and one day experienced being caught in light rain. There was no bleeding in the color. I certainly plan to buy a few in other colors.

Runs a little narrow recommend 1/2 size up. Good cushion feels comfortable and functional for daily wear. Not too heavy. Nice even color. Platform sole so for obvious reasons do not expect flexibility. Value is good it’s the average cost for a fashionable sneaker at $40. Looks good with wide leg or barrel leg pants/jeans. Wore twice, so far no concerns with quality.

reviews.review_title: So cute but you can’t wear socks without causing blisters
reviews.review_description: I’m on the fence with these. They are really cute. They are a bit snug in width. I’m a size 7 and they fit fine other than narrow. Not too uncomfortable though and should stretch. No arch support if that’s what you need. The issue is, if I wear socks the back above your heel part lifts when your toe touches down when I walk. There’s just no flexibility in the sole because of the platform. Tightening the laces helped but I’m sure you would have to constantly do that and that’s annoying. And they still slipped a little. I tried lower socks and thinner socks and basically if the sock is between your skin and the shoe it will slip around. If you’re just standing around, adorable. If you actually want to walk around with socks, there’s gonna be a problem. I tried them without socks and they’re much better. I personally just prefer socks with sneakers, so I’m still debating keeping them.

Love the color and style of these shoes. I had to return the first pair I ordered and order a half size up and they fit perfectly. This is the second tennis shoe I have ordered of this brand name and I had to return both and order a larger size, so you may want to consider ordering a half size up. Good value as they were priced lower than many other options.

They are so cute. I love them with light jeans, I think they are darling with pastel summer dress. The other day I wore them with a tailored denim blouse and high waisted black slacks. So very cute and versatile.

I’ve ordered them in pink and red as well. I have them in the off-white as well. It’s so comfortable and I have really narrow feet so I like that as well

reviews.review_title: Good shoes, a little narrow and run a bit small.
reviews.review_description: Cute shoes, run a bit small. My daughter ordered an 8, but they fit more like a 7.5. So we sized up to an 8.5 and they fit perfectly. Nice material, bright color.

title: Reebok Rapid Strike KC Walking Mens Shoes, Comfortable Hook & Loop Training Sneakers for Men
description: Reebok creates men footwear that blends timeless style, everyday comfort, and performance-driven design. The Reebok Rapid Strike KC walking shoes for men are versatile mens athletic shoes built for all-day wear, stability, and effortless style. Designed with a durable leather and synthetic upper, they combine traditional styling with modern performance materials for everyday reliability. The mesh tongue enhances breathability, while the supportive construction delivers a secure fit through every step—making them ideal comfortable shoes for men who are always on the move. A cushioned EVA midsole provides lightweight comfort and impact absorption, helping reduce fatigue whether you're walking, commuting, or staying active throughout the day. The durable TPR outsole ensures dependable traction across a variety of surfaces, while the classic silhouette pairs easily with any look. Designed with inclusive sizing, these are also great wide shoes for men, offering a familiar, accommodating fit without sacrificing style or performance. The easy on, stay-put closure makes these shoes adjustable, and makes them ideal for elderly men who have difficulty tying laces, for adults with arthritis, or for anyone who loves the quickness and ease of a hook and loop closure! Available in white or black men's sneakers in size 7-16 in medium, wide and extra wide widths.

reviews.review_description: Its difficult to find my brother's shoe size and he hate to tie his strings these was a perfect purchase for him I was happy to gift them and he wears the everyday
sizes listed are corect. Shoes are very comfortable
Product as advertised, it has no arch support. Glad I bought the larger size 11 1/2 and extra wide, comfortable with my arch support insole inserts.
Nice looking shoe. Comfortable when you get the right fit,.
Fit was perfect.
Great shoes
Fits snug even though a extra wide, but still comfortable
These are without doubt the cheapest looking shoes I have ever bought. Really surprised how low quality these shoes are. As a bonus they’re not comfortable to wear. Would never buy again.

title: Project Cloud Fashion Platform Sneakers for Women Footwear 2026 (Nita)

reviews.review_description:
I bought these for my daughter for her birthday. She absolutely loves these shoes! They look even better in person than in the pictures. They look so cute on her. The design is stylish, versatile, and can wear them with basically everything. She said they are very comfortable, lightweight, and feel well-made. She loves the platform sole look and said they are comfortable to wear all day. I bought her the black and white stripe ones. Now she wants other colors. lol She did say her heel slips slightly up and down in them but it's not an issue for her since she like them so much.

She also said they are very easy to keep clean. The material looks suede, but they aren't. I’m very happy with my purchase and would definitely recommend them!

reviews.review_title: Best shoe for style and comfort
reviews.review_description:
I originally bought these sneakers for an upcoming vacation because I wanted something comfortable for walking that would also go with multiple outfits. After trying them on, I love them so much they’re staying in my regular rotation.

They are very comfortable right out of the box with a cushioned sole that makes them great for all-day wear. They feel supportive without being heavy, which is exactly what I was hoping for in a travel shoe.

The neutral color combination is also really versatile and easy to style. They look great with jeans, casual outfits, or even slightly more dressed-up looks, which makes them perfect for trips when you want to pack light.

Overall, these are a great everyday sneaker if you’re looking for something comfortable, stylish, and practical for walking or travel. True to size. I have them in another color that I have worn for 2 years and are still excellent, very durable, easy to clean.

Read more

I got these in white in my usual size 9, and they fit true to size. I wore them all 3 days at Coachella because they were incredibly comfortable and went with every outfit. I originally planned on wearing boots, but didn’t want to destroy them in the festival dust—so an “Amazon shoes for Coachella” search led me to these, and I’m so glad it did.

Not only are the white ones super cute (my favorite color option), but they also held up amazingly well. I walked around **50,000 steps** over the weekend, and my feet were still happy. The platform gave me a little extra height, which was actually great for seeing over the crowd. Part of the platform is coming apart from the shoe a little bit, but I’ll super glue it and rock them again!

Bonus: they got completely dusty and dirty over the weekend—which honestly made them look even better with my festival outfits. The real shocker was cleanup: I washed them when I got home, and **all the dirt came right off**. They looked good as new. I even noticed water beaded up on them at first, which makes me think they have some water resistance too.

Cute, comfortable, durable, and easy to clean—basically the perfect festival shoe.

reviews.review_title: Cute Shoes But They Run Tight!
reviews.review_description:
These shoes are really cute and very well made! I absolutely loved the overall style and found the sole to be incredibly comfortable. They are the perfect versatile shoe that would have gone with most of my casual outfits.

However, my main complaint is the sizing. Even though I ordered my regular size, the shoes were much too tight. I would definitely recommend sizing up if you plan on ordering these! Sadly, I had to return them due to the fit.

Bought these shoes for golfing. Wore them to the course and they were comfortable from the get go and lasted me all 18 holes. I have flat feet but I feel these were very supportive and didn’t have to be broken in. I’m a size 7 and they were a perfect fit. I plan on sharing these shoes with all my girlfriends!

reviews.review_title: Shoes fell apart in a week of walking
reviews.review_description:
First, I’ve never left a negative review before. Truly. I haven’t. I’m the kind of person that apologizes for things that aren’t my fault and then feels guilty. These were great when I tried them on. I saw the reviews saying the heel lifts. I ordered them. They do lift. I kept them anyway because I had a week-long trip to London and they seemed really comfy for walking. First issue, they get dirty EASILY. Yes. I know they’re white sneakers but they were filthy in just days of walking in the city, like the fabric was a dirt magnet. The other issue is they weren’t easy to wipe off, so I couldn’t just grab a damp cloth and clean them up at night.

Worst part is the durability. They are clearly not made out of durable materials. I got them and wore them for 8 days in London walking about 10 miles daily. A lot of steps, sure. But they’re shoes. I surely did not walk in them enough for them to fall apart. The bottom of the shoe was collapsing into the platform by day 7. My toes were sinking. What started off as “oh I’ll have to try to wash these when I get home”, turned into “I hope these last another 24 hours to get home”. I had to throw them out when I got home. It felt so wasteful and I was so annoyed. I paid money for these and liked the look of them, but they literally couldn’t hold up to walking. I didn’t even get to test their water resistance because it was dry and 60-70 degrees the whole time. So we can’t even say it was bc they were soggy etc. I purchased them because they were more affordable than others- I guess you get what you pay for

Read more

Super sad. I love these and they were VERY comfy. But by work day 10 (only 8 hours mostly at a desk) the foam under only my large toe in each shoe felt wrinkled. 2 days later it's completely collapsed and the inside of the shoe is tearing. I have not gotten these wet, dirty, or overused them..

reviews.review_title: Cute, comfortable, pretty true to size.
reviews.review_description: I own a boutique and saw these on a vendor/boutique owner I buy from and fell in love. I read the reviews and decided to try them. Reviews were mixed on sizing so I was unsure. I am a 9 1/2 and decided to go with the 10s and glad I did because the 9 would have been too small. Some say they are narrow in the toe area. I do not find this on me but I do not have a wide foot AND as I am a 9 1/2 that may be wide so I cannot attest more than that. They fit well for me being a 9 1/2. Some say there is slippage in the heel - there is. I do not attest that to my size 9 1/2 in a 10 shoe, I believe it is just the way the shoe is made. I do have an athletic sock on with them and there is still some slippage. I plan on something to prevent that. They are heavy as others have stated but not so much so to prevent me from wearing them. They have a very comfortable footbed and a non slip sole. I, personally, would not wear these on a long outing but they are fine for every day wear and are sooooooo stinking cute. I purchased the red pair. The stripes and laces are white but the soles are ivory/off white - if this bothers you. They look like suede and almost feel like suede but not quite. Overall for the price I was very surprised at the quality and the comfort. I plan on buying a pair in another color, possibly two, as I am on my feet all day in my boutique and wearing "regular" tennis shoes I do not look trendy. These will do the trick.

title: Skechers Girls' Microspec School Sweets
description: Step into style and comfort with these versatile tennis shoes designed for active lifestyles. These white sneakers feature a sparkle print mesh upper enhanced with Tuff-Tech overlay for durability. The adaptive closure system with stretch laces and adjustable strap ensures a perfect fit, while the shock-absorbing midsole and flexible traction outsole provide reliable support. Perfect girls shoes for everyday wear, these machine washable sneakers combine fashion with functionality.

reviews.review_description: My firstborn has been using this in school for a year and still looking great! So durable, comfortable for the kid and adorable design! I bought a second one for my middle child who’s starting school this year. I trust this product!

Great Buy! Looks expensive and has great cushion support! Looks good on my granddaughter! She loves them. Purchased a 13.5, because they are a little narrow at the top; she already has the 13 from my other purchase last year.
Fit great and are so cute!!!!

These shoes are well made and I love them. My daughter however does not. It’s a bit snug getting her foot in, but not as bothersome once it’s on. If your child has sensory issues and doesn’t like the squeeze, pass on these. She’s normally a size 10 and I purchased a 10.5.
My daughter loves them. Very durable and a great price for the quality. The size is as described and my daughters feet dont hurt after wearing them all day.
Excelente producto lo recomiendo 100%

reviews.reviewer_name: hola, compre este producto en septiembre y ya no funciona, simplemente dejo de funcionar
reviews.review_description: Comodos
Great fit and stylish. My Grand Niece really loves them. Great quality and love that there are no shoe laces but it looks like shoe laces

title: New Balance Women's 608 V5 Casual Comfort Cross Trainer
description: The New Balance 608 V5 is a proven favorite for men's cross training shoes that deliver comfort from morning to night. The ABZORB heel crash pad absorbs impact on every step, while a molded PU insert and relaxed fit last provide an underfoot feel that is hard to beat. The sturdy suede upper is supportive and breaks in nicely over time, and lightweight EVA foam with an internal midsole shank adds cushioning and midfoot stability. Dual density collar foam supports the ankle, and the Phantom Liner interior has minimal seaming to reduce irritation. Whether you are at the gym, on a walk, or on your feet all day at work, the 608 V5 keeps you comfortable.

reviews.review_description:
This is my third pair of New Balance 608 V5 trainers, and after trying a different color last time (pink), I'm happy to be back to the blue version. My previous blue pair lasted for two years and was incredibly comfortable. The pink pair wasn't quite the same- the leather felt stiffer and never really broke in as well- so I decided to return to what worked.

Based on an Amazon review mentioning that the toe box could run a bit narrow, I again ordered the wide width and I'm glad I did. The fit is excellent and feels almost custom-made for my feet.

As a woman in her 60s who is prone to foot pain if I walk too much, comfort and support are everything. These shoes, along with the insoles they come with, allow me to walk, hike, and stay active without the aches and pains I've experienced in other trainers. I've spent considerably more on athletic shoes over the years, but these are the pair I come back to.

They're comfortable right out of the box, supportive without feeling heavy, and priced surprisingly well for the quality. If you're looking for a dependable walking or everyday shoe, these have earned my recommendation time and time again.

This works great for my daughter who has weak ankles. She is always spraining her ankles while just walking and this helps with stabilization as many have said in the reviews! She likes the comfort and wears this daily. These do not give out like the hokas do. Recommend

I purchased the New Balance 608 V5 while it was on sale, mainly for weightlifting.

These shoes aren't the cutest, but they perform well where it matters most for strength training. The sole is firm and very stable, keeping my feet flat and securely planted on the floor during barbell squats. Unlike cushioned walking or running shoes that compress under weight, these provide a solid, stable base that makes me feel more secure when lifting.

Because of that firm construction, don't expect a soft or plush feel. The cushioning is noticeably less than what you'd find in walking or running shoes. The comfort is okay, but that's because the shoe prioritizes stability over softness. The arch support is also fairly minimal.

I personally wouldn't recommend these for running since the shoes are quite rigid. If most of your workouts involve walking, jogging, or other cardio, there are more comfortable options available. However, if your main focus is weightlifting or strength training and you want a stable platform for exercises like squats, these work very well.

The shoes fit true to size, and I had no issues with the fit.

**Pros**

* Good stability for barbell squats and strength training

* Firm sole keeps your feet flat and securely planted

* True to size

* Great value when purchased on sale

**Cons**

* Design is fairly plain and not particularly stylish

* Minimal cushioning compared to walking or running shoes

* Fairly minimal arch support

* Too rigid for running and may not be the best choice for cardio-focused workouts

Overall, I think the New Balance 608 V5 is a good choice for anyone looking for a versatile gym shoe with a stable, supportive base for lifting. Just don't expect the soft cushioning or flexibility of a dedicated walking or running shoe.

reviews.review_title: Still My Favorite Sneakers After 5 Years — So Comfortable and Built to Last

I bought my first pair of these New Balance 608s about five years ago, and they’re still going strong. I wear them for the gym, long walks, and everyday errands, and they’ve held up beautifully — supportive, cushioned, and never once gave me sore feet or knees. I finally decided to get a new pair to start breaking in, but I’ll be honest — I’m still happily wearing my older pair and probably won’t part with them anytime soon. The new ones feel just as sturdy and well‑made, with that same reliable support and soft cushioning that made me fall in love with them in the first place.

If you want a sneaker that’s comfortable right out of the box, holds up for years, and works for both walking and workouts, these are a fantastic choice. I’ve trusted them for half a decade, and they continue to be my go‑to.

New Balance is a favorite for many reasons. Two stars off for an obvious manufacturer defect that has not gone unnoticed: the toe box is definitely too narrow. I have narrow feet. I bought my normal 9.5 medium size and wear with very thin socks. The shoes are still noticeably snug, almost too tight. When other reviews mention this, pay attention and consider a buying a wide. reviews.review_title: Cute, Comfortable, and Supportive Shoe That Holds Up During 12-Hour Shift
reviews.review_description:
I absolutely love these shoes and find them so cute and comfortable. I bought these shoes for work 3 weeks ago and have worn them every shift since. I am an ER nurse who is constantly on her feet at work for 12 hours. This is actually the second pair of new Balance shoes I have bought. I was so impressed with the first and I wanted a different color. I normally wear about a 6.5 to 7 in women’s depending on the brand. I bought a size 7 in the slate gray metallic silver color. These shoes fit me well and are true to size. The toe area is roomy enough to allow me to spread my toes out some. They also leave enough room to accommodate thicker socks, or foot swelling during shifts. I do have arches in my feet and they feel well supported while wearing them. They feel lightweight on my feet during my entire shift and my feet never feel heavy.

When I first wore them they were a little stiff, but they never once hurt my feet. I was surprised because usually new shoes have to be broken in. Of course my feet do get tired since I worked 12 hour shifts, but they have never once hurt like they have with other shoes I have worn in the past.

The sole of the shoe is cushioned and has not compressed after use. I have never once slipped while wearing them on polished and tiled flooring, so they provide traction. The mesh on the side is breathable. They are a little harder to keep clean because of the fabric near the lace toe and heel. After three weeks of use, I have not noticed any loose stitching and they have held up very well. Additionally, there isn’t any noticeable wear to the outsole.

These shoes are good for casual wear, work, travel, and light exercise.

reviews.review_title: The Iconic, Bold Cologne Scent That Fills a Room
reviews.review_description:
If you’ve ever walked into a Yankee Candle store and smelled that specific, intoxicating scent wafting through the air, it was almost certainly Midsummer's Night. It is arguably one of their most recognizable and polarizing fragrances, but for those who love it, it's an absolute classic that's hard to beat.

​Scent Profile:

This candle is unapologetically bold. Yankee Candle describes it as "a intoxicating and masculine blend of musk, patchouli, sage and mahogany cologne." That description is spot-on. It strongly evokes the feeling of a high-end men’s cologne—cool, fresh, and slightly woodsy, but with a deep, sensual warmth from the patchouli and musk. It is not fruity, floral, or traditionally sweet. If you prefer clean linen or vanilla cupcake scents, this will likely be too strong for you. But if you love deep, "dark" scents that feel sophisticated, this delivers.

​Throw and Performance:

I tested this in the classic 22 oz large jar. The scent throw is phenomenal—a solid 10/10. Midsummer's Night is known for being a powerhouse. Within 30 to 60 minutes of lighting it, the fragrance easily fills my entire downstairs living area and kitchen. It lingers in the air long after the candle has been extinguished.

​Quality and Burn:

The burn quality is consistent with the standard Yankee Candle reputation. The wax pool melts evenly across the surface, preventing tunneling, provided you let it burn long enough on the first few uses. The two wicks burn cleanly (remember to trim them before each light to minimize soot). The longevity is excellent; the large jar provides many hours of strong fragrance, justifying the price point.

​The Vibe:

This is a fantastic year-round scent, though it particularly shines in the autumn and winter evenings due to its warm, musky notes. It creates a cozy, confident, and slightly mysterious atmosphere. It’s perfect for movie nights, dinner parties, or simply relaxing after work. Because it is so cologne-forward, some describe it as a "boyfriend's sweater" scent.

​Verdict:

Midsummer's Night is a classic for a reason. It is a bold, long-lasting, and powerfully scented candle that delivers exactly what it promises. If you are a fan of deep, musky, or cologne-style fragrances and want a candle that will unmistakably scent your entire home, this is a must-buy. Highly recommended.

​Pros:

​Iconic, sophisticated, "cologne" scent

​Phenomenal scent throw (fills large spaces easily)

​Long-lasting burn time (Large Jar)

​Creates a distinct, cozy atmosphere

​Cons:

​The scent is very strong and may be overpowering for those sensitive to heavy fragrances

reviews.review_title: Great candles, all arrived whole during transport
reviews.review_description:
Pleasant smell. Lasts a long time, due to size and to slow burn rate. They burn well, and the fire doesn't go out by itself, or get too strong or weak.

Not too much smoke. Eventually, as the candle burns down, the top of the glass container gets covered in black soot, affecting esthetics for some. Still, there's no risk of wax dripping, so they're clean.

No tunneling, but you do have to let it burn until all the wax is melted (no hard walls on the sides).

The glass feels strong and substantial. I haven't had issues with glass breaking during use or during transport. They're shipped to you in sturdy, thick, well-insulated packaging.

Since my area is prone to blackouts, I keep a lot of candles at hand. I also like them for smell and ambiance. I bought about 10 of these when they were on sale, and none arrived broken!

If you lay one on its side in warm weather (which happened to one of mine during transport), then the wax softens and pools sideways, and can make the wick inaccessible. What I did was set the candle upright in a pot of hot water (in such a way that the hot water touched the walls of the jar and would soften the wax, but without there being so much water that it poured inside the jar). That reset the wax and revealed the wick. Problem solved.

Amusingly enough, Amazon wants me to review this candle's "taste"! I can't speak to that!
